## 2. Font

One family only: **Noto Sans** (Google Fonts, https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Noto+Sans), the latin variable WOFF2 file covering weights 100–900: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/notosans/v42/o-0bIpQlx3QUlC5A4PNB6Ryti20_6n1iPHjc5a7duw.woff2 . Declare it with @font-face (font-weight 100 900, font-display swap) and use it for everything with a system-ui fallback. Weights used: 300 for the logo and the product title, 400 for everything else. Turn on antialiased font smoothing. Almost all text is uppercase with very wide letter-spacing; only the product description and the panel caption are sentence case.

## 3. Head, colours and global rules

- Title "HINA — Little Wardrobe"; meta description "HINA little wardrobe: an interactive rail of soft children's clothing."; an empty data: favicon; viewport width=device-width, initial-scale=1.
- A tiny inline script in the head adds the class `pre` to the html element unless the visitor prefers reduced motion (this hides elements before the entrance animation).
- Colour tokens: wall #ECE6EB, ink #32333F (all main text and lines), muted #6A6B80 (secondary text), value #7173A6 (the spec values, a soft periwinkle-grey), periwinkle accent #9D9FE4, blush accent #E9ACA9. Main easing curve: cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.2,1).
- box-sizing border-box everywhere, no margins; html and body full height; body background is the wall colour and on desktop the body does not scroll (overflow hidden). Buttons inherit font and colour with no background or border.

## 4. Background wall

A fixed full-viewport layer behind everything. Two stacked backgrounds: a radial highlight (70 % × 80 % ellipse centred at 80 % / 40 %) going from #F1EBEF to transparent at 70 %, over a horizontal linear gradient #DED7DD (0 %) → #E6E0E5 (30 %) → #ECE6EB (60 %) → #EFE9ED (100 %). The effect is a soft lilac-grey studio wall that is slightly darker on the left and lightest just right of centre. There are no props, no floor and no other scenery.

## 5. Scaling system

All hero content (rail, garments and info UI) lives in one fixed **1440 × 900 px frame**, absolutely positioned at 50 % / 50 % of a fixed full-viewport stage with transform-origin top-left. Every coordinate in this brief is in frame pixels. On screens wider than 820 px the frame is scaled by `min(max(vw/1440, vh/900), vh/870, vw/1380)` and translated by −720 × scale and −450 × scale, so it covers the viewport but never crops the UI at the edges on unusual aspect ratios. The nav is not inside the frame: it is pinned to the viewport edges with its own unit `--ns` = max(0.62, min(1, vw/1440)), by which its font size, offsets, gaps and the burger width are all multiplied. Recompute both on resize.

## 6. Top navigation (fixed, viewport edges)

Height 42 px × ns, z-index above everything except the frame UI; 10.5 px × ns, letter-spacing 0.19em, ink colour.
- Left: the wordmark "HINA" at left 57 px × ns, top 9 px × ns, 24 px × ns, weight 300, letter-spacing 0.56em, line-height 1. It is a link to "/".
- Centre (horizontally centred, top 14 px × ns): four links CLOTHING, ACCESSORY, JOURNAL, ABOUT, with 35 px × ns between them. CLOTHING is active, with a 1 px ink underline 2 px below the text (stopping 0.2em short of the right end). Only CLOTHING has an href; the others are plain labels.
- Right (right 54 px × ns, top 14 px × ns): "SEARCH", then 34 px × ns gap, "MENU" followed 21 px × ns later by a three-line burger icon (25 px × ns wide, three 1 px ink lines at 0, 6 and 12 px).
- No buttons, pills, CTAs or extra items.

## 7. The rail (inside the frame)

**Rail line.** The rail is a straight line through frame space with y = 5 + 0.641 × (x − 330). Draw it as an SVG polygon in a 1440 × 900 viewBox, behind the garments: a tapered tube from x = 250 to x = 1062, 18 px thick at the left end (railY − 9 to railY + 9) narrowing to about 5.4 px at the right end (railY − 2.6 to railY + 2.8, with the bottom-right corner at x 1065). Fill it with a vertical gradient #FFFFFF → #F3F1F5 (55 %) → #C9C5D0, so it reads as a white powder-coated tube catching light from above. It runs off the top-left corner of the frame.

**Garment elements.** Create twelve absolutely positioned divs, one per piece, each sized to its sprite box (w × h), with the garment sheet as a non-repeating background at its native size (3312 × 2480 px) shifted by (−x, −y). Set each element's transform-origin to (hookX − x, 0), i.e. the top of its hook, so every scale and rotation pivots on the hook. Transitions on each piece: transform 0.55 s with the main easing curve, opacity 0.35 s ease, filter 0.55 s ease. Pieces never receive pointer events; all hit-testing is done mathematically (section 10).

**Slots.** The piece currently shown is "cur"; each piece's slot is (index − cur) mod 12, so slot 0 is the front and slots 1–11 run back along the rail. The hook x of each slot is: 352, 440, 505, 565, 620, 670, 716, 758, 796, 831, 863, 893. Fractional and negative slots interpolate linearly (a negative slot is 352 + slot × 120). The z-index is 100 − slot, so nearer pieces cover farther ones.

**Scale.** The front piece is drawn at scale 0.93. A piece behind is scaled by the hook x through this piecewise-linear table: 352 → 0.94, 435 → 0.905, 545 → 0.83, 670 → 0.70, 778 → 0.57, 878 → 0.445, 958 → 0.33, 1045 → 0.19. Scaling is uniform: never squash or skew a garment horizontally.

**Placement.** For a piece at slot j with hook x X and scale S: translate it to (X − (hookX − x) + dx, railY(X) − 9 × S + dy), then rotate(rot), then scale(S). dx, dy and rot are 0 except during the hover pull-out. The hook therefore sits just on top of the rail, and each garment hangs at full width from it. Because the pieces are drawn at full width and overlap, the viewer sees the whole front piece (its left sleeve near x 100 and its hem around y 700) and only the right-hand sides and hems of the pieces behind, getting smaller up to about x 1000. Their hems may hang slightly below the front piece's hem.

**Floor shadow.** A 600 × 60 px ellipse (radial gradient rgba(70,60,90,.14) fading to transparent) placed behind all pieces at x 52 and y = railY(352) + frontSpriteHeight × 0.93 − 26, so it sits under the front garment's hem.

## 8. Right-hand info column (desktop)

Absolutely positioned at left 1118, top 198, width 310 px. From top to bottom:
1. Counter "01 / 12": 11 px, letter-spacing 0.18em, muted, 18 px tall.
2. Product title in two lines (for example "SMOCK" / "DRESS"): 28 px below, 31 px, weight 300, letter-spacing 0.14em, line-height 35 px, minimum height 70 px, no wrapping.
3. A short rule: 36 px below, 20 × 1 px, muted at 70 % opacity.
4. Description in two lines: 24 px below, 13 px, letter-spacing 0.088em, line-height 24 px, muted, 300 px wide (for example "Soft brushed cotton with hand" / "smocking. Made for play and naps.").
5. Spec list: 54 px below, 10 px, letter-spacing 0.16em, line-height 27 px. Three rows with no wrapping: label column 117 px wide in ink (MATERIAL, COLOUR, SIZE), value in #7173A6 with letter-spacing 0.14em.
6. "VIEW DETAILS" button: 50 px below, 11 px, letter-spacing 0.2em, 7 px bottom padding and a 1 px ink underline, followed 14 px later by a 10 × 10 thin diagonal arrow icon (an up-right arrow, 1 px stroke).

**Pager** at left 1118, top 752, 270 px wide, spread with space-between: a thin left arrow (a 36 × 12 svg with a 1 px line and open arrowhead, at 55 % opacity), the counter "01 / 12" (11 px, 0.18em), and a matching right arrow. The buttons are 38 × 24 px.

**Left index** at left 40, top 250 (10 px, letter-spacing 0.18em, muted): the current number "01"; then 12 px below a 1 × 77 px track (ink at 18 %) with a solid ink fill that scales from the top to (current / 12) with the main easing over 0.55 s; then 19 px below it "12".

**Footer** at left 53, top 866: "HINA · LITTLE WARDROBE | 07", 10 px, letter-spacing 0.225em, muted.

**Hint** at left 723, top 866: "CLICK TO PEEK", a 20 × 10 double-headed thin arrow with 14 px margins, then "CLICK AGAIN TO FOLLOW", 9.2 px, letter-spacing 0.2em, muted.

The whole UI layer sits above the garments (z-index 300) but lets clicks pass through except on its own children.

## 9. Product data (12 pieces, in sprite order)

| 7 | LINEN | PINAFORE | Washed linen with button straps | and two deep patch pockets. | LINEN 100% | BLUSH | 2Y / 4Y / 6Y |
| 8 | SOFT KNIT | JUMPER | Open-stitch cotton knit with a | gentle, easy round neck. | COTTON KNIT | PERIWINKLE | 1Y / 2Y / 4Y |
| 9 | FRILL | DRESS | Pintucked cotton with frilled | shoulders and elastic cuffs. | ORGANIC COTTON | CLOUD WHITE | 2Y / 4Y / 6Y |
| 10 | POCKET | PINAFORE | Soft twill with frilled straps | and pockets for small treasures. | COTTON TWILL | LILAC GREY | 2Y / 4Y / 6Y |
| 11 | GINGHAM | DRESS | Smocked gingham with short | puff sleeves for sunny days. | COTTON GINGHAM | BLUSH / CREAM | 2Y / 4Y / 6Y |
| 12 | QUILTED | VEST | Lightly quilted with wooden | buttons. Warm, never bulky. | COTTON QUILT | PALE PERIWINKLE | 1Y / 2Y / 4Y |

## 10. Interactions

**Browsing (next).** Triggered by a mouse wheel (deltaY + deltaX accumulated; one step each time the total passes ±40, desktop only, and the page's own scrolling is prevented), the Right or Down arrow keys, the right pager arrow, or a left swipe of more than 36 px on touch. Steps are throttled to one every 95 ms, so a fast wheel flick runs through several pieces quickly, like flicking hangers. On a step forward:
- the front piece moves to slot −1.3 (back up the rail to the upper left, about 156 px left of the front hook) and fades to opacity 0, using its normal transitions;
- every other piece moves one slot forward with the 0.55 s eased transform, growing as it comes forward, and the new front piece lands at scale 0.93;
- after 360 ms the old front piece is jumped, with transitions switched off for one frame, to the last slot at the far end of the rail, then fades back in there;
- the hover pull-out is cleared.

**Browsing (previous).** Left or Up arrow keys, the left pager arrow, or a right swipe. The piece in the last slot is jumped invisibly to slot −1.3 with a z-index above everything, then on the next frame everything is laid out again: that piece slides down the rail into the front slot while fading in, and the others step back one slot.

**Text swap.** On every step all changing texts (counter, both title lines, both description lines, the three spec values, the pager counter) fade out with a 5 px downward shift (opacity 0.22 s, transform 0.32 s eased). After 140 ms they are replaced and fade back up. The left index number and the index fill update at the same time.

**Hover pull-out (mouse only).** Track mousemove over the stage and convert the pointer into frame coordinates (subtract the frame's on-screen left/top and divide by the frame scale). For each piece compute its span: left = hookX − (hookX − x) × S, right = hookX + (x + w − hookX) × S, top = railY(hookX) − 9 × S, bottom = top + h × S. The pointer is on the front piece if it lies between its left + 30 and right − 20 and between its top + 60 and bottom. Otherwise walk the slots from 1 to 11 and take the first piece whose right − 6 is at or past the pointer's x; that piece is hovered only if the pointer is between its top + 40 and bottom − 10 and to the right of the front piece's right − 20. The hovered rail piece is drawn pulled out: dx = 38 × S, dy = +6 px, rotate −6° (its hem swings out to the right around the hook) and scale × 1.035. Every piece behind it shifts right by 18 × its scale to make room, and the pieces in front stay still. All of this animates with the normal 0.55 s eased transitions, and moving off the pieces (or leaving the stage) settles everything back. The cursor becomes a pointer over the front piece or a hoverable rail piece. Nothing happens while the detail view is open, or on devices without hover.

**Click a rail piece ("click again to follow").** Show the pull-out on that piece (this is what a tap shows on touch screens), then after 260 ms step forward as many times as its slot number, 120 ms apart, so the rail runs and that piece arrives at the front.

**Click the front piece, or VIEW DETAILS: the detail view.** Add the class `detail` to the body. For 0.76 s every piece uses slower transitions (transform 0.7 s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.25,1), opacity 0.55 s, filter 0.55 s), then goes back to normal.
- The front piece does not move.
- The rail closes up behind it. Every piece behind is re-placed with its rail x compressed to 352 + (x − 352) × 0.36, scaled for that new x, and drawn at opacity 0.62 with filter blur(7px) saturate(.55) brightness(1.04). The result is a soft, blurred, faded wedge of garments hugging the right side of the front piece and receding up along the rail. Nothing flies away or disappears.
- The rail tube is clipped from the right (clip-path inset(0 46% 0 0), 0.7 s same curve), so it ends just behind the wedge.
- The info column and the pager slide 328 px left (0.75 s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.2,1)), and the pager widens to 596 px so its arrows sit at x 790 and about 1386 with the counter centred between them.
- After a 0.32 s delay the detail panel fades in from 46 px to the right (opacity 0.45 s ease, transform 0.7 s eased).
- Clicking the front piece again, the BACK TO COLLECTION button or pressing Escape reverses all of it. Browsing still works while the detail view is open: the front piece changes and the stack stays blurred.

**Detail panel** at left 1098, top 118, 292 × 700 px:
- "BACK TO COLLECTION" with a 9 × 9 thin × icon, top-right, 9.5 px, letter-spacing 0.2em, with a 12 px gap before the icon.
- At top 52 (spanning the width minus 22 px): the tab name on the left (for example "ON HANGER") and "01 / 03" on the right, 9.5 px, letter-spacing 0.2em, muted.
- At top 80, three equal tab buttons, 8.5 px, letter-spacing 0.16em, muted, with a 1 px ink line at 14 % along the bottom: "01 / ON HANGER", "02 / FABRIC", "03 / DETAIL". The active tab is in ink with a 1 px ink underline that stops 14 px short of the tab's right edge.
- At top 110, a 270 × 470 px image box (full width minus 22 px) with background #F0EAF0 and hidden overflow, holding three stacked layers that cross-fade (opacity 0.45 s). The active layer also settles from scale 1.03 to 1 over 0.9 s.
- A caption at top 596, 11 px, letter-spacing 0.06em, line-height 20 px, muted: "Hung on a little wooden hanger." / "Soft to the touch, washed for comfort." / "Small touches, sewn to last." for the three tabs.
- A 1 × 520 px scroll track at the far right (from top 80, ink at 12 %) with a 3 × 120 px rounded thumb (ink at 45 %) that slides to top 0 / 200 / 400 for tabs 1 / 2 / 3 (0.5 s eased).
- Opening the panel always resets it to tab 1.

**What each tab shows:**
- Piece 1, ON HANGER: the back-view cell of the smock-dress detail sheet, fitted to the box width (scale = boxWidth / 990), and the layer itself is sized to that cell's height and centred vertically so the neighbouring cell never shows. The box colour matches the photo's background.
- Piece 1, FABRIC and DETAIL: the bottom-left (fabric weave) and top-right (smocking) cells of that sheet, each scaled to cover the box (scale = max(boxW, boxH) / 995), centred, starting 6 px inside the cell to trim the white gutters.
- Pieces 2–12, ON HANGER: the piece's own transparent sprite, contained in 90 % of the box width and 88 % of its height, centred. The layer is sized exactly to the sprite box so no neighbouring garment ever shows.
- Pieces 2–12, FABRIC and DETAIL: that piece's cell (column = index mod 4, row = index div 4) on the fabric and detail close-up sheets, inset 6 px from the measured gutters, scaled to cover the box and centred.
- Recompute all of these when the panel opens, when the front piece changes, and on resize while the panel is open (the box size differs on phones).

## 11. Opening animation (one Web Animations timeline, runs once)

While the html element has the class `pre`, the garments, tube, nav, index, footer, hint, pager, rule and VIEW DETAILS are hidden, and every text line inside a reveal wrapper sits 105 % below its overflow-hidden mask. On load the script removes `pre` and runs these animations with fill backwards and easing cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.2,1). A 4-second failsafe removes `pre` regardless. With reduced motion none of it runs and everything shows at once.

| Element | Keyframes | Duration | Delay |
|---|---|---|---|
| Rail tube | opacity 0 → 1 and clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) → inset(0) (it draws in from the left) | 1000 ms | 100 ms |
| Nav | opacity 0 → 1 | 900 ms | 200 ms |
| Each garment, front first | opacity 0 → 1 while dropping from 14 px above (CSS translate) | 900 ms | 250 ms + slot × 35 ms |
| Text lines (counter, title 1, title 2, description 1, description 2, the three spec rows), in order | translateY(105%) and opacity 0 → in place, opacity 1 (a line-by-line reveal) | 1000 ms | from 650 ms, +70 ms per line |
| Index, rule, VIEW DETAILS, pager, footer, hint, in order | opacity 0 → 1 | 900 ms | from 900 ms, +70 ms each |

## 12. Phone and small screens (≤ 820 px)

- The body scrolls. The stage becomes a normal block 64vh tall (minimum 430 px) showing a cropped view of the same frame: the frame scale is stageHeight / 780 and it is shifted so the front piece and the first few rail pieces fill the width (x = min(0, max(vw − 1100 × scale, (vw − 760 × scale)/2 − 40 × scale)), y = −stageHeight/2 − 20 × scale with the frame's top at 50 %).
- The nav is absolute and 52 px tall. The wordmark sits at 18 / 16 px, 19 px, letter-spacing 0.5em. The centre links and SEARCH are hidden; MENU and the burger sit at right 18, top 20.
- The left index, footer and hint are hidden. The info column, pager and detail panel are moved by script into a section below the stage (padding 8 / 22 / 40 px) and flow normally there: title 26 px with line-height 30 px; tighter gaps (title 14, rule 18, description 18, specs 24, button 26, pager 34 px); the pager spans the full width.
- In the detail view the panel opens below the pager (34 px gap) at full width, with its image box at a 4 : 5 aspect ratio, and the page smooth-scrolls to it. The scroll track is hidden.
- On touch, swiping left or right on the stage browses, and tapping the front piece toggles the detail view. A tap on a rail piece shows its pull-out, then brings it to the front.
- When the script moves those blocks back on resize to desktop, they return into the frame UI in their original order. Nothing may cause sideways scrolling at any width (check 390, 768 and 844 × 390 landscape).

## 13. Reduced motion

With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, all CSS transitions and animations are switched off (every state change is instant), the entrance timeline is skipped, and the phone scroll to the panel is instant.

## 14. Acceptance checklist

- At 1440 × 900 the front smock dress fills the left 40 % of the screen. The diagonal white rail runs from the top-left corner to about (1062, 470). Eleven garments hang behind at full width, never squashed, showing only their right sides and shrinking into the distance. The info column reads 01 / 12, SMOCK DRESS, etc., in thin wide-tracked caps.
- The wheel, arrow keys and arrows each move one piece: the front piece slides off up the rail and fades, and the next glides forward and grows. Fast wheel flicks run through several pieces.
- Hovering a rail piece pulls it out with a small outward swing while the pieces behind make room. Clicking it runs the rail until it is at the front.
- Clicking the front piece leaves it in place, closes the rail into a blurred, faded stack right behind it, shortens the rail, slides the text left and fades in the panel. All three tabs show sharp photos of that exact piece, with no neighbouring images visible. Clicking again, Back or Escape restores the rail.
- No horizontal scroll on phones, and the phone detail panel is reachable by scroll.
- No console errors. All four images load from images.higgs.ai, and the font loads.

full_prompt:
# HERO PROMPT — "Offcut" streetwear clothing-rail hero (exact recreation)

Build a single self-contained `index.html` (inline `<style>` and `<script>`, no framework, no build step) that recreates the "Offcut" hero exactly as specified below. It is a dark, minimal streetwear shop hero: a gothic blackletter logo, a polished chrome clothing rail across the page, ten garments hanging on it **edge-on in real CSS 3D** that swing round to face the viewer when hovered, a caption under the faced garment, a "See availability" pill, and a red scrolling marquee band at the bottom. Clicking a garment lifts it off the rail into a large centred detail view with a product counter, an italic serif name, a price, prev/next arrows and a Close button, while the rest of the page washes out.

Every number in this document is load-bearing. Where a value is given, use exactly that value. Do not add any element, text, effect, sound, loader or animation that is not described here. Page `<title>` is `Offcut`, `lang="en"`, UTF-8, viewport `width=device-width,initial-scale=1`.

---

## 1. Fonts

Load from Google Fonts in one stylesheet link (with `preconnect` to `https://fonts.googleapis.com` and `https://fonts.gstatic.com` crossorigin), `display=swap`:

- **Inter** weights **400, 500, 600** (upright only).
- **Instrument Serif**, **italic only** (ital 1, regular weight 400).
- **UnifrakturMaguntia** (regular 400).

The exact family query is: Inter wght 400;500;600, Instrument Serif ital@1, UnifrakturMaguntia.

Usage:
- Body / UI default: `"Inter","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif`, antialiased (`-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased`).
- Logo: UnifrakturMaguntia with `serif` fallback.
- Product name in detail view: Instrument Serif italic with `serif` fallback.

---

## 2. Colour tokens

Define on `:root`:

| Token | Hex | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `--bg` | `#0b0b0c` | page / letterbox background, pill hover text |
| `--ink` | `#f1efec` | all primary text, pill hover fill |
| `--mute` | `#8d8a86` | caption price line, counter, detail price |
| `--red` | `#b3121b` | marquee band |

Other colours used literally:
- Artboard radial centre colour `#18181a`.
- Rail gradient stops `#fafafa`, `#b9bcc1`, `#5d6066`, `#a9adb3`, `#e6e7e9`.
- Rail end-cap gradient stops `#8d9096`, `#f3f3f4`, `#7a7d83`.

## 3. Global reset and page behaviour

- `*` → `box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0`.
- `html, body` → `height: 100%`, `overflow: hidden` (the page never scrolls), background `--bg`.
- `body` → colour `--ink`, Inter, antialiased, **text selection disabled** (`user-select: none` and the `-webkit-` prefixed version).
- `button` reset → inherit font and colour, no background, no border, `cursor: pointer`.

---

## 4. Artboard: 1500 × 1000, scaled to fit, letterboxed and centred

- All content lives inside one absolutely positioned artboard `div#art`, exactly **1500px wide × 1000px tall**, `transform-origin: 0 0`.
- Artboard background: a radial gradient, ellipse **70% wide × 55% tall**, centred **at 50% horizontally, 40% vertically**, going from `#18181a` at the centre to `#0b0b0c` (`--bg`) at the edge. (Outside the artboard, the body's flat `#0b0b0c` fills the letterbox bars, so the bars blend in.)
- Fit function (run once on load and on every `resize`):
  - `k = min(windowInnerWidth / 1500, windowInnerHeight / 1000)`.
  - Set `transform: scale(k)` on the artboard.
  - Set `left = (innerWidth − 1500·k) / 2` px and `top = (innerHeight − 1000·k) / 2` px, so the scaled artboard is centred both ways with equal bars on the two letterbox sides.
- Every coordinate below is in artboard pixels (before scaling). The page has no responsive breakpoints: the whole composition always scales as one image.

---

## 5. Shared text styles

- `.ui` class: **12px**, weight **500**, letter-spacing **0.12em**, **uppercase**.
- `.pill` class: height **34px**, horizontal padding **0 20px**, border **1px solid rgba(241,239,236,.6)**, border-radius **40px**, `display: inline-grid; place-items: center`, transitions `background .25s, color .25s`. On hover: background `--ink` (#f1efec), text colour `--bg` (#0b0b0c). The pills are decorative (no click action).

## 6. Elements in stacking (DOM) order inside the artboard

The z-order is purely DOM order (no z-index anywhere). From back to front:

1. `#about`, 2. `#logo`, 3. `#contact`, 4. `#rail`, 5. `#rack` (the garments), 6. `#cap` (caption), 7. `#avail` (pill), 8. `#band` (marquee), 9. `#det` (detail layer, containing in order: `.hit` backdrop, `#big2`, `#big`, `#prev`, `#next`, `#info`, `#close`).

Important consequence: the garments are drawn over the rail; the `#rack` container is a full 1500×1000 transparent layer that sits on top of About / logo / Contact / rail (so those are not hoverable); the detail layer is above everything.

### 6.1 Header

- **About** (`#about`, class `.ui` + `.dim`): text `About`, absolutely positioned **left 46px, top 46px**.
- **Logo** (`#logo`, class `.dim`): text `Offcut` (mixed case, NOT uppercase), absolutely positioned at **left 50%, top 26px**, `translateX(-50%)` so it is horizontally centred. Font: UnifrakturMaguntia **400, 64px, line-height 1**, letter-spacing **0.01em**, colour `--ink`.
- **Contact** (`#contact`, classes `.ui`, `.dim` and `.dimmer`): text `Contact`, absolutely positioned **right 46px, top 46px**.

None of these are links and none have click behaviour.

### 6.2 Rail

- `#rail` (class `.dim`): absolutely positioned **left 150px, right 150px** (so it spans x 150 → 1350, width **1200px**), **top 254px**, **height 12px**, border-radius **6px**.
- Background: vertical linear gradient (top → bottom) `#fafafa 0%`, `#b9bcc1 28%`, `#5d6066 55%`, `#a9adb3 78%`, `#e6e7e9 100%` — a polished chrome tube with a bright top highlight, dark core just below middle and a lighter bottom reflection.
- Box shadow: `0 10px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.45)`.
- **End caps** via `::before` and `::after`: each is **16px wide × 30px tall**, border-radius **5px**, **top −9px** relative to the rail (so they extend 9px above and 9px below the 12px tube; artboard y 245 → 275), background horizontal linear gradient (90deg) `#8d9096`, `#f3f3f4` at 45%, `#7a7d83`. Left cap at **left −14px** (artboard x 136 → 152), right cap at **right −14px** (artboard x 1348 → 1364).

### 6.3 Rack container

- `#rack` (class `.dim`): absolutely positioned at 0,0, **1500 × 1000**, transparent. It contains the ten garment elements, created in script.

### 6.4 Caption

- `#cap` (class `.dimmer`): absolutely positioned **top 552px**, horizontal position = the faced garment's `left` value, with `translateX(-50%)` so it centres under the garment. `text-align: center`, **11px**, letter-spacing **0.12em**, **uppercase**, colour `--mute`, `white-space: nowrap`, `pointer-events: none`.
- Two lines: a bold-block first line (rendered as a `<b>`, `display: block`, colour `--ink`, weight **500**, margin-bottom **4px**) holding the product **name**, then a second line (a span, in `--mute`) holding the **price**.
- Hidden by default (`opacity: 0`); class `.on` makes it `opacity: 1`.
- Transitions: `left .75s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)` and `opacity .35s` (default ease).

### 6.5 "See availability" pill

- `#avail`: a `<button>` with classes `pill ui dim dimmer`, text `See availability` (uppercase via `.ui`), absolutely positioned **left 50%, top 790px**, `translateX(-50%)`.

### 6.6 Red marquee band

- `#band` (class `.dimmer`): absolutely positioned **left 0, right 0, bottom 0**, **height 46px** (artboard y 954 → 1000), background `--red` `#b3121b`, `overflow: hidden`, `display: flex; align-items: center`.
- Inner track: one `div`, `display: flex; white-space: nowrap`, **13px**, weight **600**, letter-spacing **0.14em**, colour `--ink` (inherited). It is filled by script with the following 6-span sequence repeated **16 times**: `OFFCUT`, `•`, `LIMITED RUN`, `•`, `NO RESTOCKS`, `•` (each a separate `<span>`; the bullet is U+2022). Every span has **padding-right 22px** (that is the only spacing between items; no margins, no other separators).
- Animation: keyframe goes **to `translateX(-50%)`** (from the natural 0), **22s, linear, infinite**. Because the content is an even number of identical repeats, shifting by half the track width loops seamlessly. Text scrolls right-to-left.

### 6.7 Detail layer (`#det`)

- `#det`: absolutely positioned `inset: 0` over the whole artboard, `pointer-events: none` while closed; `pointer-events: auto` when `body.open` (and its buttons explicitly `pointer-events: auto` when open).
- `.hit`: first child, `position: absolute; inset: 0`; transparent full-artboard backdrop. Clicking it closes the detail view.
- `#big2`: the outgoing ghost used during prev/next. Absolutely positioned **left 50%, top 244px, 473px × 492px, margin-left −236.5px** (so x 513.5 → 986.5, y 244 → 736), `background-repeat: no-repeat`, `opacity: 0`, `pointer-events: none`. **Default transform-origin (centre)**. No drop shadow.
- `#big`: the big detail garment. Same box as `#big2` (left 50%, top 244, 473 × 492, margin-left −236.5), `background-repeat: no-repeat`, **transform-origin 50% 4%** (the hanger hook), `opacity: 0` by default, `filter: drop-shadow(0 30px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.6))`. It sits above `#big2`.
- `#prev` and `#next`: `<button class="arr">` with aria-labels `Previous` / `Next`. Each is absolutely positioned **top 452px**, **46 × 46px**, circular (border-radius 50%), border **1px solid rgba(241,239,236,.5)**, `display: grid; place-items: center`, opacity 0 by default. `#prev` at **left calc(50% − 300px)** = artboard x **450 → 496**; `#next` at **left calc(50% + 254px)** = x **1004 → 1050** (so both sit 17.5px outside the 473px garment box). Transitions: `opacity .4s` with **.25s delay**, `background .2s`, `color .2s`. Hover: background `--ink`, colour `--bg`.
  - Icons: inline SVG **16 × 16**, viewBox 0 0 24 24, a single open chevron path, no fill, stroke `currentColor`, stroke-width **1.8**. Previous: a "<" chevron from (15,5) to (8,12) to (15,19). Next: a ">" chevron from (9,5) to (16,12) to (9,19).
- `#info`: absolutely positioned **left 50%, top 770px**, `translateX(-50%)`, centred text, opacity 0 by default, transition **`opacity .5s` with `.25s` delay**. Children in order:
  1. `#num` — counter, **11px**, letter-spacing **0.16em**, colour `--mute`, formatted as two-digit index, space, slash, space, two-digit total: e.g. `01 / 10`.
  2. `#name` — product name, Instrument Serif **italic 400, 40px, line-height 1.15**, colour `--ink`, margin **8px top, 0 sides, 6px bottom**. Mixed case as in the product list (not uppercase).
  3. `#price` — **13px**, letter-spacing **0.08em**, colour `--mute`, margin-bottom **18px**, e.g. `€48`.
  4. A `<button class="pill ui">` with text `See availability` (decorative).
- `#close`: `<button class="ui">` text `Close`, absolutely positioned **right 46px, top 46px** (exactly where Contact sits — Contact disappears when open, Close takes its place), opacity 0 by default, transition `opacity .4s` with `.25s` delay.

## 7. The "open" wash-out states

Two utility classes control what happens to the page when the detail view is open (class `open` on `<body>`):

- `.dim` — elements: About, logo, Contact, rail, rack, avail pill. They carry `transition: opacity .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), filter .7s`. When open: **`opacity: .12` and `filter: blur(2px)`**.
- `.dimmer` — elements: Contact, caption, avail pill, band. When open: **`opacity: 0` and `pointer-events: none`**. This rule is declared after the `.dim` rule with equal specificity, so for elements that are both (Contact and the avail pill) the opacity **0** wins (they fade fully out over .7s thanks to the `.dim` transition, with the blur too).
  - The band has no transition, so it disappears **instantly** on open and reappears instantly on close.
  - The caption fades with its own `.35s` opacity transition and is not blurred.

Net visible result when open: logo, About, rail and the remaining edge-on garments are faint ghosts (12% opacity, 2px blur); Contact, caption, bottom pill and red band are gone; the big garment, arrows, info and Close are crisp.

## 8. Garment imagery: one transparent sprite sheet

All ten garments (and the big detail view) come from **one transparent PNG sprite sheet, 2048 × 1360 px**, delivered as WebP through the images.higgs.ai proxy. Use this URL exactly, character for character:

```
https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261107_130252_7b1b8485-d5c5-440c-8921-f5ae01054c6a.png&w=2048&q=90
```

Do not re-host, re-crop into separate files, or substitute other images. Each element that shows a garment uses the sheet as a CSS `background-image` with `background-repeat: no-repeat`.

### 8.1 Sheet geometry

- Sheet size: `SW = 2048`, `SH = 1360`.
- The sheet holds **5 columns × 2 rows** of garments on hangers. Cell width **`CW = 409.6`** (2048 / 5), cell height **`CH = 530`**.
- Row top Y coordinates on the sheet: **row 0 at y = 80**, **row 1 at y = 700** (`ROWY = [80, 700]`).
- Garment index `k` (0–9): column = `k mod 5`, row = `floor(k / 5)`. So k 0–4 are the top row left→right, k 5–9 the bottom row left→right.

### 8.2 Product list (index order, exact strings; the dash is an em dash U+2014 with spaces)

| k | Name | Price |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | Winged Skull Tee | €48 |
| 1 | Heavy Blank Tee — Black | €38 |
| 2 | Heavy Blank Tee — White | €38 |
| 3 | Offcut Longsleeve | €55 |

`N = 10`. The garment's rail position, its caption, its detail-view counter and its sheet cell all use the same index.

### 8.3 Padded crop box (why 50px)

On the sheet, neighbouring garments touch or overlap their cell borders (sleeves reach into the next cell). So each garment is cropped from a box **50px wider than its cell on both sides**: `PAD = 50`, box width **`BW = CW + 2·PAD = 509.6`**, box height **`CH = 530`** (no vertical padding). The box for garment k on the sheet starts at:

- `x = (k mod 5) · 409.6 − 50`
- `y = ROWY[floor(k / 5)]` (80 or 700)

and is 509.6 wide × 530 tall. (For k = 0 and k = 5 the box starts at x = −50, i.e. 50px of empty space left of the sheet, which is fine because the sheet is transparent and background-repeat is off.)

### 8.4 Pixel-based background mapping (the "paint" routine)

A single routine paints garment k into any element so that the padded crop box exactly fills that element, regardless of element size. It reads the element's **layout size** (`offsetWidth` = ew, `offsetHeight` = eh; untransformed) and sets, in **px**, not percentages:

- `background-image`: the sheet URL.
- `background-size`: width = `SW / BW · ew` = `2048 / 509.6 · ew`; height = `SH / CH · eh` = `1360 / 530 · eh`. (The X and Y scales are computed independently: `sx = ew / 509.6`, `sy = eh / 530`.)
- `background-position`: x = `−x_box / BW · ew` = `−x_box · sx`; y = `−y_box / CH · eh` = `−y_box · sy`.
- `clip-path`: the k-th polygon string from §8.5.

- Rail garment element (289 × 300): background-size ≈ **1161.44 × 769.81 px**; position for k = 0 ≈ (28.36, −45.28), k = 1 (−203.93, −45.28), k = 2 (−436.22, −45.28), k = 3 (−668.51, −45.28), k = 4 (−900.80, −45.28); k 5–9 use the same x values with y ≈ −396.23.
- Detail element (473 × 492): background-size ≈ **1900.91 × 1262.49 px**; position for k = 0 ≈ (46.41, −74.26), k = 1 (−333.77, −74.26), k = 2 (−713.96, −74.26), k = 3 (−1094.14, −74.26), k = 4 (−1474.32, −74.26); k 5–9 same x, y ≈ −649.81.

The routine is called on each rail garment once on creation, on `#big` when opening / stepping, and on `#big2` when stepping.

---

## 9. The rail: 3D edge-on garments

### 9.1 Garment element structure

For each product k, create a `div.g` containing a single `<i>` child, append it to `#rack`, and paint the `<i>` with garment k.

- `.g`: `position: absolute`, **top 236px**, **width 289px, height 300px**, **margin-left −144.5px** (so its `left` value is its horizontal centre), **`perspective: 900px`** (on the `.g` itself, i.e. each garment has its own vanishing point at its own centre), `cursor: pointer`, transition **`left .75s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`**.
- `.g i`: `position: absolute; inset: 0` (fills 289 × 300), `background-repeat: no-repeat`, **`transform-origin: 50% 4%`** (x centre, 12px down — the hanger hook sitting on the rail, which is at artboard y 254–266; the garment box top is at 236 so the hook is at ≈ y 248), **`transform: rotateY(-74deg)`** — the garment is turned almost edge-on, like clothes hanging sideways on a real rail, showing a narrow foreshortened sliver. Filter: **`brightness(.82) drop-shadow(0 18px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.5))`**. Transition: **`transform .75s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), filter .75s`** (the filter transition uses the default ease).
- Faced state `.g.face i`: **`transform: rotateY(0deg)`** (flat, facing the viewer), filter **`brightness(1) drop-shadow(0 22px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.55))`**.

The rotation is a true 3D rotation, so the near edge grows and the far edge shrinks under the 900px perspective as the garment swings round. The rotation direction is negative Y (−74°), and it animates to 0° — keep the sign.

### 9.2 Layout maths

Constants: **`SLOT = 108`** px between garment centres, **`OPEN = 86`** px extra gap, **`CX = 750`** (artboard centre).

State: `hov` (index of the faced garment, −1 for none) and `open` (index shown in detail view, −1 for none).

`layout()` sets, for each garment k:

- base x = `CX + (k − (N − 1)/2) · SLOT` = `750 + (k − 4.5) · 108`. Resting centres: **264, 372, 480, 588, 696, 804, 912, 1020, 1128, 1236**.
- If `hov ≥ 0` and `k ≠ hov`: x += `sign(k − hov) · OPEN` — every garment to the left of the faced one moves **86px left**, every garment to the right moves **86px right**; the faced one stays at its base slot. This opens a gap so the turned-to-face garment has room (all neighbours slide apart together, not just the adjacent ones).
- `left = x px`, and toggles class `face` on exactly the garment with `k === hov`.

Then the caption: if `hov ≥ 0`, set the caption's `left` to the same `left` string as the faced garment, fill the name and price of `hov`, and add `.on`; else remove `.on` (caption keeps its last text and position while fading out). Because both `.g` and `#cap` animate `left` with the same .75s curve, the caption glides with the garment.

`layout()` runs once at start (nothing faced: ten edge-on garments evenly spaced across the rail, no caption).

### 9.3 Hover / pointer behaviour

- Each `.g` listens for **`pointerenter`**: if not open, set `hov = k` and `layout()`.
- `#rack` listens for **`pointerleave`**: if not open, `hov = −1` and `layout()`.
- Note: the hover target is the whole 289 × 300 `.g` box (not the clipped image), and these boxes overlap heavily (108px slots); later garments in DOM order (higher k) are on top. Moving across the rail therefore faces garments one by one in sequence.
- Note: `#rack` is a full 1500 × 1000 layer, so moving into empty space on the artboard does NOT reset the hover — the last faced garment stays faced. It resets only when the pointer actually leaves `#rack`: leaving the artboard/window, or moving onto an element stacked above the rack that receives pointer events (the "See availability" pill or the red band). The caption has `pointer-events: none` and does not count.
- Each `.g` listens for **`click`** → `openG(k)`.

### 9.4 Keyboard (rail mode, i.e. `open < 0`)

Global `keydown` on window (no preventDefault):
- **ArrowRight**: `hov = min(N − 1, hov + 1)` then `layout()` (from no selection it goes to 0).
- **ArrowLeft**: if `hov < 0` → `hov = N − 1` (9); otherwise `hov = max(0, hov − 1)`; then `layout()`.
- **Enter**: if `hov ≥ 0`, `openG(hov)`.

---

## 10. Detail view

### 10.1 `openG(k)` — lift from the rail

1. If already open, do nothing. Set `open = k`, `hov = k`, call `layout()` (so the rail behind shows k faced with the gap open, even though it is about to be hidden/dimmed).
2. Read the garment's current centre `gx = parseFloat(G[k].style.left)`.
3. Cancel any running Web Animations on `#big`, paint `#big` with garment k, fill the info (§10.2), add class `open` to `<body>` (starts all wash-out and fade-in transitions in §6.7 / §7).
4. Animate `#big` with the Web Animations API, **750ms, easing `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`, fill `forwards`**, two keyframes:
   - from: `transform: translate(${gx − 750}px, −8px) scale(.61)`, `opacity: 1`
   - to: `transform: none`, `opacity: 1`.
   With transform-origin 50% 4% on `#big`, scale .61 makes the 473px box ≈ 289px wide (the rail garment's width) and the horizontal translate puts it over the clicked garment's slot, 8px higher — so the big image appears to start exactly where the rail garment hangs and grows/glides to the centre (473 × 492 at top 244, centred on x 750). No opacity fade: it is fully opaque from the first frame.
5. Hide the rail original: `G[k].style.visibility = 'hidden'` (so there is no duplicate on the dimmed rail).

### 10.2 `fill(k)`

- `#num` = two-digit `k + 1`, then ` / `, then two-digit `N` → e.g. `01 / 10`, `07 / 10`.
- `#name` = product name; `#price` = product price.

### 10.3 `step(d)` — previous / next (d = −1 or +1), crossfade-slide

1. If not open, do nothing. `from = open`; `open = (open + d + N) mod N` (wraps around both ways: 10 → 1 and 1 → 10).
2. `fill(open)`. Restore visibility of `G[from]`, hide `G[open]`. Set `hov = open` and `layout()` (the ghosted rail behind shifts its gap to the new garment).
3. Outgoing ghost: paint `#big2` with garment `from` and animate it, **600ms, `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`, no fill** (it snaps back to its default opacity 0 afterward):
   - from `transform: none; opacity: 1; filter: blur(0)`
   - to `transform: translateX(${−d · 120}px) scale(.94); opacity: 0; filter: blur(6px)`.
   So on Next (d = +1) the old garment slides 120px **left**, shrinks to 94%, blurs 6px and fades out; on Previous it goes right.
4. Incoming: cancel `#big` animations, paint `#big` with garment `open` and animate, **600ms, same easing, fill `forwards`**:
   - from `transform: translateX(${d · 120}px) scale(.94); opacity: 0; filter: blur(6px)`
   - to `transform: none; opacity: 1; filter: blur(0)`.
   So on Next the new garment enters from 120px right. (The `#big` drop-shadow filter is replaced by the animated blur filter while this animation is in effect — reproduce exactly by animating `filter` on `#big`.)
5. Info text swaps instantly (no animation on the text itself).

### 10.4 `closeG()` — put it back

1. If not open, do nothing. `k = open`, `gx = parseFloat(G[k].style.left)` (the faced slot position).
2. Animate `#big`, **650ms, `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`, fill `forwards`**: from `transform: none; opacity: 1` to `transform: translate(${gx − 750}px, −8px) scale(.61); opacity: 1` — the reverse of the lift, shrinking back onto its rail slot.
3. Immediately remove `open` from `<body>` (page un-dims over .7s, band reappears instantly, info/arrows/Close fade out over their transitions, `#det` stops catching pointer events).
4. After a **650ms** `setTimeout`: restore `G[k].style.visibility`, cancel all animations on `#big`, set `#big` inline `opacity: 0`, set `open = −1`, `hov = −1`, `layout()` — the rail garment reappears in place and then swings back edge-on as the gap closes (.75s).

### 10.5 Detail controls

- `#prev` click → `step(−1)`; `#next` click → `step(1)`; `#close` click → `closeG()`; `.hit` backdrop click → `closeG()`.
- Clicks on `#big` inside its traced outline, on `#info` or on the arrows do not close (they are above the backdrop); clicks on transparent areas of the big garment box fall through the clip-path to the backdrop and close.
- Keyboard while open: **ArrowRight** → `step(1)`, **ArrowLeft** → `step(−1)`, **Escape** → `closeG()`. Enter does nothing while open.

### 10.6 Debug hook

Expose `window.__closet = { openG, step, closeG, setHov(k) }` where `setHov` sets `hov = k` and runs `layout()` (used for automated screenshots/recording).

---

## 11. Timing and easing summary

| What | Duration | Easing | Delay |

| Garment slide (`.g` left) | .75s | cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) | — |
| Garment rotateY −74° ↔ 0° | .75s | cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) | — |
| Garment brightness/shadow | .75s | ease (default) | — |

| Arrow hover bg/colour | .2s | ease | — |
| Pill hover bg/colour | .25s | ease | — |

| Marquee | 22s loop | linear | — |
| Band show/hide on open | instant | — | — |

---

## 12. Things NOT to do

- Do not use flat 2D scaleX tricks for the edge-on look — it must be `rotateY` under `perspective: 900px` on each garment wrapper with origin 50% 4%.
- Do not use percentage background-size/position; compute px from the element's layout size as in §8.4.
- Do not omit or simplify the clip polygons; without them neighbouring garment sleeves show at the box edges.
- Do not crossfade the whole page or fade the big garment in on open — the lift is fully opaque and purely transform-based.
- Do not add a modal background colour; the wash-out is opacity + blur of the page itself over the unchanged radial background.
- Do not make the logo uppercase, do not change fonts, do not add hover underlines, links, or extra sections. The page is exactly one non-scrolling 1500×1000 composition.

---

## 13. Acceptance checklist

- [ ] Fonts: Inter 400/500/600, Instrument Serif italic, UnifrakturMaguntia loaded from Google Fonts; page title `Offcut`.
- [ ] 1500×1000 artboard scaled by `min(w/1500, h/1000)`, centred with equal letterbox bars in `#0b0b0c`; no scrolling; text not selectable.
- [ ] Radial background 70% × 55% at 50% 40%, `#18181a` → `#0b0b0c`.
- [ ] `ABOUT` at 46/46 left, `CONTACT` at 46/46 right, 12px 500 uppercase .12em; blackletter `Offcut` 64px centred at top 26.
- [ ] Chrome rail x 150–1350, y 254, 12px tall, radius 6, 5-stop vertical gradient, shadow 0 10 18 .45; 16×30 end caps at −14px, top −9, radius 5.
- [ ] Ten garments from the single sheet URL (verbatim), each in a 289×300 box at top 236, centres 264 … 1236 step 108, turned rotateY(−74°) about 50% 4% under perspective 900px, brightness .82 with drop-shadow 0 18 18 .5.
- [ ] Each garment shows only its own outline (verbatim polygon k); no neighbour sleeves/slivers visible at either size.
- [ ] Background mapping in px: size 2048/509.6·w × 1360/530·h, position −(col·409.6−50)·sx, −rowY·sy; rows at 80 and 700.
- [ ] Hover faces the garment (rotateY 0, brightness 1, shadow 0 22 26 .55) and pushes all left garments −86px and all right garments +86px, everything gliding .75s on cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1).
- [ ] Caption at top 552 centred under faced garment: name in ink 500 above price in mute, 11px uppercase .12em, gap 4px; fades .35s.
- [ ] Hover persists over empty artboard; resets only on leaving the rack layer (window, pill or band).
- [ ] Arrow keys move the faced garment (Right from none → 0, Left from none → 9, clamped at ends); Enter opens it.
- [ ] `SEE AVAILABILITY` pill at top 790 centred: 34px tall, padding 20, 1px .6 border, radius 40, inverts on hover.
- [ ] Red `#b3121b` band 46px at the bottom with `OFFCUT • LIMITED RUN • NO RESTOCKS •` ×16, 13px 600 .14em, 22px padding-right per item, scrolling −50% in 22s linear infinite, seamless.
- [ ] Click: garment lifts from translate(gx−750, −8px) scale(.61) to the centred 473×492 box at top 244 in 750ms, fully opaque, origin 50% 4%, drop-shadow 0 30 40 .6; rail original hidden.
- [ ] Open state: About/logo/rail/rack at opacity .12 + blur 2px over .7s; Contact, caption, bottom pill gone; band gone instantly.
- [ ] Info at top 770: `01 / 10` counter 11px .16em mute; italic Instrument Serif name 40px/1.15 with 8px/6px margins; price 13px .08em mute with 18px below; pill. Fades in .5s after .25s.
- [ ] Round 46px arrows at top 452, x 450 and 1004, 1px .5 border, 16px chevrons stroke 1.8, invert on hover; `CLOSE` at right 46 / top 46. Fade .4s after .25s.
- [ ] Next/Prev (buttons or ←/→): counter wraps 10↔1; old image slides ∓120px, scale .94, blur 6px, fades out; new image enters from ±120px with the same, 600ms; rail behind updates its gap.
- [ ] Close (button, Esc, or backdrop click): image shrinks back to its rail slot in 650ms while page un-dims; after 650ms the rail garment reappears and swings back edge-on as the gap closes.
- [ ] `window.__closet` exposes openG, step, closeG, setHov.

# PERLÉ — boutique rail hero: exact recreation brief

Build a single-file, one-screen fashion hero for a fictional evening-wear label called **PERLÉ**. The whole page is a photo-real blush boutique room seen straight on. A thin rose-gold clothing rail carries twelve satin and tulle dresses on wire hangers, each turned three-quarters to the side. Hovering a dress turns it to face front, pulls it forward and pushes its neighbours apart. Clicking opens a product window. "Put in bag" flies the dress, shrinking, into a glossy shopping bag that stands in the room. There is no scroll on desktop. Everything below is exact; do not add anything that is not listed.

---

### Runtime clean-up of the cut sheets (required)

The background remover leaves white inside each hanger's triangle. On load, load the white-background sheet and its cut version with `crossOrigin="anonymous"` into two canvases (same size), then for each sprite, only in the zone from 60 px above the sprite's top to 34% of its height (and 30 px either side):

1. **Front sheet only (pockets):** flood-fill 4-connected components of pixels whose white-sheet RGB are all ≥ 253 and whose cut alpha > 0. Any component larger than `250·f²` px (f = loaded width / 3504) gets alpha 0.
2. **Both sheets (haze):** four passes over the same zone. A pixel with min(RGB) ≥ 232 in the white sheet and max−min ≤ 16 gets alpha 0 if its cut alpha < 225 or any 4-neighbour already has alpha 0.

Export the cleaned canvas with `toBlob(..., "image/webp", .92)`, put it on the root as CSS variables `--sheet` (front) and `--side` (side), and use `var(--sheet)` / `var(--side)` as each sprite's `background-image`. Start with the raw cut URLs and swap when ready. Wait for both (failsafe 10 s) before showing the dresses. Then preload both model sheets.

## 4. Stage system (desktop, ≥ 820 px wide)

All scene content lives in one `1440×900` px stage (`transform-origin: 0 0`) inside a fixed full-viewport `.hero` (overflow hidden). Every coordinate below is in stage px.

- `cover = max(W/1440, H/900)`. If `900·cover − H > 24·cover` (a wide, short screen, where cover would crop the headline or caption), use `u = H/888` instead, else `u = cover`.
- `ox = (W − 1440u)/2`, `oy = (H − 900u)·0.4` (when cropping vertically, 40% comes off the top). Stage transform `translate(ox, oy) scale(u)`.
- Two extra copies of the plate, `transform: scaleX(-1)`, at `left: -1440px` and `left: 1440px`, so on wide screens the room continues past each side with mirrored curtain, wall and floor.
- The nav sits outside the stage, pinned to the viewport with its own unit `--n = clamp(min(W/1440, H/900), .72, 1.35)`, offset inward by `--nx = max(ox, 0)` so it lines up with the stage.

### Layers inside the stage, in paint order

1. **Plate:** `0, 0, 1440×900`, stretched to fill.
2. **Rail:** the full-frame rail cut-out at `left 17.7, top 9.9, width 1413.8, height 902.2` (`max-width: none`, pointer-events none). This places its posts at x 309 / 1350, the top bar at y ≈ 294 and the feet at y ≈ 812.
3. **Headline** `h1.hl`: two block spans, "Dress up." / "Glow up.", uppercase Anton 94.5 px, line-height 83 px, colour `--ink-2`, at `left 83.4, top 122.5`. Use `transform: scaleX(.913)` from the top-left so the ink spans x 86–400 (line 1) and 86–386 (line 2), with caps top at y 122 and 205.
4. **Sentence** `p.sub`: "Soft satin, pearl buttons and a little shine for tonight." Inter 16.3 px / 24.5 px, `--ink`, `left 443, top 184.7, width 232`, wrapping after "and".
5. **Dresses:** see §5.
6. **Hit columns:** one transparent `<button>` per dress, `top 276, height 592`, z 50 (see §6).
7. **Sticker** `button.sticker`: "Peek at this piece", uppercase Inter 10 px weight 700, letter-spacing .11em, `--pink` background, `--ink` text, padding 7/13/6, `box-shadow 0 3px 8px rgba(96,52,38,.18)`, z 45. Hidden: `opacity 0; transform: translate(-50%,0) rotate(-5deg) scale(.9)`. Shown: `opacity 1; scale(1)`, transitions .16 s opacity / .2 s transform.
8. **Bag** `button.bag`: hit box at `left 84.4, top 667.7, 205.3×197.2`, z 30, `transform-origin: 50% 100%`.
   - It holds the full-frame bag cut-out at `left -78.3, top -642.6, width 1383.2, height 891`.
   - A soft contact shadow `::before`: an ellipse 22 px tall, 6 px below the bottom, from 4% to 98% of the width, `radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(110,62,46,.32), transparent)`, blur 3 px.
   - A count badge: a 40 px circle `#F7C9C4` with `--ink` Inter 15/500 text, at `left 182.6, top 45.3` inside the box, `box-shadow 0 2px 6px rgba(96,52,38,.14)`.
9. **Credit:** "Created by Perlé Atelier.", Inter 10.5 px, `--ink` at 80% opacity, right 38, top 861.

### Nav (fixed, z 20, `--n` units)

- **Wordmark** "PERLÉ": Cormorant Garamond 500, 46n px, letter-spacing .14em, `--rose-gold`, line-height 1, at `left: nx + 84n, top: 32.5n`. It is a link to `/`.
- **Pill** "YOUR BAG" + count:
  - Box: `right: nx + 62n, top 20n, height 42n`, fully rounded, background `--ink`, text `#FBF1EC` Inter 14n.
  - Spacing: padding `0 8n 0 19n`, gap 14n.
  - Count: a 27n circle `#F8D3CF`, `--ink`, 13n/500.
  - Clicking it opens the bag panel.

### Caption under the rail (outside the stage, positioned in stage coordinates)

- Box: centred at stage x 839, top `min(oy + 845u, H − 54u)`, width 520, `transform: translate(-50%,0) scale(u)`, z 35, text centred.
- **Line 1:** Inter 16/600 `--ink`, letter-spacing −.005em. Idle text "Find your after-dark slip."
- **Line 2:** Inter 11 `--muted`, 3 px gap. Idle text "Hover to browse. Click to see it on." (on `(hover: none)` devices: "Tap to browse. Tap again to see it on.").
- **Swapping:** add `.swap` (both lines fade to 0 over .14 s), change the text after 110 ms, then remove `.swap`.
- **Toast** inside it, at top 16 px, centred:
  - Look: `#1E1310` background, `#FBF1EC` Inter 12/600, padding 9×18, fully rounded.
  - Hidden: `opacity 0, translateY(8px)`.
  - Shown for 2.6 s: opacity .22 s, transform .3 s.

## 5. The dresses

Scale: sheet px × **S = 0.44** = stage px. The hook line is **HOOK_Y = 291**. The usable rail runs **RAIL_L = 347** for **RAIL_W = 970** px. **FLOOR = 838** is the lowest a pulled-forward hem may reach.

Each dress is a zero-size wrapper `.dress` at `left: cx (hook x), top: 291`, z-index = index + 1, `transition: left .34s var(--ease), opacity .22s linear`. It holds two layers (`.art`, absolute, background from the sheet):

- `.side`, from the side sheet with row top 54/1192:
  - placement: `left = −(hookX − x)·S`, `top = (y − rowTop)·S`
  - size: `w·S × h·S`
  - background: `background-size: 3504S × 2336S`, `background-position: −x·S −y·S`
  - `transform-origin: (hookX − x)·S  −(y − rowTop)·S`, which is the hook point
- `.front`, the same construction from the front sheet with row top 42/1202.

Both layers get `filter: drop-shadow(0 7px 9px rgba(96,52,38,.16))` and the transition `transform .22s var(--ease), opacity .18s linear, filter .22s var(--ease)`.

- **Rest:** `.side` opacity 1, no transform. `.front` opacity 0, `transform: scaleX(.58)`.
- **Hovered (`.on`):** wrapper z 40 (!important).
  - `.side` → opacity 0, `scale(var(--k)) scaleX(.55)` (it squeezes out).
  - `.front` → opacity 1, `scale(var(--k))` (it opens up into the front view and grows from the hook), shadow `drop-shadow(0 22px 24px rgba(96,52,38,.26))`.
  - Per-dress `--k = min(1.42, (838 − 291) / (frontH·S))`, so short dresses grow 1.42× and long gowns stop with the hem at y 838.

### Slots (`place()`)

The dresses still on the rail are laid out left to right in slots:

- **At rest:** every slot is `970/n`, and the dress sits in the slot centre: `cx = RAIL_L + (k + .5)·step`.
- **One dress hovered:** its slot is `G = min(frontW·S·k·0.8 + 28, 970·0.42)` and the others share `(970 − G)/(n − 1)`. This pushes the dresses on its left further left and the ones on its right further right; the `left` transition animates the push.
- The hit buttons take the same slots: `left = slot start, width = slot width`.

### The twelve dresses (name, price, colour line, description, fabric & fit)

## 6. Interactions

### Hover (mouse) and first tap (touch)

- `pointerenter` on a hit column (mouse only) → `setHover(i)`.
- `pointerleave` on the hits container → `setHover(-1)`.
- Keyboard focus on a hit also hovers.
- `setHover(i)` removes `.on` from the previous dress, sets the new one and calls `place()` (the push). It then adds `.on` and shows the sticker:
  - sticker `left = cx`, `top = 291 + frontH·S·k − 18`, tilted −5°
  - caption becomes "Name · $Price" / "Colour / XS – XL"
- `setHover(-1)` hides the sticker and restores the idle caption.
- **Click:** on mouse it opens the product window. On touch/pen, the first tap on a dress that isn't hovered only hovers it, and the second tap opens it. Clicking the sticker opens the hovered dress.

### Product window (`.scrim` + `.pdp`)

**Open:**
- `body.dim` blurs the hero and nav (`blur(11px) saturate(.96)`, .22 s).
- The scrim `rgba(58,38,32,.10)` fades in over .2 s.
- The panel goes from `scale(.955)` and opacity 0 to normal (.24 s ease / .2 s).
- Focus moves to the close button.

**Panel:** `min(66vw,1000px) × min(78vh,640px)`, radius 22, background `linear-gradient(135deg,#FBF5F1,#F7ECE6 60%,#F8E3E0)`, `box-shadow 0 30px 80px rgba(70,35,25,.22), 0 4px 14px rgba(70,35,25,.08)`. Two columns, 46% / 54%.

**Left column, the photo:**
- Background `#EEE0D4` (`#E9DCD0` for dresses 2 and 7).
- "Modelled" view:
  - one model-sheet cell, scaled to the column height and centred in a clip box as wide as the scaled cell
  - dresses 2 and 7 use the re-shot cells 0 and 1 instead
- "On its hanger" view: the front sprite, scaled to fit 80% of the box, centred, lifted 24 px, `drop-shadow(0 10px 14px rgba(96,52,38,.18))`.
- The two views crossfade over .2 s.
- Toggle pills, centred 18 px from the bottom: "Modelled" / "On its hanger".
  - Size: 30 px tall, padding 0 14, Inter 11.5/600, gap 6.
  - Active: `#1E1310` with `#FBF1EC` text. Inactive: `#FFF8F4` with `--ink` text.

**Right column (padding 52/48/36/40), in order:**
- "PERLÉ" in Cormorant 22 px, .2em, rose-gold
- name: Inter 32/700, −.02em, 30 px gap above
- price "$128.00": 17/600, 18 px gap above
- description: 14/1.55, max 400 px
- "Find your size": 12/700, 24 px gap above
- five size chips XS S M L XL:
  - size 42×36, 1 px `#DCC3BA` border, `#FFF9F6` background, 12.5/500, gap 8
  - **M is preselected on every open**
  - selected chip: `#1E1310` with `#FBF1EC` text
- hint "Choose a size to make it yours.": 11.5 px `--muted` (turns `#B4473C` if no size is chosen)
- "Put in bag" button: 48 px, `#1E1310`, uppercase 12.5/700, .12em, max 440 px
- "Fabric & fit" disclosure:
  - a `<details>` with a 6 px triangle that rotates 90° when open, a hairline above it
  - text 12.5/1.55
- line "Late nights deserve a soft shine.": 11.5 `--muted`

**Close:** the round 34 px close button (`#1E1310`, × icon), Esc, or a click on the scrim.

### Put in bag: the fly into the bag (as in the original reel)

1. The button turns to "In your bag ✓" (`#5E3A30`). After 380 ms the window closes, with the blur and scrim fading.
2. Disable the hit columns. Make sure the chosen dress is hovered: front-on, pulled forward, neighbours pushed. Hide the sticker. On phones, smooth-scroll the rail to `left: 0` so the bag is on screen.
3. Animate the dress wrapper with Web Animations: delay 420 ms, duration 820 ms, `cubic-bezier(.45,.05,.55,.95)`, fill forwards.
   - Distances: `dx = 186 − cx` and `dy = 712 − 291 − frontH·S·k·0.16·0.55`. The bag mouth is at stage (186, 712).
   - Keyframes:
     - 0: `translate(0,0) scale(1)`
     - .2: `translate(.06dx, −34px) scale(.92)` (it lifts off the hook)
     - .48: `translate(.45dx, .2dy) scale(.6)`
     - .76: `translate(.85dx, .72dy) scale(.3)`
     - .9: `translate(dx, dy) scale(.16)`
     - 1: `translate(dx, dy + 46px) scale(.144)`
   - At 55% of the flight add `.flying` (z 26, below the bag's z 30), so it drops in behind the bag's front.
4. **On finish:**
   - Bag dip-and-settle, 420 ms ease-out: `translateY(0) scale(1,1)` → (.35) `translateY(4px) scale(1.05,.95)` → (.7) `translateY(-2px) scale(.98,1.02)` → none.
   - Bag count pop: scale 1 → 1.35 → 1 over 380 ms.
   - Hide the dress (`.gone`, with transitions off for one frame so it doesn't flash back), clear the hover, cancel the animation and re-enable the hits.
   - Then mark it off the rail, call `place()` so the gap closes (.34 s), update both counts and show the toast "<Name> is in your bag."

### Bag panel

The bag or the pill opens it (any product window closes first). Same scrim and blur.

- **Panel:** `min(430px,92vw) × min(86vh,720px)`, padding 40/30/26.
- **Title:** "Your pearl-pink picks.", Inter 27/600, −.025em.
- **Rows:**
  - a 62×80 thumbnail (`#F3E6DE`, radius 10, the front sprite fitted to 54×70)
  - name 14/600
  - "Colour · Size M" 12 `--muted`
  - price 13.5/600
  - an underlined "Remove" 11.5 `--muted`, which puts the dress back on the rail and calls `place()`
  - hairlines `--line`
- **Empty state:** "Nothing on hold yet. Pick a dress from the rail."
- **Footer:** "Subtotal" with a bold 19 px total.

## 7. Load sequence (one timeline, run once)

The root starts with class `js-intro`, which hides the headline spans, sentence, dresses, bag, logo, pill and caption. On the first frame, remove it and run Web Animations with `fill: backwards` and the ease `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`:

| Element | Keyframes | Duration | Delay |
|---|---|---|---|
| Logo | opacity 0 → 1, translateY(−8px) → 0 | 700 ms | 60 ms |
| Pill | opacity 0 → 1, translateY(−8px) → 0 | 700 ms | 120 ms |
| Each headline line | from opacity 0, translateY(38%), `clip-path: inset(0 0 100% 0)` to fully shown | 950 ms | 140 ms + 120 ms per line |
| Sentence | opacity 0 → 1, translateY(10px) → 0 | 900 ms | 380 ms |
| Bag | opacity 0 → 1, translateY(10px) → 0 | 800 ms | 520 ms |
| Caption | opacity 0 → 1 | 700 ms | 800 ms |
| Dresses (once both cleaned sheets are ready) | opacity 0 → 1, translateY(−14px) → 0 | 760 ms | 45 ms per dress |

Failsafe: remove `js-intro` after 2.6 s regardless.

## 8. Phones and small screens (< 820 px)

- The body scrolls vertically. The hero is in normal flow (min-height 100svh) on `radial-gradient(130% 55% at 50% 0%, #F6E5D9, transparent 70%), #EED7C9`. The room image appears only once, inside the rail strip.
- **Nav:**
  - It sits absolutely at the top.
  - Wordmark at left 20 / top 22, 27 px.
  - Pill at right 16 / top 14: 38 px tall, 12.5 px text, gap 10, padding 0 6 0 15, a 26 px count.
- **Copy block** (padding 92/20/6), replacing the in-stage headline and sentence:
  - headline: Anton `clamp(56px,17vw,84px)` / .87, −.3px
  - sentence: 15.5/1.48, max 300 px, 14 px gap
- **Rail strip** `.rack`:
  - Height: start from `min(64svh,560px)` to get `u = max(height/684, W/1148)`, then set its height to `684u`.
  - The track is `1440u` wide with overflow hidden, so you swipe through one room only. The mirrored plates are hidden.
  - Stage transform `translate(0, −200u) scale(u)` (it shows stage y 200–884).
  - Horizontal swipe only (`overflow-x: auto`, no scrollbar, `overscroll-behavior-x: contain`), starting at `scrollLeft = 292u` (the rail start). Swipe left for the bag.
  - Edges: `mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0, #000 64px, #000 calc(100% − 36px), transparent 100%)`, so the strip fades into the page colour with no seam.
- **Caption:** in flow below the strip (padding 4/20/26, min-height 92), toast at top 52.
- **Product window and bag panel:** full screen (100vw × 100dvh, no radius). The product window stacks the photo (47dvh) above the details (padding 24/22/30, title 27 px).
- **Taps:** the first tap previews (turns the dress front-on and pushes its neighbours), the second opens it.

## 9. Reduced motion

Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, turn off all transitions and animations. The intro is skipped (the dresses just appear once the sheets are ready), and Put in bag bags the dress immediately with no flight.

title: Jacket Try-On
description: Single-file, full-viewport e-commerce hero for a fictional menswear outerwear brand called VESTRA. A male model stands front-on in the centre of a pale ice-stone studio. Features interactive cursor/mouse tracking and scrub-driven interaction, cinematic looping background video integration with precision layout polish.
full_prompt:
# VESTRA — Virtual Try-On Outerwear Hero: exact recreation prompt

Build a single-file, full-viewport e-commerce hero for a fictional menswear outerwear brand called VESTRA. A male model stands front-on in the centre of a pale ice-stone studio. His jacket changes on a loop. Every few seconds, or on every scroll, the next garment's cut-out packshot flies from a product rail on the right onto his torso, the worn jacket swaps, and the product title rolls up behind a mask. The page is one screen with no scroll. It must match everything below exactly: every asset URL, element, measurement, colour, font and animation timing. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript with no libraries. Use the Web Animations API for all motion.

## 1. Assets (use these exact URLs, never re-host)

All images are loaded through the Higgsfield image proxy. Build each `src` as `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=` + encodeURIComponent(ORIGINAL) + `&w=` + WIDTH + `&q=85`. WIDTH is 2048 on desktop. On screens narrower than 820 px it is 1280 for the plates and 1024 for the packshot sheet. Each ORIGINAL is `https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/` followed by the file name below.

| Role | File name (append to the CloudFront prefix) | Native size | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Base plate: model in a plain black crew-neck tee and charcoal trousers, hands in pockets, seamless ice-stone backdrop with soft mist in the bottom corners, no UI | hf_20261115_071307_1d0f42d5-b05f-4e21-bf76-f52fb4b12bb5.png | 2048×1360 | Always visible underneath |
| Wear plate 0: the same model and pose wearing the glossy ice-grey puffer | hf_20261115_071402_80cf9c12-dd74-45cf-a639-1f8580543ff3.png | 2048×1360 | Product 0 |
| Wear plate 1: sage-green fleece zip jacket | hf_20261115_071402_63307d14-96fd-4b18-bae5-034018df0692.png | 2048×1360 | Product 1 |
| Wear plate 2: light-grey technical hooded shell | hf_20261115_071402_01ef6ea1-a2e6-4d0d-83ce-cbae31202ccc.png | 2048×1360 | Product 2 |
| Wear plate 3: deep-navy hooded parka | hf_20261115_071400_47a4d43c-8f7c-4f0a-b860-1dc753202b92.png | 2048×1360 | Product 3 |
| Packshot sheet: 2×2 grid of the four jackets as ghost-mannequin cut-outs on a transparent background | hf_20261115_071304_55f839b8-7976-43af-8b07-b439c6be0936.png | 2048×2048, alpha | Shown as CSS background-position crops |

All five plates share identical framing. The model is horizontally centred, with his head top at about plate y 150 and his garment centred at plate (1012, 640). A jacket on the body is about 600 plate px wide.

Packshot crop boxes inside the 2048×2048 sheet, given as x, y, width, height in sheet pixels:

| Product | Box |
|---|---|
| 0 Alpine Puffer (top-left) | 134, 79, 760, 863 |
| 1 Ridge Fleece (top-right) | 1138, 79, 790, 863 |
| 2 Drift Shell (bottom-left) | 137, 1024, 748, 901 |
| 3 Harbor Parka (bottom-right) | 1146, 1011, 776, 966 |

To draw packshot i at scale k (sheet px to screen px), make an element w·k × h·k in size. Set background-image to the sheet, background-size to 2048k × 2048k, background-position to (−x·k, −y·k), and background-repeat to no-repeat.

## 2. Product data (exact strings)

| # | Title (left column) | Price | Cart-pill name (rendered uppercase) | Cart-pill sub-label |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Alpine Puffer | $238.00 | Alpine Puffer Jacket | Ice Grey |
| 1 | Ridge Fleece | $148.00 | Ridge Fleece Jacket | Sage |
| 2 | Drift Shell | $196.00 | Drift Shell Jacket | Light Grey |
| 3 | Harbor Parka | $284.00 | Harbor Parka | Navy |

Product 0 is active on load.

## 3. Fonts

- Inter, as a variable font (100–900), latin subset: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/inter/v20/UcC73FwrK3iLTeHuS_nVMrMxCp50SjIa1ZL7.woff2. All UI text uses it, at weights 400 and 500.
- Archivo ExtraBold 800 at font-stretch 125% (Expanded), latin: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/archivo/v25/k3k6o8UDI-1M0wlSV9XAw6lQkqWY8Q8EsJaRE-NWIDdgffTTtDRZ9xdp.woff2. It is used only for the VESTRA wordmark.
- Declare each with @font-face and font-display: swap. Declare Inter with font-weight 100 900. Declare Archivo with font-weight 800 and font-stretch 125%. The standalone file embeds both woff2 files as base64 data URIs.

## 4. Colour tokens

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| bg | #DEE4E8 | page and hero background (matches the plate backdrop) |
| nav | #F5F7F8 | nav bar; also the loading tiles |
| ink | #18222D | all primary text, borders, the button fill, the active pagination dash, the badge |
| muted | #56616A | eyebrow and pill sub-label |
| white | #FFFFFF | cart pill, button text |
| nav border | rgba(24,34,45,.06) | 1 px under the nav |
| dash idle | rgba(24,34,45,.22) | inactive pagination dashes |
| scroller track | rgba(24,34,45,.10) | right-edge indicator track |

Text contrast: ink on bg is about 13:1 and muted on bg is about 5:1, both passing AA.

## 5. Scaling system

The design is measured on a 1440×900 frame. Desktop unit: `--u = min(100vw/1440, 100vh/900)`, and every desktop size below is a number times `--u`. Elements are anchored to the viewport edges, not to a centred frame. The left column is pinned to the left edge, the rail to the right edge, the cart pill to the bottom centre, and the nav to the top. Vertical positions of the copy and rail are offsets from the viewport's vertical centre (50vh). The breakpoint is 820 px: below it the phone layout applies (section 9). html and body are 100% tall, overflow hidden, and the background is bg. The hero is position: fixed with inset 0, overflow hidden and touch-action none.

## 6. Desktop layout (values at 1440×900, where u = 1)

Plates: one container holds six stacked images: the base, then wear plates 0–3. Wear plates have opacity 0 except the active one, which has opacity 1. The container is 2048×1360 with transform-origin top-left, transformed by translate(ox, oy) scale(ps):
- ps = max(vw/2048, vh/1360) (cover)
- ox = (vw − 2048·ps)/2
- oy starts as (vh − 1360·ps)/2. It is then clamped so the head stays below the nav: oy = min(0, max(oy, navHeight + 18u − 150·ps)), where navHeight = max(44u, 40px). In short, wide windows the crop comes off the bottom.

At 1440×900 the result is ps 0.703, and the model spans about x 500–925 with his head top near y 86.

- Centre: "VESTRA", absolutely centred at left 50% and top 50% with translate(−50%,−50%). Archivo 800, stretch 125%, font-size max(19.5u, 17px), letter-spacing 0.01em, line-height 1. At 1440 it renders about 106 px wide.

  - Account: circle cx12 cy8 r4, plus the shoulders path M4.5 20.5 c1.2-3.8 4-5.5 7.5-5.5 s6.3 1.7 7.5 5.5 z.

Left copy column: absolute, left 42u, top = 50vh − 183u, z-index 3.
- Eyebrow "NEW SEASON": Inter 500, 11.4u, letter-spacing 0.22em, uppercase, muted, line-height 1. It spans x 42–144 and y ≈265–279.
- Title: an h1 in a mask wrapper (overflow hidden, position relative) holding one span. Margin-top 16u, Inter 400, 55.7u, letter-spacing −0.022em, line-height 1.12, nowrap, ink. "Alpine Puffer" spans x 42–366 and y ≈291–358.

The text is Inter 400 at 14.5u, followed after a gap of 12u by a 15u right-arrow SVG (M2 8 h11, M9 4 l4 4-4 4, stroke 1.4). The box is x 42–181, y 427–469. On hover the fill becomes ink and the text white, with a 0.3 s transition.

Product rail: an absolute full-screen layer at z-index 2 with pointer-events none. Only its packshots take pointer events and show the pointer cursor. Two packshots are visible: active+1 in slot 0 and active+2 in slot 1, wrapping modulo 4. Packshot scale s = 0.335u. Each packshot is vertically centred on cy = 50vh − 13u, so its top is cy − h·s/2.
- Slot 0 left edge: vw − 393u (x 1047 at 1440).

It is a flex row with items centred, padding 0 10u 0 12u, z-index 5. At 1440×900 it spans x 483–957 and y 788–848. Contents, left to right:
- Thumbnail: 42u square, radius 4u. It is the active product's packshot from the sheet, fitted inside at 92% and centred.
- Meta block: margin-left 15u, flex 1, line-height 1.25. The name is Inter 500 at 13u, letter-spacing 0.01em, uppercase, single line with ellipsis. The sub-label is Inter 400 at 11.5u, muted, margin-top 3u.
