"Drag to explore": absolute, right 44u, bottom 66u. Inter 400 at 14.5u in ink, followed after a gap of 12u by the same 15u arrow. It spans x 1264–1396.

## 7. The garment swap (exact timeline, 1200 ms in total)

A swap to target product T, from current product A, runs these steps. The two worn jackets cross-dissolve; the base plate (black tee) never shows during a swap.

| Time (ms) | What happens | Easing |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | Layer order: wear plate A gets z-index 1 and stays fully opaque; wear plate T gets z-index 2 and class "on" (its animation holds it at opacity 0 until its delay ends) | — |
| 100–350 | Old title span and old price span translate from Y 0 to −105% inside their masks. They are set absolute (top-left) as soon as the swap starts and removed when done | cubic-bezier(.55,0,.8,.3) |
| 100–300 | Every rail packshot except the flyer fades to 0 | linear |
| 60–1010 | Glide: T's packshot is moved out of the rail into the hero itself (its own layer, so the rail refill cannot cut the flight short). It translates from its rail slot to the torso while scaling up, one transform animation of 950 ms. The end transform puts its box centre at (ox + 1012·ps, oy + 710·ps), scaled by k = (0.86 · 600 · ps)/(760 · s), so it lands slightly smaller and lower than the worn jacket and never covers the face. Transform-origin is the centre, z-index 4 | cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.3,1): fast start, long soft landing |
| 60–1070 | Flyer opacity, a separate 1010 ms animation with keyframes 1 → 1 at 0.45 → 0.6 at 0.72 → 0. It is removed when this finishes. If the packshot was not in the rail (going backwards), it is created at slot 0 and its keyframes start at 0, reaching 1 at 0.18 | ease-in-out |
| 350–800 | New title and new price spans translate from Y 105% to 0 inside their masks | cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1) |
| 420–1180 | Wear plate T fades from opacity 0 to 1 on top of A. When it finishes, A loses class "on" | cubic-bezier(.45,0,.25,1) |
| 600 | The rail is rebuilt with T+1 in slot 0 and T+2 in slot 1. Each new packshot enters from 45u to the right of its slot at opacity 0, reaching its slot at opacity 1 over 350 ms. The active pagination dash moves to T. The cart pill's thumbnail, name, sub-label and price fade to 0 over 150 ms, are swapped, then fade back to 1 | cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1) |
| 1200 | The swap is complete. If another swap was requested during this one, it runs now; otherwise the autoplay timer restarts | — |

The motion copies the reference video: the next jacket travels from the rail and settles softly onto the model while the worn jacket changes underneath it, and the title rolls up behind a mask.

## 8. Triggers, scroll and autoplay

- Autoplay loop: after the loading reveal (at 600 ms), schedule the next product (active+1, wrapping 3 to 0) after a 2000 ms hold. Each swap restarts the hold when it finishes, so the jackets cycle about every 3.2 s forever.
- Scroll (desktop): listen for wheel events on the window with passive false and call preventDefault (the page never scrolls). Scrolling down goes to the next jacket and scrolling up to the previous one. Every scroll counts:
  - Convert the delta to pixels: deltaMode 1 × 16, deltaMode 2 × the viewport height.
  - Add it to an accumulator, which resets when the direction changes or after 250 ms without wheel events.
  - When the accumulator reaches ±50 px and at least 140 ms have passed since the last step, take one step in that direction and reset the accumulator. One mouse-wheel notch (100 px) is therefore always one jacket, and the 140 ms gap stops trackpad momentum from racing through the rail.
- Stepping: step(dir) moves one jacket from wherever the page is heading. If a swap is running, the base is the queued target rather than the current one. A request made during a running swap replaces the queue with that target (or clears it if the target equals the current jacket), and runs when the swap finishes. Rapid scrolls therefore all register: five quick notches down land five jackets along.
- Touch: a pointer movement of more than 40 px on release counts as a swipe. A mainly horizontal swipe goes next (left) or previous (right). A mainly vertical touch swipe goes next (finger up, like scrolling down) or previous (finger down). The hero has touch-action: none.
- Click a rail packshot: swap to that product. Clicks that end a drag are ignored.
- Keys: ArrowRight, ArrowDown and PageDown go next. ArrowLeft, ArrowUp and PageUp go back.
- User control: any scroll, swipe, drag, key press or rail click sets a 6000 ms user hold. Autoplay waits until 6 s after the last user input before moving on, so it never undoes a scroll back.
- Pausing the loop (the visitor can stop it):
  - While a mouse pointer is over a packshot, the cart pill or the Shop Now button. It resumes when the pointer leaves those elements or leaves the window.
  - While a pointer is pressed on the hero (dragging or touching).
  - While the tab is hidden, using visibilitychange.

## 9. Loading reveal

A fixed grid of tiles covers the whole viewport at z-index 20, coloured nav (#F5F7F8). It has 10 columns × 6 rows on desktop and 5 × 9 on phones. The tile order is shuffled with Fisher–Yates. Over 600 ms, tiles are hidden instantly (no fade) in that order, so tile n is hidden once elapsed/600 × count ≥ n. The overlay is removed when all tiles are hidden, with a 1000 ms safety removal. The reveal starts when the base plate and wear plate 0 have decoded, or after a 1800 ms failsafe.

## 10. Phone layout (below 820 px)

`--u = 100vw/390`. The nav is 52 px tall with 16 px padding. "Collections" is 14 px, the wordmark 19 px, the icons 21 px with a gap of 20 px, and the badge 15 px.

Copy: left 20 px, right 20 px, top 76 px.
- Eyebrow 10.5 px.
- Title clamp(34px, 10vw, 44px) with margin-top 12 px.
- Price 19 px with margin-top 8 px.
- Shop Now 38 px tall, padding 0 16 px, 13.5 px text.

The stage runs from 8 px below the bottom of the Shop Now button to vh − 82 px. The plates are scaled with ps = min(stageHeight/1080, 0.64·vw/600) and placed so the garment centre (plate x 1012) sits at 39% of the viewport width, with oy = stageTop − 120·ps. The plate container gets a soft mask: the intersection of two linear gradients, horizontal and vertical, each transparent → black at 9% → black at 91% → transparent. The plate edges dissolve into the matching bg colour with no seams.

The rail packshot scale is s = 0.29·ps. Slot 0 is at vw − 102u and slot 1 at vw − 10u (only a sliver shows). The rail centre is at stageTop + 0.40·stageHeight, and the dashes sit 500·s below it. The dashes are 2 px tall, idle 5 px, active 18 px, with a gap of 4 px.

Cart pill: left and right 12 px, bottom 12 px plus the safe-area inset, height 58 px, radius 12 px.
- Thumbnail 40 px.
- Name 12 px and sub-label 11 px.
- Price 13 px.
- Button 40 px tall, padding 0 13 px, 13 px text, radius 8 px.

"Drag to explore" and the right-edge indicator are hidden. Swiping the stage swaps, and touching it holds the autoplay.

On short phones in landscape (below 820 px wide and below 520 px tall): copy top 64 px, title 28 px, price 16 px, Shop Now 34 px tall.

On screens 820 px and wider, including landscape phones, the desktop layout applies. The nav values use the max() floors above so the bar never collapses.

## 11. Reduced motion

With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, there are no tiles and no autoplay. Swaps triggered by click, swipe or keys are instant: the plate class switches, the title and price text are replaced, the rail is rebuilt and the pill updates, with no animation.

## 12. Acceptance checklist

- At 1440×900 the title spans x 42–366, the cart pill x 483–957 / y 788–848, the first packshot sits at x 1047, and the wordmark is centred and about 106 px wide.
- On load the tiles clear in about 0.6 s in random order, then the puffer is shown.
- After a 2 s hold, the fleece glides from the rail onto the model while the tee shows briefly, the title rolls to "Ridge Fleece", the rail refills from the right, and the pill shows "RIDGE FLEECE JACKET · Sage · $148.00". The order then loops through Drift Shell, Harbor Parka and back to Alpine Puffer.
- Hovering a packshot or the pill stops the loop, and leaving restarts it. Click, drag and the arrow keys all work.
- Each scroll notch moves exactly one jacket (down forward, up back), five rapid notches move five, and autoplay then waits 6 s.
- During a swap the tee never shows, and the incoming packshot glides onto the torso and dissolves into the worn jacket over about 1.2 s.
- The phone at 390×844 shows no seams and no horizontal scroll.
- All images load from images.higgs.ai and both fonts render.

title: Kids Store
description: Single-screen, full-viewport hero for a fictional premium kids' clothing brand called BUNTO°. It is one HTML file with inline CSS and JavaScript, no frameworks and no build step. Features interactive cursor/mouse tracking and scrub-driven interaction, dynamic canvas particle and fluid simulation with precision layout polish.
full_prompt:
# BUNTO° — kids' basics hero with a rotating garment ring

Build a single-screen, full-viewport hero for a fictional premium kids' clothing brand called BUNTO°. It is one HTML file with inline CSS and JavaScript, no frameworks and no build step. The page never scrolls (body overflow hidden). Everything below is exact; follow the numbers, the copy and the timings as written.

## 1. Overall idea

A warm off-white page with tiny wide-tracked all-caps labels around the edges, a huge pale ghost word "TINY" behind the centre, and six floating kids' garments arranged on an invisible horizontal ring that turns slowly and continuously, left to right across the front. The front piece is the largest, straight and highest. The side pieces are smaller, lower and lean outwards. The back pieces sit lower still, tucked behind the side pieces. Visitors can drag or fling the ring with mouse or touch. Hovering a piece updates the large index number bottom-left. Clicking any piece opens a product view: the ring freezes, the chosen piece glides to the left and grows, the others shrink and drift out to the sides, a round close button appears on the piece, and a product panel with name, description, four colour swatches and an "Add to bag" link fades in on the right. Swatches swap the garment's colourway in place. "Add to bag" flies a shrinking copy of the garment in an arc into the bag icon in the top bar, which bounces and shows a count badge.

## 2. Assets

There is one image. It is a transparent sprite sheet, 3200 × 2560 px, laid out as 5 columns × 4 rows of equal 640 × 640 cells, each cell holding one garment centred on a transparent background.

- Sheet URL (use exactly this, it serves a transparent WebP): `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261113_115509_577e7e29-0e80-43e6-93ac-e6cf71972818.png&w=3200&q=85`
- Original PNG behind it: `https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261113_115509_577e7e29-0e80-43e6-93ac-e6cf71972818.png`
- Columns (products), left to right: 0 = cotton dungarees with bib pocket and rolled cuffs, 1 = sleeveless knit romper with wooden shoulder buttons, 2 = long-sleeve cotton tee with a chest pocket, 3 = chunky knit button cardigan with wooden buttons, 4 = bucket hat.
- Rows (colourways), top to bottom: 0 = Peach, 1 = Pink, 2 = Sage, 3 = Butter.
- Show one cell by putting the sheet on an element as `background-image`, `background-size: 500% 400%`, `background-repeat: no-repeat`, and `background-position: (col × 25)% (row × 33.333)%`. Never crop or re-host the image; every garment on the page is a CSS crop of this one sheet.
- Store the sheet URL once as a CSS custom property `--sheet: url("…")` on `:root` and reuse it.
- Add a hidden inline SVG filter, `<filter id="clean" color-interpolation-filters="sRGB">` containing `<feComponentTransfer><feFuncA type="linear" slope="1.1" intercept="-0.1"/></feComponentTransfer>`, and apply `filter: url(#clean)` to every garment layer. It removes faint compression specks around the cut-outs.

## 3. Fonts

One family: Inter, variable weight 200–700, latin subset, from Google Fonts: `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@200..700&display=swap` (self-host the latin woff2 as `@font-face { font-family: "Inter"; font-weight: 200 700; font-display: swap }` if you prefer). Fallback `system-ui, sans-serif`. Turn on `-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased`.

Weights in use: 200 for the big index number, 500 for all small caps labels and the product title, 600 for the bag count, 700 for the logo and the ghost word.

## 4. Colour tokens

- `--bg #F9F2E9` page background (warm cream)
- `--ghost #F5E6D9` ghost word "TINY"
- `--ink #3E3A3C` all text and icons
- `--muted #716D71` product description and category label
- `--line #E6D9D2` hairline borders of the round bag and close buttons
- `--dot #CFC6C2` inactive pagination dots (active dot uses `--ink`)
- Swatch colours: Peach `#FEDBDA`, Pink `#FCB7CC`, Sage `#C8C997`, Butter `#F5B55A`
- Floor shadow: radial gradient `rgba(120,96,86,.16)` at the centre → `rgba(120,96,86,.07)` at 55% → transparent, blurred by 3 design px.

## 5. Head

- `<title>BUNTO° — Soft things for small people</title>`
- Meta description: "Premium organic-cotton basics for ages 1–6: rompers, dungarees, tees, cardigans and hats in soft peach, pink, sage and butter."
- `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">`, `lang="en"`.

## 6. Scaling system

Two units, both relative to a 1440 × 900 design frame:

- `--n: calc(100vw/1440)` is the chrome unit. Edge-pinned UI (logo, labels, nav, index, scroll hint) is placed with it relative to the viewport edges.
- `--u: min(100vw/1440, 100vh/900)` is the stage unit. A `.stage` box of `1440u × 900u` is centred in the viewport (`left:50%; top:50%; transform: translate(-50%,-50%)`), and everything inside it (ghost word, shadow, dots, garments, close button, product panel) is positioned in design px multiplied by `--u`.

All small caps text uses a `max(9px, …)` or `max(8px, …)` floor so it never becomes unreadable.

## 7. Layout (desktop, design px at 1440 × 900)

Reusable caps style `.caps`: `font-size: max(9px, 10.5n)`, weight 500, `letter-spacing: .32em`, uppercase, line-height 1.62.

Edge chrome (positioned in `n` units from the viewport edges):

1. Logo, top-left: "BUNTO" plus a superscript "°", a link to "/". Left 46, top 30, font-size `max(22px, 30n)`, weight 700, letter-spacing −0.035em, line-height 1. The "°" is a `<sup>` at 0.5em, weight 500, raised `vertical-align: .9em`, margin-left .04em.
2. Tagline, top centre: two lines "SOFT THINGS FOR SMALL PEOPLE" / "AGES 1–6", caps style, centred at 50% horizontally, top 37, no wrapping, with `padding-left: .32em` to optically centre the tracking.
3. Nav, top-right: right 39, top 32, a flex row with a 16n gap: the caps link "MENU" (font-size `max(9px, 9.5n)`), then a round bag button. The bag button is `max(28px, 35n)` square, 1px `--line` border, fully round, centred icon at 42% size. The icon is an outline bag (16 × 16 viewBox, stroke 1.3): path `M3.5 5.5h9l-.7 8h-7.6z` for the body and `M5.8 5.5V4.4a2.2 2.2 0 0 1 4.4 0v1.1` for the handle. Inside the button sits a count badge (see section 11), and the button has `aria-label="Bag, 0 items"`.
4. Left label: "THE BASICS — 16 PIECES", caps, left 46, top 131.
5. Right label: "ORGANIC COTTON" / "KNIT", caps, right-aligned, right 38, top 132.
6. Vertical label on the far left edge: "EVERYDAY ESSENTIALS FOR LITTLE EXPLORERS", caps at `max(8px, 9n)`, rotated −90°, centred on left 26, top 447 (a zero-width flex box centred on that point, translated −50% vertically, then rotated).
7. Index, bottom-left: left 46, bottom 52, a flex row of: a big number "01" (font-size `max(30px, 50n)`, weight 200, letter-spacing −0.04em, line-height 1, inside an overflow-hidden box 1em tall so it can roll), a 1px × 28n vertical bar in `--ink` at 45% opacity with 20n margins either side, and a two-line caps label (`max(8px, 9.5n)`, min-width 16em) "ROMPER" / "COLLECTION". A second label, "CHOOSE" / "A COLOUR", is stacked on top of it, absolutely positioned and hidden (opacity 0, translateY 8px). Both labels transition opacity and transform over .45s ease.
8. Scroll hint, bottom centre: bottom 59, centred, a down arrow (11 × 16 viewBox, stroke 1.2, path `M5.5 1v13M1.5 10l4 4 4-4`, width 11n, min 8px) and "SCROLL TO EXPLORE" in caps at `max(8px, 9.5n)`, 14n gap.

Stage contents (design px × `u`, inside the centred 1440 × 900 stage):

1. Ghost word "TINY": full-width centred, top 109, font-size 295, weight 700, letter-spacing −0.02em, line-height 1, colour `--ghost`, no pointer events, not selectable, `aria-hidden`.
2. Floor shadow: an ellipse at left 370, top 690, 700 × 48, fully round, the radial gradient from section 4, blur 3.
3. Pagination dots: five 9 × 9 round dots (min 6px), 21 apart, centred at y 752. They are decorative (`aria-hidden`). The dot at index (front piece index mod 5) is `--ink`; the rest are `--dot`. Colour transition .5s.
4. Six garment elements (`.item`), each a 510 × 510 box whose centre is the transform origin (width/height 510u, negative margins of 255u, then positioned purely with `transform`). Each holds two full-size layers, `.art` and `.art2`, showing the sheet crop. `.art2` starts at opacity 0 and is used for colour cross-fades. Items are `role="button"`, focusable (`tabindex=0`), with `aria-label` like "Peach Romper", and `cursor: pointer`.
5. Close button (product view only): a 44 × 44 round button (min 34px), 1px `--line` border, background `rgba(249,242,233,.7)`, centred × icon (12 × 12 viewBox, stroke 1.3, path `M1.5 1.5l9 9M10.5 1.5l-9 9`, 36% size), `aria-label="Close"`, z-index 300. Hidden by default: opacity 0, `translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.6)`, no pointer events. Its border turns `--ink` on hover.
6. Product panel (product view only): left 905, top 368, width 400. In order: a category line (caps at `max(8px, 9.5u)`, colour `--muted`), the product name as an h2 (font-size 34u, weight 500, letter-spacing −0.025em, line-height 1.1, margins 12u above and 14u below), the description paragraph (font-size `max(12px, 14u)`, line-height 1.6, `--muted`, max 30em), a swatch row (flex, 12u gap, margins 26u top and 30u bottom) of four 24u round colour buttons (min 18px, `role="radio"` inside a `role="radiogroup"` with `aria-label="Colour"`), and finally an "ADD TO BAG →" text button (caps at `max(8px, 9.5u)`, 1px `--ink` underline as a bottom border, 4px bottom padding). The selected swatch shows a 1px `--ink` ring 5u outside it at 70% opacity (a `::after` that scales from .8 to 1 over .3s).

## 8. The ring (the core motion)

Products in ring order (index: column, starting row): 0 = Romper Peach (1, 0), 1 = Tee Pink (2, 1), 2 = Dungarees Sage (0, 2), 3 = Cardigan Butter (3, 3), 4 = Bucket hat Pink (4, 1), 5 = Cardigan Sage (3, 2). The colours alternate so neighbours never match.

Product copy:

- Dungarees: category "Dungarees · Ages 1–5"; description "Washed cotton twill with a bib pocket, adjustable straps and rolled-up cuffs."
- Romper: "Romper · Ages 1–3"; "Soft knit in organic cotton, with wooden shoulder buttons and snaps for easy changes."
- Tee: "Long-sleeve tee · Ages 1–6"; "Heavyweight organic jersey with a little chest pocket and ribbed cuffs."
- Cardigan: "Cardigan · Ages 1–6"; "Chunky hand-feel knit with wooden buttons, made for layering on cool mornings."
- Bucket hat: "Bucket hat · Ages 1–6"; "Garment-dyed cotton canvas with a soft brim that folds into any pocket."

The product name is "<Colour> <Kind>", for example "Peach Romper" or "Sage Cardigan".

Geometry, in design px, run every animation frame with `requestAnimationFrame`:

- Constants: centre `CX = 718`, `CY = 418`, radius `R = 411`, vertical drop `DROP = 110`, base scale `S0 = 0.97`, tilt `TILT = 9°`, `N = 6`, `STEP = 2π/6`.
- Piece *i* sits at angle `θ = base + i·STEP`. Let `c = cos θ`, `s = sin θ` and `k = (1 + c)/2` (1 at the front, 0 at the back).
- x = `CX + R·s`; y = `CY + (1 − k)·DROP`; scale = `S0·(0.72 + 0.28·k)`; z-index = `round(k·100) + 1`; rotation = `TILT·s` degrees, so pieces on the left lean outwards anticlockwise, pieces on the right lean outwards clockwise, and the front piece is straight.
- Apply it as `transform: translate(x·u, y·u) scale(scale) rotate(rotation deg)`.
- Auto-turn: `base` grows by `OMEGA·dt` every frame, where `OMEGA = STEP / 4.2 s`. One slot every 4.2 s and a full turn every ≈ 25 s. Because x = R·sin θ, the front pieces travel left to right, come round behind on the right, and re-emerge on the left. Clamp `dt` to 50 ms, and do not advance while the tab is hidden.
- Front piece: the one with the largest cos θ. It drives which pagination dot is active.

Drag and fling:

- `pointerdown` on the stage (left button only, not in the product view) starts a drag. The stage has `touch-action: pan-y` (vertical page scrolling still works on phones), `cursor: grab`, and `cursor: grabbing` while dragging, with user-select disabled.
- `pointermove` (on window): convert the horizontal pointer delta to design px (divide by stage width / 1440) and add `dx / R` to `base`, so the front piece tracks the pointer. Keep a smoothed velocity `v = 0.6·v + 0.4·(dθ per 16.7 ms)`. Once the accumulated movement passes 6 design px, mark the gesture as a drag, add the `dragging` class and capture the pointer. A drag never opens a piece.
- On `pointerup` or `pointercancel`: if it was a drag, start a fling of `clamp(v, ±0.12)` rad per frame. Each frame add the fling to `base` and multiply it by `0.92^(dt·60)` until it falls below 0.0005. At release the auto-turn weight drops to 0 and climbs back to 1 at 0.8 per second, so the throw blends smoothly back into the slow turn.
- The auto-turn and the fling pause during a drag and while a piece is open.

Hover: entering a piece sets the index to that piece's number (01–06) and the label to "<KIND>" / "COLLECTION". Leaving resets it to "01" / "ROMPER COLLECTION". The number change is a vertical roll: the current digits slide up out of view (translateY −110%, .7s `cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1)`), then after 300 ms the new digits jump to +110% with no transition and roll back to 0.

## 9. Product view (click)

- Clicking (or pressing Enter/Space on) any visible piece opens it. Add class `detail` to the hero. A blend value `d` animates 0 → 1 over 560 ms with ease-in-out cubic (`t<.5 ? 4t³ : 1 − (−2t+2)³/2`). Closing animates it back to 0 the same way.
- Chosen piece: interpolate from its live ring pose to a target. Desktop target x 470, y 425, scale 1.12; phone target x 716, y 300, scale 0.86. Rotation goes to 0, and z-index becomes 300.
- Every other piece: move outwards along x by `240·d` (away from the chosen piece's ring x), multiply its scale by `1 − 0.45·d`, multiply its opacity by `max(0, 1 − 1.4·d)`, and disable its pointer events.
- Floor shadow: translate by `((targetX − 718)·0.82·d, (targetY − 418)·d)` design px (an extra −60·d px vertically on phones) and scaleX `1 − 0.45·d`, so it settles under the opened piece.
- Pagination dots fade to `opacity: 1 − d`.
- The ring stops turning while open and resumes from the same angle after closing.
- Close button: placed at `(targetX + 205·targetScale, targetY − 200·targetScale)` design px, which is the top-right corner of the opened garment. With class `detail` it becomes opacity 1, scale 1 and clickable, after a .25s delay (opacity .35s ease, transform .45s `cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)`). Focus moves to it.
- Product panel: each child starts at opacity 0 and translateY 18u. In detail it goes to opacity 1 and none, with opacity .55s ease, transform .7s `cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)`, staggered by 60 ms per child (0, .06, .12, .18, .24 s).
- Index: shows the opened piece's number. The "KIND / COLLECTION" label fades out upwards (−8px) while "CHOOSE / A COLOUR" fades in from +8px.
- Closing: the close button, the Escape key or keyboard all reverse everything. Focus returns to the piece and the index resets to 01 / ROMPER COLLECTION.

Colour swatches: clicking a swatch puts the new row's crop on `.art2`, adds a `swap` class (opacity transition .35s), and fades `.art2` to 1. After 360 ms it copies the crop to `.art`, hides `.art2` again without a transition, and plays a small scale bounce on the piece (×(1 + 0.035·sin(π·t)) over 420 ms). The product name, the aria-label, the selected ring and `aria-checked` all update.

## 10. Entrance (on load, once)

Wait until the sheet image has loaded (with a 2.5 s failsafe), then:

- Every chrome element starts hidden (class `rv`, opacity 0, only applied when JS has run) and is animated with the Web Animations API from opacity 0 and translateY 14px (its existing transform preserved) to its rest state. Each takes 1000 ms with `cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)`, staggered 80 ms + 60 ms × order. The order is logo, tagline, nav, left label, right label, vertical label, ghost, shadow, dots, index, scroll hint. The ghost word is the exception: 1400 ms rising from 40px, starting at 150 ms. When each animation finishes, remove `rv` and cancel the animation so later inline styles (dot fade, shadow move) take over.
- The ring rises in at the same time, starting 300 ms after load and taking 1.6 s overall. Each piece's progress is `clamp((entered·1600 − (1 − cos θ)·260)/1000)` with ease-out cubic, so the front pieces arrive first and the back pieces a little later. Each piece moves up 36 design px into place, scales from 0.95 to 1, and fades from 0 to 1.

## 11. Add to bag

- Clicking "ADD TO BAG →" takes the opened piece's on-screen rectangle and the bag button's rectangle. It creates a fixed-position copy (`.fly`, z-index 1000, no pointer events) of the same size with the same sheet crop and colour, the `#clean` filter plus `drop-shadow(0 10px 14px rgba(90,70,60,.18))`.
- The copy flies along a quadratic Bézier from the piece's top-left to the point that centres it on the bag. The control point is at x = start + 0.62·(end − start), y = max(0, min(startY, endY) − 0.12·height). The path is sampled into 25 keyframes. The scale rises to 1.06 over the first 12% (sine), then shrinks to `max(0.04, bagWidth·0.9/width)` with an exponent of 0.55, so it shrinks early. The rotation is `−14·sin(π·t)` degrees, and the opacity drops by 60% over the last 10%. Duration 950 ms, easing `cubic-bezier(.45,0,.25,1)`.
- On landing: remove the copy and increment the count. The badge (a 17px-tall pill at the bag's top-right, −5px offsets, `--ink` background, `--bg` text, 9.5px weight 600) pops in from scale 0 with `cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)` .45s. The bag button wiggles (scale 1 → 1.28 with −8° → 0.94 with 4° → 1, 520 ms ease-out), the badge pulses (scale 1.45, 420 ms, 60 ms delay), and the bag's aria-label becomes "Bag, N item(s)".
- The button text changes to "ADDED TO BAG ✓" and goes back to "ADD TO BAG →" after 1.8 s. The garment in the product view stays where it is.

## 12. Phone (max-width 820px and min-height 521px)

- `--u: min(100vw/600, 100vh/1100)`, so the ring is larger relative to the screen and its side and back pieces run off the edges.
- Hidden: the tagline, both side labels, the vertical label and the "MENU" text.
- The logo is at left 20, top 22, 24px; the bag is at right 20, top 18. The stage centre is at 45% of the viewport height. The ghost word is 250u at top 150u.
- The index is at left 20, bottom 26, with a 34px number, a 22px bar and 12px margins. The scroll hint becomes just the arrow at right 20, bottom 34.
- Product view: the piece goes to x 716, y 300, scale 0.86, centred above the panel. The panel is centred (left `calc(50% − 270u)`, top 585u, width 540u), with a 24px title, a 13px description at line-height 1.5, 9px caps lines, and swatches with a 12px gap and 12/14px margins. The close button follows the same formula, so it sits at the top-right of the piece.

Landscape phone (max-width 820px and max-height 520px): use the desktop layout with `--u: min(100vw/1440, 100vh/900)` and `--n: calc(100vw/1000)`, the stage centred at 50%, the panel at left 905u, top 330u, width 430u, a 20px title and an 11px description. At any height up to 520px, hide the vertical label.

## 13. Reduced motion

With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`: no entrance animation (everything visible at once), no auto-turn, a product-view blend of about 1 ms, no fly animation (the badge just counts), no colour cross-fade, and transitions off for the panel, index, dots, shadow and swatch layers. Dragging still works.

## 14. Acceptance checklist

- At 1440 × 900 the ring turns slowly and continuously, left to right at the front, one piece every 4.2 s, with no jumps.
- The side pieces lean outwards about 9° at most, the front piece is straight, and the back pieces are lower and partly hidden.
- Dragging turns the ring under the pointer, a fling coasts and blends back into the auto-turn, and a drag never opens a piece.
- Clicking any piece runs the 560 ms transition into the product view, with the close button on the piece's top-right, and closing restores the ring at the same angle.
- All four swatches swap the colourway with a cross-fade, and the title updates.
- Add to bag flies the garment into the bag, the bag bounces, and the count increments every time.
- At 390 × 844 there is no sideways scroll, the product view stacks the piece above the panel, and the close button stays on the piece.
- No text other than the copy listed here, and no extra decoration.

full_prompt:
# HERO PROMPT — "MAISON EDIT" build-your-look virtual try-on (exact recreation)

Build one self-contained `index.html` with inline `<style>` and `<script>`, no framework and no build step. It must recreate the "Maison Edit — Build Your Look" virtual try-on page exactly as specified below.

The page is a wide, warm off-white fashion web app with three columns:

1. **Shop panel (left).** Logo above the panel, then search, category tabs, stores, a product grid and a tab bar.
2. **Model (centre).** A large photoreal young Korean woman stands on a white 360° turntable platform directly on the page background. Around her are a round icon rail, a worn-items strip and a 3D/AR toggle.
3. **Look panels (right).** "YOUR LOOK" (her four pieces, the total, style & fit checks and "Shop the Look"), with a "Recommended for you" card below.

**Interaction:**
- Every piece can be swapped live on the model: tops, skirts, shoes and bags mix freely across 81 combinations.
- The model is a canvas compositor. It blends pixel-aligned photo variants through soft region masks and reveals each change with a sweep line.

**Rules:**
- Every number below is load-bearing. Where a value is given, use exactly that value.
- No real brand names.
- Do not add anything that is not described here.

**Page basics:**
- `<title>`: `Maison Edit — Build Your Look`.
- `lang="en"`, UTF-8.
- Viewport: `width=device-width,initial-scale=1`.

---

## 1. Assets (use these exact URLs)

### 1.4 Masks

There are eight soft region masks, one per variant: 340×512 RGBA PNG, white with the **alpha** channel equal to the region weight. They are embedded as data URIs; the exact strings are in the appendix at the end of this document. They were derived from the variants:

## 3. Layout (proportions from a 1344×752 design)

- **`#app`:** `height: 100vh; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,357fr) minmax(0,500fr) minmax(0,292fr); padding: 0 7.3vw`.
- **Left column:** padding `2.6vh 0 3.4vh`.

**Responsive:**

  - order is stage (`min(92svh, 820px)` tall), then the look panels, then the shop (88svh);

## 4. Shop panel (left)

**Category tabs:**

---

## 5. Stage (centre): the model straight on the page

- **`#figure`:**
  - absolute, `left: 45%; top: 3.6vh; height: 85.5vh; aspect-ratio: 1360/2048; transform: translateX(-50%)`.
  - It contains two stacked canvases, `#cOld` and `#cNew`, each 1000 × 1506 px and filling the figure, inside `#spin`, inside `#body`.
- **`#body`:** perspective 1600, `cursor: grab`, `touch-action: pan-y`.

- **Turntable `#tt`:**
  - width 112% of the figure, height `85.5vh·(1360/2048)·1.12/3.3`;
  - top edge at `98.6% − 0.40·height`, so the platform's top ellipse is centred under the feet.
  - Top face: an ellipse at `inset: 0 0 16% 0`, `radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 38%, #fdfcfb, #f3f1ee 60%, #e7e4df)`.
  - Side: an ellipse at `inset: 16% 0 0 0`, `linear-gradient(#e2dfda, #d3cfc8)`, placed behind the top face.
  - A dashed SVG ellipse ring sits on the top face: `stroke rgba(0,0,0,.13)`, dash `3 5`, pathLength 300. Its `stroke-dashoffset` animates continuously and speeds up with drag velocity.
  - The label "⟲ 360° ⟳" uses two long curved arrows that nudge outwards on hover.
- **Shadow:** an ellipse at `top: 96.6%`, 46% wide, `radial-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,.26), transparent)`, blurred 2px. It shifts with the rotation.

**Rail** at `left: 8.4%; top: 8.6vh`, a column with gap `clamp(6px, 1.2vh, 10px)`:
- **Buttons:** round, `clamp(30px, 5.2vh, 40px)`, #fbfaf8 with a soft shadow; hover scale 1.08; active is an ink fill with white icons.
- **Tooltips:** an ink pill to the right. Category buttons show "Tops · <current piece>".
- **Buttons, in order:**
  1. ← undo (disabled at 40% opacity when there is no history);
  2. body / size: toasts "Size M · 165 cm · fit profile saved";
  3. top;
  4. skirt;
  5. shoe;
  6. bag;
  7. ✦ "AI stylist · surprise me".
- A category button cycles that category to its next piece, and also sets the shop filter to that category.

**Worn strip** at `left: 75.4%; top: 10.8vh`:
- a #fbfaf8 radius-10 card holding four vertical thumbnails, `clamp(36px, 4vw, 56px)` wide;
- hovering a thumbnail outlines it in ink and highlights the matching look row;
- clicking cycles that piece;
- the thumbnail that just changed pops in from scale .6.

**3D / AR pill** at `left: 72%; top: 4vh`:
- an ink indicator slides between "3D" and "AR".
- **AR on:**
  - the room photo fades and scales in behind the model (`left / right 4%`, `top 2.6vh`, `bottom 3.4vh`, radius 16);
  - white corner brackets appear;
  - a white scan line sweeps down once;
  - a bottom label with a red pulsing dot reads "AR preview · your room".

**Drag to rotate:**
- pointer drag sets `ry = clamp(start + dx·.22, −34°, 34°)`;
- on release `ry` springs back to 0 by ×0.92 per frame.

---

## 6. Outfit compositor (the core)

**State:** `look = {t, k, s, g}`, starting as `{t1, k1, s1, g1}`, which is the base photo.

**`draw(ctx, look)`:**
1. Draw base at full size.
2. For each category in the order **shoes → skirt → top → bag**, if its key is not `*1`:
   - on an offscreen canvas, draw the variant's mask, then `source-in` the variant image (this gives the masked variant);
   - on the main canvas, use `destination-out` with the mask, which punches the region out;
   - then use `lighter` with the masked variant.

This is an exact soft replacement (premultiplied lerp), so any combination composes cleanly.

**Swap animation (`render(category)`):**
- Draw the new state into `#cNew`.
- Animate a sweep from the category's region top to its region bottom, over 720ms with ease-in-out (quadratic). Region y-ranges as fractions of the figure height: top `.07–.53`, skirt `.32–.57`, shoes `.53–1`, bag `.45–.75`.
- Each frame:
  - `#cNew` has `clip-path: inset(0 0 (100 − y)% 0)`, so it shows above the line;
  - `#cOld` has `clip-path: inset(y% 0 0 0)`, so it shows below the line.
  - This means the old outfit never shows through the transparent areas of the new one.
- A 2px white glint line with a glow rides on `y`.
- At the end, copy the state to `#cOld` and reset both clips.
- If a new change starts mid-sweep, first redraw `#cOld` with the previous state.

**`wear(key)`:**
- push the history;
- update `look`;
- render;
- sync the whole UI (§7);
- fly the clicked thumbnail to the strip slot;
- toast "Trying on · <name>".

`cycle(cat)` steps 1 → 2 → 3 → 1.

**Undo** restores the previous state and animates the changed region.

**AI stylist** steps through five curated looks, swapping their pieces one after another 520ms apart, with the toast "AI stylist · <name>":

| Look | Pieces |
|---|---|
| Monochrome minimal | t2 k1 s1 g1 |
| Wine romance | t3 k3 s3 g3 |
| Weekend denim | t1 k2 s2 g2 |
| Soft contrast | t2 k3 s3 g2 |
| Campus cool | t3 k2 s2 g3 |

---

## 7. Right column

### 7.1 Look panel

- **Header:** "YOUR LOOK" (letter-spaced .2em), with the live **total** on the right. The total counts to its new value over 600ms (ease-out cubic).
- **Four rows** (top, skirt, shoes, bag):
  - each row has a thumbnail at aspect 523/450, `height: min(9vh, 100%)`, radius 8;
  - store caps, name and price;
  - a single **›** chevron that moves 2px on hover.
  - Clicking a row cycles that piece and sets the shop filter to its category.
  - A changed row's thumbnail plays `swapIn` (scale .6 with −8° rotation, to normal, .55s spring).
  - Hovering a row outlines its strip thumbnail.
- **"STYLE & FIT":** three rows, each with a check circle that fills ink with an animated tick (staggered 140ms), the label, an ⓘ, and a right-aligned percentage that counts up. Hovering a row shows an ink bubble with its note.

| Row | Score | Bubble note |
|---|---|---|
| Fits your size | always 100 | "Size M fits your saved measurements" |
| Matches your style | 56 + 9 × (most common tag count across the worn pieces), max 99 | "Based on 4 pieces and your saved styles" |
| Complements your body shape | 78 + (k1 → 14, k3 → 10, otherwise 6) + (no sneakers → 4) | "Mini length + knee height balance your frame" |

  A row's check fills when its score is ≥ 80.

- **"Shop the Look":**
  - #2b2b2b fill, radius 9, height `clamp(36px, 5.2vh, 44px)`, with an external-link icon;
  - on click: a light sweep across it, the four look thumbnails fly into it, a white count badge appears, the label briefly reads "Added · view bag", and the toast reads "4 pieces added · $total".

### 7.2 Recommended for you

- A ✦ icon and the title.
- **Three cards:** pieces not currently worn, preferring the mood of the current top (first tag). Each card has a thumbnail at aspect 523/450, store, name and price.
- Clicking a card wears that piece.

**Toast:** a fixed ink pill at the top centre, 12px white text, spring-in, hidden after 1.8 s.

---

## 8. Acceptance checklist

- [ ] It looks like the reference composition, as a wide web page:
  - the logo sits above the left panel;
  - the model stands huge on a small white platform directly on the warm page background;
  - the rail and strip float beside her;
  - the right column holds the look and recommended panels.
- [ ] Every way of choosing a piece swaps it on the model with a sweep: grid card, recommendation, look row, strip thumbnail, rail button, stylist and undo.
- [ ] Any mix of the 12 pieces composites with no seams or leftovers, and the old piece is never visible behind the new one.
- [ ] The total, fit scores, "Wearing" tags, strip, look rows and recommendations all update together.
- [ ] Filters, search, store tiles, hearts and Saved, AR mode, drag-to-rotate and Shop the Look all work.
- [ ] It is responsive down to a phone, with a single stacked column.

---

- `t3`: `data:image/png;base64,`

full_prompt: # Arriving Tomorrow: Mix-and-Match Outfit Drop Post (exact recreation prompt) Build a single-file, interactive, square (1:1) social-media post that teases a clothing drop. On a flat light-grey card, a bold title reads "ARRIVING TOMORROW". Below it sits an oversized hoodie, with relaxed drawstring sweat shorts underneath, both shot as clean ghost-mannequin product photos, plus thin ‹ › arrows on the left and right. - **Arrows:** clicking an arrow swaps the outfit to the next colourway. The hoodie slides out one way and the shorts the other, then the new pieces cross in from the opposite sides and land with a small tilt wobble. - **Single piece:** tapping just the hoodie or just the shorts changes only that piece, and dragging a piece sideways swipes it. - **Autoplay:** when idle, the post plays itself. Every colour is made in code from one white hoodie photo and one white shorts photo. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS in one file, with no libraries. Every value below is exact. Reproduce every string, number, timing and URL as written. --- ## 1. Page basics - ``, title `Arriving Tomorrow`, viewport `width=device-width,initial-scale=1`, charset utf-8. - **Font (Google Fonts):** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter+Tight:wght@500;600&display=swap`, with preconnects to `https://fonts.googleapis.com` and `https://fonts.gstatic.com` (crossorigin). The standalone version embeds the latin woff2 faces as base64 `@font-face` rules instead of the link. - **Variables:** `--bg:#ececec`, `--ink:#111`. - **Reset and base:** - Universal `box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0`. - `html,body` fill the height, `overflow:hidden`, background `--bg`. - body font `"Inter Tight","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif`, colour ink, antialiased, `user-select:none`. ## 2. Assets (all URLs exact) Both images are transparent PNG cut-outs of WHITE garments with soft natural fabric folds, no logos and no text, served through the images.higgs.ai proxy (which sends `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`, so they work as CSS masks). 1. **White oversized pullover hoodie** (hood, kangaroo pocket, ribbed cuffs and hem; ghost-mannequin front view): `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261106_065532_0fd0b9b0-7f8e-4519-b490-6478519b5186.png&w=1200&q=88` 2. **White relaxed sweat shorts** (elastic waistband, drawstring; flat front view): `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261106_065534_5ab4e8d0-8d00-42b4-b0ac-6dc60ea7aac0.png&w=1200&q=88` ## 3. Layout - **Card `#card`:** absolutely centred (translate -50%,-50%), overflow hidden, background `--bg`. - On load and resize: `s = min(innerWidth, innerHeight)`; the card is s × s with `font-size: s/100` px, so **1em = 1% of the card**. - **Title `h1`:** "ARRIVING TOMORROW", absolute, full width at top 5.4%, centred. Inter Tight 600, 4.1em, letter-spacing -.035em, line-height 1. - **Rows:** full width; `#top` at top 11% and 48% tall, `#bot` at top 58% and 36% tall. - **Garment `.g`** (one per piece; a new element is created for each colour): - Absolute, top and bottom 0, left 50%, 46em wide, margin-left -23em, `cursor:grab`, `touch-action:pan-y`. - Filter `drop-shadow(0 .9em .7em rgba(0,0,0,.13)) drop-shadow(0 .15em .25em rgba(0,0,0,.08))`. - Inside: a `.hov` wrapper (absolute, inset -6%; transform transition .45s `cubic-bezier(.3,1.5,.5,1)`; on hover `translateY(-1.2%) scale(1.025)`) containing two layers: - **`.tint`:** inset 0, background-color = the colourway. It is masked by the garment image: `mask: url() center/contain no-repeat`, with a `-webkit-` prefix too. The URL is passed through a `--m` custom property. - **``:** the same white garment, `object-fit:contain`, `mix-blend-mode:multiply`, `filter:url(#shade)`, no pointer events, not draggable. - **Shading filter:** declared once in a hidden inline SVG as `` with feComponentTransfer, where R, G and B each use `type="gamma" exponent="2.6"`. This deepens the fabric folds so the multiplied colour keeps real shading. A contrast filter would wash the near-whites out. - **Arrows:** - Buttons `#prev` (left 1.5em) and `#next` (right 1.5em): absolute, vertically centred, 9em × 12em, no background or border. - Each holds a 3.6em × 5.2em SVG chevron (viewBox 0 0 24 34). Paths: prev `M17 3 4 17l13 14`, next `M7 3l13 14L7 31`. No fill, currentColor stroke 2.2, round caps and joins. - Hover nudges the chevron .6em outward (.35s spring); `:active` scales it .85. ## 4. Colourways - **Colours:** - sky `#8dd2ef` - lemon `#f6dc55` - grass `#46cc45` - lilac `#b29de4` - tang `#fa8430` - fuchsia `#ee4cb3` - cobalt `#1d84d2` - **Sequences** (index advances independently per row): - TOPS: sky, grass, tang, fuchsia, lemon, sky, lilac, tang - BOTS: lemon, lilac, grass, cobalt, fuchsia, tang, sky, lemon - Start at sky hoodie with lemon shorts. ## 5. Slide transition (WAAPI) `slide(row, dir, delay, fromPct)`, where `dir` is +1 for next and -1 for previous. - **Direction sign:** `sgn = dir` for the top row and `-dir` for the bottom row. Next sends the hoodie out to the left and the shorts out to the right, so the pieces cross. - Advance that row's index (wrapping), create the new garment, and disable pointer events on the old one. - **Old piece:** animates from `translateX(fromPct%) rotate(0)` to `translateX(-sgn·150%) rotate(-sgn·9deg)` over 520ms with `cubic-bezier(.55,0,.75,.35)`, fill forwards, then is removed. - **New piece:** 1250ms with `cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.3,1)`, fill backwards. Keyframes: - 0: `translateX(sgn·150%) rotate(sgn·10deg)` - .42: the same (it waits off-card while the old piece leaves) - .78: `translateX(-sgn·3%) rotate(-sgn·3.5deg)` - .90: `translateX(sgn·.8%) rotate(sgn·1.4deg)` - 1: `none` - **Both pieces (arrows and keys):** ignored if called within 700ms of the previous call. Otherwise run the top row at delay 0 and the bottom row at delay 110ms. - **Keyboard:** ArrowRight is next and ArrowLeft is previous. ## 6. Single-piece interaction On pointerdown on the current piece of a row, capture the pointer and track dx. While dragging, the piece follows with `translateX(dx/width·100%) rotate(dx/width·8deg)`. On pointerup: - **Moved under 4px (a tap):** clear the transform and advance only that row (`slide(row, +1)`). - **Dragged past 14% of its width:** slide that row. The direction is `-sign(p)` for the top row and `+sign(p)` for the bottom row, so dragging the hoodie left or the shorts right means next. The old piece starts from its dragged position. - **Otherwise:** spring back to none over 450ms with `cubic-bezier(.3,1.6,.5,1)`. ## 7. Autoplay - Track the last interaction time: any pointermove, click, tap, drag or key resets it. - A 250ms timer loop checks it. If more than 3500ms have passed, advance both pieces, then backdate the timer by 1300ms so the next automatic change comes about 2.2 s later, like the original teaser loop.

| 0 | Cobalt Rain Shell, 425, `[300,1080]`, pin `[.60,.30]` | Wide Cargo Pant, 165, `[1020,2010]`, pin `[.38,.70]` |
| 1 | Mirror Down Parka, 650, `[230,1100]`, pin `[.62,.30]` | Straight Tech Trouser, 180, `[1040,2010]`, pin `[.38,.72]` |
| 2 | Storm Hooded Shell, 390, `[230,1040]`, pin `[.62,.30]` | Wide Cargo Pant, 165, `[1000,2010]`, pin `[.38,.70]` |
| 3 | Hooded Long Parka, 720, `[260,1440]`, pin `[.62,.36]` | Straight Tech Trouser, 180, `[1360,2010]`, pin `[.40,.82]` |
| 4 | Quilted Down Vest, 310, `[240,1110]`, pin `[.58,.30]` | Graphite Cargo Pant, 175, `[1060,2010]`, pin `[.38,.70]` |
| 5 | Graphite Fleece Half-Zip, 210, `[320,1000]`, pin `[.60,.28]` | Pleated Wide Trouser, 195, `[940,2010]`, pin `[.40,.70]` |

**Floor-glow tone per look**, used in a radial gradient as described in section 4:

| Look | Tone |
|---|---|
| 0 | `rgba(40,80,255,.30)` |
| 1 | `rgba(200,210,230,.24)` |
| 2 | `rgba(70,78,96,.32)` |
| 3 | `rgba(80,86,100,.30)` |
| 4 | `rgba(90,96,110,.30)` |
| 5 | `rgba(110,112,120,.26)` |

**Loading:**
- Preload all six with `new Image()` and `decode()`.
- The initial centre look is **index 2 (Night Run)**.

---

## 2. Font and tokens

**Font:**
- **Inter** 300 / 400 / 500 / 600 from Google Fonts, with `display=swap`.
- Fallback stack: `"Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif`.
- Antialiased, and `user-select: none` on the page.

**Tokens:**
```
--bg:#0d0e10  --panel:#121316  --card:#1b1d21  --card-2:#24272c
--ink:#f2f3f5 --mute:#8a8e96   --dim:#5b5f67   --line:rgba(255,255,255,.08)
--blue:#1f4dff --blue-2:#3d64ff
--sw: clamp(300px, 31vw, 500px)      /* sidebar width */
```

---

## 3. Page layout (fluid)

**Desktop:**
- `html, body`: full height, `overflow: hidden`, background `--bg`.
- `#stage`: `position: fixed; inset: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) var(--sw)`.
- Column 1 is `#runway` (relative, 100% height, `overflow: hidden`). Column 2 is `#side`, the sidebar.

**Phone layout (≤ 820px):**
- `--sw: 100vw`; the page scrolls (`overflow: auto`, height auto).
- `#stage` becomes `display: block`.
- `#runway` height is `min(86svh, 760px)`.
- The sidebar stacks below it with a top border instead of a left border, and natural height.
- The title moves to `top: 78px` so it sits under the nav pill, which is absolutely centred.
- Timeline labels collapse to just numbers: segments 22px wide, the active one 44px, look names hidden.
- The VIEW cursor is disabled.

At ≤ 1100px, timeline segments are 30px wide and the active one is 120px.

---

## 4. Runway background and text

- **`#runway` background,** two layers:
  - `radial-gradient(60% 46% at 50% 44%, rgba(70,78,96,.32), transparent 70%)`;
  - over `linear-gradient(180deg, #131418 0%, #101114 56%, #0a0b0d 74%, #0b0c0e 100%)`.
- **Horizon hairline:** a 1px `::after` at `top: 66%` with `linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,.07), transparent)`.
- **`#floorGlow`:**
  - absolute, `left: 52%; top: 69%; width: 70%; height: 24%; transform: translateX(-50%)`, round;
  - background `radial-gradient(closest-side, <look tone>, transparent)`, with a `.9s` background transition when the look changes.
- **Title** (top-left, z 25):
  - position `left: clamp(20px, 4.4%, 48px); top: clamp(22px, 4.2vh, 38px)`, max-width 46%;
  - `h1` "Night ’26 Shell": Inter 400, `clamp(26px, 3.6vw, 40px)`, letter-spacing −.025em, line-height 1;
  - `p`: 13px `--mute`, 12px top margin: "Six looks, styled head to toe. Tap a pin to see the piece."

---

## 5. Floating nav pill

- **Position:** fixed, horizontally centred over the runway: `left: calc((100vw - var(--sw))/2); translateX(-50%); top: clamp(14px, 2.4vh, 22px)`.
- **Box:** height 46, radius 24, padding 0 8.
- **Surface:**
  - background `rgba(28,30,35,.78)`, 1px `--line` border, `blur(14px)` backdrop;
  - shadow `0 10px 30px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.7)`.
- **Contents,** in order:
  - menu (two lines);
  - a 1×20 separator;
  - logo: a white stylised bird/wing mark, 40×20, in a 56px-wide button;
  - a separator;
  - search, account and bag icons, each 18px white 1.6-stroke line icons in 38px round buttons with an 8% hover fill.
- **Bag badge:** a 16px blue pill with a white 10px/600 count at the top-right of the bag button.
  - It is hidden at count 0 via `scale(0)` and springs in with `.35s cubic-bezier(.3,1.8,.5,1)`.
  - Every change plays a `bump` (scale 1.5 at 40%).

---

## 6. The carousel (the core of the section)

### 6.1 Geometry, measured from the runway each time it resizes

```
narrow = innerWidth <= 820
MH  = min(runwayH * (narrow ? .66 : .705), runwayW * (narrow ? 1.05 : .92))   // model box height
MW  = MH * 421/634                                                           // model box width
U   = MH / 634                                                               // unit scale
CX  = runwayW * (narrow ? .5 : .523)                                         // centre x
FEET= runwayH * (narrow ? .86 : .85)                                         // centre model's feet y
```

- Set `--mh` and `--mw` CSS variables from these values.
- Re-measure on `resize` and with a `ResizeObserver` on `#runway`.

### 6.2 Model element

- `.model`: absolute, `width: var(--mw); height: var(--mh); margin-left: calc(var(--mw)/-2)`, `transform-origin: 50% 100%`, `pointer-events: none`.
- It contains:
  - **`.fig`**, filling the box: the look image at `center bottom / contain`, with `-webkit-box-reflect: below -2px linear-gradient(transparent 68%, rgba(255,255,255,.22))`. This produces the floor reflection.
  - **`.hit`**, the only clickable area: `left: 29%; right: 29%; top: 3%; bottom: 2%; pointer-events: auto; cursor: none`, with the default cursor on the centre model. This body-sized hit area means the centre model's transparent margins never block clicks on its neighbours.

### 6.3 Continuous position and depth table

`pos` is a float carousel position (start 2). Each frame, for each model `i`:
- `d = wrap(i − pos)` into `[−3, 3)`;
- interpolate linearly through this table by `a = |d|`.

| a | x offset | scale | feet lift | blur px | brightness | opacity |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | 1 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 1 |
| 1 | 160 | .94 | 12 | 1.2 | .90 | 1 |
| 2 | 284 | .85 | 59 | 4 | .72 | 1 |
| 3 | 362 | .78 | 95 | 8 | .55 | .55 |
| 3.6 | 392 | .74 | 110 | 11 | .48 | 0 |

- x offset and lift are multiplied by `U`; blur is multiplied by `max(.6, U)`. The x offset takes the sign of `d`.
- `transform: translate3d(CX + x, FEET − lift − MH, 0) scale(sc)`.
- `filter: blur(bl) brightness(br)`; `opacity: op`; `z-index: 100 − round(a·10)`.
- The model with `|d| < .5` gets class `c` (centre).

The result is that neighbours overlap the centre slightly, and the row recedes into depth: feet higher, smaller, blurrier, darker. The outer pair fades away, and models wrap round smoothly from one side to the other.

### 6.4 Transition

`go(i, dir)`:
1. Take the shortest signed distance `d = wrap(i − pos)`. If `dir` is given and the distance is exactly 3, use that direction.
2. Tween `pos` from its current value to `pos + d` over `760 + (|d| − 1)·140` ms with **`ease = t => 1 − (1 − t)^4.2`**. This is a fast ease-out: about 60% of the travel happens in the first 150 ms, followed by a long soft settle.
3. On start: set `active`, hide the pins, hide the VIEW cursor, swap the sidebar cards (§8.2), update the timeline, restart the autoplay timer, and set the floor-glow tone.
4. On end: show the pins.

### 6.5 Ways to change looks

- Click a side model's `.hit` area.
- **Drag / swipe** on the runway:
  - `pos = startPos − dx/(170·U)`;
  - on release, snap with `go(round(pos))`, and swallow the click that follows a drag;
  - `touch-action: pan-y` on the models layer.
- The ← and → buttons step one look in that direction, and the ArrowLeft / ArrowRight keys do the same.
- Click a timeline segment to jump to that look.
- Autoplay (§7).

### 6.6 VIEW cursor

`#view` is fixed and follows the pointer:
- 58px white circle centred on the pointer;
- the text `VIEW` inside: 8px/600, .18em tracking, colour `#0d0e10`;
- `scale(0)` → `scale(1)` with `.35s cubic-bezier(.3,1.4,.5,1)`.

**Every animation frame**, run `elementFromPoint(lastPointer)`. Show the circle only when the pointer is over a non-centre model's hit area, no tween is running and no drag is in progress. Re-checking every frame keeps it correct while models slide under a still cursor.

### 6.7 Pins (centre model only)

- **Marker:**
  - two 24px glass dots per look, at the pin fractions of the centre model box;
  - fill `rgba(255,255,255,.16)`, 1px white border, `blur(6px)` backdrop, 6px white core;
  - a `::before` ring pulsing (scale .6 → 1.7, 2.2 s).
- **Appearing:** each springs in with `scale 0 → 1` and `.45s cubic-bezier(.3,1.6,.5,1)`, staggered 120 ms + k·120 ms after a transition ends.
- **Tooltip:** sits to the right, in a dark glass box `rgba(20,22,26,.85)`, and shows "**Piece name**  $price.00" (the price muted).
- **Linking with the sidebar:**
  - Hovering a pin highlights its sidebar card: blue border `rgba(61,100,255,.8)` and background `#1d2130`.
  - Hovering a card shows its pin's tooltip.
  - Clicking a pin toggles its tooltip.

---

## 7. Bottom controls and autoplay

`#ctrl` geometry:
- absolute, `left / right: clamp(16px, 4.4%, 48px); bottom: clamp(14px, 2.8vh, 24px)`;
- height 40, flex, gap `clamp(12px, 2.5%, 28px)`, z 20.

**Contents:**
- **←** arrow button: 40px round, 1.4-stroke long arrow, 8% hover fill, `scale(.92)` while pressed.
- **Timeline:** six `.seg` buttons in a flex row (gap 6, max-width 520).
  - Each segment is a 2px bar (track `rgba(255,255,255,.18)` with a white fill `<i>`) over a 10px label `01`…`06`.
  - Segments are 52px wide. The active one widens to 150px over `.6s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1)` and shows its look name after the number (white, weight 500, fading in).
  - Earlier segments are filled 100%.
- **Pause / play** button (36px), pushed right with `margin-left: auto`. Its icon toggles between two bars and a triangle. Space also toggles it.
- **→** arrow button.

**Autoplay:**
- On by default.
- Dwell is 5200 ms: the active segment's fill grows from 0 to 100% and then calls `go(active + 1, +1)`.
- The timer restarts on every change.
- It is paused while a drag is in progress, and stops when paused.

---

## 8. Sidebar `#side`

- **Panel:** background `--panel`, 1px `--line` left border.
- **Padding:** `clamp(20px,3.3vh,30px) clamp(16px,1.9vw,28px) clamp(18px,3vh,28px)`.
- **Layout:** flex column, `overflow: auto`.

### 8.1 Content

- **Header:**
  - "In this **look**" at 20px/400, with "look" in `--mute`;
  - right-aligned `2 PIECES` at 10px/500, .14em tracking, `--mute`.
- **Two cards** (gap 12, 22px top margin):
  - Card: height `clamp(104px, 13.8vh, 124px)`, radius 16, `--card` fill, 1px `--line` border, padding 12, gap 18.
  - Thumbnail: 4:5 (height = card height − 24), radius 10, `--card-2` fill. It is the look image cropped to that piece's `[y0, y1]` rows, centred horizontally on source x 680 (scale `k = min(h/(y1 − y0), w/560)`).
  - A tiny `1` / `2` index sits at its top-right.
  - Name at 14px; price `$NNN.00` at 13px `--mute`.
  - A 32px round **+** button at the bottom-right.
- **Bundle** (`margin-top: auto`):
  - "Complete the look" at 13px/500;
  - "Bundle all 2 and save 10%" at 11px `--mute`;
  - on the right, the struck-through sum (11px `--dim`) and the bundle price (22px), which is the sum × 0.9.
  - Both prices **count** from the old value to the new one over 600 ms (ease-out cubic).
- **CTA:**
  - 54px tall, full width, radius 28, `--blue` fill (hover `--blue-2`, pressed `scale(.985)`);
  - `ADD FULL LOOK TO BAG` at 12px/600 with .08em tracking, plus a long arrow that slides 4px on hover.
  - On click a white overlay sweeps across it (`scaleX` 0 → 1, .7 s).

### 8.2 Card swap animation (on every look change)

1. Add `.out` to both cards. The thumbnail, text and + button go to opacity 0, `blur(6px)` and `translateY(6px)`. At the same time a skeleton layer fades in: grey blocks with a moving shimmer, `linear-gradient(90deg, #202328, #2a2e34, #202328)` at 200% size, 1.1 s linear loop.
2. After 420 ms, fill in the new look's data.
3. Remove `.out` from card 1 at +180 ms and from card 2 at +320 ms, so the new content comes back in sequence. Use `.35s` opacity/filter transitions and a `.45s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)` transform.

### 8.3 Bag behaviour

- **"+" on a card:**
  - Adds that piece. The button turns blue and its plus rotates 45° into an ×.
  - A 'flyer' copy of the thumbnail flies to the bag icon, shrinking to a 12px dot over `.75s cubic-bezier(.6,0,.2,1)`.
  - After 700 ms the bag count increments with a bump.
  - Toast: "Piece name added".
  - Clicking again removes the piece and toasts "Removed from bag".
- **Full-look button:**
  - Adds every missing piece, with flyers staggered 120 ms apart.
  - Toast: "Look name — full look added · saved 10%", or "Full look already in your bag".
  - The label becomes `FULL LOOK IN BAG` when both pieces are in the bag.
- **Toast:**
  - Fixed, centred over the runway at `top: clamp(70px, 9vh, 84px)`.
  - Dark glass `rgba(28,30,35,.92)`, 12px text.
  - Slides 10px down into place; auto-hides after 1.7 s.

---

## 9. Acceptance checklist

- [ ] It is truly responsive, with no fixed-size scaled stage:
  - 1920×1080 and 1280×720 fill the screen;
  - tablet and phone stack the runway above the sidebar with no horizontal scroll.
- [ ] The runway is a packed, overlapping depth row: the centre is sharp and largest, and neighbours are smaller, feet higher, progressively blurred and darker, with reflections under every model.
- [ ] Look changes are one continuous slide using `1 − (1 − t)^4.2`, roughly 760 ms. Every model interpolates scale, lift, blur and brightness.
- [ ] Hovering a side model shows the round VIEW cursor, and clicking brings that model to the centre. The centre's transparent margins never block clicks on its neighbours.
- [ ] Sidebar cards blur to skeleton shimmers and refill in sequence, and the prices count.
- [ ] Pins, the timeline, autoplay with pause, the arrows, keys, drag and swipe, add to bag with the flying thumbnail and badge bump, and the full-look bundle all work.

title: Sportswear Store
description: Single-file, three-section landing page for a fictional athletic knitwear label called OVRA. It is a light, misty-orchid sportswear site: a framed hero with a cut-out athlete, a "WORKOUT" photo collage, and a "Fresh Fits" card with giant scrolling stencil type. Features cinematic looping background video integration, seamless infinite marquee ticker transitions with precision layout polish.
full_prompt:
# OVRA "Every Workout": full recreation brief

Build a single-file, three-section landing page for a fictional athletic knitwear label called OVRA. It is a light, misty-orchid sportswear site: a framed hero with a cut-out athlete, a "WORKOUT" photo collage, and a "Fresh Fits" card with giant scrolling stencil type. Everything below is exact. Use one HTML file with inline CSS and JS, no frameworks, no libraries.

## 1. Assets (use these URLs exactly, never re-host)

| Asset | URL | Native size | How it is used |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hero athlete cut-out (transparent PNG served as WebP) | https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261114_120532_a504ce9e-4820-4193-8b7c-9b1abb1f45b9.png&w=1528&q=85 | 1528 × 2048 | One img element. Young man with short twisted hair, clear wraparound sport glasses, oversized orchid ribbed knit full-zip with a tall funnel collar, framed head to hips. |
| Collage sheet (2×2 grid) | https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261114_120327_e42374b9-471e-4799-9dca-07fe8b4d6536.png&w=2048&q=85 (the inner url is https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261114_120327_e42374b9-471e-4799-9dca-07fe8b4d6536.png, URL-encoded) | 2048 × 2048 | Background-image crops for the three collage cards, the hero video card and the three hero avatars. |
| Marquee sheet (2×2 grid) | https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url= + URL-encoded https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261114_120324_90c4bb35-2fb2-47a8-aa6e-14a7c92e2214.png + &w=1744&q=85 | 1744 × 2336 | Background-image crops for the four looks that cycle in the marquee card. |

Build the two sheet URLs in JS as 'https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=' + encodeURIComponent(innerUrl) + '&w=<native width>&q=85'.

### Sheet cells (pixel rectangles x, y, w, h inside each sheet)

| Element | Sheet | Cell x,y,w,h | Focal point (fx, fy) | Content |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Collage centre card | collage | 29, 28, 982, 982 | 0.5, 0.2 | Side profile of the same athlete, looking right, orchid funnel collar, orchid-to-pale-lilac studio gradient |
| Collage left card | collage | 1036, 28, 982, 982 | 0.5, 0.3 | Woman's torso and legs in a lilac fleece half-zip and joggers, hand in pocket |
| Collage right card | collage | 29, 1036, 982, 982 | 0.5, 0.45 | Crossed forearms in plum fleece sleeves with lilac fingerless gloves |
| Hero video card | collage | 1036, 1036, 982, 983 | 0.5, 0.62 | Three athletes sitting and crouching in lilac, orchid and plum knit sets |
| Avatar 1 | collage | 1452, 1186, 130, 130 | centre | Woman's face (ponytail) |
| Avatar 2 | collage | 1200, 1146, 135, 135 | centre | Man's face (clear glasses) |
| Avatar 3 | collage | 1690, 1150, 135, 135 | centre | Woman's face (lilac beanie) |
| Marquee look 1 (start) | marquee | 0, 0, 866, 1159 | 0.5, 1 | Group of four athletes in orchid, lilac and plum half-zips, top 40% empty lilac gradient |
| Marquee look 2 | marquee | 878, 0, 866, 1159 | 0.5, 1 | Woman full length in lilac ribbed half-zip and joggers |
| Marquee look 3 | marquee | 0, 1172, 866, 1164 | 0.5, 1 | Man full length in plum fleece set holding a lilac duffel |
| Marquee look 4 | marquee | 878, 1172, 866, 1164 | 0.5, 1 | Woman full length in orchid cropped knit zip top and leggings |

Crop logic (run on load and on resize) for every element with a cell: let ew, eh be the element's box; s = max(ew / cw, eh / ch); background-size = (sheetW × s)px (sheetH × s)px; background-position-x = −(cx × s) − (cw × s − ew) × fx; background-position-y = −(cy × s) − (ch × s − eh) × fy; background-repeat no-repeat; fallback background-color #CDB4D6.

## 2. Font

One family: Archivo (Google Fonts variable font, axes wdth 62–125 and wght 100–900), latin subset, self-hosted as a WOFF2 (https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/archivo/v25/k3kQo8UDI-1M0wlSfdnoLg.woff2), declared with font-weight 100 900 and font-stretch 62% 125%, font-display swap. Fallback stack: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif. Every piece of text on the page is Archivo; weight and width vary per element as listed below.

### Stencil lettering

The stencil look (hero WORKOUT!, card WORKOUT, both marquee rows) is ordinary Archivo with one thin cut through each letter, made with a CSS mask on each letter's own span: a linear gradient that is black everywhere except a transparent gap 0.068em wide (±0.034em) centred at a set percentage of the letter box. Cut direction and position per letter: W vertical at 50%; O vertical 50%; R vertical 29%; K vertical 27%; U vertical 50%; T horizontal at 21% (just under the bar); F vertical 29%; E vertical 29%; S vertical 50%; H vertical 29%; I horizontal 52%; Y horizontal 50%; N vertical 29%; X horizontal 50%; C vertical 52%; A horizontal 62%; the exclamation mark has no cut. Vertical means a 90° gradient (gap runs top to bottom), horizontal means 180°.

## 3. Colour tokens

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| sky-top | #E4D0EA | Hero gradient top |
| sky-mid | #EBDDEF | Hero gradient at 45% |
| sky-bot | #F8F1F9 | Hero gradient bottom |
| bezel | #EFE6F1 | Page background, notch fill |
| panel | #F4EEF6 | Collage panel |
| panel2 | #F3E9F4 | Marquee panel |
| ink | #26132A | Headlines, nav, light-pill text |
| muted | #6E5873 | Body copy |
| pill | #2D1833 | Dark pills, lock button, LEVEL UP tag |
| line | #C9B6CF | Outline of the collage word |
| marquee type | #CDBFD3 | Giant marquee rows |
| avatar ring | #EADDEE | 2u border around avatars |
| collage empty card | gradient #8E6A99 → #D9C4E0 (top to bottom) | Centre card before its photo strips in |
| marquee card | gradient #BA8FC7 0%, #D8C0E1 55%, #E7D7EC 100% | Card base under the looks |

## 4. Scaling system

Desktop design frame: 1440 × 956. Define u = min(100vw / 1440, 100svh / 956) and uw = 100vw / 1440. Every size and position is written as a number × u; offsets from the left and right page edges for the nav and hero side blocks use uw so they hug the edges on wide screens. Below 821 px width switch to the phone frame: u = uw = 100vw / 390. Body: margin 0, background bezel, overflow-x hidden, antialiased.

Each section is a block (height 956u) containing one rounded panel: margin 0 16u, height 924u, border-radius 36u, overflow hidden. The hero and collage sections have 16u top padding; the marquee has 16u top and bottom padding. Page order: hero, collage, marquee. No footer.

## 5. Hero (desktop, all positions relative to the hero panel)

Panel background: linear-gradient(180deg, #E4D0EA 0%, #EBDDEF 45%, #F8F1F9 100%).

Notch: an SVG (viewBox 0 0 560 61, preserveAspectRatio none) centred at the top of the panel (top −1px), 560u × 61u, fill bezel, path "M0 0 C34 0 46 6 60 22 L78 44 C88 56 98 61 116 61 L444 61 C462 61 472 56 482 44 L500 22 C514 6 526 0 560 0 Z". It reads as a trapezoid tab cut down into the panel with soft rounded shoulders.

Logo: the text OVRA centred horizontally, top 10u, 33u, weight 380, font-stretch 122%, letter-spacing 0.2em (with 0.2em left padding to re-centre), line-height 1, ink. Sits inside the notch.

Left nav: top 33u, left 40uw, links SHOP, MEN, WOMEN, TRENDING, gap 30u, 13.5u, weight 470, letter-spacing −0.01em, ink.

Right nav: top 17u, right 41uw, row with gap 31u: SEASONAL, ACCESSORIES (same type as left nav), then a dark pill "SIGN  IN / UP" (two spaces after SIGN; 44u tall, padding 0 22u, fully rounded, background pill, white text 13.5u weight 470, margin-right −27u so it nearly touches the next item), then a 44u round lock button (background pill, 2u border in sky-top) holding a 15u white outline padlock icon (16×16 viewBox: rounded rect x3 y7 w10 h7.5 r2, shackle path M5.2 7V5a2.8 2.8 0 0 1 5.6 0v2, a 0.9 radius dot at 8,10.8; stroke white 1.4).

Rays: an SVG filling the panel (viewBox 0 0 1408 924, preserveAspectRatio none), z-index 1, six white lines at 75% opacity, 1.1px, non-scaling stroke, all starting at 704,610 and ending at 0,300; 0,470; 90,924; 1408,300; 1408,470; 1318,924.

## 6. The model

**Structure:** `#modelWrap.full` › `#shadow` + `#modelInner` › `#breath` › (`#figs`, `#scan`, `#hotspots`).

- **`#modelWrap`:**
  - `left: 800px; top: 72px; width: 440px; height: 663px; margin-left: -220px`;

- **`#modelInner`:**
