### 6.1 Outfit swap (the signature effect)

`showLook(i)`:
1. Immediately mark grid card `i` as `.on`.
2. Await `IMGS[i].decode()`, so the wipe never reveals an unloaded image. A token guards against rapid clicks: only the latest call proceeds.
3. Append a new `.fig.in` with look `i`'s `w=1000` image. `.in` starts at `clip-path: inset(0 0 100% 0)` and runs `wipe 1.05s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.25,1) forwards` to `inset(0 0 0 0)`. The new outfit is revealed **top to bottom** over the old one. No opacity is involved.
4. At the same moment, restart `#scan.go`. `#scan` is a 2px line spanning `left: -10%; right: -10%`:
   - background `linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #fff 25%, #fff 75%, transparent)`;
   - glow `0 0 22px 6px rgba(255,255,255,.55), 0 0 60px 18px rgba(214,226,255,.35)`.

   Its animation, `scan 1.05s` with the same easing, moves it from `top: 0` to `top: 100%`. It stays fully visible until 92%, then fades. The line rides exactly on the wipe edge.
5. On the wipe's `animationend`, remove all older `.fig`s and drop `.in`.
6. Re-render the accordion rows, the hotspots and the favourite states for the new look.

`rescan()` replays only the scan line. It is used as "re-render" feedback by the tuning controls.

### 6.2 Hotspots (full framing only)

- Show one round marker per non-empty piece group, positioned in % of the figure box:
  - tops (60%, 24%), full (60%, 38%), bottoms (38%, 47%), shoes (40%, 95%), acc (56%, 14%).
- Marker style:
  - 26px circle, `rgba(255,255,255,.25)` fill, 1px white border, `blur(6px)` backdrop;
  - a 6px white dot centre;
  - a `::before` ring pulsing with `ping 2.4s` (scale .6 → 1.6, opacity 1 → 0);
  - hover: scale 1.18.
- Hover tooltip: appears to the right (`left: 34px`), slides in from −6px, with dark glass `rgba(30,30,34,.55)` and `blur(14px)`. Text: "**Piece name** · Colour · $Price".
- Click opens that accordion row.
- Hidden (opacity 0, no pointer) when the framing is not `.full`.

---

## 7. Top bar

- **Logo** at (30, 22):
  - `VELL` in Syne 800, 46px, line-height 1, letter-spacing −.02em;
  - then, 18px gap and baseline-aligned, `CREATE A VELL` at 15px with .06em tracking.
- **Tabs `#tabs.glass`:**
  - geometry `left: 410; top: 22; 720×54`, radius 30, padding 4, flex;
  - five equal buttons `DNA, BODY, STYLE, PERSONALITY, STORY`, each 44px tall, radius 24, 16px, .05em tracking, colour `--ink-2`; the active one is white;
  - a sliding `#tabInd.pill-on` (44px tall, radius 24, `top: 5`) animates `left` and `width` over `.55s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1)` to the active button.
  - STYLE is active by default.
- **Icon buttons** (right: 28, top: 24, gap 12), each a 50px round glass button with 22px white line icons:
  - **Cart:** badge counts pieces in the cart.
  - **Heart:** badge counts favourites. Its icon fills white when the current look is a favourite.
  - **Bag (Library):** badge counts saved looks. Clicking toggles the Library drawer.
  - **More (•••):** toggles a dropdown menu.
- **Badges:**
  - 20px white pill with dark text, 12px/600, at the top-right corner;
  - `scale(0)` when the count is 0, `scale(1)` otherwise, with a `.35s cubic-bezier(.3,1.8,.5,1)` spring;
  - a `bump` keyframe (scale 1.45 at 40%) plays on every change.
- **More menu** (glass, 210px wide, under the icons at top 84, origin top-right):
  - closed: scale .9 and opacity 0; open: normal;
  - items: Share look, Export render, Duplicate, Settings;
  - each item closes the menu and toasts "Share link copied", "Exported 4K render", "Duplicated as new VELL" or "Settings saved".

---

## 8. Profile card `#profile.glass`

- Geometry: `left: 24; top: 96; 476×124`, flex, centred, gap 20, padding 0 16.
- **Avatar:**
  - 98×98, radius 18, 1.5px border `rgba(255,255,255,.85)`, white glow;
  - a **face crop of the current look's image**: a 360×360 window of the 1360×2048 source at (500, 46), scaled so 360 → 98 (background-size `1360·k × 2048·k`, position `−500·k −46·k`, where `k = 98/360`).
  - It updates whenever the look changes.
- **Name:**
  - `Han Seo-yeon`, 28px/400;
  - followed by a pencil button (38px round) and a glass shuffle button (38px round).
- **Meta row** (16px, `--ink-2`, separated by 1×16 line dividers):
  - `23` | `Seoul, KR` | a cloud icon and `14°C`;
  - hovering the weather shows the tooltip "Overcast · soft daylight".
- **Pencil:** toggles `contentEditable` on the name and selects all of it. While editing, the name gets a white 1px ring and a 14% white fill. Enter or clicking the pencil again ends editing and toasts "Name updated".
- **Shuffle:** rotates its button +180° each click (.5s). It cycles through these identities, scrambling the name with random letters for about 14 frames before it resolves:
  - Han Seo-yeon, 23, Seoul KR, 14°C
  - Kim Ha-eun, 22, Busan KR, 17°C
  - Yoon Ji-woo, 25, Seoul KR, 12°C
  - Park Min-ji, 24, Incheon KR, 13°C
  - Lee Soo-ah, 21, Daegu KR, 15°C

  It also updates the age, city and temperature, and the DNA seed `VL-0{400 + k·37}-KR`.

---

## 9. Style menu `#side.glass` and Randomize

- **Style menu:**
  - geometry `left: 24; top: 236; 172×470`, padding 10, column, gap 2;
  - eight 54px buttons (radius 16, 16px, gap 14, 22px line icon then label, colour `--ink-2`, white on hover or active): Face, Hair, Makeup, Body, **Outfits** (active), Accessories, Tattoos, Details;
  - a sliding `#sideInd.pill-on` (152×54, radius 16) animates `top` over `.45s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1)`.
- **Randomize `#rand.glass`:**
  - geometry `left: 24; top: 722; 220×52`, radius 16;
  - a circular-arrows icon followed by `Randomize VELL`.
- Both slide out to the left when the active tab is not STYLE: `translateX(-240px)` for the menu and `-280px` for Randomize, `.6s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1)`.
- **Menu actions:**
  - Outfits → Outfits view.
  - Body → Body view.
  - Any other item → the **Tune** view for that item.

---

## 10. Right panel `#panel.glass`

- Geometry: `left: 1112; top: 96; 464×680`, padding 22 18 18, `overflow: hidden`.
- It contains six absolutely stacked `.view`s (`inset: 22px 18px 18px`, flex column).
- Hidden views get `opacity: 0; transform: translateX(30px)` and no pointer events, with a `.55s` transform and `.4s` opacity transition.
- View headers are `h3` at 17px/400, uppercase, .06em tracking, with a right-aligned 12px `--ink-3` note in normal case.

### 10.1 Outfits view (default)

**Header:** `OUTFITS`, with the note "8 looks" (live count, singular "look" when there is one).

**Category chips** (7, space-between):
- Each chip is a 58px column: a 48px rounded-14 tile (`--glass-2` fill, `--line` border) with a 24px line icon, and a 12px label underneath.
- The active chip gets `--glow`.
- Order: All (grid icon), Everyday (tee), Athletic, Sleep (moon), Formal, Party (dress), Street (hoodie).
- Click filters the grid:
  - non-matching cards go `.out` (opacity 0, scale .85), then `display: none` after 300ms;
  - matching cards re-enter with a stagger (45ms apart, 500ms each) from `translateY(14px) scale(.96)`.

**Grid:**
- 4 columns, gap 10, height 296, margin-top 16.
- Each card:
  - 142px tall, radius 14, 1px `--line` border;
  - background `linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.22), rgba(255,255,255,.06))`;
  - the look's `w=360` image in an inner `.im` layer extending 20% beyond each side, `center top / auto 104%`.
- Hover: the card lifts 3px and the image scales 1.06. A name tag slides up from below: 11px, dark-glass pill, 6px insets.
- Active card: `--glow` plus a 3px `rgba(255,255,255,.25)` ring.
- Each card has a 24px round heart badge at the top-right. It is hidden, and springs in when the look is a favourite.
- Interaction:
  - click: `pickLook(i)` (ignored if `i` is already the current look) → swap the model, update the avatar and filter thumbnails, commit to history;
  - double-click: toggle favourite.

**Accordion** (`margin-top: auto`, gap 7): five rows, TOPS, BOTTOMS, FULL BODY, SHOES, ACCESSORIES.
- Row style: radius 12, `--glass-2` fill, `--line` border; the header button is 42px, 15px uppercase.
- The piece count of the current look shows as a small "· n" next to the title.
- A chevron rotates 180° when the row is open.
- The body opens with `grid-template-rows: 0fr → 1fr` over `.4s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1)`. Only one row is open at a time.
- Item lines, one per piece: name, then a smaller muted colour, then a white price `$NN`, then a 28px round `+` button.
- The `+` button toggles the piece in the cart: it turns into a white filled `✓`, updates the cart badge, and toasts "Added to cart".

### 10.2 Tune view (Face, Hair, Makeup, Accessories, Tattoos, Details)

**Layout**, top to bottom:
1. The header shows the item name and the note "changes re-render the model".
2. An optional row of 34px colour swatches. The active swatch gets a 3px white ring.
   - Hair: `#14110f #3b2a20 #6b4a35 #a07c5a #d9c3a1`
   - Makeup: `#e8b4a8 #d98c8c #b5525e #8e3c4a`
3. Preset chips (`.opt`: radius 12, 9×14 padding, 14px; the active one gets `--glow`).
4. Sliders.

**Content per item:**
- **Face:** sliders Smile 35, Jawline 50, Freckles 10. Presets Soft, Defined, Natural, Sculpted.
- **Hair:** sliders Volume 60, Shine 70. Presets High bun, Low bun, Long straight, Bob, Ponytail.
- **Makeup:** sliders Blush 30, Lip tint 45, Glow 55. Presets No-makeup, Glass skin, Soft glam, Editorial.
- **Accessories:** multi-select, labelled "Add items". Options: Gold hoops, Silver chain, Shoulder bag, Sunglasses, Watch, Hair clip.
- **Tattoos:** slider Opacity 40. Presets None, Fine line, Floral, Script, Minimal dots.
- **Details:** sliders Skin texture 70, Fabric detail 80, Lighting softness 60. Presets Studio, Natural, Cinematic.

**Behaviour:**
- Picking a preset replays the scan line and toasts "Hair: Bob" (or the equivalent).
- Picking a swatch, or releasing a slider, replays the scan line.
- State is remembered per item.

**Slider style** (used everywhere):
- a 4px track filled white up to `--p` and `rgba(255,255,255,.28)` after it;
- a 22px white thumb with a 5px translucent white border and a white glow;
- the label row shows the name on the left and the bold value on the right.

### 10.3 DNA view (tab DNA)

- Header: `DNA`, with the note "identity seed".
- A 300×120 SVG **animated double helix**: 26 rungs, 11px apart.
  - Strand points are at `60 ± sin(i·.42 + t)·38`; `t` grows by .03 per frame.
  - Dot radius is `2 + depth·2.4` and alpha is `.4 + depth·.6`; rung alpha is `.15 + depth·.25`.
- Rows (15px, separated by 1px dividers): Seed `VL-0423-KR`, Heritage Korean, Age 23, Eye colour Dark brown, Hair Black · high bun.
- A full-width `Re-seed identity` outline button (46px, radius 14, white 1.5px border, white fill on hover). It does the same thing as the profile shuffle, plus a scan.

### 10.4 Body view (tab BODY, or the Body menu item)

- **Height (cm) slider:** 150–185, default 168. It sets `--height = 1 + (v − 168)/168·.9`.
- **Build slider:** 0–100, default 50. It sets `--build = 1 + (v − 50)/50·.07`.
- Both commit to history on release.
- **Posture** chips: Relaxed (active), Confident, Editorial. They replay the scan.
- **Framing** chips: Full body, Mid shot, Portrait. They set the framing and stay in sync with the Pose button.

### 10.5 Personality view

- Header: `PERSONALITY`, with the note "pick up to 3".
- Ten trait chips: Curious, Bold, Calm, Witty, Romantic, Driven, Playful, Gentle, Creative, Loyal.
  - The default selection is Curious, Creative and Gentle.
  - Picking a fourth drops the oldest.
  - Every change recomputes the five radar values deterministically from the selected trait names (30–94).
- **Radar** (250×210 SVG):
  - five axes (Openness, Energy, Warmth, Focus, Humour), radius 78;
  - four concentric grid pentagons;
  - 11px labels;
  - the value polygon is filled `rgba(255,255,255,.28)` with a 1.5px white stroke.
- Openness and Energy sliders below the radar edit those axes live.

### 10.6 Story view

- Header: `STORY`, with the note "auto-written from your choices".
- A rounded glass text box (16px / 1.6). Every time the tab opens it **types** a bio, 2 characters every 22ms, with a blinking 2px caret. The bio is built from the name, height, city, look name and traits:

  > "{name} is {height} cm of {trait1} energy from {city}. Mornings start with a long walk along the river in her {look name lowercase} look; friends call her {trait2} and a little {trait3}. She collects film cameras, keeps a sketchbook of strangers' outfits, and is saving for a studio of her own."

- **Rewrite story** picks three random traits and types again.

---

## 11. Bottom controls

### 11.1 Control bar `#ctrl.glass`

- Geometry: `left: 504; top: 742; 592×54`, radius 18.
- Four equal 44px buttons (17px, icon gap 12): **Undo**, **Redo**, **Pose**, **Reset**.
- Disabled buttons sit at 40% opacity. Pose always has `--glow` and its label shows the current framing: `Full`, `Mid` or `Portrait`.

**History:**
- `S = {look, grade, real, height, build}`, defaulting to `{0, 0, 75, 168, 50}`.
- Every committed change pushes a copy and truncates the redo tail.
- Undo and Redo re-apply a snapshot. The look is swapped with the full wipe animation.
- Cmd/Ctrl+Z undoes and Shift+Cmd/Ctrl+Z redoes. ArrowLeft and ArrowRight step through the looks.

**Buttons:**
- **Pose** cycles the framing full → mid → portrait.
- **Reset** applies the defaults with full framing, commits, and toasts "Reset to default".

### 11.2 Realism `#real.glass`

- Geometry: `left: 24; top: 796; 452×88`, padding 16 20.
- Contents: the title `Realism` (16px), a slider (0–100, default 75) with its `75%` value on the right, and the end labels `Stylized` / `Hyper Realistic` (13px) under it.
- Mapping, with `k = max(0, (80 − v)/80)`:
  - model `--real = saturate(1 + k·.9) contrast(1 + k·.25) blur(k·1.4px) brightness(1 + k·.05)`;
  - background `blur(k·5px) saturate(1 + k·.5)`.

### 11.3 Filter `#filt.glass`

- Geometry: `left: 494; top: 796; 640×88`, flex, gap 16.
- **Dropdown:**
  - a `Filter` title over a 156×38 dropdown button showing the current filter name and a chevron (which rotates when open);
  - the list opens **upward** (`bottom: 46px`) as a glass list with one button per filter.
- **Thumbnails:** five 64×64 radius-12 thumbnails, each a **face crop of the current look** (same crop as the avatar, `k = 64/360`).
  - Each previews its own filter: the CSS filter on the thumbnail, plus an `<i>` soft-light tint overlay.
  - The active one gets `--glow`; hover lifts 3px.
  - Click applies the filter and commits.
- A 36px round **›** button rotates the five-thumbnail window by one, nudging the row from −14px back to 0 over 350ms.

**Filters** (`#grade` filter / `#tint` background):

| Filter | `#grade` filter | `#tint` background |
|---|---|---|
| Daylight (default) | `none` | `transparent` |
| Soft Film | `contrast(.92) saturate(.85) brightness(1.06)` | `linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,226,214,.35), rgba(180,200,220,.35))` |
| Cool Studio | `saturate(.9) brightness(1.06) contrast(1.04)` | `linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(150,190,255,.55), rgba(200,220,255,.3))` |
| Blue Hour | `brightness(.82) contrast(1.1) saturate(1.1)` | `linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(70,60,170,.75), rgba(150,90,170,.55))` |
| Mono | `grayscale(1) contrast(1.12) brightness(1.03)` | `transparent` |
| Golden Hour | `saturate(1.1) brightness(1.02)` | `linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,180,90,.6), rgba(255,140,80,.4))` |

Both properties transition over .9s.

### 11.4 Save `#save.glass`

- Geometry: `left: 1302; top: 796; 274×88`, padding 14.
- Inside it is `SAVE TO LIBRARY`:
  - 17px, .06em tracking, radius 16, 1.5px white border;
  - glow `0 0 18px rgba(255,255,255,.35), inset 0 0 14px rgba(255,255,255,.15)`;
  - hover: white fill with dark text.
- On click:
  - a skewed white shine sweeps across the button (.9s);
  - the **Library drawer** opens;
  - a "flyer" clone of the current look (with the current grade filter) starts over the model's box (middle 50% of its width) and flies over `.8s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1)` to the next 72×104 slot in the library row;
  - after 860ms the slot becomes a real saved card (it pops in from scale .4), the Library badge counts up, and the toast reads "Saved to library".
  - Clicking a saved card loads that look.

### 11.5 Library drawer `#lib.glass`

- Geometry: `left: 504; top: 560; 592×170`, sitting above the control bar.
- Hidden state: `translateY(20px) scale(.97)` and opacity 0, `.4s`.
- Contents: a `LIBRARY` header with the note "n saved", then a horizontal row of 72×104 saved cards. The empty text is "Save a look to start your library."
- Clicking outside the drawer, the Bag button and the Save button closes it.

---

## 12. Randomize

- The icon spins +360° (.8s).
- A **roulette** highlight then steps across the visible cards 12 times, slowing from 50ms by +8ms per step.
- It lands on a random different look and swaps it in with the wipe.
- It also sets a random filter from the first four and a random realism between 55 and 99, then commits.

---

## 13. Toast

- Glass pill centred at stage top 96, with a white check icon, 15px text.
- It drops in from −20px with a `.35s cubic-bezier(.3,1.4,.5,1)` spring and auto-hides after 1.8s.

---

## 14. Initial state and acceptance checklist

**Initial state:**
- Look 0 (Denim Maxi) shown without animation.
- Daylight filter, realism 75%, height 168, build 50, Full framing.
- Undo and Redo disabled.
- STYLE tab with the Outfits menu item active.
- Indicators positioned after layout and again on `load`.

**Checklist:**
- [ ] The scene is cool neutral daylight, not yellow, and the loft is nearly empty.
- [ ] All eight looks show the same Korean woman in the same pose. Swapping is a top-to-bottom clip wipe with a glowing scan line, and never a cross-fade.
- [ ] The avatar and the five filter thumbnails are face crops of the *current* look.
- [ ] Every control described above works: chips filter with a stagger, the accordion shows real pieces and prices, the cart / favourite / library badges spring, and undo / redo / reset follow real history.
- [ ] Pose re-frames full → mid → portrait with the head kept in frame, and the hotspots hide outside full framing.
- [ ] Tabs slide the indicator, swap the right-panel views, and slide the style menu and Randomize away outside STYLE.
- [ ] Panels are dark smoked glass with white text and the `--glow` active state everywhere.
- [ ] The 1600×900 stage scales to fit, and the background parallax follows the cursor.

description: Single, self-contained, production-ready index.html — one file, no build step, no frameworks, no local assets. It renders a full-viewport dark hero section for a fictional e-commerce SaaS called "Vertex Shops". Features dynamic canvas particle and fluid simulation, cinematic looping background video integration with precision layout polish.
full_prompt:
Build a single, self-contained, production-ready `index.html` — one file, no build step, no frameworks, no local assets. It renders a full-viewport dark hero section for a fictional e-commerce SaaS called "Vertex Shops". Every image loads from the absolute CloudFront URLs in §8. There is NO video anywhere in this page. Two components below are marked PIXEL CONTRACT. Those are the most commonly botched parts of this design. Implement them exactly as written, including the DO-NOT lists. Do not "improve" them, do not substitute a more conventional button/pill pattern, do not add glows or centring that is not specified. ===================================================================== 0. GLOBAL SHELL ===================================================================== , . Vision — Streamline the shop virtual FONTS — exactly these three tags in , in this order: Reset: *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box} html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#020204} /* page never scrolls */ body{font-family:Poppins,Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;color:#fff;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased} a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit} /* REQUIRED - button labels must never underline */ ===================================================================== 1. CORE ARCHITECTURE — A FIXED DESIGN CANVAS THAT IS SCALED ===================================================================== The single most important idea: the desktop composition is authored at a fixed 1172 x 657 px design canvas. EVERY element is absolutely positioned in raw design pixels — there is no flow layout, no flexbox column, no auto-centring on desktop. The whole canvas is then scaled by ONE transform to fit the viewport. The optical centre of every centred element is x=586. .stage{position:fixed;inset:0;overflow:hidden;background:#020204} .canvas{position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;width:1172px;height:657px; transform:translateX(-50%) scale(var(--k,1));transform-origin:50% 0} .canvas>*{position:absolute} .stack{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:300} /* layout shell, no box of its own */ .stack>*{position:absolute} .navmenu{display:contents} /* shell, invisible on desktop */ .burger{display:none} /* desktop */ Scale law, computed in JS on every resize: k = min(vw / W, vh / 560) Using 560 (not 657) as the height divisor is deliberate: it fills the width and lets the browser mock bleed off the bottom edge rather than letterboxing. W = 1172 on desktop; see §10 for the tablet ramp. Background (never animates — it is the stage): .bg{position:absolute;inset:0; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(25,127,255,0) 38%, rgba(25,127,255,.042) 54%, rgba(25,127,255,.052) 68%, rgba(25,127,255,.030) 100%), #020204} STARFIELD — two 1x1px divs whose entire star field is one giant box-shadow list, generated in JS. .stars{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:1px;height:1px; border-radius:50%;background:#fff} Layer A (#stA): 150 stars, blur 0px, alpha random .05–.30 Layer B (#stB): 18 stars, blur 1.2px, alpha random .35–.70 Each entry: "vw vh px 0 rgba(255,255,255,)", joined with commas, assigned to el.style.boxShadow. ===================================================================== 1.5 EXACT COORDINATE TABLE — NON-NEGOTIABLE ===================================================================== All values are design pixels inside the 1172 x 657 canvas. Reproduce every one. If your layout does not match this table, the layout is wrong. ELEMENT POSITION SIZE RADIUS .nav left 247, top 3 678 x 64 32 .mark left 21, top 19 (in nav) 24 x 24 — .wm left 50, top 0 (in nav) auto — .wm .kick left 3, top 20 auto — .wm .name left 0, top 26 auto — .links left 156, top 0 (in nav) auto x 62 — .nav .btn left 530.7,top 10.5 125.5 x 39.5 14 .badge left 462, top 95 250 x 39 12 .badge i left 4, top 4 (in badge) 29 x 29 8 .badge b left 45, top 0 (in badge) auto x 39 — .h1 (both lines) left 586, translateX(-50%) nowrap — #h1a first baseline y 204.5 ink width 563.5 cap height 37.2 #h1b first baseline y 258.5 ink width 197.5 cap height 37.2 .sub (both lines) left 586, translateX(-50%) nowrap — #sub1 first baseline y 300.5 ink width 389 cap height 8.4 #sub2 first baseline y 316.5 ink width 311 cap height 8.4 .cta2 left 526, top 349 121 x 54.5 13 .showcase left 0, top 0 1172 x 0 — .ring left 0, top 0 1172 x 657 — .card left 586, top 616 130 x 300 12 margin:-150px 0 0 -65px (so the card centres on that point) .browser left 165, top 558 842 x calc(99px + var(--fill,0px)) radius 28 28 0 0 .page left 7, right 6, top 42, bottom 0 10 10 0 0 .wa right 16, bottom 24 (in .stage, OUTSIDE .canvas) 56 x 56 50% Z-INDEX ORDER (front to back): .nav 400 · .stack / .h1 / .sub / .cta2 / .badge / .wa 300 · .browser 100 · .ring 5 · .bg 0. The browser mock MUST paint in FRONT of the carousel ring, overlapping its lower third. That overlap is the whole point of the composition. Remaining ink targets for the type fitter (§11): #wmName ink 51 cap 11.4 first baseline y 38.5 #badgeTxt ink 184 cap 9.4 transform pre 'translate(2px,-1px)' #ctaLabel ink 87 cap 8.9 then optically centred in its button #vpLabel ink 76 cap 9.5 then optically centred in its button .links a cap 7.9 (one shared size), then the whole row squeezed to width 317 ===================================================================== 2. PIXEL CONTRACT A — THE BADGE ===================================================================== The badge is a FIXED-SIZE absolutely-positioned box with an icon tile pinned to its left edge and a left-aligned label beside it. full_prompt:
# VirtualFit: Spatial Try-On Arc (exact recreation prompt)

Build a single-screen, visionOS-style virtual try-on hero called **VirtualFit**.

- **Scene:** a softly blurred bright living room fills the screen. A man stands in the centre, cut off at mid-thigh, in front of a huge ghosted `FIT` word.
- **Garment arc:** frosted-glass garment cards curve around him in a 3D arc. They recede, shrink, tilt and blur toward the edges and bob gently. You can drag, flick, scroll, use the arrow keys or buttons, or click a card.
- **Try-on:** when the arc settles on a garment, a glowing horizontal scan line sweeps down the model with a faint scan-line grid and reveals him wearing that garment.
- **Controls:** a glass pill tab bar sits at the top, a glass tool rail on the left, and a glass buy card at the bottom (thumbnail, rolling name and price, size chips and colour dots).
- **Cursor:** a 58px glass cursor reads `TRY ON` over cards and `DRAG` over empty space.

Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS in one file, with no libraries. Reproduce every value, string, timing and URL exactly.

---

## 1. Page basics

- `<html lang="en">`, title `VirtualFit: Spatial Try-On`, viewport `width=device-width,initial-scale=1`.
- **Font:** Inter 400, 500, 600, 700, 800 and 900 from `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap`, with preconnects to fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com (crossorigin). The standalone version embeds the latin woff2 as base64 `@font-face` rules instead.
- **Reset:** `*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}`. `html,body{height:100%}`.
- **`body`:** background `#e9e4dc`, colour `#fff`, Inter, `overflow:hidden`, antialiased, `user-select:none`.
- **Buttons:** reset to inherit font and colour, no background and no border.
- On `(pointer:fine)`, `cursor:none` on html, body and buttons.
- **CSS variables:**
  - `--ease:cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`
  - `--sans:"Inter",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif`
  - `--MH:min(78vh,62vw)` (model height; `min(62vh,128vw)` below 768px)
  - `--CW`, the card width, set by JS
  - the three image variables in section 2

## 2. Assets (use these exact URLs)

| Variable | URL | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `--room` | `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261104_080623_c94c85a3-23d5-4a0c-afff-41be1b5b8191.png&w=2400&q=85` | Bright Scandinavian living room, 16:9. Big window with plants at left, beige sofa and round coffee table lower left, white wall with leaf shadows in the middle, a plant in a grey pot and an oak shelf with books at right, oak floor with a cream rug. |
| `--model` | `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261104_080717_e02cb856-b812-4c9b-9b86-8a741c7f65eb.png&w=2688&q=85` | Transparent sheet, 2688×1520. The same man (short dark hair, trimmed beard, charcoal trousers) five times side by side, from head to mid-thigh, in: a white crew tee, an oversized white sweatshirt, a white linen shirt, a heather-grey hoodie, and a white ringer tee with black trims. |
| `--garm` | `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261104_080719_f5a4cca2-cf42-4957-ab3b-ddec34d2b71a.png&w=2048&q=85` | Transparent ghost-mannequin sheet, 2048×1360, in a 3×2 grid. Top row: white tee, white sweatshirt, white linen shirt. Bottom row: grey hoodie, ringer tee, navy tee (the navy tee is unused). |

**Crops:**
- **Model:** each figure is a 524×1360 window of the model sheet, so `background-size:513% 111.76%` with `background-position-y:100%`.
- **Garments:** each is a 640×640 box of the garment sheet, so `background-size:320% 212.5%`.

## 3. Data

```js
const ITEMS=[
  {n:"Basic T-shirt", p:45,  g:[1.14,3.06],  m:.37,   c:[["White","#f4f2ee"],["Ash","#c9c7c2"],["Charcoal","#3b3c3f"],["Navy","#27324d"]]},
  {n:"Basic Sweater", p:105, g:[49.7,1.39],  m:25.0,  c:[["White","#f6f4ef"],["Oat","#ddd3c2"],["Sage","#b9c2ae"],["Black","#1f1f21"]]},
  {n:"Linen Shirt",   p:95,  g:[98.2,3.33],  m:49.86, c:[["White","#f7f6f1"],["Sand","#d9ccb4"],["Sky","#bcd0e2"],["Olive","#717556"]]},
  {n:"Grey Hoodie",   p:110, g:[1.14,93.3],  m:74.77, c:[["Heather","#a9a9a8"],["Bone","#e6e1d6"],["Forest","#33463a"],["Black","#1f1f21"]]},
  {n:"Ringer Tee",    p:55,  g:[49.7,95.3],  m:99.35, c:[["White / Black","#f4f2ee"],["Cream / Navy","#efe6d3"],["Grey / Red","#c9c7c2"],["White / Green","#e9efe8"]]},
];
```

- `g` is the garment `background-position` (x%, y%).
- `m` is the model `background-position-x` (%).
- There are 10 cards in all (two copies of the 5 items, so the arc loops seamlessly).

## 4. Layers and styling

1. **`.room`** (fixed, inset -3%): the room on `center/cover`, `filter:blur(2.5px) saturate(1.05)`, `transform:scale(1.08)`. An `::after` overlay adds `radial-gradient(70% 60% at 50% 45%, rgba(255,252,246,.10), rgba(40,30,20,.16))`.
2. **`.ghost`** (fixed, z 2): `FIT` with each letter in its own inline-block span.
   - Position: centred at `top:calc(50% − MH×.42)`.
   - Font: Inter 900 at `MH×.42`, line-height .8, letter-spacing -.04em.
   - Colour `rgba(255,255,255,.3)`, a 1px stroke `rgba(255,255,255,.35)`, and text-shadow `0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35)`.
3. **Glass material `.glass`** (used by the tabs, rail, arrows, cards and buy card):
   - background `linear-gradient(155deg, rgba(250,248,245,.30), rgba(150,144,136,.20) 48%, rgba(205,200,192,.24))`
   - `backdrop-filter:blur(22px) saturate(1.5)`
   - border `1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5)`
   - shadows `inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.12), 0 20px 50px -24px rgba(40,30,20,.45)`
4. **Tabs `.tabs.glass`:**
   - Layout: fixed, centred, top 4.2vh, z 30, padding 5px, radius 999px, gap 2px.
   - Buttons: `Tops` (active), `Bottoms`, `Outerwear`, `Shoes`, `Accessories`. Each is 38px tall with 0 22px padding, Inter 500 14px, colour `rgba(30,30,32,.72)`; the active one is `#111`.
   - A sliding white pill (`rgba(255,255,255,.92)`, shadow `0 4px 14px -6px rgba(0,0,0,.3)`) sits under the active tab. It moves with `transform` and `width` over .6s `--ease`.
5. **Rail `.rail.glass`:**
   - Layout: fixed, left `max(18px,1.8vw)`, vertically centred, padding 8px, gap 10px, radius 999px.
   - Four 42px round buttons with 20px icons: a filled tee (active: white `rgba(255,255,255,.9)` disc, colour #111), a cart, a calendar and a profile.
   - Inactive icons are `rgba(30,30,32,.8)` and hover to `rgba(255,255,255,.35)`.
6. **Stage `.stage`** (fixed, inset 0, z 10, `touch-action:pan-y`) holds `.arc` at the centre.
   - Each `.card.glass` is `CW` wide and `CW×1.42` tall, centred on the arc origin, radius 22px, overflow hidden.
   - Inside each card:
     - Garment image `.g`: left/right 8%, top 5%, height 66%, `drop-shadow(0 14px 14px rgba(40,30,20,.22))`.
     - Name: Inter 500 at `CW×.068`, bottom 17%.
     - Price `$NN`: Inter 700 at `CW×.095`, bottom 7%.
     - Name and price are both white with `text-shadow 0 1px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.18)`.
   - A `.sheen` diagonal highlight (`linear-gradient(105deg, transparent 40%, rgba(255,255,255,.5) 50%, transparent 60%)`) sweeps across once (1s) when the cursor enters a card.
   - `CW = min(14.8vw, 33vh)`, or `min(30vw, 170px)` below 768px.
7. **Model `.model`** (fixed, centred, bottom 0, height `--MH`, `aspect-ratio:524/1360`, z 50, no pointer events). Layers:
   - `#mCur`: the current outfit.
   - `#mNext`: the next outfit, starting at `clip-path:inset(0 0 100% 0)`.
   - `.grid`: `repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 0 5px, rgba(255,255,255,.22) 5px 6px)`, `mix-blend-mode:screen`, clipped.
   - `.scan`: a 2px line spanning -14% to 114% of the width. Gradient `transparent → #fff 18% → #fff 82% → transparent`, glow `0 0 18px 4px rgba(255,255,255,.75), 0 0 60px 10px rgba(190,225,255,.45)`. Its `::after` trails a `MH×.12` tall wash, `linear-gradient(to top, rgba(220,238,255,.32), transparent)`, above it.
8. **Arrows:** 46px glass circles with 16px chevrons in `#222`, vertically centred. Left one at `calc(max(18px,1.8vw) + 76px)`, right one at `max(18px,1.8vw)`. Hidden on phones.
9. **Buy card `.buy.glass`:**
   - Layout: fixed, centred, bottom 4.6vh, z 60, width `min(640px, 100vw − 32px)`, flex, gap 22px, padding `12px 22px 12px 12px`, radius 24px, white text, text-shadow `0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.18)`.
   - **Thumbnail:** 64px, radius 14px, `rgba(255,255,255,.3)`, garment inset 6px.
   - **Info:** name in Inter 600 16px; price in Inter 500 14px at .9 opacity. Each sits in a `.ln` mask, 1.15em tall with overflow hidden, so text can roll.
   - **`Size`** label (Inter 500 12px, .85 opacity), then 30px round chips `S` `M` `L` `XL`. They are `rgba(255,255,255,.22)` with white text; the active one (`M` at start) is white with #111 text; pressing one scales it to .9.
   - **Colour:** the label `Color · <name>` rolls when it changes. Below it are four 18px dots in the item's colours. The active dot has a ring: `0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.95), 0 0 0 4px rgba(0,0,0,.12)`.
10. **Cursor `.cur`** (58px, fixed, z 100):
    - Ring: 1.5px `rgba(255,255,255,.95)` border, `rgba(255,255,255,.14)` fill, `backdrop-filter:blur(6px)`, shadow `0 6px 20px -8px rgba(0,0,0,.35)`.
    - A 6px white dot in the centre.
    - Hidden labels in Inter 700 10px, letter-spacing .12em: `TRY ON` (#111) and `DRAG` (white).
    - It follows the pointer with `pos += (target − pos) × .22`.
    - Over a card (`try`): the ring scales to 1.5 and fills `rgba(255,255,255,.92)`, and `TRY ON` scales in.
    - Over empty stage or while dragging (`drag`): the ring scales to 1.2 and `DRAG` shows.
    - Over a button (`btn`): the ring scales to .6.
    - Pointer down: 1.05.
    - Transitions: ring .5s, dot .4s, text .45s, all `--ease`.

## 5. Arc maths (every animation frame)

**State:** `pos` (float), `target` (int). When not dragging, `pos += (target − pos) × .11`.

**Card offset:** for card `i`, `u = mod(i − pos + 5, 10) − 5`. Let `a = |u|` and `sg = sign(u)`.

**Horizontal placement:**
- Table `XS = [0, .215, .345, .432, .49, .52] × W` (phones: `[0, .36, .5, .56, .6, .62] × W`).
- `xAt(a)` interpolates linearly through that table.
- `x = sg × xAt(a) × ie`, where `ie` is the intro ease (below).

**Per-card values:**
- **Behind the model** (`a < 1`): `s = .55 + .45a`, `z = −260(1 − a)`, opacity `a`, `ry = −sg × 16a`.
- **Otherwise:** `s = 1 / (1 + .3(a − 1)^1.15)`, `z = −110(a − 1)`, `ry = −sg × (16 + 9 × min(2, a − 1))`, blur `max(0, a − 1.6) × 2.4` px.
- **Far edge** (`a > 3.4`): opacity `1 − (a − 3.4)/.8`.
- **Bob:** `sin(t × 1.1 + seed) × H × .006 × min(1, a)`. `y = bob − (1 − s) × H × .04`.
- **Pointer tilt:** `ry += sx × 10`, where `sx` and `sy` are the smoothed pointer offsets in [-.5, .5], smoothed by `× .06`.

**Transform:** `translate(x, y) perspective(1300px) translateZ(z) rotateY(ry) rotateX(−sy × 6) scale(s × (.6 + .4ie))`. Each card carries its own perspective; there is no shared `preserve-3d` scene, which keeps the backdrop blur from flickering.

**Stacking and visibility:** z-index is 1 behind the model, otherwise `round(100 − 10a)`. A card is hidden when its opacity is below .01. Card opacity is multiplied by `ie`.

**Intro:** `intro += .012` per frame, and `ie = 1 − (1 − intro)³`. The cards spread out from the centre and scale up.

**Parallax:**
- Room: `translate3d(−sx × 22px, −sy × 14px, 0) scale(1.08 − .03ie)`.
- Ghost word: `translate(calc(−50% − sx × 40px), −sy × 16px)`.
- Ghost letters rise in: letter `i` gets `translateY((1 − ie)(60 + 30i)px)`.

**Settle:** when `|target − pos| < .02` and `mod(round(target), 5)` differs from the outfit shown (and nothing is being dragged), run try-on for that item.

## 6. Try-on scan (950 ms, `cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1)`)

1. Update the buy card, cancel any running scan, and set `#mNext` to the new figure.
2. Run these Web Animations together:
   - **`#mNext` clip:** `inset(0 0 100% 0)` → `inset(0 0 0% 0)` over 950ms, fill forwards.
   - **`.grid` clip:** `inset(0 0 100% 0)` → `inset(0 0 0 0)` at 50% → `inset(100% 0 0 0)` over 1092ms.
   - **`.scan`:** top 0%, `scaleX(.2)`, opacity 0 → top 6%, `scaleX(1)`, opacity 1 at 8% → top 94% at 92% → top 100%, `scaleX(.2)`, opacity 0.
   - **`#mNext` settle:** `scale(1.012)` → 1 over 1250ms, ease-out.
3. When the clip animation finishes, copy the figure to `#mCur` and cancel all four animations.

On load, `#mCur` stays hidden and the first scan reveals the model from nothing.

## 7. Buy card updates

- **Name, price and colour label** roll: the old text animates `translateY(0)` → `−110%` while the new text animates `110%` → `0`, over 620ms with `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`.
- **Thumbnail:** jumps to the new crop and animates from `translateY(70%) scale(.8)` over 650ms.
- **Colour dots:** rebuilt from the item's colours with the first one active. Clicking a dot rolls the label to `Color · <name>`.
- **Size chips:** clicking one sets it active.

## 8. Input

- **Drag:** pointerdown on the stage starts a drag. `pos = p0 − dx / XS[1]` (one card per arc step), and the velocity is tracked in px/ms. On release, `target = round(pos − flick × 3.2)`.
- **Click:** a click (moved under 6px) on a card sets `target` so that card comes to the centre.
- **Wheel:** horizontal or vertical delta builds up past 60, then steps ±1 with at least 260ms between steps.
- **Keys and buttons:** arrow keys and the arrow buttons step ±1.
- **Tabs:** clicking a tab slides the pill to it and adds 5 to `target`, so the arc does a full lap and lands back on the same garment.

## 9. Phones (≤767px) and reduced motion

- **Phones:**
  - The tabs shrink to 32px with 0 13px padding and 12px text, and scroll sideways.
  - The rail moves to bottom left (`left:10px`, `bottom:calc(4.6vh + 150px)`) with 34px buttons.
  - The arrows are hidden.
  - The buy card wraps onto two lines.
- **Reduced motion:**
  - The spring snaps straight to the target and the intro is instant.
  - No bob and no sheen.
  - The scan is skipped: the outfit swaps instantly.
  - The buy card text swaps without rolling.

SMOOTH VIDEO SCROLL — SAME LOGIC (do not replace with GSAP or naive currentTime only)

Hook useVideoScrub(videoSrc):

Constants:
  LERP_TAU = 8
  SNAP = 0.002
  LRU_MAX = 24
  LEAD = 24
  WATCHDOG = 60000 ms

State:
  bank: {ts microseconds, blob webp}[]
  lru: Map<index, ImageBitmap | null>
  current / target times in seconds
  ready, reverted, painted, building, dur

rAF loop every frame:
  dt = min(0.1, deltaSeconds)
  p = getProgress(); setScrollProgress(p)
  if dur > 0:
    target = p * dur
    if prefers-reduced-motion: current = target
    else:
      current += (target - current) * (1 - exp(-dt * LERP_TAU))
      if abs(target-current) < SNAP: current = target
    if ready: draw nearest frame from bank
    else: fallback: if not seeking and abs(video.currentTime - current) > 0.01, set video.currentTime = current

Frame bank (build after window load, skip if reduced-motion or no VideoDecoder):
  fetch the CloudFront mp4 as ArrayBuffer
  parse with MP4Box.createFile(), extract video track, configure VideoDecoder (codec + avcC/hvcC/vpcC/av1C description)
  decode samples as EncodedVideoChunk (key vs delta)
  throttle with LEAD so decode doesn't outrun blob encoding
  each VideoFrame → offscreen canvas → toBlob('image/webp', 0.82) stored with timestamp
  sort bank by ts
  nearestIndex: binary search on timestamps (compare t*1e6)
  warmLRU around i-1..i+2, createImageBitmap, evict oldest when size > LRU_MAX
  first successful canvas paint → canvasLive true (canvas fades in over video)
  if hardware decode fails, retry once with hardwareAcceleration: 'prefer-software'
  60s watchdog → revert to video seeking fallback, hide canvas
  CORS: fetch needs CloudFront CORS; video element still works as fallback if decode fails

Video element still renders underneath until canvas is live.

- Add extra brands, logos, cookie widgets, or “scroll down to discover”
- Change copy or nav labels
- Play the video with play()
- Use a different video host or local file
- Skip mobile overlay or hamburger
- Skip lerp (jumping frames = wrong)

DELIVER
Working Vite React TS app: index.html, App.tsx, useVideoScrub.ts, index.css, mp4box.d.ts, vite alias @, lucide-react + mp4box installed. Pixel-faithful to the spec above.

# Prompt: ZENTRADE FAQ page

Build a single-file **FAQ page for a fictional online trading platform, ZENTRADE**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is dark and premium: a near-black page with a soft green glow and stepped green light bars at the top, frosted-glass navigation, a big bold headline, a glass search bar, four pill-shaped category cards and a smooth one-at-a-time accordion.

## Scale

- **Units:** every desktop size is in reference pixels of a 1778px-wide page, multiplied by `--u = 100vw / 1778` (capped at 2200px wide).
- **Tablet (768–1199px):** a fixed `--u = .82px` with a reflowed layout.
- **Phone (under 768px):** a fixed `--u = .8px` with one column.
- **Content column:** 1224u, centred.

## Type and colour

- **Figtree:** 800 for the headline, 400/500/600 for the UI and body.
- **Lexend 300:** the search field only.
- **Colours:**
  - page `#090909`
  - lime `#83F34D` with dark lime text `#0B2400`
  - cards `#1B1B1B`, icon rings `#232323`
  - accordion rows `#131313`
  - rules `#2F2F2F`
  - muted text white at 82%

## Background (CSS only, static)

- **Glow:** a central radial green glow (740u × 950u, centred 92u from the top) that fades from `#1D2E13` to the page colour.
- **Light bars:** a 655u-tall top layer with five stepped vertical light bars on each side. Each fades from green (`#2A4B1B` → `#1D2F14`) to transparent, and the bars step down in height towards the centre (430, 360, 288, 216 and 156u) and are about 80–98u wide.
- **Top spill:** a faint green light spill along the top edge.

## Navigation (58u tall, 22u from the top)

- **Left:**
  - an angled white "Z" mark (51 × 26u) drawn as one SVG path: a top bar, a diagonal and a bottom bar, with slanted ends
  - "ZENTRADE" in Figtree 500 at 26.4u
- **Centre:** a frosted-glass pill (54u tall, radius 13u, 18u blur, white border at 14%) with "About Us · Accounts · Partnerships · FAQs" at 17u. Links glow faint lime on hover.
- **Right:**
  - a glass language selector (138 × 47u): a round US flag, "English" and a chevron
  - a 101u outline "Login" button with a lime border
  - a 142u lime "Trade Now" button with dark text
  - buttons are 58u tall with a 12u radius

## Hero (centred, 177u below the nav)

- **Tag:** a pill "FAQ" (97 × 52u) of green-tinted glass with a pale green 1.3u border.
- **Headline:** "Frequently Asked Questions", Figtree 800, 62.8u on a 75u line.
- **Lede:** two lines at 17u on a 28u line: "Find answers to the most common questions about ZENTRADE’s platforms, / accounts, deposits, trading conditions, and more."
- **Button:** a white "Join Our Community" button (221 × 50u, radius 11u).

## FAQ area (1224u column)

- **Search:** a glass bar 79u below the hero (74u tall, fully rounded, white at 16% with a 24u blur). A magnifier icon, then "Search for your queries" in Lexend 300.
  - **Focus:** a lime border and a soft lime ring.
  - **Filtering:** typing filters the questions by question and answer text. "No questions match your search." appears when nothing matches.
- **Categories:** a 2×2 grid, 59u below the search, with 23u × 25u gaps.
  - **Each card:** fully rounded, 129u tall, `#1B1B1B`, with a 99u round icon disc holding a white glyph:
    - money bag
    - candlesticks
    - target
    - trending-up arrow
  - **Card text:** title (Figtree 500, 23.2u) and "62 Articles" (16.6u, muted).
  - **Titles:** About Zen Trade · Trading Rules & Guidelines · Zen Trade Challenge Insight · Zen Trade Features.
  - **Hover:** the border tints lime.
- **Accordion:** 58u below the cards. Five rows, 22u apart.
  - **Rows:** each question is a full-width button (min 82u tall, radius 14u, `#131313`, Figtree 500 at 23.6u) with a thin circular chevron at the right. The chevron points down when closed and rotates up when open.
  - **Opening:** only one item is open at a time. The answer opens with a `grid-template-rows: 0fr → 1fr` transition (.32s). The answer text is 15.2u on a 23u line, with a thin rule under it.
  - **Questions and answers:**
    1. "What assets can I trade on ZENTRADE?" (open by default): forex majors and minors, indices, commodities such as gold and oil, and popular cryptocurrencies, all from one account, with live spread, leverage and hours shown before each order.
    2. "What is ZENTRADE?": an online trading platform with access to global markets through a fast, secure, easy-to-use interface and dedicated support.
    3. "How do I open an account?": sign up, complete the form, verify your identity, then make your first deposit.
    4. "Which deposit and withdrawal methods are available?": the secure methods listed in your client area, varying by region.
    5. "What are the trading conditions?": spreads, leverage and fees vary by account type and instrument; compare them on the Accounts page.

## Motion

| 2 | 45, 876, 834 | 76, 913, 848 | 60, 901, 845 |
| 3 | 45, 606, 1169 | 80, 550, 1179 | 76, 520, 1180 |
| 4 | 1024, 937, 177 | 1024, 936, 177 | 1026, 931, 175 |
| 5 | 1024, 936, 511 | 1024, 940, 513 | 1026, 929, 508 |
| 6 | 1024, 907, 825 | 1024, 894, 851 | 1024, 901, 845 |
| 7 | 1024, 962, 1166 | 1024, 938, 1185 | 1024, 934, 1184 |

**How a crop is painted at scale `s` (px per sheet px):** a div ("face") of width 340·s and height (h+6)·s, `left: −170·s` (so its horizontal centre sits on the hook), `top: 0`, `background-image` = the sheet, `background-size: (1360·s)px auto`, `background-position: (−(hookX−170)·s)px (−y·s)px`, `background-repeat: no-repeat`. Never cut or re-host the images: every garment, thumbnail and quick-view image is a CSS crop of these three sheets.

### Fonts

| Family | Weights | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Inter (variable) | 100–900 (uses 400, 500, 600, 700) | https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/inter/v20/UcC73FwrK3iLTeHuS_nVMrMxCp50SjIa1ZL7.woff2 (latin subset; Google Fonts CSS: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap) |
| Cormorant Garamond | 500 | https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/cormorantgaramond/v21/co3umX5slCNuHLi8bLeY9MK7whWMhyjypVO7abI26QOD_s06KnTOig.woff2 (Google Fonts CSS: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:wght@500&display=swap) |

Declare both with `@font-face` (Inter with `font-weight: 100 900`), `font-display: swap`. Body font: `"Inter", system-ui, sans-serif`, with `-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased`. Cormorant Garamond is used only for the wordmark.

---

## 2. Head, tokens and the scaling unit

- `<html lang="en" class="is-loading">`, title "Maison Verrel — The Rail", viewport `width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover`.
- Colour tokens: background `#FAF7F2`, utility bar `#EFEBE4`, ink `#1A1716`, muted `#746A5E`, hairline `#DDD5C9`, search pill `#EDE8DF`, tag `#F6F1E7`. Near-black for buttons and badges: `#0E0D0C`.
- **One design unit `--u`** (a px length set by JS). Every size below is written in design px and must be rendered as `calc(N * var(--u))`.
  - Desktop (viewport width > 820): `u = min(innerWidth/1440, innerHeight/900)`. The design frame is 1440 × 900.
  - Phone and tablet (width ≤ 820): `u = min(innerWidth/390, innerHeight/780)`.
  - Recompute on `resize`. If width or height is 0 (a hidden or collapsed frame), skip the layout until the next resize.
- Rail parameters as CSS custom properties read by JS (unitless design px): desktop `--rail-top: 270; --rail-sag: 74; --gap: 121; --gs: .455; --start: 113`; phone `--rail-top: 292; --rail-sag: 30; --gap: 80; --gs: .30; --start: 46`.
- Elements are absolutely positioned and pinned to the edges they belong to: left items use `left`, right items use `right`, centred items use `left: 50%; translate: -50% 0`. Vertical offsets are from the top, and the footer is measured from the bottom.

---

## 3. Structure and desktop layout (1440 × 900 frame)

The DOM is: a `.page` wrapper (`position: fixed; inset: 0`), containing `.stage` (every hero element) and `.qv` (the quick-view layer). After `.page` comes the cart `aside.drawer`.

### Utility bar
Full width, top 0, height 31, background `#EFEBE4`. Right-aligned links with right padding 48: "Our Ateliers", "Care", "Journal", "Sign In", in Inter 13.5, colour `#6B655D`. Between links is a "|" in `#A39C92` with 15 of margin on each side (drawn with `a + a::before`).

### Nav row (top 31, height 72)
- **Wordmark** "MAISON VERREL": Cormorant Garamond 500, size 23.6, letter-spacing 0.075em, line-height 1. Left 47, top 20 inside the nav. It spans x 47–251 on screen.
- **Links** "Home", "Atelier", "The Rail", "Contact": Inter 500, size 15.5, gap 42, centred (`left: 50%; translate: -50% 0`) and nudged left by 8 (`transform: translateX(-8u)`), top 25. On screen they span x 545–879.
- **Tools**, right 64, top 16, in a flex row:
  - Search pill: 150 × 40, radius 20, background `#EDE8DF`, left padding 29, gap 14. Magnifier icon 19 × 19 (circle r 7 at 10.5/10.5 plus a line to the bottom-right, stroke `#2A2420`, width 1.7, round caps), then the word "Search" in Inter 15, colour `#8B857C`.
  - Account icon 22 × 22 (head circle r 4 and a shoulders path, stroke `#1A1716`, 1.6), 26 to the left of it.
  - Bag button 32 further right: bag outline 22 × 22 (trapezoid body plus handle arc, stroke 1.6). Count badge: 18 tall, minimum width 18, fully rounded, `#0E0D0C`, white Inter 600 at 10.5, at left 12 and top −9 relative to the icon. It starts at **3**.

### Eyebrow (top 144, centred)
"NEW COLLECTION" in Inter 600 12.4, tracking 0.18em, colour `#5A5148`. Then a 1 × 13 divider in `#C9C0B3`, then "EVENING & TAILORING" in the same size, colour `#8A7F72`, tracking 0.213em. Gap 17 between parts. On screen: x 535–679, divider ≈ 697, x 715–901.

### Headline (top 176, centred, one line)
"Silhouettes that hang right." in Inter 600, size 62, letter-spacing −0.035em, line-height 1.1. Each word is its own inline-block span with a right margin of 0.24em (none on the last). Word colours fade from ink to light: "Silhouettes" `#141210`, "that" `#54493F`, "hang" `#75675A`, and "right." has a text gradient, `linear-gradient(90deg, #A6968A, #C6B8A9)` clipped to the text. It spans about x 347–1102, with cap-top near y 190 and baseline near y 235.

### The rail
- `.rail-zone`: full width, from top 230 to bottom 120, `touch-action: pan-y`, cursor `grab` (`grabbing` while dragging).
- The rail is an SVG quadratic curve across the full page width, recomputed on every resize. Its centreline is `railY(x) = (railTop + sag · (1 − t²)) · u`, where `t = (x − W/2) / (W/2)` and W is the page width. That gives y 270 at both edges and 344 in the middle on desktop. With y0 = railY(0) and yc = 2·railY(W/2) − y0, the path is `M0 y0 Q W/2 yc W y0`. Draw three strokes in this order, with no fill:
  1. A shadow 4u lower: `rgba(80,60,35,.12)`, width 3u.
  2. The main tube: width 5.2u, stroke a vertical gradient `#E9DCBC` → `#C2A877` (45%) → `#7F6743`.
  3. A highlight 1.3u higher: `rgba(255,247,226,.85)`, width 1.1u.

### Garments on the rail
- Twenty pieces in this order of k: **0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 0, 5, 6, 7, 0, 4, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 1, 4, 3**. The first eleven match the mockup's line-up across the screen.
- Hook x of piece i: `x = (start + i·gap)·u − scroll + offset_i`. Hook y: `railY(x) − 3u`, so every hanger sits on the curve and slides along it as the rail scrolls.
- Each piece is nested like this: `.g` (translated to its hook point with `translate3d`) › `.drop` (intro animation) › `.sway` (rotation, origin at the hook, i.e. `transform-origin: 0 0`) › `.lift` (hover scale, origin 0 0, `perspective: 700u`). Inside `.lift` are two faces, side and front, painted at scale `s = gs·u` (0.455u on desktop), plus the price tag. Next to `.drop` is a soft floor shadow and an invisible hit button.
- **Price tag:** 35 × 19, background `#F6F1E7`, radius 2, shadow `0 1u 3u rgba(60,45,30,.18)`, text "$690" in Inter 600 9.6, colour `#2A2420`. A 2.4u hole dot in `#B9AE9C` sits near its top centre. Place it at left −6u and top 52u from the hook. Rotate tag i by the repeating pattern −5, 4, −3, 6, −4, 3, −6, 4, −3, 5 degrees.
- **Shadow:** an ellipse 16u tall and 110·(gs/0.48)u wide, centred under the hook and 4u below the garment's bottom, filled with `radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(70,52,34,.13), transparent)`.
- **Hit area:** a button `gap·u` wide, centred on the hook, as tall as the side face, with aria-label "<name>, $690".

### Footer (desktop)
- **Left** (left 47, bottom 58, a box 420 × 40): a hint "Hover a piece · click to look closer" in Inter 14.6, colour `#776D63`, preceded by a 27 × 1 rule in `#8E857A` with a gap of 13. A hidden label in the same spot holds two lines: the hovered piece's name (Inter 600) and its price "$690.00", at 13 px in ink.
- **Progress** (centred, bottom 64): a track 140 × 2 in `#DCD4C8`. The thumb is 58% of the track width, ink coloured, with `left = progress × 42%`.
- **Right** (right 48, bottom 46, right-aligned): two lines "Cut from Italian silk and wool." / "Tailored to order. Made to last." in Inter 600 15.6, line-height 1.24, tracking −0.005em. Below them, 14 lower, the link "Shop the Collection" in Inter 500 13.4 with a 15 × 10 arrow (a line plus a chevron, stroke 1.3), a gap of 9, a 1 px ink underline and bottom padding 5.

---

## 4. Interactions (exact behaviour)

### 4.1 Load sequence (runs once)
The `html.is-loading` guard hides the garments, headline words and footer until fonts plus the side and front sheets are ready. A failsafe starts the intro anyway after 2.5 s. When the intro starts, remove the class and run Web Animations:

| Element | From → to | Duration | Delay | Easing |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Garment `.drop` i (0–19) | translateY(−42u), opacity 0, blur(6px) → none, 1, blur(0) | 620 ms | i × 70 ms | cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1), fill backwards |
| Garment swing impulse | add ±1.6 to the sway velocity, alternating sign by index | — | i × 70 + 420 ms | spring (see 4.2) |
| Headline word j (0–3) | blur(12px), opacity 0, translateY(6u) → sharp, 1, 0 | 820 ms | 60 + j × 110 ms | cubic-bezier(.25,.8,.3,1) |
| Footer left / progress / footer right | opacity 0 → 1 | 420 ms | 600 / 680 / 760 ms | ease-out |

The rail, nav, utility bar and eyebrow are visible from the first frame. So the garments drop onto their hooks one by one from left to right, each with a little pendulum swing, while the headline sharpens word by word out of a blur.

### 4.2 Rail scroll, inertia and sway (one requestAnimationFrame loop)
- State in px: `target`, `cur`, `vel`. `maxScroll = max(0, (2·start + 19·gap)·u − pageWidth)`, and `target` is clamped to [0, maxScroll].
- Every frame (dt = elapsed / 16.667, capped at 3): `cur += (target − cur) · (1 − (1 − 0.085)^dt)`, and `vel = Δcur / dt`.
- **Wheel** anywhere, when the quick-view is closed: `preventDefault()` and add the dominant of deltaX or deltaY × 0.9 to target.
- **Drag** (pointer on the rail zone): it counts as a drag once the pointer moves more than 6 px. While dragging, `target = startTarget − dx × 1.15`, and hover is cleared. On release, fling with `target −= releaseVelocity(px/ms) × 260`. A click that followed a drag is ignored.
- **Keys:** ArrowRight and ArrowLeft move one gap. Escape closes the quick-view, or the cart if the quick-view is shut.
- **Sway** (per piece, a damped spring, skipped when reduced motion is on): target angle = clamp(−vel × 0.22, −7°, 7°); `av += (target − a) · 0.05 · dt; av *= 0.88^dt; a += av · dt`; apply `rotate(a deg)` on `.sway` around the hook. Fast scrolling makes the clothes swing against the direction of travel, and they settle when the rail stops.
- **Progress thumb:** `left = (cur / maxScroll) × 42%`.

### 4.3 Hover: turn to face (mouse only)
- Entering a hit area with a mouse pointer (not while dragging or adding to cart) gives `.g` the class `hov` and raises it to z-index 5.
- **Lift:** `.lift` goes to `translateY(12u) scale(1.2)` over 0.42 s, cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1). It scales from the hook, so the garment grows and drops slightly.
- **Turn:** the side face rotates Y 0 → −90° in 0.15 s (cubic-bezier(.5,0,1,1)). Then the front face rotates Y 90° → 0 in 0.15 s with a 0.15 s delay (cubic-bezier(0,0,.3,1)). On leave it plays in reverse, front out first, then side back in after 0.15 s. Both faces use `backface-visibility: hidden` and `transform-origin: 50% 0`.
- **Neighbours make room:** each piece eases (factor 0.16 per frame) towards an offset of sign(d) × [0, 50, 24, 9, 0][min(|d|, 4)] × (gs/0.48)u, where d = its index − the hovered index.
- **Label:** the hint fades up and out (opacity 0, translateY −6u, 0.3 s), and the name/price label fades in from translateY 6u.
- **Touch** (`hover: none`): the hint reads "Tap a piece · tap again to look closer". The first tap does the hover turn and the second tap opens the quick-view.

### 4.4 Click: quick-view
- `body.qv-open` fades `.stage` to opacity 0 with blur(8px) over 0.45 s, and disables pointer events on it.
- **Image:** a `.qv-img` layer holds a front face and a back face of the piece. On desktop they are painted at scale 0.9u, with the hook at x 440u and y 62u. A 1.5 px rod in `#3B3631` hangs from the top of the screen down to the hook. It fades in after 0.45 s.
- **Fly-in:** the image animates from the garment's current position and size on the rail (the front face if it was hovered, otherwise the side face) to its place. Use a translate plus a scale from origin 0 0, with the scale set by the height ratio, opacity 0.6 → 1, over 700 ms, cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1). Hide the rail copy while the quick-view is open. Cancel any running animation on the layer before starting, and use a token so a close that finishes late can never clear a newer open.
- **Info column** (left 972u, width 430u, vertically centred with translate −42%), every item fading up 10u with a stagger of 0.28 s + j × 0.045 s:
  1. Counter "i / 20": Inter 12, tracking 0.12em, colour `#8A7F72`.
  2. Name: Inter 600 23, tracking −0.01em.
  3. Price "$690.00": Inter 600 15.5.
  4. Tabs "Front" and "Back": Inter 15, gap 32, inactive `#8A7F72`, active ink with a 2 px underline and bottom padding 6. Switching crossfades the two faces over 0.25 s, but only once that sheet has loaded.
  5. "SIZE": Inter 11, tracking 0.14em, muted.
  6. Size pills S, M, L, XL: 52 × 44, fully rounded, border 1.5 px `#DDD5C9`, Inter 500 14. The selected one is filled `#0E0D0C` with white text. S is selected by default.
  7. "Add to cart": full width, 58 tall, fully rounded, `#0E0D0C`, white Inter 600 16.
  8. Meta row, separated by a top hairline: the piece name on the left and "View product page" (underlined) on the right, Inter 13.5.
- **Close:** a "Close ×" button at top right (right 28, top 22, height 32), with a 1.5 px ink border, background `#FAF7F2` and Inter 500 14. It reverses the flight back to the rail position with opacity → 0 over 520 ms (cubic-bezier(.55,0,.2,1)). Escape also closes it.

### 4.5 Add to cart: fly into the bag
1. The button turns `#8D8780` and shows a 16u white spinner (0.7 s linear rotation) and the text "Adding…" for 1000 ms.
2. Clone the face that is currently showing (front or back) as a fixed element on top of everything at its exact on-screen rectangle. Close the quick-view without the return flight: the piece reappears on its hook with a small drop (translateY −24u → 0, opacity 0 → 1, 520 ms, delay 260 ms) and a sway nudge of +1.4.
3. The clone flies in an arc to the centre of the bag icon over 820 ms, cubic-bezier(.55,.05,.35,1), with `transform-origin: 50% 42%`. Keyframes: start; at 45% it has moved 45% of the way, lifted 90u higher, at scale (1 + end) × 0.42; at the end it has moved the full distance at scale `end = bagHeight × 1.6 / cloneHeight` (minimum 0.04) and opacity 0.35.
4. When it lands: remove the clone, put the item (with the chosen size, quantity 1) at the top of the cart, raise the badge 3 → 4 with a pop (scale 1 → 1.45 → 1, 0.5 s, cubic-bezier(.3,1.6,.5,1)) and bounce the bag (scale 1 → 1.22 with rotate −6° → 0.94 → 1, 520 ms, ease-out).
5. **The cart drawer does not open.** It opens only when the bag icon is clicked.

### 4.6 Cart drawer (opens from the bag icon)
- `aside.drawer`: fixed on the right, 560u wide, full height, background `#FDFBF7`, left hairline. It slides from translateX(100%) to 0 over 0.6 s, cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1).
- **Page shift:** `.page` animates its `right` from 0 to 560u with the same curve, so the hero re-centres in the remaining space. The rail is redrawn for the new width every frame. In this state the search pill collapses to a 40u circle (left padding 10.5u, text clipped) and the nav links move to `left: calc(50% + 24u)`, so nothing overlaps.
- **Header:** "Cart" in Inter 700 27, tracking −0.02em. A count chip (24u, `#E9E3DA`, Inter 600 12.5). A round close button (40u, `#EFEAE2`) at the right.
- **Rows** (grid 76u | 1fr | auto, gap 18, padding 16 top and 18 bottom, hairline `#ECE6DC`): a thumbnail (76 × 96, the front crop fitted and centred), then the name in Inter 500 17, the size and "$690.00" in Inter 14 `#6F665C` with line-height 1.5, a quantity stepper (40 tall, border `#DCD4C8`, radius 4, buttons "−" and "+", value in the middle) and a trash icon. The line total is on the right in Inter 600 16. A new row slides in from translateX(30u) over 0.6 s.
- **Starting cart:** Taupe Wool Blazer (M), Champagne Bias Slip (S), Ivory Belted Trench (M).
- **Footer:** "Estimated total" with the sum (for example $2,760.00), the note "Taxes and shipping calculated at checkout." in `#8A7F72` 12.5, and a full-width black "Checkout" button (52 tall, radius 3).
- The steppers and trash update the count chip, the badge and the total live.

---

## 5. Phone and tablet (width ≤ 820)
- `u = min(width/390, height/780)`. The utility bar, nav links, search pill and account icon are hidden. The wordmark sits at left 20, top 26, size 20, and the bag at right 30, top 24.
- The eyebrow moves to top 104 (size 9.5, gap 10). The headline moves to top 130, size 40, width 330, wraps over two lines ("Silhouettes that / hang right."), centred, line-height 1.08.
- The rail uses the phone rail parameters (rail-top 292, sag 30, gap 80, scale 0.30, start 46), and the rail zone runs from top 260 to bottom 150.
- The hint sits at left 20, bottom 150. The progress bar is at bottom 128, width 110. The copy block is at right 20, bottom 30, size 13, with the link at 12.
- **Quick-view:** the image is centred horizontally with its hook at top 64. The scale is the largest value up to 0.46u that fits the piece's taller view (front or back) into the space above the info panel. The panel is pinned at left 20, bottom 24, width 350, with a 94% background tint shown only while open.
- The drawer is full width and the page does not shift. There is no sideways scroll at any size: 375 × 667, 390 × 844, 768 × 1024 and landscape 844 × 390 (which uses the desktop branch) must all fit.

## 6. Reduced motion
Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`:
- Every CSS transition and animation duration becomes 0.
- The intro is skipped (everything shows at once) and there is no sway.
- The quick-view, close and fly-to-bag happen instantly, with no motion: the item is simply added and the badge updates.

## 7. Acceptance checklist
- [ ] At 1440 × 900 the layout matches the measurements above: wordmark x 47–251, eyebrow centred at y ≈ 151, headline x ≈ 347–1102, rail at 270 → 344 → 270, eleven garments visible with the first hook at x 113, footer copy right-aligned at x 1392.
- [ ] The garments drop on one by one, swing, and the headline sharpens from blur. Everything appears within about 1.5 s of the sheets loading.
- [ ] Wheel and drag scroll the rail with inertia, the clothes swing with the speed and settle, and the progress thumb follows.
- [ ] Hover turns the piece from side-on to front, lifts it 1.2×, moves the neighbours aside and shows its name and price at bottom left.
- [ ] Clicking any of the 20 pieces always shows its image in the quick-view, including after closing, switching quickly or adding to cart. Front and Back both work.
- [ ] Add to cart shows the loading state, flies the garment into the bag, and the badge goes up. The drawer stays closed until the bag is clicked.
- [ ] The phone layout works by touch with no sideways scroll, and reduced motion removes all movement.

title: Fashion Lookbook
description: Single-file, full-viewport fashion lookbook called NOWHERE®. Nine full-body models, each shot from a high overhead camera on a light grey studio floor, stand in a 3D carousel ring that can be dragged, scrolled sideways, played automatically or switched to a 3×3 grid. Features interactive cursor/mouse tracking and scrub-driven interaction, physical spring dynamics and kinetic damping with precision layout polish.
full_prompt:
# NOWHERE® Lookbook — full recreation brief

Build a single-file, full-viewport fashion lookbook called **NOWHERE®**. Nine full-body models, each shot from a high overhead camera on a light grey studio floor, stand in a 3D carousel ring that can be dragged, scrolled sideways, played automatically or switched to a 3×3 grid. Clicking the front model zooms it into a "look view" with numbered dots on each garment, and a paper receipt prints down from the top-right listing the three pieces with sizes, a 10% whole-fit discount and an add-to-bag flow. Everything is plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript in one file, with no libraries. The page is exactly one screen tall (100svh, never scrolls). Everything below must be reproduced exactly.

## 1. Assets

All images are transparent PNG cut-outs served as WebP through an image proxy. Use these exact URLs. Each look image has a native 914×1616 frame (aspect about 0.566). The figure fills the frame top to bottom and stands with the soles a little above the bottom edge, so each look has a "foot" value (the empty fraction under the shoes) used to push the image down so the shoes sit on the box's bottom edge.

## 5. The ring (core math)

Measure on every stage resize (ResizeObserver):
- W, H = stage width and height. "mobile" means innerWidth < 810.
- bottomPad = 168 on mobile, 120 otherwise. topPad = 136.
- modelH = max(200, round((H − bottomPad − 18 − topPad) / 1.12)). Set it as `--model-h` on the stage.
- frontScale = 1.12 on mobile, 1.165 otherwise.
- dragPx (pixels per look) = max(90 on mobile or 120, W × 0.3).
- body width = modelH × 4/7.

Ring constants: radius factor 0.44 (0.84 on mobile), perspective factor 0.8 (1.1 on mobile), horizon 0.06, front step 0.03, lift 40 px, angular step = 2π/9.

For every look i, given the continuous ring position `pos`:
- a = (i − pos) × step, wrapped into (−π, π].
- R = W × radius factor, P = W × perspective factor.
- k = P / (P + R × (1 − cos a)) (the perspective factor).
- dist = |a| / step, near = clamp(1 − dist, 0, 1).
- scale = k × (1 + (frontScale − 1) × near).
- x = W/2 + R × sin(a) × k.
- yNear = H − bottomPad − 40, yFar = topPad + (H − topPad) × 0.06 − 40.
- y = yFar + (yNear − yFar) × k + (desktop only: H × 0.03 × near).
- blur = 1.8 × dist when dist ≤ 1, otherwise min(1.8 + (dist − 1) × 2, 6.5) px.
- transform = translate3d(x, y − H, 0) translateX(−50%) scale(scale). Opacity is 1, except 0 when the scaled body is fully outside the stage (more than 4 px past either edge), which also sets visibility hidden. pointer-events are off below opacity 0.5. z-index = round(scale × 1000). Only write opacity and filter when they change.

**Spring**: pos follows goal with a critically damped spring: stiffness 95, damping 2√95, integrated in 3 sub-steps per frame with dt clamped to 0.034 s. It settles when both |pos − goal| and |velocity| are ≤ 0.0005. Run requestAnimationFrame only while it moves, while dragging, or when a relayout is pending. Add an "is-moving" class meanwhile, which sets will-change on the models. Pause when the stage leaves the viewport (IntersectionObserver).

**Intro**: pos starts at −1.15 with the goal at 0, so on load the ring visibly spins about one look into place (instant under reduced motion).

**Active look**: active = round(goal) mod 9. Changing it updates the counter, name, live region, drawer highlight, grid captions, receipt and dock pieces; replays the name swap, the piece rise and a **light sweep**; closes the look view if open; and restarts the autoplay timer. The sweep is a 42%-wide skewed (−12°) white gradient band (transparent → .28 at 42% → .6 at 50% → .28 at 58% → transparent, 100°) in a soft-light blended overlay. It runs 1.5 s with cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1) from translateX(−130%) to 330%, fading in by 18% and out by the end.

**Autoplay**: on by default, off under reduced motion. Every 5 s it advances one look, unless the tab is hidden, the stage is off-screen, the user is dragging or hovering the receipt with a mouse, or the look view, grid or drawer is open (then it just reschedules). The toggle button flips it. Any drag, wheel, arrow key, ring click, grid switch, drawer opening, look view opening or receipt interaction turns autoplay off.

**Dragging** (pointer events on the stage; ignored in grid or look view, and for non-primary mouse buttons):
- On pointerdown, record the start x/y, the start goal, the pointer id and a velocity trail.
- On move: if the vertical movement exceeds 10 px and beats the horizontal, give up (let the page scroll). If the horizontal movement exceeds 8 px and is more than 1.2× the vertical, start dragging: capture the pointer, add "is-dragging" (cursor grabbing) and stop autoplay.
- While dragging: goal = startGoal − dx / dragPx, active = round(goal), and keep the last 6 samples.
- On release: velocity v = (last x − first x) / (last t − first t) in px/ms; base = round(startGoal). On mobile, move ±1 if |dx| > 30 or |v| > 0.3, otherwise snap back. On desktop, target = round(goal − v × 160 / dragPx); if that equals base and |v| > 0.3, push one look in the flick direction; clamp to base ± 2.
- Ignore the click that fires within 60 ms after a drag ends.

**Clicking a model**: in the ring, if it is the front model (shortest signed distance 0) open the look view, otherwise rotate to it the short way. In the grid, jump the ring to it instantly and open the look view.

**Wheel**: only horizontal-dominant wheels (deltaX bigger than deltaY), not in grid or look view. Prevent the default, accumulate deltaX, and step one look when the total passes 45, then lock for 520 ms.

**Keys** (stage focused): ←/→ step; in the grid ↑/↓ jump ±3; Enter opens the look view. Escape anywhere closes the look view, or else the drawer.

## 6. Follow cursor (only for fine-pointer, hover-capable devices)

An 80 px circle centred on the pointer: 1 px dashed ink border, white at 60% with a 6 px backdrop blur. It holds the stacked labels "DRAG" and "VIEW" (12-px caps). The real cursor is hidden over the stage. It eases toward the pointer each frame with factor 0.18. States:
- on (enters the stage): scale 0.3 → 1, opacity 0 → 1, 0.6 s ease.
- over the front model, or any model in the grid: black fill, solid border, white "VIEW".
- over a non-front model: a small black dot (scale 0.2), labels hidden.
- dragging: black, scale 0.74.
- in the look view: hidden (0 opacity), and the pins and close button get a pointer cursor.
- pointer leaves the stage: off.

## 7. Grid view

Switching animates every model with transitions of transform 1.25 s morph, plus opacity and filter 0.8 s ease. Each model is delayed by round(|wrapped angle| / π × 4) × 0.32 s going to the grid (0.24 s going back), so models ripple outward from the front. The animation class is removed after 1.7 s. Grid placement: rows = 3, top = 80 (72 on mobile), rowH = (H − 96 (104 on mobile) − top) / 3, colW = W/3, scale = min(rowH − 40, colW × 7/4 × 0.92) / modelH, x = colW × (col + 0.5), y = top + rowH × (row + 1) − 32. No blur, full opacity, z = 10 + row. Each model gets a caption below it ("0N  NAME", muted, the active one in ink) at y + 12, fading in with opacity 0.8 s ease delayed 0.9 s + i × 50 ms. In grid mode the dock name, pieces and shop button fade out, and hovering one model dims every other figure to 0.35.

When the look view opens it becomes visible and **prints down** from translateY(−100%) to 0 in 18 hard steps (steps(18, end)) over 1.3 s, delayed 0.3 s. A white panel sliding in from the left (width min(560 px, 100%), 1 px solid ink right border, padding 24 px 32 px 32 px, or 16 px 16 px 24 px on phones). Closed, it sits at translateX(−101%), hidden. Open, it slides in over 1 s ease and dims the page with a 200vmax box-shadow at rgba(0,0,0,.14).
- Top row: "LOOKS · VOL. 01" in caps, plus a "CLOSE" pill.
- An ordered list of the 9 looks, each a full-width row with a dashed top rule (the last also has a bottom rule). The 3-column grid (32 px, 1fr, auto) holds the number in caps, the name at 40 px light uppercase (ellipsis), and in muted italic "3 pieces · $total". The current look's name is italic. On hover the name goes italic and slides 8 px right over 0.7 s. Rows rise in on open (1 s ease, delayed 0.12 s + i × 50 ms). Clicking a row rotates the ring the short way to that look and closes the drawer.
- Footer nav pills: "Vol. 01", "Places", "Letters", "Postcards".
- While the drawer is open the code mark and the dock name fade out. Opening it focuses the current look's row, and closing it returns focus to the Looks button.

## 11. Content

| 6 | Analog | Corduroy Blazer (Outerwear, $156) | Black Slim Jeans (Bottom, $98) | Desert Boots (Shoes, $146) |
| 7 | Rewind | Faded Black Hoodie (Top, $86) | Carpenter Trousers (Bottom, $94) | Retro Court Sneaker (Shoes, $116) |

## 12. Accessibility and reduced motion

The stage is a focusable region (aria-roledescription "carousel", or "grid of looks" in grid mode) with the label "Looks — arrow keys turn the ring, Enter opens the look". It has a polite live region announcing "Look N: Name". The drawer, look view and receipt toggle aria-hidden, the Looks button toggles aria-expanded, and the view buttons and size chips use aria-pressed. Under prefers-reduced-motion every animation and transition is turned off, the ring snaps without the spring, there is no intro spin and no autoplay, and the cursor follows instantly.

## 13. Acceptance checklist
- On load the ring spins about one position into place; the front model is largest and sharp, and neighbours shrink, rise toward the horizon and blur up to 6.5 px.
- A drag of about 30% of the width moves one look; a fast flick moves up to two; scrolling sideways steps one; arrows step one.
- Every 5 s it advances, with a light sweep, the name swap and the piece pills rising in.
- The follow circle reads DRAG, turns black with VIEW over the front model, and shrinks to a dot over the others.

- Pin tooltips never leave the area; hovering lines and pins cross-highlights them.
- The size picker, Add to bag, the bag tally bump, the toast, the whole-fit CTA with its size prompt and the completed state all work.
