title: Fox Couture
description: Single-page, three-section fashion landing page for a fictional digital-fashion label called Novu®. Its mascot is a photoreal 3D fennec fox in orange shield sunglasses, a chunky silver chain and an oversized white varsity jacket. Features interactive cursor/mouse tracking and scrub-driven interaction, dynamic canvas particle and fluid simulation with precision layout polish.
full_prompt:
# Novu® London — full recreation brief

Build a single-page, three-section fashion landing page for a fictional digital-fashion label called **Novu®**. Its mascot is a photoreal 3D fennec fox in orange shield sunglasses, a chunky silver chain and an oversized white varsity jacket. The page has three sections: a hero with a giant wordmark, a pinned "story" section, and a partners carousel with a footer. Behind the hero and the story runs **one continuous scroll-scrubbed video**. The fox walks in place the whole time while the camera orbits all the way around it (front close-up → profile → back → profile walk → front) and pulls back to the full body. Scrolling down plays the orbit forward; scrolling up plays it backward. The look is a pale, warm, grainy photo studio, with black ink type and one hot orange accent.

Everything below is exact. Build it as one HTML file with inline CSS and inline JavaScript, no framework and no build step. Two external scripts are loaded at runtime from jsDelivr (mp4box.js and Lenis).

---

## 1. Assets (use these exact URLs)

All images are direct Higgsfield generation results served through the images.higgs.ai resizer. Never download, crop or re-host them.

| Asset | Exact URL | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| Scene video (Kling 3.0, 10.04 s, 241 frames, 24 fps, 1280×720, H.264, a single keyframe, moov at the front of the file, CORS open) | https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261107_145142_a39216fc-13cf-4ce3-baf8-d9bdbfd5f955.mp4 | Scroll-scrubbed background behind the hero and the story (desktop only) |
| Hero still (2048×1360 original) | https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261107_005547_8a9e6889-76aa-4688-81b5-4452d9afa4ad.png&w=2048&q=85 | Hero image on phones and with reduced motion only. The `w` parameter is the viewport width × devicePixelRatio × 1.05, rounded to a multiple of 64, with a minimum of 1024 and a maximum of 2048. |
| Story still (2048×1360 original) | https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261107_005547_a3e2027b-0bcb-455d-bef4-6c0c6d722cb1.png&w=2048&q=85 (same width rule) | Full-body walking fox on phones and with reduced motion only |
| Story still, small | the same story URL with &w=480 | Blurred backdrop behind the story still (reduced motion, wide screens) |
| Partner sheet (2688×1520 original, a 3×2 grid of six portrait cards with thin white gutters) | https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261107_005542_4250aa05-1091-4015-b242-d58db718f6b7.png&w=2000&q=85 | Six partner cards, each shown with a CSS background-position crop of this one sheet |
| mp4box.js 0.5.2 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mp4box@0.5.2/dist/mp4box.all.min.js | Demuxes the MP4 so WebCodecs can decode it |
| Lenis 1.1.13 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lenis@1.1.13/dist/lenis.min.js | Smooth wheel scrolling |

Partner sheet content, by grid cell (column, row): (0,0) a snow leopard in a grey quilted puffer, light grey backdrop; (1,0) a hare in round black sunglasses and a black leather jacket, charcoal backdrop; (2,0) a raccoon in a dark cap and a satin bomber with orange-striped cuffs, mid grey; (0,1) an owl in a black bucket hat and a black tailored coat, mid grey; (1,1) an axolotl in a chrome visor and a white satin hoodie with orange cord tips, light grey; (2,1) a red panda in a chunky grey knit cardigan and a silver chain, mid grey.

## 2. Fonts

Two variable fonts. Self-host the latin WOFF2 files, or embed them as base64 data URIs in a standalone build.

| Family | Source (Google Fonts, latin subset) | Axes used | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Archivo | https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/archivo/v25/k3kQo8UDI-1M0wlSfdnoLg.woff2 | weight 100–900, width (font-stretch) 62%–125% | Everything: wordmark, labels, headings, body |
| Outfit | https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/outfit/v15/QGYvz_MVcBeNP4NJtEtq.woff2 | weight 100–900 | Only the small "Novu®" logo that appears after scrolling |

Declare them with @font-face: Outfit with font-weight 100 900 and font-display swap; Archivo with font-weight 100 900, font-stretch 62% 125% and font-display swap. The body default is Archivo at font-stretch 112%, with antialiased font smoothing.

## 3. Head, tokens and global layers

- Title: "Novu® London — High-Fashion Novus". Meta description: "Fully 3D fashion characters, ready to redesign digital couture." Viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1. Language: en.
- Colour tokens: background #e9e6e1 (warm bone); ink #0b0b0b; mute #77736d; pill rgba(255,255,255,.42); line rgba(11,11,11,.14); accent #ff5a1f (hot orange).
- The html and body backgrounds are the background token. Reset margins and padding, use border-box sizing, links inherit colour with no underline, and buttons are unstyled.
- **Film grain**: a fixed layer at inset −50%, z-index 60, pointer-events none, opacity .07, mix-blend-mode multiply. Its background is an inline SVG data URI: a 240×240 SVG with a feTurbulence filter (type fractalNoise, baseFrequency .9, numOctaves 2, stitchTiles stitch), then an feColorMatrix that keeps only alpha. The layer animates "grain" over 1 s with steps(6), infinitely, translating through (0,0) → (−3%,2%) → (2%,−4%) → (−4%,−1%) → (3%,3%) → (0,0).
- **Vignette**: a fixed full-screen layer at z-index 59 with an inset box-shadow of 220 n-units spread, colour rgba(60,52,44,.22).

## 4. Scaling system

- The design frame is 1440×900. The frame unit is u = (viewport width without the scrollbar) ÷ 1440. JavaScript writes document.documentElement.clientWidth into a CSS variable --vw on load and on every resize, so the frame centres exactly even with a scrollbar.
- The nav/footer unit is n = min(vw ÷ 1440, 100svh ÷ 760), so the fixed UI shrinks on short screens.
- At 820px wide and below, both units become 100vw ÷ 390 (a 390px phone design).
- Every measurement below is written in design pixels: "53u" means 53 × u, and "53n" means 53 × n.

## 5. Fixed top nav (z-index 40, height 66n, pointer-events none on the container, auto on its children)

| Element | Exact text | Position and size | Style |
|---|---|---|---|
| Play Trailer pill (button) | PLAY TRAILER | left 53n, top 8n, width 178n, height 50n | Pill: flex, gap 16n, padding 0 9n 0 24n, radius 999px, background = pill token, backdrop blur 10px. Label: Archivo 700, stretch 108%, uppercase, letter-spacing −.01em, 13n. Ends in a 32n black circle with a white play triangle (an SVG path in a 10×10 viewBox: M2.5 1.2 L9 5 L2.5 8.8 z). |
| Centre label | HIGH-FASHION NOVUS | left 463n, top 22n | Label style, 14.5n |
| View Marketplace pill (link to #partners) | VIEW MARKETPLACE | right 127n, top 8n, width 227n | The same pill; its circle shows a pause icon (two vertical strokes, 1.6 wide, round caps) |
| Menu button | (aria-label "Open menu") | right 55n, top 8n, 50n circle, white, shadow 0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.06) | Three 16n×2px ink bars, offset −5n, 0 and +5n vertically. When open they become an X (top bar rotates 45°, middle fades out, bottom rotates −45°). Hover: scale 1.08. |
| Mini logo (link to #top) | Novu® | left 53n, top 18n | Outfit 600, 30n, letter-spacing −.02em. The ® is a superscript at .45em. Hidden (opacity 0, translateY −8px) until scrolled. |

Pill hover: the background rises to rgba(255,255,255,.75), and the circle turns orange, rotates 90° and scales to 1.08 (.45s, cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)).

When scrollY is more than 35% of the viewport height, the body gets the class "scrolled". The two pills and the centre label then fade out and move up 10px, and the mini logo fades in (.4s).

**Menu overlay**: fixed full screen at z-index 35, background rgba(233,230,225,.86) with an 18px backdrop blur, column centred, padding 0 53n. It holds three links:
- "01 The Drop" → #top
- "02 The Walk" → #walk
- "03 Partners" → #partners

The links are Archivo 900, stretch 125%, uppercase, size max(40px, 88n), line-height 1, letter-spacing −.03em. The number sits in a span at .18em, weight 500, letter-spacing .2em, margin-right .6em. When the menu opens the links rise from translateY(30px) and opacity 0 over .6s, staggered by 0, .06s and .12s. Hovering a link turns it orange. Escape closes the menu, and clicking a link closes it.

## 6. Fixed bottom bar (z-index 40, height 100n)

| Element | Exact text | Position | Style |
|---|---|---|---|
| Our Roadmap pill (link to #walk) | OUR ROADMAP | left 53n, bottom 22n, width 188n | Pill. The circle icon is two small rings joined by an S-shaped path (stroke 1.4, round caps). |
| Icon button (aria-label "Random Novu") | — | left 261n, bottom 22n, 52n circle, pill background, 10px backdrop blur | A 26n fox-mask glyph in a 28×28 viewBox: a black fox head, an orange visor rectangle (x 8.6, y 12.6, 10.8×3.4, radius 1.4) and a small bone-coloured nose dot. Hover: rotate −12° and scale 1.06. |
| Switch group | PRESS · NOVUBAR · TO SWITCH | centred, bottom 32n | "PRESS" and "TO SWITCH" are 10n white hints at .85 opacity. NOVUBAR is a black key 32n tall with 0 36n padding, white 13n label, and a hard 3n black under-shadow plus 0 6n 14px rgba(0,0,0,.18). It presses down 3n when clicked (class "hit" for 140 ms). |
| Fashion Index link (to #partners) | FASHION INDEX ↗ | left 1111n, bottom 40n, 13.5n | A north-east arrow icon. On hover a 1.5px underline wipes in from the left (.45s) and the arrow nudges 2px up and right. |
| Dots | — | right 58n, bottom 43n | Five 3.5n ink dots, gap 4n. Each blinks opacity 1 → .2 → 1 over 1.8s, staggered by .12s. |

When the partners section's top passes 55% of the viewport height, the body gets "at-end" and the whole bar fades out and moves down 20px (.5s).

**Novubar behaviour**: clicking NOVUBAR, or pressing Space when focus isn't on an input, button or link, jumps to the next stop:
1. the top of the page;
2. the start of the story plus 2% of the viewport height;
3. the start of the story plus 135% of the viewport height;
4. the partners section.

After the last stop it goes back to the top. It uses Lenis scrollTo with a 1.6 s duration when Lenis is loaded, otherwise native smooth scrolling.

## 7. Stage: hero + story share one background

Wrap the hero and the story in a relative "stage" container. Its first child is the **scene**: a sticky layer (top 0, height 100svh, margin-bottom −100svh, overflow hidden, z-index 0, pointer-events none) holding one full-size canvas. The scene starts at opacity 0 and fades to 1 over .9s once the body has the class "scene-on". The hero and the story sit above it at z-index 1 with transparent backgrounds.

### 7a. Hero (height 100svh, min 520px, overflow hidden)

A frame box fills the width, is anchored to the top, and has height max(900u, 100%), so text never clips and extra height crops at the bottom. Inside it:

- **Wordmark (h1, aria-label "Novu London")**: Archivo weight 650, line-height 1, 177u, no wrapping. It is built from three absolutely positioned parts, and every character is its own inline-block span so it can animate:
  - "Novu" at left 53u, top 72.3u, font-stretch 107%;
  - the ® as an inline SVG at left 533u, top 103u, 70u × 70u: a circle of radius 31 with stroke width 7, plus an "R" drawn as a filled path, both in currentColor;
  - "LONDON" at left 650u, top 72.3u, font-stretch 100%.
  - **Fitting**: after the fonts load and on every resize (desktop only), measure each part's natural width and set its letter-spacing to (target × u − natural) ÷ (letters − 1). The target for "Novu" is 464u (it spans 53 → 517) and for "LONDON" 737u (650 → 1387). This makes the ink span exactly the mockup.
- **Copy block 1**: top 298u, left 53u, Archivo 600, stretch 104%, 16.5u, line-height 1.22, uppercase, letter-spacing −.005em. Each line is a separately masked span (overflow hidden) holding an inner block that can slide:
  - "**BUILT IN 3D,** READY" (the bold part at weight 850)
  - "TO REDESIGN DIGITAL"
  - "COUTURE"
- **Copy block 2**: top 298u, left 339u, the same style:
  - "MEET ALL"
  - "**7777 STYLED**"
  - "BIG-EARED NOVUS"
- **Tag**: left 1022u, top 596u, label style 13.5u: "NVU0023." followed by a 46u × 8u SVG arrow (a 44-unit line plus a small open arrowhead, stroke 1.3, ink). The line loops a draw animation: stroke-dasharray 46, offset 46 → 0 (by 45%) → hold → −46, over 2.4 s, cubic-bezier(.6,0,.2,1), starting after 1.6 s, infinite.
- **Hero still** (an img with alt "A fennec fox character in orange shield sunglasses, a silver chain and a white varsity jacket"): object-fit cover over the frame. **On desktop it is never loaded or shown.** The body gets the class "video-bg" and the img stays display none with no src. The backdrop stays plain bone until the video's first frame is ready. The still is used only on phones and with reduced motion.
- **Wordmark parallax**: while scrolling, the wordmark moves up by 40% × min(1, scrollY ÷ viewport height).

### 7b. Story (id "walk", height 300svh)

A sticky inner "stick" (top 0, height 100svh, overflow hidden) holds a frame box at 100% height with:

- **Panel 01** (article): label "01 /", heading "STREETWEAR, BUT" / "MADE YOURS", and the paragraph "Swap your NOVU's style with limited digital drops, climb the Fashion Index and shape a look that lives in every world." ("NOVU's" is orange).
- **Panel 02**: label "02 /", heading "RUN THE" / "NOVUWALK", and the paragraph "Hit the catwalk and flaunt your whole wardrobe. Become a NOVUFLUENCER and collect the real-world perks." ("NOVUFLUENCER" is orange).
- **Panel geometry**: absolute, left 140u, top 262u, width 600u.
  - Label: 11u, letter-spacing .35em, mute colour, weight 500, stretch 125%.
  - Heading: margin-top 30u, Archivo 900, stretch 125%, 40u, line-height .92, letter-spacing −.025em, uppercase. Each line is a masked span with padding-bottom .04em.
  - Paragraph: margin-top 22u, 15.5u, line-height 1.36, colour #55514b, stretch 108%, weight 450, max-width 330u. Highlights use the accent colour.
- **While the video scene runs, Panel 01 moves to left 860u (the right side)**, because the fox walks on the left of the frame at that moment, as on the original site.
- **Progress dashes**: two 46u × 2px tracks (line colour) with an ink fill that scales on X from the left, gap 8u, at left 140u, top 560u. While Panel 01 is on the right they slide to left 860u (.6s). Their opacity follows whichever panel is more visible, so they are hidden between panels.

## 8. The scroll-scrubbed scene (desktop, motion allowed)

**Video content**: one continuous 10-second shot. The fennec fox walks in place for the whole clip (a steady treadmill-style walk cycle; head, shoulders, ears and chain bob; hands in its pockets) and its body always faces the same way. Only the camera moves:
- it starts on a low-angle front close-up of the head and shoulders (this frame matches the hero composition, with the wordmark above the head);
- orbits to the fox's left profile;
- goes behind it, showing the back of the jacket with a big orange "23";
- continues to the right-side profile while pulling back and lowering, where the full body walks on the left of the frame;
- ends on a front full-body view with the fox right of centre.

The backdrop is a plain seamless bone-white studio with a soft floor shadow, and the whole clip has a warm grade with film grain.

**Why not a video element**: Kling encodes the clip with a single keyframe, so seeking a video element backwards is very slow. Hardware video decoders can also stall or be blocklisted; on the build machine the hardware decoder managed about 1 fps. So every frame is decoded once in software and cached.

**Loading pipeline** (starts immediately on desktop):
1. Load mp4box.js, then fetch the MP4 with CORS and read it as a stream. Append each chunk to an mp4box file object with a running byte offset. Kling files keep the index at the front, so decoding starts with the first bytes.
2. In onReady, read the video track: the sample count (241) and the codec. Pull the decoder description from the avcC box (write the box to a big-endian DataStream and skip its first 8 bytes). Create a WebCodecs VideoDecoder configured with that codec, the coded size, the description and **hardwareAcceleration "prefer-software"**.
3. Extract samples in batches of 12 and turn each into an EncodedVideoChunk (type "key" if it is a sync sample, otherwise "delta", with timestamp and duration in microseconds).
4. Feed the decoder with backpressure: decode only while the decoder queue holds fewer than 4 items **and** fewer than 3 frames per encoder are waiting. Re-check after every "dequeue" event and after every encoded frame. When the stream has ended and every chunk has been fed, flush once.
5. Start an **encoder pool** of N = clamp(hardwareConcurrency − 1, 1, 4) Web Workers, created from an inline blob script. Each decoded VideoFrame is transferred, never copied, to worker (frame index mod N). A worker processes its frames one at a time:
   - draws the frame onto an OffscreenCanvas the size of the video (2D context with willReadFrequently);
   - closes the frame;
   - averages the RGB of the left and right 4-pixel columns, which become that frame's edge colours;
   - converts the canvas to a JPEG blob at quality .88;
   - posts back the index, the time, the blob and the edge colours.
6. The main thread stores each blob and its edge colours by index. The first stored frame (index 0) switches the scene on: it sizes the canvas, renders, waits two animation frames, then adds "scene-on" so the canvas fades in.
7. Fallback when WebCodecs, Worker, OffscreenCanvas or ReadableStream is missing, or the pipeline fails: play the video once, muted, at playbackRate .5, inside a 2×2px fixed element at opacity .01 (it has to be painted for frame callbacks to fire). Capture each presented frame with requestVideoFrameCallback, file it by round(mediaTime × 24), and store it the same way.

**Rendering**:
- The canvas backing size is its CSS size × min(devicePixelRatio, 1.5).
- The stage progress P (0 to 1) is −(stage top) ÷ (stage height − viewport height).
- The target frame is min(1, P ÷ .85) × 240, so the last frame is reached at 85% of the stage and then held.
- A playhead eases toward the target every animation frame: cur += (target − cur) × (1 − (1 − k)^(dt ÷ 16.7)), where k = .6 when Lenis is running and .25 otherwise. It snaps once within .02.
- **Sub-frame blending**: draw frame floor(cur), then draw the next frame on top at globalAlpha equal to the fractional part.
- Decoded ImageBitmaps live in an LRU window of 56 bitmaps. Each animation frame queues decodes (createImageBitmap from the JPEG blob, at most 8 in flight) for every frame between the playhead and the target plus 14 beyond, and 4 frames behind. If the exact frame isn't decoded yet, draw the nearest decoded frame within 12 instead of freezing.
- **Framing**: interpolate between two rectangles with t = clamp((cur ÷ 240 − .35) ÷ .55), eased with an ease-in-out cubic (4t³ for t < .5, otherwise 1 − (−2t + 2)³ ÷ 2).
  - Rect 0 matches the hero layout: the 16:9 frame is cover-fitted into a box of the full canvas width and height max(width × 900 ÷ 1440, canvas height), anchored at the top and centred.
  - Rect 1 fits the frame to the full canvas height, centred horizontally, so the walking figure keeps its feet in view.
- **Wide screens**: before drawing, fill the left half of the canvas with that frame's left edge colour and the right half with its right edge colour. Where the frame doesn't reach a side, feather its edge into that colour with a linear gradient over 6% of the frame width.
- Redraw only when the frame index, the blend amount (to 2 decimals) or the framing t (to 3 decimals) changes.

**Panel timing** (story progress p from 0 to 1 across the sticky run, while the scene runs):
- Panel 01: opacity = clamp((p − .20) ÷ .06) × (1 − clamp((p − .43) ÷ .06)).
- Panel 02: opacity = clamp((p − .64) ÷ .08).
- As a panel's opacity a rises, its heading lines slide up from translateY((1 − ease(a)) × (105% + line × 20%)), its paragraph rises from (1 − ease(a)) × 24px, and its label slides 16px horizontally (in from the right for Panel 01, from the left for Panel 02).
- Dash fills: the first fills over p .20 → .55, the second over .55 → 1.
- Without the scene (reduced motion), the panels sit on the left: Panel 01 shows for p < .5 and Panel 02 after.

**Smooth scroll**: when motion is allowed, load Lenis and create it with lerp .085, smoothWheel true, wheelMultiplier 1 and anchors true. Drive it with a requestAnimationFrame loop. Add the standard Lenis CSS: html.lenis and its body get height auto, .lenis-smooth disables scroll-behavior, and .lenis-stopped hides overflow.

## 9. Partners section (id "partners")

- Padding-top 56n. Background: a vertical gradient #e9e6e1 → #f1efec at 60% → #f4f3f1.
- Label "03 /" (11n, .35em tracking, mute colour) and heading "OUR" / "PARTNERS" (Archivo 900, stretch 125%, 42n, line-height .9, letter-spacing −.025em, uppercase), both indented 50n.
- **Track**: a horizontal flex row with gap 20n and padding 28n 50n 0, scrollable on X with the scrollbar hidden and a grab cursor. It holds 12 cards (the six partners twice):
  - Snowline · 01 · PUFFER
  - Hush Hare · 02 · LEATHER
  - Night Bandit · 03 · BOMBER
  - Hoot & Co · 04 · TAILORING
  - Axo Lab · 05 · TECH
  - Ember Knit · 06 · KNITWEAR
- **Card**: width 253n, aspect ratio 1.179, overflow hidden, background #cfcbc5. Its art layer uses the partner sheet with background-size 304.9% 203.25%. The background-position X is .15%, 50.07% or 99.94% by grid column, and Y is .2% or 99.7% by grid row. The art sits at grayscale(.85) contrast(1.02).

  - Quote: "WE SEW, WE STYLE," / "WE WALK. WE WIN." in Archivo 900, stretch 125%, 21n, line-height 1. Below it "Novu Studio Manifest" (12.5n, mute colour, weight 450, stretch 108%, margin-top 18n).
  - "CONNECT" / "WITH" / "US" in the same style as the quote, margin-right 70n.

  - "STYLED BY @NOVUSTUDIOLDN" (the handle in ink);
  - a flexible spacer;
  - "TERMS & CONDITIONS" and "PRIVACY POLICY" (orange on hover);
  - the blinking dots again.

## 10. Opening animation (Web Animations, run once after fonts load)

The body starts with the class "pre", which hides the hero still, every wordmark character, the copy lines, the tag, the nav items (except the mini logo) and the bottom-bar items. When fonts are ready, remove "pre" and run the timeline below. All entries use easing cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) with fill backwards.

| Target | From | Duration | Delay |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hero still (phones and reduced motion only) | opacity 0, scale 1.08, blur 10px | 1800 ms | 0 |
| Each wordmark character (Novu, ®, LONDON, in order) | opacity 0, translateY(60%) rotate(4deg) | 1100 ms | 250 + i × 55 ms |
| Each copy line (6 total) | opacity 0, translateY(100%) | 900 ms | 850 + i × 70 ms |
| Tag | opacity 0, translateX(−20px) | 900 ms | 1300 ms |
| Nav items (Play Trailer, centre label, View Marketplace, menu) | opacity 0, translateY(−24px) | 900 ms | 500 + i × 80 ms |
| Bottom-bar items (Roadmap, icon, switch, Fashion Index, dots) | opacity 0, translateY(24px); the switch keeps its translateX(−50%) | 900 ms | 700 + i × 80 ms |

When all animations finish, cancel them and mark the page ready. There is a failsafe reveal at 4 s and a hard one at 6 s. The scene canvas fades in independently of this timeline, as soon as the first video frame is decoded.

## 11. Phone layout (820px and below, 390px design)

- Units: n = u = 100vw ÷ 390. The scene video is not used and the stills are loaded instead.
- **Nav**: only the Play Trailer pill (left 16, top 14, 42 tall, 11px label, 30px circle) and the menu button (right 16, top 14, 42px). Once scrolled, the nav gets a bone gradient background so content scrolls under it cleanly.
- **Bottom bar**: only the NOVUBAR key (38 tall, 12px label, bottom 20).
- **Hero** stacks vertically below an 84px top padding:
  - the wordmark at 76px with line-height .9: "Novu" plus a .36em ® on the first line, "LONDON" on the second;
  - copy block 1 and copy block 2 at 14px;
  - the hero still in a 470px-tall box with object-position 57% 40%, masked to fade in from transparent over its top 26%;
  - the tag pinned bottom-right.
- **Story** stacks too: Panel 01 then Panel 02 (headings 33px, paragraphs 14.5px, fully visible, no motion), then the story still in a 520px box at object-position 72% 50%. No progress dashes.
- **Partners**: cards 240px wide with gap 12, captions always visible, art at grayscale(.3).
- **Footer**: two columns; the quote and "CONNECT WITH US" span both columns at 24px (the line breaks in "Connect with us" are hidden so it reads as one line). The legal row wraps and has 110px of bottom padding so the NOVUBAR key never covers it.

## 12. Reduced motion

With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce:
- all CSS animations and transitions are off and the grain layer is hidden;
- the scene video is never loaded and the stills are shown;
- there is no smooth scroll and no opening animation;
- the story panels switch instantly at the midpoint;
- the partner track doesn't drift.

## 13. Acceptance checklist

- At 1440×900, the wordmark ink spans 53 → 1387 at a 122px cap height. The ® circle sits at 533–603. The copy lines sit at y 306, 326 and 346. The tag is at 1022, 603.
- On desktop, nothing but the plain backdrop shows until the video's first frame is decoded (about 1 s on a normal connection); then the video fades in. The hero still is never requested on desktop.
- All 241 frames are cached within a few seconds. Scrolling down orbits the camera smoothly from the close-up to the full-body walk, and scrolling up plays it backwards. The fox's walk never moves forward in the frame.
- Panel 01 appears on the right during the profile walk and Panel 02 on the left over the final front view. The dashes follow the visible panel.
- Wheel scrolling glides (Lenis), and the playhead stays within a few frames of the scroll position.
- NOVUBAR and the Space key step through the four stops. The menu opens and closes. Card hover shows colour and the caption. The track drifts and can be dragged.
- At 390px every section stacks, with no horizontal scroll and nothing covered by the NOVUBAR key.
- With reduced motion, the stills show and nothing animates.

full_prompt: # Obverse — interactive techwear lookbook slider with shoppable hotspots Build a single-file, full-viewport, fully responsive fashion e-commerce **lookbook slider** for an invented store called **"OBVERSE"**. Each slide is one collaboration "look": a transparent cut-out model standing on a light-grey seamless studio floor, with a giant pale wordmark behind them. Frosted product hotspot tags point at each garment. The page is extremely interactive: - a masked wipe transition between looks, a rolling slide counter and line-masked text swaps; - drag, wheel and keyboard navigation; - hover tags that expand into size pickers, a quick-view drawer, add-to-bag with a flying thumbnail and a working bag drawer; - a press-and-hold magnifier lens, a search overlay and an index overlay; - live currency switching with counting prices, a "fullscreen" focus mode and a custom labelled cursor. The layout matches a minimal Helvetica-style lookbook UI kit: tiny black nav at the top, a huge thin slide counter at top-left, product info at bottom-left and the collab mark at bottom-right. Everything below must be matched exactly. The page never scrolls (`html, body { height:100%; overflow:hidden }`). --- ## 1. Global look - **Font:** **Inter Tight** from Google Fonts, weights 200, 300, 400, 500 and 600, with fallback `"Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif`. It is the only typeface. Antialiased. - **Colour tokens:** - `--bg: #e4e4e4` - `--ink: #0d0d0d` - `--mute: #8b8b8b` - `--line: rgba(0,0,0,.12)` - `--blue: #1747e6` for all prices - `--tag: rgba(250,250,250,.78)` - **Easings:** - `--ease: cubic-bezier(.77,0,.18,1)` for slides, wipes and drawers. - `--out: cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)` for reveals. - An "exit" curve `cubic-bezier(.7,0,.84,0)` for things leaving. - **Side padding:** `--pad: clamp(16px, 2.6vw, 38px)`. - **Stage** (fixed, inset 0, overflow hidden): - background `radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 45%, #ececec 0%, #e4e4e4 55%, #d9d9d9 100%)`; - a grain overlay through `::after`: an inline SVG `feTurbulence` fractalNoise (baseFrequency .9, 2 octaves) tinted grey at alpha .18, `opacity .35`, `mix-blend-mode: multiply`. - **No edge margins:** the stage and figures go edge to edge. - **Selection:** `::selection` is ink background with grey text. ## 2. Assets (transparent PNG cut-outs, served as WebP with alpha) Every model image is a 1744×2336 cut-out with a transparent background. Use them exactly as given: 1. Look 01 — man in sunglasses walking right, black strapped tech trench: `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261115_045212_ac4848bb-f365-4841-af88-2aeed5407ae1.png&w=1400&q=85` 2. Figure layout (JS, recomputed on resize) Every look is its own full-stage `.layer` (absolute, inset 0, transparent) holding a `.fig`, which holds `.fig-in`, which holds: - the shadow; - the ``, with `object-fit: contain` and no pointer events; - a `.hit` box placed over the subject's bounding box (cursor "grab"); - the hotspots. Sizing: - **Desktop:** the subject height (y1−y0 of the image) equals **80 % of the viewport height**, and the feet line (y1) sits at **90.5 % of the viewport height**. - **Phones under 640 px:** 60 % height, with the feet at 78 %. - The image width is height × 1744/2336. - **Width cap:** if the subject width would exceed 50 % of the viewport width (62 % on phones), shrink to fit. - The subject's horizontal centre ((x0+x1)/2) sits at exactly 50 vw. **Floor shadow:** - an ellipse at the subject's bottom-centre, 1.25 × the subject width wide and 16 % of that tall; - translated (−50 %, −62 %); - `radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(0,0,0,.34), rgba(0,0,0,.12) 55%, transparent)`, blur 6 px. **Mouse parallax** (rAF lerp at 0.06 toward the normalised pointer, −.5 to .5): - `.fig-in` gets `translate3d(sx·−18px, sy·−10px, 0) perspective(1400px) rotateY(sx·4deg)`; - the background wordmark moves the opposite way, `sx·46px, sy·22px`. ## 5. Background wordmark - **Position:** centred at left 50 % and top 46 %, behind the figures, no wrapping. - **Text:** the collab in caps, for example `ASKER × KODA`. - **Type:** Inter Tight 500, `clamp(120px, 21vw, 420px)`, `letter-spacing: -.065em`, `line-height: .8`, colour `#dadada`. The "×" is weight 200 in `#d2d2d2`. - **Masking:** every character is its own overflow-hidden inline-block with an inner ``, so it can roll. - **Fit to width:** after rendering, scale the font size down until the word's width is at most 94 % of the viewport width (125 % in fullscreen mode). There must be **no font-size transition**, or the measurement breaks. - **On a slide change:** the old letters roll out (translateY ∓105 %, 520 ms, 18 ms stagger, exit curve). The new letters then roll in from ±105 % (900 ms, 28 ms stagger, `--out`). The direction follows the slide direction. ## 6. Chrome ### Nav - Fixed top, padding `24px var(--pad)`, 13 px text. - **Left to right:** 1. Logo "OBVERSE" (600, 13.5 px, .02em tracking), in a box `clamp(120px, 17.5vw, 250px)` wide. 2. "**Fullscreen**", with `margin-left: clamp(20px, 6vw, 90px)`. 5. A stylish young woman sits on an invisible chair on a bright green hill under a clear blue sky. A green rotating crystal gem floats above her head, and cream pill-shaped action bubbles fan out around her like a game pie menu: "Gossip", "Flirt", "Change Outfit", "Ask About Mood", "Talk About Pet", "More Choices…". # Prompt: MAREN fashion hero

It covers the frame, drawn 1155×794 from the top-left of the 1155×767 frame.
- **Polaroid:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/4612f265-40f3-4fc9-af4c-b03c289c2b75.jpg` (520×650). A blonde woman in sunglasses, a lilac tee and light jeans, sitting on stone steps before an old building.

- **Bottom-left:** "NEW / SEASON / COLLECTION".
- **Polaroid:** tilted −13°, white frame, the photo, and a handwritten "Stylist T-shirt" caption. It overlaps the left column line.
- **Watermark:** a giant italic "MAREN" across the bottom at low opacity, partly behind the model.

## Motion (UI)

- **Entrance:** one CSS sequence.
  - The header items drop in, and each headline line rises in turn.
  - The supporting copy fades up.
  - The polaroid drops and settles to its tilt.
- **Reduced motion:** no background video.

## Phones (portrait)

- The photo covers the screen.
- The headline and copy re-flow over it, with the polaroid smaller and the watermark scaled.
- One screen, no scrolling.

## Acceptance check (1440×960)

- The model in the lilac sweater fills the frame under a lilac-peach sunset.
- The white grid lines frame the "Timeless Style for *Modern You*" headline.
- The tilted polaroid sits lower-left, and "MAREN" appears as the faint watermark.

## DESKTOP INTERACTIVE IMAGE REVEAL EFFECT (exact behavior)

1. Base layer: BG_IMAGE_1 full bleed
2. Reveal layer: BG_IMAGE_2 full bleed, clipped by a CSS/WebKit mask generated from an offscreen canvas
3. Subtle SVG grid overlay at `opacity: 0.10`, stroke `#64748b`, strokeWidth `0.6`

### Spotlight / mask algorithm (exact)
- Track raw mouse (`mousemove` on `window`) into `mouseRef`
- Every animation frame, ease `smoothRef` toward mouse with factor **0.1**:
  - `smooth.x += (mouse.x - smooth.x) * 0.1`
  - `smooth.y += (mouse.y - smooth.y) * 0.1`
- Spotlight radius (fluid): `Math.round(Math.min(420, Math.max(160, window.innerWidth * 0.16)))`
- Draw soft radial gradient circle on offscreen canvas at smoothed cursor:
  - `createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, radius)`
  - stops exactly:
    - 0 → `rgba(255,255,255,1)`
    - 0.4 → `rgba(255,255,255,1)`
    - 0.6 → `rgba(255,255,255,0.75)`
    - 0.75 → `rgba(255,255,255,0.4)`
    - 0.88 → `rgba(255,255,255,0.12)`
    - 1 → `rgba(255,255,255,0)`
- Export canvas each frame as `toDataURL()` and apply to BG_IMAGE_2 as:
  - `mask-image: url(dataUrl)` / `-webkit-mask-image: url(dataUrl)`
  - `mask-size: 100% 100%`
- Result: moving the cursor smoothly reveals BG_IMAGE_2 inside a soft circular spotlight while BG_IMAGE_1 remains everywhere else

### Parallax grid
- Grid cell size (fluid): `Math.round(Math.min(64, Math.max(36, window.innerWidth * 0.028)))`, update on resize
- SVG `<pattern>` with path `M {cell} 0 L 0 0 0 {cell}`
- Offset grid with eased parallax: normalize smoothed cursor to container (`cx`, `cy` from −0.5 to 0.5), ease offset toward `cx*16` / `cy*16` with factor **0.06**

full_prompt:
# Prompt: Capabilities — amber "Clarity across every layer" section

Build a single-file **capabilities section** for an infrastructure-monitoring product. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is near-black and technical: a mono context strip, a big tight headline with one glowing amber word, and three glass cards, each with a glowing amber holographic wireframe object.

## Scale

- **Units:** measured on an 826×552 artboard. Every length is N × `--u`, where `--u` is the largest uniform "contain" scale, but never under 1px per artboard pixel on narrow, short screens.
- **Spare space:** goes into flexible gaps or taller cards, never letterbox bands.

## Type and colour

- **Page:** `#050505`, with two faint vertical hairline guides at the thirds (white at 3%).
- **Fonts:** **Geist** (variable) for text, **JetBrains Mono** for the top strip.
- **Strip:** 7.2u mono caps, tracking .275em, white at 44%. Left, "01" with a short rule after it; centre "// Capabilities"; right "Full Visibility".
- **Headline:** "Clarity across every layer". Geist at about weight 473, 47.3u, tracking −.05em. "Clarity" is filled with an amber gradient (`#FFC24A` → `#E9931E` → `#A85A0C`).
- **Lede:** "A unified view of your infrastructure. Detect patterns, anticipate issues, and optimize performance before problems arise.", 13.4u at about weight 290, white at 64%.

## Cards

- **Grid:** three columns 16u apart, each card at least 273u tall, radius 4u.
- **Glass:** fill white at 2.1%, a 1u hairline border (slightly brighter on top), a 14px backdrop blur, and a soft amber radial glow (`rgba(190,112,22,.2)` fading out over 135u).
- **Stage** (170u, top of the card) holds the icon. Each icon is an image of a glowing amber wireframe object on pure black, shown with `mix-blend-mode:screen` and a soft radial mask, so only the glow shows:
  1. **Real-Time Signals:** concentric radar rings around a glowing orb, with a small dot on the outer ring.
  2. **Actionable Insights:** thin glowing bar-chart cylinders beside two overlapping wireframe spheres, with three short dashes above.
  3. **Automated Reporting:** a stack of translucent glowing document sheets with text lines.
- **Body:** a 15u title (white at 96%) and two lines at 10.5u (white at 58%):
  1. "Stay ahead with live system data and continuous performance tracking across all nodes."
  2. "Turn complex data into clear decisions with instant, intelligent analysis."
  3. "Generate structured reports that reveal system health at a glance."

## Motion

- **Entrance:** one master Web Animations timeline with backwards fill, run once.
  - The strip items rise, and the rule after "01" draws.
  - The headline rises inside a fixed mask, and "Clarity" fades up.
  - The lede settles.
  - The cards rise in reading order. Each icon performs once: the radar pops in from 72%, the chart wipes up, and the report sheets wipe in from the left.
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance.

## Tablet and phone

- **Tablet:** cards become stacked horizontal panels with the icon on the left.
- **Phone:** stacked cards; the top strip keeps one line.

## Acceptance check (1440×960)

- The amber "Clarity" headline sits over three dark glass cards with glowing amber holographic icons.
- There are no visible black squares behind the icons.
- No brands.

full_prompt:
# Hale Moor: build brief for the full landing page

Build **one self-contained `index.html`**: a soft, pastel, scroll-driven landing page for a fictional venture fund called **Hale Moor**. Two real-time WebGL objects carry it:

- a luminous **iridescent particle sphere** that rises in the hero and then travels through the page as you scroll;
- a **faceted geodesic glass crystal** that takes over in the focus-area section.

Everything else is HTML/CSS laid over a fixed full-screen canvas. There are no images and no videos: all imagery is drawn live in WebGL or as inline SVG.

The page has seven parts, top to bottom:

1. Hero
2. Manifesto
3. Track record (portfolio cards)
4. Focus area (the crystal)
5. Who we are (names wheel)
6. Footer
7. A fixed nav and a fixed pager that sit over all of them

Follow every value below exactly. All desktop measurements are in a **1440 × 900 design frame**.

---

## 1. External resources (exact URLs)

| What | URL | How it is used |
|---|---|---|
| Three.js 0.173.0 (ES module) | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.173.0/build/three.module.js` | Through an import map: `{"imports":{"three":"<that URL>"}}`, then `import * as THREE from 'three'` in a `<script type="module">`. No add-ons. |
| Instrument Sans (latin, variable 400–700) | `https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/instrumentsans/v4/pxiTypc9vsFDm051Uf6KVwgkfoSxQ0GsQv8ToedPibnr0SZe1Q.woff2` | `@font-face { font-family:'Instrument Sans'; font-weight:400 700; font-stretch:100%; font-display:swap }`. Body face. |
| Geist Mono (latin, variable 100–900) | `https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/geistmono/v6/or3nQ6H-1_WfwkMZI_qYFrcdmg.woff2` | `@font-face { font-family:'Geist Mono'; font-weight:100 900; font-display:swap }`. Labels, tabs, chips, pager. |

In the standalone file, both fonts are embedded as `data:font/woff2;base64,…` in the `src` of each `@font-face`. There are no other assets.

## 2. Units, colours and global styles

**Units (CSS custom properties on `:root`):**

## 6. The WebGL scene (Three.js 0.173)

**Renderer:**
- `new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, alpha:true, antialias:true, premultipliedAlpha:true, powerPreference:'high-performance' })`.
- `setClearColor(0x000000, 0)`.
- Pixel ratio `min(devicePixelRatio, 2)`.
- If WebGL fails, still run the text entrance.

**Camera:** `PerspectiveCamera(35°, aspect, 0.1, 100)` at (0, 0, 10). The visible height at z = 0 is `VIS_H = 2·10·tan(17.5°)`.

**Placing an object from screen pixels.** Given a screen centre (cx, cy) and a screen radius r in CSS px:
- `k = VIS_H / innerHeight`
- `Rs = r·k`
- world radius `R = Rs·10 / sqrt(100 + Rs²)` (this undoes the perspective growth of the silhouette)
- `x = (cx − vw/2)·k`
- `y = −(cy − vh/2)·k`

**Shared material set-up.** Every material is a `ShaderMaterial` with:
- `transparent:true`, `depthWrite:false`, `depthTest:false`;
- `CustomBlending`, `AddEquation`, `blendSrc = OneFactor`, `blendDst = OneMinusSrcAlphaFactor`, and the same factors for alpha;
- shaders that output **premultiplied** colour.

This gives soft, additive-looking light that stays correct on a transparent canvas.

**Noise:** standard 3D simplex noise (Ashima Arts / Stefan Gustavson, MIT), `float snoise(vec3)`.

**Shared uniforms:**
- `uTime`
- `uReveal` (0→1)
- `uPx` (object size → device pixels)
- `uMouse` (vec2, world)
- `uMouseStr` (0–1)
- `uMouseRad` (0.3·R)
- `uFade` (scroll fade of the main sphere)

**Mouse push** (in the vertex shader of both particle layers):
- `wp = modelMatrix·p`; `dlt = wp.xy − uMouse`; `dd = |dlt|`.
- `push = uMouseStr · exp(−dd²/uMouseRad²)`.
- `dir = dlt/dd`; `wp.xy += (dir·0.6 + perp(dir)·0.4) · push · uMouseRad · 0.32`.
- `wp.z += push · uMouseRad · 0.25`.

The perpendicular term makes the cursor *stir* the particles rather than punch a hole in them.

### 6a. Main sphere: three layers inside `orb → spin`

Draw order is cloud (1), glass (2), spray (3).

**1. Inner cloud.** 120,000 points (65,000 on phones), placed at a random direction × `r = 0.5 + 0.47·rand^0.45`, with `aRand` vec4.

- **Vertex shader:**
  - Drift: `p += (snoise(q), snoise(q+17.1), snoise(q+43.7))·0.04`, where `q = p·1.6 + (0,0,t·0.12)`.
  - Reveal: `rv = smoothstep(aRand.x·0.45, aRand.x·0.45 + 0.55, uReveal)`, then `p *= mix(0.55, 1, rv)`.
- **Colour** (from the original position o):
  - `n = snoise(o·1.25 + 3)`, `n2 = snoise(o·2.6 − 5 + t·0.03)`.
  - Start with `mix(violet (0.50,0.33,0.84), lilac (0.74,0.55,0.95), smoothstep(−0.45, 0.6, n2))`.
  - Blend in teal (0.42,0.86,0.84) by `smoothstep(0.2, 0.75, −o.x·0.85 − o.y·0.25 + n·0.45)·0.85`, so teal sits on the lower left.
  - Blend in pink (0.98,0.48,0.80) by `smoothstep(0.2, 0.8, o.x·0.85 + n·0.5)·0.8`, so pink sits on the right.
  - 8% of points are sparkles (`aRand.y > 0.92`), mixed 92% toward white.
- **Clusters:** `cluster = smoothstep(−0.4, 0.55, snoise(o·2.3 + t·0.035))`.
- **Alpha:** `vAlpha = (0.35 + 0.65·cluster)·rv·(0.7 + 0.3·aRand.z)`.
- **Point size:** `0.0072·(0.55 + 0.9·aRand.w)·(1 + spark·1.1)·(0.75 + 0.45·cluster)·uPx / −mv.z`.
- **Fragment shader:**
  - Disc `a = smoothstep(0.5, 0.08, |coord − .5|)`.
  - Sparkles twinkle at `0.65 + 0.35·sin(t·4 + fragX·0.37 + fragY·0.21)`.
  - Output `(col·α, α·mix(0.92, 0.6, spark))`, where `α = a·vAlpha·tw·uFade`.

**2. Rim spray.** 40,000 points (16,000 on phones).
- **Directions:** 78% hug the silhouette ring, `normalize(cos θ, sin θ, ±0.32·rand)`; the rest are fully random.
- **Vertex shader:**
  - `life = fract(t·(0.045 + 0.07·aRand.x) + aRand.y)`.
  - Tufts: `tuft = (0.5 + 0.5·snoise(dir·3.2 + (0, t·0.02, 0)))^1.6`.
  - Reach: `reach = 0.015 + 0.42·aRand.z^1.7·(0.25 + 1.1·tuft)`.
  - Radius `r = 1 + reach·(0.35 + 0.65·life)`, plus a small noise drift of `0.03·(0.4 + life)`.
  - Reveal `rv = smoothstep(0.35 + aRand.w·0.4, 1, uReveal)`.
  - Silhouette weight `sil = 1 − |worldNormal.z|`.
  - `alpha = sin(life·π)·(0.45 + 0.75·tuft)·rv·(0.7 + 0.5·aRand.w)·(0.3 + 0.7·sil)`.
  - Colour: warm white, tinted 25% × aRand.x toward mint on the left and pink on the right.
  - Point size `0.0075·(0.45 + 1.1·aRand.x²)`.
- **Fragment shader:** `core = smoothstep(0.24, 0, d)`, `halo = smoothstep(0.5, 0, d)·0.55`, output alpha × 0.85.

**3. Glass shell.** `SphereGeometry(1, 160, 96)`, scaled `mix(0.8, 1, uReveal)`.
- `f = 1 − dot(N, V)`, `fr = f^2.6`.
- Thin-film colour: `irid = 0.5 + 0.5·cos(2π·(f·1.15 + atan(y,x)·0.16 + t·0.025 + (0, .33, .67)))`, then mixed 50% with white.
- Edge line `edge = smoothstep(0.78, 0.96, f)·(1 − smoothstep(0.992, 1, f))`.
- `col = mix((0.98, 0.95, 1), irid, smoothstep(0.35, 0.95, f))`, then 60% toward white on the edge.
- `alpha = (0.025 + fr·0.42 + edge·0.6)·uReveal·uFade`.

**Size uniform.** `uPx = vh·dpr / VIS_H · 10 · sqrt(R·R_hero)`. The dots grow only with √scale, so the sphere stays fine-grained when it gets big.

**Motion:**
- `spin.rotation.y = t·0.045 + scrollY·0.0004`.
- `orb` rotation eases toward the mouse: `ry = ndcX·0.28`, `rx = −ndcY·0.16`, with `L = 1 − 0.0025^dt` and factor ×0.6.
- `orb.x` adds `ry·R·0.12`, eased with factor ×0.5.
- `uMouseStr` eases to 1 while the pointer has moved within the last 900 ms, and back to 0 otherwise.
- `uMouse` follows the pointer ray hitting the z = 0 plane, with factor ×1.4.
- **Hero rise:** `orb.y = layout.y − (1 − uReveal)·R·0.28`.

### 6b. The crystal (focus section): group `crystal → crystalSpin`

**Geometry:** `IcosahedronGeometry(1, 1)`, which gives 80 flat triangular panels and is non-indexed. Add a barycentric attribute `aBary`, with each vertex getting (1,0,0), (0,1,0) or (0,0,1) by index mod 3.

**Meshes:** draw it twice with the shared material settings, first `BackSide` (alpha × 0.5) and then `FrontSide`.

**Fragment shader:**
- Flat normal `N = normalize(cross(dFdx(viewPos), dFdy(viewPos)))`.
- `fres = (1 − |N·V|)^2.2`.
- `minB = min(bary)`.
- **Rib** `edge = 1 − smoothstep(0, 0.03, minB)`.
- **Bevel** `bevel = 1 − smoothstep(0.03, 0.12, minB)`, and `fringe = bevel·(1 − edge)`.
- **Dispersion:** `h = N·norm(0.35, 0.65, 0.6)·1.3 + minB·4 + objY·0.35 + t·0.04`, `rainbow = 0.55 + 0.45·cos(2π(h + (0, .33, .67)))`.
- **Caustics:** `caustic = (1 − |snoise(obj·2.6 + (0, t·0.18, t·0.07))|)^14`.
- **Glint:** `spec = max(N·H, 0)^48`, with light direction `norm(−0.45, 0.7, 0.55)`.
- **Colour:**
  - `col = (0.92, 0.9, 1)·(0.22 + 0.4·fres)`
  - `+ rainbow·(0.14·fres + 0.5·fringe + 0.12·caustic)`
  - `+ (1, 0.97, 1)·(edge + caustic·0.25 + spec)`
- **Alpha:** `(0.06 + fres·0.26 + edge·0.9 + fringe·0.26 + caustic·0.14 + spec·0.8)·(1 + 0.35·uHover)`, clamped, then × `mix(1, 0.5, back)` × `uFade2`.

The result is clear glass with white ribs and a thin prism fringe beside each rib.

**Core glow:** a camera-facing 2.6 × 2.6 quad drawn before the shell. Its alpha is `(e^(−5d²)·0.95 + e^(−1.6d²)·0.45)·smoothstep(1, 0.55, d)·(0.85 + 0.1·sin(t·0.8) + 0.2·uHover)·uFade2`, with colour (1, 0.94, 0.99). The `smoothstep` is required so the quad never shows its square edge.

**Motion:**
- `crystalSpin.rotation = (0.32 + t·0.025, t·0.11 + scrollY·0.0007, 0)`.
- `crystal.rotation = orb.rotation·1.4` (it follows the mouse).
- `crystal.x` adds `mouseOffset·0.6`.
- `uHover` eases to 1 while the cursor is inside the crystal's screen circle (`1 − 0.02^dt`).

---

## 7. Scroll choreography (one smoothed scroll value drives everything)

**Smoothed scroll.** Each frame: `sS += (scrollY − sS)·(1 − 0.0015^dt)`, snapping when the difference is under 0.1. Section tops and bottoms are measured with `getBoundingClientRect().top + scrollY` on load, on resize and after `document.fonts.ready`.

**Keyframes.** Each key is `(scroll, cx, cy, r, fade)`. Interpolate between neighbouring keys with smoothstep `x²(3 − 2x)`. In the tables, `w = vw/1440`, `m`/`tr`/`fo`/`te` are the manifesto, track, focus and team sections, and `H` is the hero placement.

**Main sphere, desktop:**

| Scroll | cx | cy | r | fade |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | hero (720u, 875u) | | 427u | 1 |
| m.top | 330w | 0.47vh | 560w | 1 |
| tr.top + 0.2vh | 290w | 0.50vh | 600w | 0.95 |
| tr.bottom − vh | 250w | 0.46vh | 600w | 0.85 |
| fo.top − 0.15vh | −420w | 0.20vh | 520w | 0 |
| fo.bottom − 0.5vh | −420w | 0.20vh | 520w | 0 |
| fo.bottom − 0.45vh | 1030w | 1.30vh | 330w | 0 (repositions while invisible) |
| te.top | 1030w | 0.45vh | 330w | 1 |
| te.top + 0.9vh | 150w | 0.50vh | 470w | 1 |
| te.bottom − vh | 150w | 0.50vh | 470w | 1 |
| te.bottom | 150w | −0.2vh | 470w | 0.5 |

**Main sphere, phone:**

| Scroll | cx | cy | r | fade |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | hero | | | 1 |
| m.top | 0.1vw | 0.17vh | 0.62vw | 0.95 |
| tr.top + 0.3vh | 0.08vw | 0.22vh | 0.62vw | 0.7 |
| fo.top − 0.3vh | −0.7vw | 0.1vh | 0.6vw | 0 |
| fo.bottom − 0.5vh | −0.7vw | 0.1vh | 0.6vw | 0 |
| fo.bottom − 0.45vh | 0.5vw | 1.3vh | 0.42vw | 0 |
| te.top | 0.5vw | 0.27vh | 0.42vw | 1 |
| te.top + 0.9vh | −0.12vw | 0.5vh | 0.5vw | 1 |
| te.bottom − vh | −0.12vw | 0.5vh | 0.5vw | 1 |
| te.bottom | −0.12vw | −0.1vh | 0.5vw | 0.6 |

**Crystal, desktop:**

| Scroll | cx | cy | r | fade |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| fo.top − 0.75vh | 1180w | 1.05vh | 230w | 0 |
| fo.top − 0.05vh | 979w | (434/900)vh | 305w | 1 |
| fo.bottom − 0.6vh | 979w | (434/900)vh | 305w | 1 |
| fo.bottom − 0.2vh | 900w | 0.12vh | 250w | 0 |

**Crystal, phone:**

| Scroll | cx | cy | r | fade |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| fo.top − 0.7vh | 0.7vw | 1.1vh | 0.3vw | 0 |
| fo.top | 0.5vw | 0.24vh | 0.36vw | 1 |
| fo.bottom − 0.6vh | 0.5vw | 0.24vh | 0.36vw | 1 |
| fo.bottom − 0.2vh | 0.5vw | −0.05vh | 0.3vw | 0 |

Hide either group entirely when its fade is below 0.003.

**Colour layers.** With `ramp(x, a, b) = clamp((x − a)/(b − a))`:
- manifesto opacity `= ramp(sS, 0.35vh, vh)·(1 − ramp(sS, fo.top − 0.9vh, fo.top − 0.2vh))`;
- focus opacity `= ramp(sS, fo.top − 0.9vh, fo.top − 0.2vh)·(1 − ramp(sS, fo.bottom − 0.8vh, fo.bottom − 0.2vh))`;
- team opacity `= ramp(sS, fo.bottom − 0.8vh, fo.bottom − 0.2vh)`;
- hero glow opacity `= 1 − ramp(sS, 0, 0.5vh)`.

**Pager:** `.show` while `fo.top − 0.3vh < sS < fo.bottom − 0.6vh`.

**Team wheel.** Let `tp = ramp(sS, te.top, te.bottom − vh)`.
- Intro opacity `= 1 − ramp(tp, 0.12, 0.26)`.
- Wheel opacity `= ramp(tp, 0.2, 0.34)`.
- Active index `= ramp(tp, 0.3, 0.98)·11`.
- Name i is placed at angle `a = (i − active)·11°` (13° on phones) on a circle of radius `RR = sphere r·1.12` (1.10 on phones) around the sphere's screen centre:
  - `transform: translate(cx + cos a·RR, cy + sin a·RR) rotate(a) translateY(−50%) scale(1 + 0.16·near)`, where `near = max(0, 1 − |i − active|)`;
  - opacity `(0.35 + 0.65·near)·max(0, 1 − |a|/1.15)`.
- The rule starts at `cx + RR + 430w` and ends `80w` before the right edge, at height cy. Its opacity is `1 − min(1, |active − round(active)|·1.6)`, and its role text is the rounded active person's role.

---

## 8. Entrance (one Web Animations timeline, run once)

- `<html class="pre">` hides the wordmark, menu and headline (`opacity:0`).
- **Failsafe:** an inline script in `<head>` waits 2600 ms. If `.pre` is still there, it sets `window.__heroShown = true` and removes `.pre`.
- Once the module runs:
  - **Sphere reveal proxy:** a detached `<i>` animates opacity 0→1 over 2200 ms, easing `cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.24,1)`, `fill:both`. Every frame, `uReveal` = `proxy.effect.getComputedTiming().progress`, so the sphere shares the same timeline. It always runs.
  - If `__heroShown` is already set, stop here so the copy isn't hidden again. Otherwise animate, all with `fill:'backwards'` and easing `cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)`:
    - wordmark: opacity 0→1, translateY(−8px)→0, 700 ms, delay 200;
    - menu: the same, delay 280;
    - headline: opacity 0→1, `translate: 0 22px`→0, `blur(6px)`→0, 1100 ms, delay 350. Use the individual `translate` property so the CSS `transform` offset survives.
  - Then remove `.pre`.
- **Section reveals:** an `IntersectionObserver` (threshold 0.15, rootMargin `0px 0px -6% 0px`) adds `.in` to each `.reveal`, then unobserves it.
  - `.reveal`: `opacity 0; translate 0 28w`, with a 1 s transition on both properties using `cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)`.
  - Each item has `transition-delay = (index mod 4)·70 ms`.

---

## 9. Loop, resize and reduced motion

- `renderer.setAnimationLoop`. Skip frames while `document.hidden`. `dt = min(clock.getDelta(), 0.05)`.
- **On resize:** update the size and pixel ratio, set the camera aspect, re-measure the sections and rebuild the keyframes.
- **`prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`:**
  - No animation loop, no mouse listeners and no entrance animations. Remove `.pre` at once.
  - `uReveal = 1`. All `.reveal` elements get `.in`, with no transitions.
  - The sphere and crystal jump straight to their keyframe for the current `scrollY`; `render(0)` runs on every scroll and resize.
  - Card, button and pager transitions are off.
- **Phone layout:** at ≤ 820px, every section uses the phone values given above and there is no horizontal scroll.

---

## 10. Accessibility and semantics

- `<main>` wraps the hero and the sections. The headline is an `h1`; the closing line is an `h2`.
- The stage and canvas are `aria-hidden`.
- The wheel has `aria-label="Team"`. The pager is a `nav` with `aria-label="Focus areas"`, and its buttons are labelled.
- Every company, person and claim is fictional.

# Prompt: Vexor signup CTA and footer

Build a single-file **signup call-to-action with a footer for a fictional global payments company, Vexor**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is pure black with one framed CTA card filled with slowly swirling coral and crimson smoke, a white headline, a dark waitlist input with a coral button, and a minimal footer underneath.

## Media

- **Still plate:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/03c58212-3a59-4c80-b19d-30d05a174563.webp`. Abstract coral, pink and crimson smoke on black, densest on the right and fading to black at the upper left, behind the copy.
- **Loop video:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/f6f4ec49-d5dd-4893-8eb4-fa0f932aceaf.mp4` (5s, muted). The same smoke curling and drifting. Its last second crossfades into its first, so it loops without a jump and never plays in reverse.
- **Video behaviour:**
  - It covers the plate inside the card (object-fit cover, anchored right bottom) at 80% opacity.
  - It fades in on `loadeddata`.
  - It is hidden for reduced motion.

## Scale

- **Units:** desktop sizes are in reference pixels of a 1440 frame (`--u = 100cqw / 1440`). The card also respects the height (`--v = min(100cqw / 1240, 100dvh / 720)`), so it fits one screen.
- **Tablet and phone:** they use their own reference boxes (768×700, 768×612 and 390×655) and stack the footer.

## Type and colour

- **Font:** Inter (variable 100–900, embedded as "Inter Vexor").
- **Colours:**
  - page `#000`
  - text white
  - placeholder `#808081`
  - input fill black with a 15% white border
  - accent gradient `#FF8A73` → `#F0605A`
  - card border: a coral gradient (`rgba(244,118,104,.67)` → `.29`)
  - dividers white at 20%

## Layout (1440 frame)

- **CTA card:** about 1380 × 340u with a 20u radius.
  - **Headline:** "Get your Vexor Account", centred, about 34u, semibold.
  - **Sub:** two lines: "Join 200+ businesses like yours, powering their global / transactions with Vexor."
  - **Waitlist field:** a pill (about 460u wide) with the placeholder "Enter your email to join the waitlist" and an inset coral "Get Free Access" pill button with a soft inner highlight.
- **Footer** (below the card, same side margins):
  - Left: a three-slash "W"-like Vexor mark and a four-line paragraph: "Get paid for free from countries in the EU, Asia, and the US. There are no deposit charges. Create an account in your preferred currency and share the details to get paid. We make it easy to go international."
  - Right: "Contact Us", then "+44 20 7946 0321", then "Vexor Labs Ltd, / 12 Harbour Row, / Bristol BS1 5TT, UK".
  - A thin rule, then "Copyright © Vexor Labs. 2025. All Rights Reserved." and "Email us: hello@vexor.example".

## Motion

- **Entrance:** a one-time CSS sequence of about 1.4s:
  - the card rule draws
  - the title rises
  - the copy fades
  - the form expands from its centre, then the button pops
  - the footer mark fades last
- **Hover:**
  - The input border brightens.
  - The coral button lifts 1px and glows warmer.
  - The phone and email links underline.
- **Reduced motion:** static, with no video.

## Acceptance check (1440×960)

- A framed card of moving coral smoke with a centred white headline and waitlist pill.
- A clean two-column footer below, with even margins.
- **Content:** no real brands or logos.

Build a single-file, one-screen **split landing hero for a fictional freelancer bank, nuvo**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step.

- **Left:** a tall rounded photo panel showing a golden-hour clifftop meadow with a white lighthouse above the sea, with a stack of floating banking UI cards over it and a big "Hey, it's nuvo!" in the bottom-left corner.
- **Right:** a calm off-white column with a small header, a large three-line headline (sans plus serif italic), a lede, a coral CTA and two small facts at the bottom.

## Layout and scale

- **Page:** a full-viewport page on a pale peach ground `#F8E6DD`, with a unit `--u` scaled from a desktop reference so everything stays one screen.
- **Columns:**
  - **Left panel:** about 46% of the width, rounded corners, with an 8u margin from the page edge.
  - **Right column:** fills the rest of the width on a warm white `#FAF9F5`.

## Type and colour

- **Fonts:**
  - **Instrument Sans** (variable, stretch 95%) for the UI and the first headline lines.
  - **Instrument Serif Italic** for "freelance life", "it's nuvo!" and the card logo.
- **Colours:**
  - ink `#151615`, soft ink `#696C64`, muted `#C3C4C1`
  - coral card `#FE8A70`, coral CTA `#FA7F62`, negative amounts `#E5714D`
  - dark card `#2C3426`, chips `#EFF2E9`

## Left panel

- **Photo:** cover-fit. A grassy slope full of white and yellow wildflowers sweeps up from the lower left to sea cliffs on the right, with a small white lighthouse on top, the sea below and a warm sunset sky.
- **Motion:** a muted, looping 4s video of the same shot sits over the photo with identical cover framing (object-position 50% 50%; 50% 32% on tablets): `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/8c7344a4-d74c-4611-a9f5-bfe0125be0ef.mp4` (1012×1552, portrait).
  - The grass and wildflowers ripple in a sea breeze, waves break on the rocks, clouds drift and the sun glints on the water, with a slow forward camera drift.
  - The last second crossfades into the first, so it loops without a jump and never plays in reverse.
  - Fade it in (0.8s) once its first frame is ready. Hide it for reduced motion so the still photo shows.
- **Rule:** nothing in the scene is drawn or animated in code. Only the UI animates.
- **Dust:** a few tiny white floating dust specks (SVG circles) near the top.
- **Floating cards** (overlapping, with soft depth):
  1. **Coral balance card:** "TOTAL BALANCE", "$24,318.40", a white chip "+$3,200 today", a small dark dot, and "VIEW DETAIL" underlined.
  2. **Frosted glass list card:** "Westbrook Studio" with "+$3,200", then two more rows partly hidden behind the dark card (amounts "−$640" and "−$15" in coral chips), and a white row "Invoice #0413 is due tomorrow" with "SEND A REMINDER ↗".
  3. **Dark card:** "Virtual cart" and "Debit" at the top, and a large "nuvo" wordmark.
- **Corner text:** "Hey," / "*it's nuvo!*" in big white type at the bottom left.

## Right column

- **Header:** a light square menu button (three lines) on the left, the "nuvo" wordmark centred, and a dark square profile button on the right.
- **Headline:** centred, about 64u, tight leading: "Banking that / keeps up with / *freelance life*", with the last line in Instrument Serif Italic.
- **Lede:** "One account for invoices, taxes and / getting paid from anywhere. No monthly / fees, no waiting for Monday."
- **CTA:** a coral rounded pill "Open an account" (151u × 45u) with a small dark square arrow button inside it, on the right. It is exactly centred under the lede on the column's centre line (`left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%)`). Any hover or lift animation must keep that centring transform, for example `translateX(-50%) translateY(-2px)`, never `transform: none`.
- **Footer facts:** "No monthly fees · 30+ currencies" in light grey.

## Motion

- **Entrance:** one Web Animations timeline, about 2.5s, removed at the end.
  - The header settles.
  - The headline lines wipe up one by one.
  - The lede and CTA rise in turn.
  - The cards float in on the photo.
- **Hover:** the CTA lifts slightly.
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance and no video.

## Responsive

- **Phones:** the right column comes first (header, headline, lede, CTA, facts), and the photo panel with its cards stacks below it.

## Acceptance check (1440×960)

- The golden-hour lighthouse cliff panel sits on the left, with coral, glass and dark cards and "Hey, it's nuvo!".
- The clean right column has the three-line sans and serif headline and the coral CTA.
- **Content:** no real brands.

**1. Typography & Setup:**
- Import the "Inter" font from Google Fonts (weights 400, 500, 600, 700) and set it as the default sans-serif font in the Tailwind config/CSS.

- Create a section at the top of the page. Height should be `50vh` (on mobile/lg) and `30vh` (on md screens).
- Background color: `#FDFDFD`.
- Center a text element that says "View Below". The text should be `text-gray-300`, small font, bold, uppercase, with wide `tracking-[0.5em]`.

- Make sure the background covers the container (`bg-cover bg-center`) and set `overflow-hidden` with `relative` positioning.
- Set up a Framer Motion `useScroll` target on this container. Map the `scrollYProgress` from `[0, 1]` to `[-50, 150]` using `useTransform`. Apply this transformed y-value to the foreground truck image layer (described below).

**4. The Top-Aligned Footer Card:**
- Position a container `absolute top-0 w-full` inside the main parallax section. Give it top padding (`pt-12` mobile/lg, `pt-24` tablet).
- Inside, create a card constrained to `max-w-7xl mx-auto`.
- Card Styling: `bg-white/95`, `backdrop-blur-sm`, `shadow-xl`, rounded corners (`rounded-2xl` mobile, `rounded-3xl` desktop), `overflow-hidden`.
- Animation: The card should slide down and fade in (`initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -20 }}`, `animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}`, duration 0.8s easeOut).
- **Footer Content (Top Half):**
  - Use a flex row layout (flex-col on mobile, flex-row on md+) with spread space.
  - **Logo Area**: Include an orange square (`bg-orange-500`, 40x40px mobile, 48x48px desktop, rounded-lg, shadow-inner, p-2). Next to the logo block, add the text "HAUL!" (`text-gray-900`, 2xl/3xl, font-bold, tracking-tighter).
  - **Links Area**: Display 3 columns of links using flex. Layout: `Company` (Founding, Platform, Testify), `Mobile` (Get Apple App, Get Google App), `Contracts` (Private Data, User Consent). Section headers should be uppercase, tracking-widest, text-sm, bold. Link items should be gray-500, font-medium, and hover to `orange-600` with transition.
- **Footer Content (Bottom Bar):**
  - Add a top border (`border-gray-100`) and use a solid white background (`bg-white`).
  - Layout: flex, space between, aligning text to the left and social icons to the right. 
  - Text: "© 2026 HAUL! All Rights Reserved" (text-sm, gray-500, medium).
  - **Social Icons**: Map through an array of icons imported from `lucide-react`: Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Linkedin (w-5 h-5). Wrap them in `a` tags shaped as 40x40px circles with `border-gray-100`. On hover, they should turn `bg-orange-500` with white text and an `orange-500` border (transition all duration-300).

**5. Background Truck Parallax Layer:**
- Add a `motion.div` placed absolutely at the bottom of the container (`absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-full`).
- Add standard pointer-events-none and z-20.
- Ensure the `y` axis style is tied to the `useTransform` created in step 3 so it scrolls at a different speed than the background.
- Inside, place an image with `src="https://roof-wish-40038865.figma.site/_components/v2/f31fd17907ce60745d45e83a61d44fd3810d5f25/truck_1.8c4bff83.png"`.

full_prompt:
# Prompt: Koru Tech footer

Build a single-file **website footer section** (header bar plus full footer, one screen) for a fictional IT services company, **Koru Tech**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is dark and techy: a near-black green page and a glass nav. At the bottom, a glowing emerald horizon over a perspective grid floor, with a giant outlined "KORU TECH" wordmark standing on the horizon line. Emerald accents throughout.

## Media

- **Still:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/139344bb-585a-4867-9a31-94cbfad8f6d9.jpg` (1920×1280, 3:2). A dark green-black sky, a bright emerald horizon light low in the frame (horizon at 78.6% height), and a faint emerald perspective grid floor below.
- **Motion:** a muted 4s loop of the same scene, `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/17d62c8c-c7a4-491d-82ff-b0cbd3387820.mp4` (1600×1064).
  - The camera glides forward over the grid; the grid lines stream towards the viewer and the horizon glow breathes brighter and dimmer.
  - The horizon was stabilised so it never moves, and the last second crossfades into the first, so it loops without a jump and never plays in reverse.
  - Fade it in (0.9s) once its first frame is ready.
- **Rule:** nothing in the scene is drawn or animated in code. Only the UI animates.

## Scale

- **Units:** a 1536-wide reference frame, `--u = min(100vw/1536, 100vh/930)`, centred. The page is a flex column at least one screen tall.
- **Rows:** a 100u header row at the top and an 805u footer row pinned to the bottom. Only the empty band between them stretches.
- **Scene box:** pinned to the page bottom, centred, `width: max(100%, 1536u)`, `aspect-ratio: 3/2`, holding the still (cover, bottom-centre), the video (cover, object-position 50% 100%) and the wordmark.

## Type and colour

- **Font:** **Albert Sans** 400/600.
- **Colours:**
  - page `#030D0B`
  - accent emerald `#0BE3AE`, deeper emerald `#02C78A`
  - text `#F8F8F8`, muted `#BBBCC2`
- **Glass:** an emerald-tinted fill (4.5% → 7%) with an emerald hairline border that is brighter at the top.

## Header (1536 frame)

- **Logo:** at (251, 43). A 45u emerald gradient rounded tile (`#14E6B0` → `#01B987`, radius 10) holding a bold white geometric "K", then "KORU TECH" (600, 17u, tracking .06em).
- **Nav:** a glass pill 452×58u at (543, 33) with "Home · Services · Projects · About · Contact" at 15.2u. Home is the current page, in emerald.
- **Button:** a white "Book a Call" pill (158×51u at 1131.5, 37) with an emerald arrow.

## Footer

- **Left column** (from x 134):
  - the logo again
  - the tagline "Maximize your digital infrastructure and / enhance organizational efficiency." (16u)
  - "QUICK CONTACT" (tracking .05em)
  - four 51u round emerald-ring buttons: professional network (emerald glyph), Instagram, X and YouTube (white glyphs)
- **Link columns** (headings 600 at 17.4u, links 16.6u):
  - **Quick Links** at x 723: Home, About Us, Services, Projects, Contact Us
  - **Support** at x 921: FAQs, Support Center
  - **Get in Touch With Us** at x 1148, each row with a small emerald icon:
    - phone: "Phone: +64 9 555 0142"
    - mail: "Email: info@korutech.example"
    - mail: "Email: sales@korutech.example"
    - pin: "Address: Wellington, New Zealand"
- **Wordmark:** an inline SVG spanning the scene width (viewBox 1440×200, 21% of the box tall, bottom 21.4%, so it stands on the horizon). It's "KORU TECH" as outlined text (Albert Sans 600, textLength 1478, so the "H" runs off the right edge) with a 1.6px stroke. ## Media

- **Sky:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/4ec0de15-9d60-43b1-a76e-7d721f094fd6.jpg`. A deep indigo-to-violet gradient with a soft diagonal light fold, `background-size: cover`, anchored to the bottom centre.

## Scale

## Type and colour

## Hero (top left, 47u in, 35u down)

- **Badge:** a 43u white note badge with a folded top-right corner and an indigo notes glyph.
- **Headline:** "Let Your Work Speak For Itself. / We’ll Handle The Words." at 53.8u on a 66u line, white at 90%, 41u below the badge.

  - a 193.5u white "Sign Up" button with a 48u indigo square holding a circled arrow
  - the field focuses to white at 26% with a 1.5u inner ring
  - submitting clears the field and shows "Thanks — we’ll be in touch."

## Footer card

- **Card:** square-cornered white, 48u from each side, sitting right on top of the floor. A fine double inner border and a crisp 1u dark outline with a tiny drop line underneath.
- **Top row:** 360u tall, 62u top padding, 58u left padding. Grid columns: 469u (flexible), then 236, 207.5, 199.5 and 165u.
  - **Brand column:**
    - an original indigo logo of six small hexagons around a filled centre hexagon (33 × 31u), then "NimbusOS" at 25.4u
    - "The Architect Of / Modern Digital Growth." at 30.6u, 60u below
    - a 177 × 48u indigo "Get In Touch" button with a white square arrow cap
  - **Link columns:** each starts with a 2.4u light rule on its left, a 19.8u heading, then links at 15.8u in muted grey, 19.5u apart. Links turn indigo on hover.
    - Industries: Automotive, Energy & Utilities, Financial, Life Science, Embedded Teams
    - Insights: News, Case Studies, Podcasts, Events, Public Sector

## Motion

full_prompt:
# Prompt: "offline" power-button footer

Build a single-file **website footer** for a fictional digital-wellbeing product, **offline** ("Everything you need to know before you finally log off"). Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The footer is one full-bleed cinematic scene: a small beige vintage all-in-one computer (generic, no brand logo) on a grassy hill under a blue sky. The wordmark's "o" is a power button. Clicking it takes the scene offline: the sky turns to night, the CRT collapses to a point, and that last point of light flies up into the power-o.

## Media

- **Scene clip, 1080p:** https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/abdab52e-bb1b-477d-ae7c-26c5f8915433.mp4 (1920×1080, 60 fps, 5.0 s, no audio)
- **Scene clip, 720p, for screens ≤ 900 px:** https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/15017aa7-135b-471f-a8a1-42a208bc61b2.mp4
- **Poster:** https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/af6deff1-d678-4dc6-ae24-2880b16cdb20.jpg (the clip's first frame: day, screen off)
- **Fonts:**
  - Instrument Serif 400 (wordmark and column headings), self-hosted latin woff2: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/instrumentserif/v5/jizBRFtNs2ka5fXjeivQ4LroWlx-6zUTjnTLgNs.woff2
  - Inter 400/500 (body and links), latin variable woff2: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/inter/v20/UcC73FwrK3iLTeHuS_nVMrMxCp50SjIa1ZL7W0Q5nw.woff2

### Clip timeline

The clip is one locked-off shot:

| Time (s) | What happens |
|---|---|
| 0 – 1.17 | Day, CRT off (glossy black screen) |
| 1.2 – 1.6 | Switch-on: a thin white line expands into white static, then TV colour bars with a purple-pink glow |
| 1.9 – 2.7 | Steady colour bars, dandelion seeds drifting |
| 2.7 – 4.4 | The sky turns from day through a warm dusk to deep navy night with stars; the light on the computer and grass dims |
| 4.46 – 4.62 | The picture collapses to a thin line, then to one point of light at the screen's centre |
| 4.62 – 5.0 | Night: dark screen, a faint point, stars, seeds |

Nothing in the scene is drawn or animated in code. Every scene change comes from the clip, which never plays in reverse and never crossfades.

## Layout (desktop; 1 u = 1/1902 of the viewport width)

- **Footer:** 100svh tall, `overflow:hidden`. The video and poster cover it (`object-fit:cover`, `object-position: center bottom`).
- **Top tint:** a soft dark wash on the top 38 %.
- **Grid:** top-left at 105u / 78u, with columns of 528u, 404u and 404u, then the rest. White text.
- **Brand column:**
  - **Wordmark** "offline", Instrument Serif 58u. The **o is an inline SVG power symbol** (viewBox 0 0 50 62):
    - an open circle `M14.2 22.6 A19 19 0 1 0 35.8 22.6`
    - a vertical tick `M25 6.5 V33`
    - stroke 4.6, round caps, `currentColor`, matched to the serif's weight
    - plus a blurred white halo ring whose opacity is driven by a `--lit` variable
  - **Tagline:** 19.5u Inter at 1.5 line height, max 300u wide.
  - **Copyright:** "© 2026 OFFLINE, Inc. All rights reserved." at 17u, 34u below the tagline.
- **Link columns:** headings in Instrument Serif 35u, 40u above the first link. Links in Inter 19.5u with 19u gaps:
  - **Platform:** Manifesto, How it works, Pricing, FAQ
  - **About:** About, Careers, Privacy Policy, Cookie Policy
  - **Social Media:** LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok

## Interaction

### Arrival (online)

- When the footer is 35 % in view, the text rises in: 10u lift, 0.9 s, staggered 60 ms.
- The clip plays from 0.6 s, shows the switch-on, then pauses on the colour bars at 2.3 s.

### Online idle (code overlay on a canvas over the video)

- **Scanline:** a soft white scanline band (≈52 px tall, 10 % white) sweeps down the screen glass every ~1.8 s, with a faint flicker. It's clipped to the screen rectangle, which is (806, 505)–(1077, 724) in the clip's 1920×1080 frame, mapped through the same cover transform as the video.
- **Glints:** ~10 small four-point star glints twinkle in the sky. Their number grows to ~22 as the clip's sky reaches night.

### The wordmark is a power button

- It's a `<button>` with `cursor:pointer` and aria-pressed.
- **Hover:** a soft white `drop-shadow` glow on the power-o.
- **Press:** the o scales to 0.94.

### Click while online → offline

- The clip plays from 2.3 s to the end at 1×: dusk, then night, then the CRT collapse.
- At clip time 4.72 s a **glowing dot** leaves the screen's last point of light, at (945, 594) in the clip frame.
  - It flies for 0.78 s on a curved, eased (cubic in-out) quadratic path up and left into the centre of the power-o.
  - Size: a white core with a 6× radial bloom halo, growing and then shrinking along the way.
- **Landing:** the power-o's halo ring glows (`--lit` from 0.9 to 0 over 0.9 s), as if the light went into the button.
- The clip holds on its night frame.

### Click while offline → back online

- Cut back to 0.6 s and replay the switch-on to the 2.3 s colour-bar idle.
- Clicks during the switch-off are ignored.

### Links

- On hover, a 1.6u underline wipes in from the left over 0.32 s and wipes out to the right.

## Phone (≤ 760 px)

- **Text:** the text block sits on top in two columns, with the brand spanning both.
- **Scene:** the clip sits at the bottom at 170 % width (16:9), with its top edge masked into the sky.
- **Sky:** the sky behind the text is a canvas. It paints the clip's top rows, blurred by 18 px and stretched, every frame, so it follows the clip from day to night.
- **Spacing:** the footer's bottom padding is about 80 % of the clip's height.

## Reduced motion

- No video and no entrance; the poster and text show statically.

## Acceptance check (1440×960)

1. On load, the CRT switches on (line, static, colour bars) on a day sky, and the scanline shimmer runs.
2. Click the power-o: the sky goes to night, the CRT collapses, and a glowing dot flies into the o, which glows.
3. Click again: the scene comes back online.
4. Link hovers underline.
5. No brand logos anywhere.

## Media

- **Glow plate:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/4a917d4c-123f-4b68-8125-b201961b7791.jpg` (2240×843). A smooth cobalt-to-cyan light field across the top that fades into dark navy.

  - The aurora ribbons flow, ripple and curl across the band while the light drifts sideways.

  - It fades in (0.9s) once its first frame is ready.

## Scale

## Colours and type

- **Colours:**
  - page `#00071A`
  - text white; links `#AFCAF3`; copyright `#B3CCEF`
  - accent cyan `#2EF0FD`
  - dividers and the dashed rule `#2A74E8` at about 40%
- **Sky:** above the glow image (on tall screens) the background is a horizontal gradient taken from the plate's top row: `#2A70F9 → #0C40D2 → #126FF3 → #57E3FC → #64E4FC`.
- **Font:** Inter Display 300/400/500.

## Layout (reference units)

- **Glow box:** the top 558u, `preserveAspectRatio="none"` across the full width. The plate and the video share it, and both are masked so their bottom 18% fades into the page.
- **Arc:** a thin arc (1.6px, gradient `#2A6DFC → #3FD0FF`) sweeps from (0, 143) down through about (816, 386) and up to (1326, 334).
- **Ring:** r = 78 at (780.7, 351.5). A glass disc with a dark inner radial fill and a 2.4px rim graded from blue at the bottom-left to bright cyan `#8AF0FF` at the top-right. A soft 5px blurred copy of the rim sits under it as a glow.
- **Wordmark:** "Vantix", bold geometric sans (Plus Jakarta Sans 700), drawn as one vector path, reading bottom to top.
  - Its cap height is 88.5u, its baseline is at x = 667.5u, and its bottom is aligned at y = 901.7u.
  - It's filled with a vertical gradient `#1DB6FC → #44F4FD → #19DAFD`.
  - The two vertical hairlines at x = 473 and 762 fade in from the top.
- **Left:**
  - "Elevate your brand with / us and experience the / difference." (500, 29u) at (72, 589)
  - a 76u cyan ring with a cyan ↗ arrow, then "Book a call" (30u, cyan, underlined) at (73, 741)
- **Right:** "Important" (Services, Portfolio, Pricing, About, Reviews) at x = 859 and "Legal" (Terms & conditions, Privacy policy, Contact us) at x = 1078. Headings are 28u/500; links are 21.6u/300 on a 58.75u row.
- **Bottom:**
  - a full-width dashed rule at y = 964
  - "Follow us" at (72, 1025)
  - five 45u round icons (X, Instagram, LinkedIn, Dribbble, Behance): dark blue glass with a thin blue ring and cyan glyphs
  - "Copyright © 2024 - All rights reserved" (15u, light) aligned right at y = 1099

## Motion

- **Entrance:** one CSS sequence with backwards fill, about 1.6s.
  - The wordmark wipes up out of a clip.
  - The headline rises out of a clip.
  - The two link columns and the CTA rise in turn.
  - The social row and the copyright fade in.
- **Hover:**
  - the CTA ring fills faint cyan and its arrow turns 45°, while the underline retracts
  - links turn cyan
  - icons lift 3u
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance and no video.

## Tablet and phone (below 960px, portrait or touch)

- **One-screen grid:** the glow band on top takes the spare height, with the plate cropped to its bottom.
- **Wordmark:** horizontal and full width, rising out of the glow, with a rule just under it.
- **Main block:** headline and CTA, then the link columns. On phones they stack below the headline.
- **Bottom:** the social row, then the copyright.

## Acceptance check (1440×1152)

- The aurora visibly flows behind the arc and ring.
- The cyan "Vantix" stands vertically between the hairlines.
- Every accent (CTA, icons, wordmark) is cyan; there are no drop shadows.
- **Content:** no real brands except the generic social glyphs.
