## 8. Animations and interactions

### 8.1 Preloader timeline

- **Start.** It starts on window load, or immediately if document.readyState is already "complete". A failsafe setTimeout calls it after 8000 ms. A started flag makes it run only once.
- **Returning visitors.** It reads localStorage "reshoot_preloader_v1" and treats the visitor as returning if the value is "1", then writes "1". The speed factor sp is 1/5 for a returning visitor and 1 otherwise. Both reads and writes are in try/catch.
- **Scroll lock.** It scrolls to (0, 0), then sets overflow hidden on both html and body.
- **Image hard-cuts.** A setInterval every 500 × sp ms (100 ms when returning) sets z-index 9 on the layer at the current index and 1 on the others, then advances the index modulo 4.
  - Before the first tick the last DOM layer (pre:1) is on top.
  - From then on the sequence is pre:3 (0.5 s), pre:0 (1.0 s), pre:2 (1.5 s), pre:1 (2.0 s), and so on.
  - These are instant cuts with no crossfade.
- **New-visitor counter.**
  - Steps are 0, 17, 35, 58, 76, 89, 100 with total T = 2.5 s, run on a GSAP timeline with delay .5.
  - Each segment tweens a plain number from the previous step to the next over 2.5/6 ≈ 0.4167 s with ease power2.out, writing Math.round of the value into the counter.
  - The first segment is 0 to 0, a short hold. The counter reaches 100 at 3.0 s.
  - The number is printed with no "%" sign.
- **Returning-visitor text.** The counter text becomes "Synced". It also gets its own fromTo: from opacity 0, y 8px, blur 6px to opacity 1, y 0, blur 0, over .2 s with delay .1 and ease power2.out.
- **Main timeline.**
  1. Set all direct children of the preloader to visibility visible.
  2. Fade them in: fromTo opacity 0 with filter blur(20px) to opacity 1 with blur(0px), duration 1 × sp, stagger .05 × sp, ease power2.out. The three children are the counter, the logo/loader row and the image stack.
  3. Fade them out: opacity 0 with blur(20px), duration 1 × sp, delay 2.5 × sp, stagger .05 × sp, ease power2.in.
  4. Fade the whole preloader to opacity 0 over .6 × sp with ease power2.in.
- **On complete.**
  - Remove is-loading from html and set the preloader to visibility hidden.
  - Dispatch the document event "preloader:done", which starts the hero intro.
  - Clear the image interval.
  - After 1 × sp seconds (gsap.delayedCall), release the scroll lock.

### 8.2 Opening sequence table (first visit, seconds from window load)

| Element | Property | Starts at | Duration | Stagger | Ease |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Preloader children (3) | opacity 0→1, blur 20px→0 | 0 | 1.0 | 0.05 | power2.out |
| Preloader photos | hard-cut z-index swaps | 0.5, then every 0.5 | instant | — | — |
| Counter | 0→17→35→58→76→89→100 | 0.5 (first segment holds at 0) | 6 × 0.4167 = 2.5 | sequential | power2.out per segment |
| Preloader children | opacity 1→0, blur 0→20px | 3.6 | 1.0 | 0.05 | power2.in |
| Preloader overlay | opacity 1→0 | 4.7 | 0.6 | — | power2.in |
| "preloader:done" fires (T₀) | — | ≈ 5.3 | — | — | — |
| Hero text words (©, year, "scroll", "down", headline words) | flash keyframes | T₀ + 0 | 0.15 per word | 0.2 per word, per element | power2.out |
| Header logo link | opacity 0→1, y 24→0, scale .9→1 | T₀ + 0.10 | 0.5 | — | power2.out |
| Header pill + menu holder | same | T₀ + 0.20 | 0.6 | — | power2.out |
| Ring cards (8) | opacity 0→1, scale .5→1 | T₀ + 0.30 | 0.5 | 0.12 | power2.out |
| Sign-in + Get started (is-header-btn) | opacity 0→1, y 24→0, scale .9→1 | T₀ + 0.35 | 0.5 | — | power2.out |
| Hero chips (12) | opacity 0→1, x 40→0, scale .9→1 | T₀ + 0.35 | 0.5 | 0.12 | power2.out |
| Scroll unlock | overflow restored | T₀ + 1.0 | — | — | — |

On a returning visit, every preloader value is divided by 5, so T₀ ≈ 1.06 s. The hero intro timings stay the same.

### 8.3 Hero intro details

At script start, unless reduced motion is on, GSAP sets these hidden states:

- Every data-hero-text element: opacity 0.
- Header logo link, header pill, menu holder and .is-header-btn: opacity 0, y 24, scale .9.
- Ring cards: opacity 0, scale .5.
- Hero chips: opacity 0, x 40, scale .9.

On "preloader:done", playHeroIntro builds a timeline. Each data-hero-text element is word-split (see 8.11), its words are set to opacity 0 in the violet flash colour, and the element itself is set to opacity 1. All three elements' word tweens are placed at time 0 with stagger .2 and ease power2.out, using three keyframes per word:

1. opacity 1 in --flash-a over .05.
2. Colour to --flash-b over .05.
3. Opacity to the word's stored final opacity (1, or .5 inside .u-fonts-50) and colour to var(--fonts-100) over .05.

So each word blinks violet, then pink, then settles to ink. The headline's words are "Your", "shelves,", "radiantly", "re-shot.", and the italic span keeps its styling. The other tweens follow the table above.

### 8.4 Ring rotation

- On load, each holder is set to rotate d and its photo to rotate −d. This runs even with reduced motion.
- Unless reduced motion is on:
  - hero__carousel__in rotates to 360 over 32 s, ease none, repeat −1. The ring turns clockwise.
  - Every ring photo rotates by "−=360" over 32 s, ease none, repeat −1.
- The two cancel out, so every photo stays perfectly upright while its card tilts around the orbit. The intro's scale and opacity tweens act on the cards, not the photos, so they don't conflict with the rotation.

### 8.5 Hero chip loop

The CSS keyframe "hero-row" runs 24 s, linear, infinite. It goes from translate(var(--tx, 0%), var(--ty, 0%)) to translate(var(--tx-end, 0%), var(--ty-end, −100%)). With two identical rows, the list scrolls up seamlessly, one row-height (100%) per cycle. At ≤991 the variables change it to a leftward horizontal scroll (see section 7). The 7rem mainbg fades soften the entry and exit.

### 8.6 Menu open and close

- **Open timeline** (paused). Tween the card to y 0 and the open width, height and padding over .4 s with ease power2.out. Then tween the groups to opacity 1, stagger .05, duration .3, starting .2 s before the first tween ends ("−=0.2").
- **Burger timeline** (paused, duration .25, ease power2.out, both bars at time 0):
  - The top bar goes from y −.2rem to y .025rem and rotate 45.
  - The bottom bar goes from y .2rem to y −.025rem and rotate −45.
  - Transform origin is centred, which forms an X.
- **Label scramble.**
  - Total frames T = 20, one frame every 20 ms. L is the longer of the old and new label lengths.
  - On frame f, character i shows the new character if i is within the new label and f/T > i/L. Otherwise it shows "•".
  - After frame 20 the text is set to the final label and the interval clears.
  - The label scrambles to "Close" on open and back to "Menu" on close.
- **Opening.** Set the open flag, add class is-open to the button, play the burger timeline, scramble to "Close", set aria-label to "Close menu" and play the open timeline.
- **Closing.**
  - Clear the flag, remove is-open, reverse the burger, scramble to "Menu" and set aria-label to "Open menu".
  - Tween the groups in reverse DOM order to opacity 0 (stagger .05, duration .2).
  - Call the open timeline's reverse with argument .3. In GSAP this jumps the playhead to 0.3 s and plays backward from there, so the close is a quick ~0.3 s collapse, not a delay.
- **Close triggers.** Clicking the button while open, clicking anywhere outside both the card and the button, pressing Escape, and clicking any menu group (so following a link closes it).
- **Resize.** While open, the card tweens to the new open size over .2 s. While closed, it snaps to the new collapsed state.

### 8.7 Hover-stagger roll (buttons and menu links)

- **Scope.** Every [hover-stagger] element. Skipped entirely under reduced motion. The hover target is the closest [hover-stagger-wrap] ancestor (the whole pill for buttons), or the element itself for menu links.
- **Setup.**
  - The element gets position relative (if unset), display inline-block (if unset) and overflow hidden, plus the 100% × 70% centred mask from section 5.
  - Its text moves into a span, and a clone of that span is placed absolutely at left 0, top 100%, directly underneath.
  - SplitType splits both spans into characters.
- **Animation.** A paused timeline (defaults: duration .2, stagger .02, ease power1.inOut) tweens the original characters and the clone characters from yPercent 0 to −100 at the same time, with opacity held at 1. The label rolls up letter by letter and the copy rolls in from below.
- **Triggers.** mouseenter calls restart. mouseleave calls reverse.

### 8.8 Scroll percentage indicator

A requestAnimationFrame loop runs forever, including under reduced motion. Each frame computes m = scrollHeight − innerHeight. The value is 0 if m ≤ 0, otherwise scrollY / m × 100 clamped to 0–100. It writes Math.round(value) + "%" into #progress. The markup holds "100%" until the first frame.

### 8.9 Theme toggle

- **Storage.** The localStorage key is "reshoot-light" and holds the string "true" or "false". The default is "true" (blush) when the key is missing or invalid.
- **apply(on).** Toggles class light on body, writes the key (in try/catch) and sets aria-pressed on every [data-theme-toggle] to the opposite of on, so pressed means night. Except during the initial apply, it dispatches a window CustomEvent "theme:changed" with detail on.
- **Clicks.** A click flips the current state.
- **Icons.** CSS shows the sun in blush and the moon in night.
- **Flash colours.** Word-flash colours are read from the body's computed --flash-a and --flash-b. The scroll-flash colours are captured when the page loads.

### 8.10 Scroll word flashes

- **Targets.** Every [data-flash] element (the How it works heading and the Photoshoots h3) and every [data-flash-stb] element (the four step headlines and four step numbers).
- **Setup.** Each is word-split. Unless reduced motion is on, its words are set to opacity 0 in --flash-a.
- **Trigger.** A ScrollTrigger on the element with start "top 90%" and once: true.
- **Animation.** Words staggered .1 apart, three keyframes each:
  1. opacity 1 in --flash-a over .2 with ease power2.out.
  2. Colour to --flash-b over .05.
  3. Colour to the final ink over .1. The final ink is var(--ink) (#3a1d43) for data-flash-stb, otherwise var(--fonts-100).

### 8.11 Word-split helper

A TreeWalker collects every text node inside the element. Each node is split on whitespace runs, keeping the whitespace as plain text nodes. Each non-blank piece is wrapped in a span with the given class (flash-word or hero-flash-word). Its data-final-opacity is .5 if the text node's parent is inside a .u-fonts-50 element, otherwise 1. Nested markup such as the italic spans and line breaks is preserved, because only text nodes are replaced.

### 8.12 How it works column crawl and brightness

- **Crawl.** CSS keyframe "columnanima": translateY 0% to −100% over 24 s, linear, infinite, on both duplicated columns. The phrase list rises endlessly inside the masked 34rem window.
- **Brightness loop.** A requestAnimationFrame loop with fadeFinish = .15. Each frame, for each of the six phrases, it measures the phrase relative to the window:
  - top = phrase top − window top, bottom = top + phrase height, H = window height.
  - Default opacity is .2.
  - If the phrase is at least partly visible (bottom > 0 and top < H):
    - n = clamp(1 − bottom / H, 0, 1)
    - p = clamp(n / (1 − .15), 0, 1)
    - opacity = .2 + .8 × p
- **Effect.** Phrases near the bottom of the window sit at .2. They brighten linearly as they rise and reach full opacity once their bottom edge is in the top 15% of the window. The mask then fades them out at the very top.

### 8.13 Trusted-by marquee

The CSS keyframe "marquee" runs translateX 0% to −100% over 24 s, linear, infinite, on both duplicated rows. This gives a seamless leftward loop. Each row's padding-right equals the gap, so the seam stays even. The 6.5rem side fades blend the tiles into the page.

### 8.14 Step slides: pinned 3D stack

This applies to every slide except the last, and is skipped under reduced motion.

- **Tween 1: tip back and shrink.** Tween the content card to:
  - rotationZ = (Math.random() − .5) × 10, a random tilt between −5° and +5°, chosen once per page load
  - scale .7
  - rotationX 40
  - ease power1.in

  Its ScrollTrigger pins the slide's content wrap (the element carrying perspective 250vw), with the slide as trigger, start "top 0%", end "+=" + innerHeight (one viewport of scroll) and scrub true. Pin spacing uses GSAP defaults.
- **Tween 2: fade.** Tween the same card to autoAlpha 0 with ease power1.in. Its ScrollTrigger has the card as trigger, start "top −80%", end "+=" + 0.5 × innerHeight and scrub true.
- **Effect.** As you scroll past a slide, it holds in place while it tips backward away from you, shrinks and twists slightly, then fades out across the last stretch of the pin. The next pastel slide scrolls up to replace it. The fourth slide is never transformed.
- Inside step 02, the "Generating…" chip icon ticks constantly via spinStep.

---

## 9. Reduced motion (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)

- **Preloader.** The inline head script removes is-loading at once. The CSS media query sets the preloader to display none. The preloader JS also hides it, removes is-loading and returns early: no scroll lock, no counter, no localStorage write.
- **CSS animations.** These are set to none with !important: the hero chip rows, the How it works columns, the marquee rows, the preloader spinner and the step chip spinner.
- **Ring.** The cards are placed at their angles with upright photos but don't rotate.
- **Hero intro.** Not run, and the hidden starting states are never applied, so the header, hero text, ring cards and chips are visible right away.
- **Scroll flashes.** Words are still split into spans but never hidden or animated.
- **Hover-stagger.** Not set up at all, so links and buttons keep plain text.
- **Step pin and 3D stack.** Not created. The four slides scroll normally as 100vh panels.
- **Still active:**
  - The menu open/close timeline, burger and scramble (not gated)
  - The theme toggle
  - The percentage readout
  - The How it works brightness loop, which keeps applying position-based opacities to the now-static column
  - The ResizeObserver photo cropping

---

## 10. Acceptance checklist

- [ ] One index.html with inline CSS and JS. GSAP 3.12.5, ScrollTrigger 3.12.5 and SplitType 0.3.4 load from the exact CDN URLs in section 4. The only local files are assets/fonts/inter-var.woff2 and assets/fonts/instrument-serif-italic.woff2, downloaded from the two Google Fonts URLs.
- [ ] The root font-size uses all five rules with the exact coefficients, so 1rem = 16px at 1728px wide. The type-scale variables and their ≤991 and ≤767 overrides match.
- [ ] body starts with "body light". Blush is the default, night tokens are exactly as tabled, and the toggle persists "reshoot-light" as "true" or "false".
- [ ] All ten sheets load through images.higgs.ai with the exact encoded URLs and w values from section 2.2. No cloudfront URL is used directly as a background.
- [ ] Every .ph tile crops with the 8px inset, the cover scale k = max(ew/w, eh/h), the focal fx and fy (default .5) and a shared ResizeObserver. The data-fy overrides are .3, .35, .2 and .3 where listed. No white gutter shows in any tile.
- [ ] Every data-img key sits where section 2.5 says, including the preloader's DOM order pre:3, pre:0, pre:2, pre:1 and the ring's angle-to-key mapping.
- [ ] The preloader runs: blur in (1 s), stepped counter 0→100 in six power2.out segments starting at .5 s, 0.5 s photo hard-cuts, blur out at 3.6 s, overlay fade at 4.7 s, then "preloader:done". Returning visitors run at 1/5 speed with "Synced". The 8 s failsafe exists.
- [ ] The hero ring has eight cards at 45° steps on radius --R = min(22vw, 35svh). Cards are .37R × .44R with radius .12R, and photos are .52R and upright. The ring spins 360° per 32 s while the photos counter-rotate. The headline is R × .172 and sits inside the ring.
- [ ] Hero words flash violet → pink → ink at .2 s stagger. The header pops in with y 24 and scale .9 at .1, .2 and .35. Ring cards scale from .5 with .12 stagger from .3. Chips slide from x 40 with .12 stagger from .35.
- [ ] Hero chips loop vertically over 24 s on desktop and horizontally at ≤991.
- [ ] The header pill shows Menu, the theme toggle and a live rounded scroll percentage. The menu grows from 15rem × 2.7rem to 18rem × 39rem over .4 s. The label scrambles with "•" over 20 frames of 20 ms, and the burger rotates to ±45°. The menu closes on outside click, Escape and link click.
- [ ] Buttons and menu links roll their characters up (−100% yPercent, .2 s, .02 stagger, power1.inOut) on hover and reverse on leave.
- [ ] How it works: the heading flashes at "top 90%" once. The three-phrase column crawls up over 24 s inside a 12/88 mask, and phrase opacity follows the .2 + .8p formula with fadeFinish .15. The ten-tile wordmark marquee runs left over 24 s with edge fades.
- [ ] The Photoshoots panel is full-bleed, 70rem tall with 3rem radius. It has the tag, the heading (flashes) and body copy, the base:0 card, the arrow and the dark dashboard: "Generated photos", "Lunelle Serum · 10 of 24", "✦ Generate more", five columns of 3:4 cells with check badges, and cells 1, 4 and 7 selected. The dashboard bleeds off the right edge, and the white spark button sits bottom-right. Below 991px the alternate collage shows instead.
- [ ] Four 100vh step slides with the exact gradients, headlines, numbers, bullets, captions and chips. Slides 1 to 3 pin for one viewport and tween to rotationX 40, scale .7 and a random ±5° Z rotation with power1.in. They fade with autoAlpha from "top −80%" over half a viewport.
- [ ] The mobile layout matches section 7: logo-only header, right-aligned menu with a Get started button, smaller ring, two-column card grid with the fourth card hidden, and so on.
- [ ] Reduced motion matches section 9 exactly.
- [ ] No real brand names appear anywhere. "Reshoot", "Lunelle" and every wordmark are invented.

title: Crystal Koi
description: Single-file, five-section landing page called Nectarline ("Supply Side Studio®"), a fictional self-serve programmatic-media curation product. The page sits on top of a fixed, full-viewport scene: a looping dusk lotus-pond video in the hero (drawn through a WebGL hover-ripple lens), which crossfades to a deep violet gradient for the middle sections and to a night version of the pond behind the footer. Features interactive cursor/mouse tracking and scrub-driven interaction, hardware-accelerated WebGL / Three.js 3D rendering with precision layout polish.
full_prompt:
# Nectarline — exact recreation prompt

Build a single-file, five-section landing page called **Nectarline** ("Supply Side Studio®"), a fictional self-serve programmatic-media curation product. The page sits on top of a fixed, full-viewport scene: a looping dusk lotus-pond video in the hero (drawn through a WebGL hover-ripple lens), which crossfades to a deep violet gradient for the middle sections and to a night version of the pond behind the footer. A 3D crystal-glass koi fish (a real GLB model rendered with Three.js) swims through every section, its position, size and heading driven by scroll, and its body bending in a swimming wave. All UI is ordinary HTML laid over that scene. Recreate it exactly as specified below: every text, colour, size, position, timing and formula is the real one.

Everything is one HTML file: inline CSS, two inline scripts (one classic, one ES module), Three.js from a CDN import map. No build step, no framework.

---

## 1. Media and asset URLs (use these exact links, do not re-host)

| Asset | URL | How it is used |
|---|---|---|
| Day plate (dusk lotus pond, still) | https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261104_151305_25ef1f45-0886-491c-a7a8-81e296402d5a.png&w=2400&q=85 | CSS background-image of the hero scene layer, cover, centred. Visible until the video has a frame, and on its own under reduced motion. |
| Pond loop video (Kling 3.0, 5.04 s, 1276×720, 24 fps, no audio, first frame = last frame) | https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261104_160514_d8369d6e-d8ba-4532-9751-b32e0c8aaf75.mp4 | A muted, looping, playsinline, preload auto, crossorigin anonymous video. It is never shown directly: its frames are uploaded every animation frame as a WebGL texture and drawn through the ripple lens shader (section 9). The host sends Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *, which WebGL needs. |
| Night plate (same pond at night, stars, dim glowing lotuses) | https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261104_151304_3b7ab857-b4c2-4f5a-8d7f-e1ec429185a5.png&w=2400&q=85 | CSS background-image of the third scene layer, cover, centred; fades in behind the call-to-action and footer. |
| Koi 3D model (Tripo H3.1 image-to-3D, about 6.2 MB GLB, one mesh, about 17.5k vertices, base-colour texture) | https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261104_151843_47d87652-1c40-465c-b0d6-cd94c22a9d3e.glb | Loaded with Three.js GLTFLoader. CORS is open on this host. |
| Three.js 0.170.0 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js and the addons folder https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/ | Import map: "three" points at the module file, "three/addons/" at the addons folder. Use GLTFLoader (three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js) and RoomEnvironment (three/addons/environments/RoomEnvironment.js). |

There are no other images. Every icon, chart, badge, logo orb and decoration is inline SVG or CSS.

## 2. Fonts

| Family | Role | Weights used | File (latin subset, woff2) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Inter Tight | All UI and headlines (a free stand-in for Neue Haas Display) | variable 100–900; used at 300, 400, 500, 600 | https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/intertight/v9/NGSwv5HMAFg6IuGlBNMjxLsH8ag.woff2 |
| Instrument Serif, italic | Single accent words inside headlines | 400 italic only | https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/instrumentserif/v5/jizHRFtNs2ka5fXjeivQ4LroWlx-6zAjjH7M.woff2 |
| Fira Code | Labels, tags, numbers in tables, the typed bid request | 400 | https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/firacode/v27/uU9eCBsR6Z2vfE9aq3bL0fxyUs4tcw4W_D1sJVD7Ng.woff2 |

Declare three @font-face rules with font-display swap: "Inter Tight" with font-weight range 100 900; "Instrument Serif" with font-style italic; "Fira Code". In the single-file deliverable the three files are embedded as base64 data URIs. Equivalently, the Google Fonts stylesheet for Inter Tight 300–600, Instrument Serif italic and Fira Code 400 gives the same faces. Font stacks: sans = "Inter Tight", system-ui, sans-serif; serif = "Instrument Serif", Georgia, serif; mono = "Fira Code", ui-monospace, monospace. Body text uses -webkit-font-smoothing antialiased.

## 3. Head, colour tokens and base

Title: "Nectarline — Supply Side Studio". Meta description: "The leading independent self-serve studio for curating programmatic supply." Viewport meta width=device-width, initial-scale=1. The html element starts with the class "anim" (entrance guard, section 10).

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| ink | #f4f2ff | primary text |
| ink-2 | rgba(236,232,255,.72) | body copy, secondary text |
| ink-3 | rgba(220,214,255,.5) | captions, tags, table headers |
| peri | #6f78ff | primary button, accent fills |
| peri-2 | #8d94ff | accent text, hover of primary button, step numbers |
| navy (page background) | #0d0830 | html and body background |
| line | rgba(196,178,255,.15) | hairlines and dividers |
| glass-hi (role card hover) | linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(120,100,255,.2), rgba(70,50,170,.14)) | |

Reset: every element box-sizing border-box, margin 0, padding 0. Links inherit colour, no underline. Buttons inherit font and colour, no border, transparent background, pointer cursor. Body overflow-x hidden.

## 4. Scaling system

One design unit, u, is derived from a 1440 px wide frame: u = content width / 1440 on screens wider than 820 px, and content width / 390 at 820 px and below. Use the document's clientWidth (which excludes the scrollbar), set by script as the CSS custom property --u in px on load and on resize (the stylesheet fallback is 100vw/1440, or 100vw/390 in the small-screen query). Every desktop measurement below is in u; "40u" means calc(40 × var(--u)). On phones most rules switch to fixed px values (section 12).

## 5. The fixed scene stack (behind everything)

A fixed full-viewport container, z-index 0, pointer-events none, overflow hidden, aria-hidden. It holds four layers, each absolutely filling it, in this order (back to front):

1. **Day plate**: background-image = day plate, cover, centred; will-change opacity and transform. Inside it: the pond video (absolute, 100%×100%, object-fit cover, opacity 0, transition opacity 1.2 s ease; it only becomes visible if WebGL is unavailable, by gaining a class that sets opacity 1), then the ripple canvas "pondfx" (absolute, 100%×100%, block, opacity 0, transition opacity 1.2 s ease; it gets opacity 1 on the video's first "playing" event).
2. **Violet layer**: background linear-gradient(180deg, #160c40 0%, #0f0832 50%, #0b0626 100%), opacity 0. It is a flat gradient with no radial glows or blobs.
3. **Night plate**: background-image = night plate, cover, centred, opacity 0. A ::after overlay darkens it for footer legibility: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(13,8,40,.15) 0%, transparent 30%, rgba(13,8,40,.6) 58%, rgba(11,6,34,.94) 100%).
4. **Koi canvas**: a full-viewport transparent WebGL canvas (Three.js renderer, alpha true, antialias true).

Main content is position relative, z-index 1, above the scene.

**Scroll crossfade** (runs on scroll and resize; h = viewport height, y = scrollY, smoothstep(a,b,v) = t²(3−2t) with t = clamp((v−a)/(b−a))):
- toViolet = smoothstep(0.15h, 1.05h, y).
- Day plate opacity = 1 − toViolet; its transform = scale(1 + 0.08·toViolet) translateY(−0.06·y px) (a slow push-in and parallax as you leave the hero).
- toNight = smoothstep(endTop − 1.1h, endTop − 0.1h, y), where endTop is the CTA/footer section's offsetTop.
- Violet layer opacity = toViolet × (1 − toNight). Night plate opacity = toNight.
- The nav gets the class "scrolled" when y > 0.5h.
- The pond video plays while toViolet < 0.999 and is paused otherwise (no decoding when it can't be seen).

## 6. Navigation (fixed, z-index 20)

Fixed bar: top 24u, left 36u, right 32u, height 52u, flex, items centred, space-between, font-size 16u.
- **Logo** (link to #top): flex, gap 14u, weight 600, 23u, letter-spacing −0.01em. The orb before the word is a 34u circle: radial-gradient(circle at 32% 30%, #fff 0 8%, #cdb8ff 22%, #8a6cff 52%, #4b3bd6 78%), box-shadow 0 0 18u rgba(160,140,255,.55) plus an inset −4u −5u 10u rgba(40,20,140,.5). Text: "Nectarline".
- **Centre menu**: absolutely centred (left 50%, translateX(−50%)), flex, gap 4u, padding 5u, radius 12u, background rgba(120,124,220,.28), 1 px border rgba(200,200,255,.22), backdrop-filter blur(14px) saturate(1.3). Items: "Product", "Channels", "Resources" (each followed by a 10u chevron: a 10×10 viewBox path M2 3.5 l3 3 3−3, stroke currentColor 1.4, opacity .8) and "Customer Stories" (no chevron). Item: flex, gap 7u, padding 10u 14u, radius 8u, weight 500, background transition .25 s; hover background rgba(255,255,255,.12). When the nav has "scrolled", the menu background becomes rgba(14,16,60,.55).
- **Right group**: flex, gap 10u. "Login" (weight 500, padding 0 14u). Pill "Book a Call": grey glass (background rgba(120,124,200,.42), border rgba(210,210,255,.2), blur 10px). Pill "Get Started — it's Free": dark (#141a4d, border rgba(160,160,255,.18); hover #1c2363). Pills: inline-flex, height 46u, padding 0 17u, radius 10u, weight 500, nowrap; transitions .25 s; hover translateY(−1px).

## 7. Shared components

- **Button**: inline-flex, centred, height 49u, padding 0 18u, radius 11u, 16u, weight 500, nowrap, transition transform .25 s, box-shadow .3 s, background .3 s; hover translateY(−2px).
  - fill: background #6f78ff, shadow 0 8u 26u rgba(90,96,255,.35); hover background #8d94ff, shadow 0 10u 34u rgba(110,116,255,.5).
  - ghost: 1 px border rgba(230,226,255,.42), background rgba(255,255,255,.03); hover rgba(255,255,255,.1).
  - white: #fff with text #14163f. dk: #11143f with a 1 px border rgba(160,160,255,.2).
- **Accent text**: colour #8d94ff. **Serif accent**: Instrument Serif italic 400, letter-spacing 0.
- **Lede**: 18u, line-height 1.55, ink-2, letter-spacing −0.005em.
- **Glass surface** (cards, as on the original): background linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(110,90,240,.14), rgba(60,40,150,.08)); 1 px border rgba(205,190,255,.16); box-shadow inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.08) and 0 24u 60u rgba(8,3,30,.28); backdrop-filter blur(22px) saturate(1.35). The koi shows softly frosted through these cards; that is intended.
- **Chip**: inline-flex, gap 6u, height 24u, padding 0 9u, radius 6u, Fira Code 11u, letter-spacing .02em, ink-2, background rgba(170,150,255,.1), border rgba(190,170,255,.12). Variant "up": text #7cf0bd, background rgba(80,220,160,.1), border rgba(80,220,160,.18). Variant "live": a 6u dot before the text, #5ee6a8 with a 0 0 8u #5ee6a8 glow, pulsing opacity to .35 at 50% over 2 s ease-in-out, infinite.
- **Text link with arrow**: inline-flex, gap 10u, 16u, weight 500; the 16u arrow (path M2 8 h11 M9 4 l4 4 −4 4, stroke 1.5) moves right 4u on hover over .3 s.
- **Icons**: bare line icons, no tile, no background, no border: a 24u box, opacity .85, holding a 22u-wide white SVG with stroke-width 1.3.
- **Scroll reveal**: elements marked "reveal" start at opacity 0 and translateY(36u), with transition on opacity and transform of 1 s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1). An IntersectionObserver (threshold .15) adds the class "in" (opacity 1, no transform) once and then stops watching that element.

## 8. Sections, top to bottom (desktop measurements)

### 8.1 Hero (id hero), height 100vh, min-height 900u, position relative

All children absolutely positioned on the 1440×900 frame:
- **Headline** at left 67u, top 526u: weight 300, 74u, line-height 68u, letter-spacing −0.025em, two lines "Introducing" and "Nectarline". Each line is a block wrapper with overflow hidden and padding-bottom 6u, holding a block span (the span slides up inside its mask on entrance).
- **Subline** at left 67u, top 684u: "Supply Side Studio" followed by a superscript ® at 0.55em; 20u, ink-2, letter-spacing −0.005em.
- **Buttons** at left 67u, top 742u, flex, gap 11u: fill "Get Started — it's Free" and ghost "Book a Call".
- **Scroll card** (a button) at left 1202u, top 703u, 193u × 152u, radius 10u, padding 16u 17u, background linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(120,128,255,.72), rgba(98,104,240,.62)), border rgba(210,210,255,.3), blur 16px, 27u, line-height 1.18, letter-spacing −0.01em, column flex with space-between. Text: "Scroll down" / "& discover". Bottom-right: a 22u white down-arrow (M11 3 v15 M5 12 l6 6 6 −6, stroke 1.6) that bobs 5u down and back over 2.2 s ease-in-out, infinite. Hover lifts the card 4u (.35 s). Clicking smooth-scrolls to the Studio section.

### 8.2 Studio (id studio), centred, padding 300u 64u 150u

- **Headline** (reveal): weight 300, 52u, line-height 1.1, letter-spacing −0.028em, max-width 1240u, margin 22u auto 0. Text: "The leading independent " + accent "self-serve curation studio" + line break + "for all programmatic media buyers."
- **Lede** (reveal), max-width 600u, margin-top 22u: "Shape supply before you bid. Package, forecast and launch private deals from one calm workspace."
- **Buttons** (reveal), centred, gap 10u, margin-top 34u: fill "Get started — it's free", ghost "Book a Call".
- **Stats row** (reveal): a 4-column grid, max-width 1060u, margin 72u auto 0, hairline top and bottom borders (line colour), vertical hairlines between cells. Each cell has padding 24u 20u and is left-aligned; the number is weight 300, 40u, letter-spacing −0.03em, line-height 1; the caption is 14u, ink-3, line-height 1.4, margin-top 10u. Cells: "2.4B" / "bid requests shaped" ↵ "every day"; "48s" / "median time from brief" ↵ "to live deal ID"; "120+" / "supply partners" ↵ "in one workspace"; "0%" / "buy-side markup" ↵ "on curated media". These figures are placeholder copy for the fictional brand.
- **Product dashboard** (reveal, id dash): max-width 1220u, margin 80u auto 0, radius 16u, background linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(30,20,78,.86), rgba(20,13,56,.9)), border in the line colour, box-shadow 0 50u 140u rgba(6,2,30,.7), a 7u ring rgba(150,120,255,.05), an inset top highlight rgba(255,255,255,.06); overflow hidden; 13u base text. A 1 px highlight line runs along the top edge from 10% to 90%: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(200,180,255,.7), transparent).
  - **Top bar**: height 54u, padding 0 18u, flex, gap 16u, hairline bottom border rgba(190,170,255,.09). ## 9. Hero hover lens (WebGL, matches the original's post effect)

The pond is drawn into the "pondfx" canvas with WebGL 1. If WebGL is unavailable, or the program fails to link, show the plain video instead.
- Canvas backing size = viewport × min(devicePixelRatio, 1.5), updated on resize.
- One full-screen quad (two triangles over −1..1); vUv = position·0.5 + 0.5.
- Texture: the video element, re-uploaded every frame (RGB, unsigned byte, flip-Y on, clamp to edge, linear filtering).
- Cover fit: A = canvas aspect, V = video aspect (1276/720). If A > V then scale = (1, V/A), else scale = (A/V, 1). Multiply the scale by z = 0.975 (a slight zoom that leaves room for the tilt). Sampling: texture2D(tex, (uv − 0.5)·scale + 0.5 + tilt).
- Fragment shader, exactly the original's ripple: dist = distance(vUv, mouse); ripple = sin(dist·20 − time·5)·0.006; strength = smoothstep(0.2, 0.0, dist)·presence; offset = normalize(vUv − mouse + 1e−5)·ripple·strength. Red is sampled at vUv + offset + (0.005, 0)·strength, green at vUv + offset, blue at vUv + offset − (0.005, 0)·strength. Output alpha is 1. This gives a circular ripple of about a fifth of the screen around the cursor, with a red/blue colour split at its edge.
- time = seconds since the effect started. mouse = the pointer in uv (x/width, 1 − y/height). presence eases toward 1 while the pointer is in the window and toward 0 when it leaves, with rate k = 1 − e^(−6·dt). The mouse uniform keeps its last value while presence fades.
- Tilt: target tx, ty = pointer mapped to −1..1 (u·2 − 1, v·2 − 1; 0 when the pointer leaves), eased with k = 1 − e^(−dt/0.1) (settles in about 0.3 s, like the original's 0.3 s easing). The tilt uniform = (tx·0.009·scale.x, ty·0.009·scale.y), about 1° at this field of view.
- The loop runs on requestAnimationFrame but only draws when the video is ready (has played once), not paused and has data (readyState ≥ 2). dt is capped at 0.05 s.
- Pointer state is shared by both scripts: one window pointermove listener sets u, v, tx, ty and inside = true; a pointerleave listener on the document element sets inside = false and tx = ty = 0.

## 11. The 3D koi (Three.js module)

- **Renderer**: on the koi canvas, alpha true, antialias true, high-performance power preference, pixel ratio min(devicePixelRatio, 2), sRGB output, ACES filmic tone mapping at exposure 0.95. The size follows the window.
- **Scene lighting**: environment = PMREM of RoomEnvironment (sigma 0.04); hemisphere light 0xc6b2ff / 0x2a1c80 at 0.7; key directional light 0xffc8f0 at 1.6 from (3, 5, 6); rim directional light 0x8c7bff at 2.8 from (−5, −1, −4). There is no glow sprite and no halo: the fish is drawn alone.
- **Camera**: perspective, 30° vertical field of view, near 0.1, far 100, at (0, 0, 10) looking down −Z. Visible frustum at z = 0: height fh = 2·tan(15°)·10, width fw = fh·aspect.
- **Model normalisation** (bake every mesh's world transform into its geometry first): take the bounding box; the longest axis is the fish's length. If it is Z, rotate +90° about Y; if Y, rotate −90° about Z. Then rotate 180° about Y so the nose points to +X (this Tripo model faces −X otherwise). Translate the box centre to the origin and scale uniformly so the length is 1. Recompute normals.
- **Material** (replaces the model's own; keeps its base-colour texture as both map and emissive map): MeshPhysicalMaterial with colour 0xc9b4ff (0xb8a4ff if there is no texture), roughness 0.18, metalness 0.15, clearcoat 1, clearcoat roughness 0.1, iridescence 0.85, iridescence IOR 1.4, thickness range 260–700, emissive 0x7a46ff at intensity 0.55, sheen 0.25 with sheen colour 0xff9ce6, transparent at opacity 0.95, environment intensity 0.75, double-sided. This gives a lilac-pink crystal look that stays bright against the dark violet background.
- **Swim deformation** (injected into the vertex shader in place of the begin_vertex chunk, using model-space position with the head at +X): tail = clamp((0.32 − x)/0.82, 0, 1); z += sin(x·freq − time·speed)·amp·(0.15 + 1.6·tail²); y += cos(x·freq·0.5 − time·speed·0.5)·amp·0.12·tail. Defaults: freq 5.2, speed 6.5, amp 0.075.
- **Swim speed follows scroll**: track scroll velocity vel (pixels per second, smoothed: vel += (instant − vel)·0.1). speedUp = min(|vel|/1800, 1.4). The shader time advances by dt·(1 + speedUp) each frame, and amp = 0.07 + 0.03·speedUp.
- **Scene graph**: rig (position and heading) → body (uniform scale) → mesh.
- **Scroll choreography**: one pose per section. x and y are in half-viewport units (−1..1, x to the right, y up), s is the fish length as a share of viewport height, and yaw, pitch and roll are in radians (yaw about Y, where 0 faces right; pitch about Z, where negative is nose down; roll about X).

| Pose | Scroll position where it applies (h = viewport height) | x | y | s | yaw | pitch | roll |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| hero | 0 | 0.02 | 0.16 | 0.72 | 0.18 | −0.92 | 0.05 |
| statement | Studio section top + 0.2h | −0.66 | −0.6 | 0.42 | 0.5 | 0.2 | −0.1 |
| dash | dashboard top + half its height − 0.5h | 0.5 | −0.5 | 0.46 | −0.35 | 0.32 | 0.1 |
| packs | Packages section top + 0.3h | 0.4 | −0.78 | 0.5 | 0.55 | −0.05 | 0.08 |
| uses | Use-cases section top + 0.3h | −0.42 | −0.42 | 0.6 | 3.0 (turned to face left) | 0.12 | −0.06 |
| end | min(CTA/footer section top, maximum scroll) | −0.7 | 0.56 | 0.48 | 0.3 | −0.14 | 0.05 |

  Section tops are page-absolute (bounding rect top + scrollY), recomputed on load and resize. Between two neighbouring poses, interpolate every value with easeInOutCubic of the scroll progress between their positions (4t³ below 0.5, otherwise 1 − (−2t + 2)³/2). Before the first pose use the first; after the last, the last.
- **Per frame** (dt capped at 0.05 s, t = elapsed seconds): ease the current pose toward the target with k = 1 − e^(−3.2·dt) (k = 1 under reduced motion). Idle bob: y += sin(0.9t)·0.018. Position = (x·fw/2, (y + bob)·fh/2, 0). Rotation (XYZ order) = (roll + sin(0.7t)·0.04, yaw + sin(0.5t)·0.06, pitch). Scale = s·fh.
- **Pointer tilt** (the original's TILT camera control): camera.rotation.y eases toward −tx·0.01745 and camera.rotation.x toward ty·0.01745 (1° maximum) with k = 1 − e^(−dt/0.1).
- **Phone poses** (≤ 820 px wide) override only x, y and s: hero (0.12, 0.38, 0.46), statement (0.42, −0.72, 0.3), dash (−0.35, −0.74, 0.3), packs (0.38, −0.74, 0.3), uses (−0.3, −0.76, 0.32), end (0.3, −0.74, 0.32).

## HLS.js Video Implementation
```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import Hls from "hls.js";

const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
const videoSrc = "https://stream.mux.com/T6oQJQ02cQ6N01TR6iHwZkKFkbepS34dkkIc9iukgy400g.m3u8";

useEffect(() => {
  const video = videoRef.current;
  if (!video) return;

  if (Hls.isSupported()) {
    const hls = new Hls();
    hls.loadSource(videoSrc);
    hls.attachMedia(video);
    hls.on(Hls.Events.MANIFEST_PARSED, () => {
      video.play().catch((e) => console.log("Auto-play prevented:", e));
    });
    return () => {
      hls.destroy();
    };
  } else if (video.canPlayType("application/vnd.apple.mpegurl")) {
    video.src = videoSrc;
    video.addEventListener("loadedmetadata", () => {
      video.play().catch((e) => console.log("Auto-play prevented:", e));
    });
  }
}, []);
```

4 sections separated by horizontal dividers:

Add-ons (checkboxes): Two checkboxes with price labels on the right in #FF5656:

"I want to optimize my website for SEO" → +$50/pages Custom checkboxes: w-5 h-5 border-2 rounded, checked = border-[#FF5656] bg-[#FF5656] with white SVG checkmark.

Timeline (radio buttons): h3 "How fast do you need this?" — 3 options with prices:

"Within 7 Days" → +$100/pages

"Within 14 Days" → +$25/pages

"Regular Speed (Based on discussion)" → no extra cost (default)

RIGHT COLUMN (Cost Estimation): Padding p-8 lg:p-12, border border-white/10 rounded-r-2xl, min-height 717.98px.

h3 "Estimated Cost" + description paragraph.

3 stacked cards (rounded-2xl p-6 space-y-3):

Agency card: bg-muted/50. Title "Typical Agency charges minimum". Large price text-4xl font-bold. Subtitle: "+ Too much extra time & additional cost".

Freelancer card: bg-muted/50. Title "Regular Freelancer charges minimum". Large price text-4xl font-bold. Subtitle: "+ Too much headache & back-and-forth".

Your price card: bg-gradient-to-r from-pink-500 to-orange-500 text-white. Title "With Webfluin Studio". Price text-5xl font-bold. Subtitle: "Save your money, time & headache".

PRICING LOGIC:

calculatePrice():
  Base prices by service:
    design: base=399, perPage=100
    development: base=199, perPage=100
    both: base=499, perPage=200
  
  total = max(base, base + (pages - 1) * perPage)
  if needContent: total += pages * 50
  if needSEO: total += pages * 50
  if rush: total += pages * 100
  if fast: total += pages * 25

calculateAgencyCost():
  perPage = (both ? 1000 : 400)
  return 8000 + (pages - 1) * perPage

calculateFreelancerCost():
  perPage = (both ? 500 : 200)
  return 3000 + (pages - 1) * perPage

All prices displayed with .toLocaleString() and $ prefix.

State: serviceType (design|development|both, default both), pages (number, default 5), needContent (bool), needSEO (bool), timeline (regular|fast|rush, default regular).

Dependencies: Shadcn Slider component, useToast hook.

```css
@keyframes fade-up {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px); filter: blur(6px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); filter: blur(0); }
}

@keyframes fade-down {

Build one standalone HTML document that is the entire Vexel hero screen. Output only that file. Reproduce the markup, CSS, SVG paths, type, motion, and responsive rules exactly. Do not restyle, simplify, rename classes, or substitute a different background.

Page
- Language English. Title: Vexel — Your next customer starts with a hello.
- Viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover. Theme color #01061a.
- One screen, no page scroll. Column, centered. Background #01061a with a horizontal sky gradient: #00061a 0%, #01071b 22%, #01071a 45%, #010718 62%, #010614 80%, #020511 100%.

Type
- Font family "Google Sans", then "Product Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif.
- Embed Google Sans with font-display:block:
  weight 400 from assets/google-sans-400.woff2
  weight 500 from assets/google-sans-500.woff2
- Antialiased, geometricPrecision, normal kerning.

Scale
- Reference frame is 1280×800. Every layout number is multiplied by --u. At 1280×800, --u is 1px.
- Default: --u = min(100dvh/800, max(100vw/1280, min(100vw/640, .75px))). Fall back to vh where dvh is unsupported.
- Colors: ink #ffffff; nav rgba(238,242,255,.9); subhead rgba(226,233,255,.74); link rgba(212,236,255,.77); hairline rgba(255,255,255,.19); button #ffffff with ink #0a0a0a.

Masthead, centered
- Wordmark link, aria-label "Vexel home", href "#". White filled SVG, viewBox "588 40.5 103.5 23.5", height max(23.5u, 17px), shifted left by 0.5u. Paths, in order:
  M588.6 40.8H594.9L601.4 56.6L606.5 40.8H612.6L604.2 63.5H597.8Z
  M612.8 40.8H630.5V45.2H619.2V49.8H628.3V54.4H619.2V58.9H631.5V63.5H612.8Z
  M631.3 40.8H637.9L642.5 47.4L646.5 40.8H653.1L646.4 52L653.6 63.5H647.1L642.5 56.4L638.3 63.5H631.4L638.8 52Z
  M653.6 40.8H669.6V63.5H653.6V58.9H664.3V54.4H657V49.8H664.3V45.2H653.6Z
  M672.4 40.8H677.6V58.9H690.5V63.5H672.4Z
- Top padding: safe-area-inset-top plus 40.5u.
- Hairline under the logo: width max(284u, 252px), 1px, margin-top 24u.
- Nav width matches the hairline. Three links, space-between, margin-top 17.4u, side padding 8.9u: Platform #platform, Company #company, Contact #contact. Size max(15u, 13px), tracking -0.033em, color the nav token, hover #fff.

Copy, centered
- A flexible gap above the copy flexes at 82.98 and never shorter than 24u.
- Headline, weight 400, size max(68u, 34px), line-height 0.9559, tracking -0.0279em, nowrap. Two masked lines:
  line 1: Your next customer
  line 2: starts with a hello.
  Line 2 tracking -0.0294em and shifted right 2.6u. Each line is a span.l containing a span.li.
- Subhead: "Make the first move. We’ll help with what follows." Join the words inside each sentence with U+00A0 no-break spaces. The only normal space is the space after the period, so that is the only wrap point. Size max(21u, 15px), tracking -0.005em, margin-top 18.98u, color the subhead token, text-wrap balance.
- Button "Start a conversation" to #contact. Width max(216u, 196px), height max(46u, 44px), radius max(4.5u, 4px), weight 500, size max(17u, 15px), tracking -0.0265em, margin-top 25.64u. Hover fill #e8eef7 and a 4u ring of rgba(120,200,255,.12).
- Link "Discover the platform" to #platform, size max(14.8u, 13px), tracking -0.051em, margin-top 20.55u. Beside it, a 0.68em by 0.85em stroke arrow, viewBox "0 0 11 12.6", stroke 1.45, round caps: M5.5 .4V12M1 7.5L5.5 12L10 7.5. On hover the arrow moves down 0.12em.

Background video
- Use this URL and no other asset. Do not download it and do not replace it with a local file or poster image:
  https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261005_182549_18378239-da8f-48a7-9666-d6e0a6a88561.mp4
- Video element: autoplay, muted, loop, playsinline, no controls, decorative.
- The field fills the remaining height (flex 318.68, min-height 160u) and is a size container. The video is absolutely centered, width auto, pointer-events none. Its horizon, 50.463% down the frame, sits 36.4u above the bottom of the copy. Height is the larger of fitting the field width at the artwork ratio 1619:971 and reaching the bottom edge: max(100cqw * 971/1619, (100cqh + 36.4u) / 0.49537 + 1px). Without container units, fall back to max(60vw, 105vh). Fade the top 4% of the video to transparent with a mask.

Focus
- Remove the default outline. Visible focus on the wordmark, nav links, and discover link is a 2px #7fd4ff outline offset 4px. The button uses offset 3px.

Responsive
- Tablet, 600px to 1099.98px wide and at least 541px tall: hold --u at min(100dvh/800, 1px, max(100vw/1280, 100dvh/1190, .86px)). Cap the video field at 48% of the screen height. Enlarge tap targets with negative margin so nothing moves: nav links 14px 8px, discover link 12px 10px.
- Portrait under 600px: same scale model, but use svh. Keep the two headline lines nowrap. Headline size is max(26px, min(68u, (100vw - 48px) / 8.235)). Subhead floor 16px, size min(21u, 3.345vw), line-height 1.25, overflow-wrap break-word. Hero side padding 24px. Hairline and nav width min(max(284u, 252px), 100vw - 32px). Field max-height 48%. Same enlarged tap targets.
- Landscape shorter than 540px: keep the desktop proportions and lower the floors — logo 13px, hairline and nav 210px, nav 11px, headline 28px, subhead 12px, button 150×34px at 12.5px, discover 11px, gap min 14u, field min 120u.
- Coarse pointer in that short landscape: grow tap targets only.
- At 359px and below, outside the portrait block, allow the headline to wrap at 30px.
- prefers-reduced-motion: no transitions, and do not run the entrance.

Entrance, once per load, only if Web Animations and matchMedia exist and reduced motion is off
- Add class "intro" immediately. If the entrance has not started within 3500ms, remove it.
- While intro is on: wordmark, nav items, subhead, button, and discover link start at opacity 0. Hairline starts at scaleX(0). Each headline line is clipped at its baseline and its inner span starts at translateY(104%).
- Wait for document.fonts.ready and for the video loadeddata event, but never longer than 900ms, then start.
- Distances scale with k, the logo height divided by 23.5, clamped from 0.65 to 1.
- Wordmark: from opacity 0 and translateY(-6k px), delay 60ms, 900ms, cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1).
- Hairline: scaleX 0 to 1, delay 180ms, 1000ms, cubic-bezier(0.7, 0, 0.2, 1).
- Nav: center link first at 420ms, then the outer links at 490ms. Each from opacity 0 and translateY(-4k px), 700ms, the same quint easing.
- Headline lines rise from translateY(104%) to none, 1100ms, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1). First line delay 200ms, second 290ms.
- Subhead rises 10k px, delay 700ms, 850ms, quint.
- Button rises 12k px from scale 0.975, delay 860ms, 900ms, expo.
- Discover link rises 6k px, delay 1040ms, 700ms, quint.
- Arrow starts 5k px above and settles, delay 1120ms, 820ms, expo.
- All animations use fill both. When every animation finishes, remove intro, cancel the animations, and if focus is not inside the page, toggle the page display none for one reflow so the masks do not leave a separate GPU layer. Then set data-intro="done" on the document element.

title: Video Editor
description: Single-file landing page (one index.html, no build step) for Glaze, a fictional programmable video editor. It has three sections stacked vertically, plus a fixed header and a full-screen loader: 1. Features interactive cursor/mouse tracking and scrub-driven interaction, hardware-accelerated WebGL / Three.js 3D rendering with precision layout polish.
full_prompt:
# Glaze — "Crafted for Motion": exact recreation brief

Build a single-file landing page (one `index.html`, no build step) for **Glaze**, a fictional programmable video editor. It has three sections stacked vertically, plus a fixed header and a full-screen loader:

1. **Hero** — a pale blue-grey gradient screen with a large live 3D keychain hanging from the top centre (five charms on chains, real rigid-body physics, pushed by the mouse), a huge two-line headline "Crafted for / Motion" anchored bottom-left, and the subtitle with a black "Get Started" button anchored bottom-right.
2. **Logo ticker** — a grey caption and an endlessly drifting row of invented wordmarks.
3. **Timeline → statement** — a dark editor timeline with two video tracks (V1, V2) holding five motion-graphics clips, staggered in time, under a moving orange playhead; below it, a large centred three-line sentence with five empty inline slots. When the sentence scrolls into view while you scroll down, the five clips fly out of the timeline and land, small, inside the sentence. Scrolling back up sends them back onto their tracks.

Everything below is exact. Follow it value for value.

---

## 1. Libraries and assets

| What | Exact source |
|---|---|
| GSAP 3.12.5 (classic script) | `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/gsap.min.js` |
| ScrollTrigger 3.12.5 (classic script) | `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/ScrollTrigger.min.js` |
| three.js 0.169.0 (ES module via import map, key `three`) | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.169.0/build/three.module.js` |
| three addons (import map prefix `three/addons/`) | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.169.0/examples/jsm/` — uses `environments/RoomEnvironment.js`, `geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js`, `loaders/FontLoader.js`, `geometries/TextGeometry.js` |
| Rapier 3D physics 0.14.0, compat build (import map key `rapier`) | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@dimforge/rapier3d-compat@0.14.0/rapier.es.js` (call its `init()` before use) |
| Typeface for the 3D letter "G" | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.169.0/examples/fonts/helvetiker_bold.typeface.json` |
| Tile sheet still (3 × 2 grid of six rounded motion-graphics tiles on near-black, 2048 × 1360 source) | `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261109_062058_badb8004-99df-4227-91bb-ecd9ca4d0adb.png&w=2048&q=85` |
| Tile sheet motion (Kling clip of the same sheet padded to 16:9: 1280 × 720, 24 fps, 5.04 s, loops seamlessly) | `https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261109_065027_c89c0a52-25ea-47a9-9e65-f17ff3ea5daf.mp4` |

The six tiles on the sheet, left to right, top row then bottom row: (1) a puffy pale sky-blue pillow squircle with a glossy tangerine 3D star bulging from it; (2) a deep cobalt tile with the glowing blurred white lowercase word "glaze"; (3) an orange-and-cobalt halftone-dot blob; (4) cobalt/electric-blue vertical light streaks with chromatic fringing behind bold orange "JUST / EDIT"; (5) an orange tile with stacked warped white "MOTION" rows; (6) a liquid chrome blob with cobalt and orange reflections (on the sheet but not used on the page).

## 2. Fonts

All self-hosted woff2 (latin subset) from Fontsource on jsDelivr, `font-display: swap`. In the standalone build every file is base64-embedded as a `data:font/woff2` URL.

| Family | Weight | URL |
|---|---|---|
| Inter Tight | 400 | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/fontsource/fonts/inter-tight@latest/latin-400-normal.woff2` |
| Inter Tight | 500 | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/fontsource/fonts/inter-tight@latest/latin-500-normal.woff2` |
| Inter Tight | 600 | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/fontsource/fonts/inter-tight@latest/latin-600-normal.woff2` |
| Kaushan Script | 400 | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/fontsource/fonts/kaushan-script@latest/latin-400-normal.woff2` |
| Unbounded | 700 | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/fontsource/fonts/unbounded@latest/latin-700-normal.woff2` |
| Syncopate | 700 | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/fontsource/fonts/syncopate@latest/latin-700-normal.woff2` |
| Michroma | 400 | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/fontsource/fonts/michroma@latest/latin-400-normal.woff2` |
| Archivo Black | 400 | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/fontsource/fonts/archivo-black@latest/latin-400-normal.woff2` |

Body font: Inter Tight, fallback `system-ui, sans-serif`, `-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased`.

## 3. Head, tokens and scaling

- Title: `Glaze — Crafted for Motion`. `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">`, `lang="en"`.
- Global reset: `box-sizing: border-box`, zero margin and padding; links inherit colour with no underline; buttons have no background or border.
- Colour tokens: ink `#111418`; page background `#f4f7fb`; header pill `rgba(234,239,246,.82)`; timeline panel `#12151b`.
- **Scaling unit `--u`**: the design is drawn on a 1536-px-wide frame. `--u = 100vw / 1536`. Inside the hero only, `--u = min(100vw / 1536, 100vh / 864)` so short, wide windows shrink the hero type with the height. Below 820 px width, `--u = 100vw / 390` (phone layout, section 10). Every "u" value below is a multiple of this unit.
- `body` has `overflow-x: hidden`.

## 4. Loader (first thing on screen)

- A fixed full-viewport layer (z-index 50), background `#f4f7fb`, content centred, starting with `clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0)`.
- One line of text: **"Press play on fresh ideas."** — Inter Tight 500, 34u (22 px on phones), letter-spacing −0.01em, inside a paragraph with `overflow: hidden` so the line can slide in and out of a mask.
- Sequence: after 0.15 s the line rises into view from `yPercent 110` over 0.7 s, `expo.out`. The page then waits until **both** (a) the 3D keychain has finished building and rendered its first frame and (b) 1.4 s have passed since load. Then the exit plays: the line leaves upward to `yPercent −110` over 0.55 s `expo.in`; overlapping by 0.15 s, the whole layer wipes upward to `clip-path: inset(0 0 100% 0)` over 0.8 s `expo.inOut`. The page entrance (section 6) starts at the start of that wipe; the layer is removed when the wipe ends.
- Failsafe: if the 3D never becomes ready, the exit fires anyway at 6 s.
- With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the loader is not shown at all.

## 5. Header (fixed, above everything except the loader)

- Fixed at top 24u, left 90u, right 90u; a flex row with the two pills pushed to opposite ends, aligned to the top. The header itself ignores the pointer; the pills accept it. z-index 20.
- **Pills**: height 64u, radius 16u, background `rgba(234,239,246,.82)` with a 14 px backdrop blur.
- **Left pill**: width 708u, horizontal padding 22u, `overflow: hidden`, width transition 0.6 s `cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1)`. Contents in order:
  - Logo "Glaze" + a dot: Kaushan Script 31u, line-height 1, letter-spacing −0.01em, the whole logo skewed −6° horizontally. The dot is a 4u filled circle in the text colour, 3u after the word, sitting on the baseline. `aria-label="Glaze home"`.
  - Nav, 52u after the logo, gap 25u, Inter Tight 18u, colour `#1e2128`: **Co-Create, Product, Blocks, Templates, Pricing, Blog**. Hover: opacity 0.55 (0.2 s). The nav fades with a 0.35 s opacity transition.
  - A "More" button pushed to the far right of the pill: 30u square, holding a vertical two-dot glyph (two 2-unit-radius circles 12 units apart in a 4 × 16 viewBox), drawn 4u × 16u.
- **Right pill**: height 60u, 2u lower than the left pill (margin-top 2u), padding 0 13u 0 22u, gap 18u, Inter Tight 18u: a plain **Login** link, then **Try for free** as a dark chip (background `#16191f`, text `#fafafa`, radius 9u, padding 8u 16u; hover background `#2b3140`).
- **Compact state**: once `scrollY > 40`, the left pill animates to width 250u (just logo + dots) and the nav fades to opacity 0 and stops taking clicks. Scrolling back to the top restores it.

## 6. Section 1 — Hero

### Layout
- Full viewport height (`100vh`, min 560 px), `overflow: hidden`, background a vertical linear gradient: `#dbe3ee` at 0%, `#eef2f8` at 62%, `#f4f7fb` at 100%.
- A `<canvas>` fills the hero absolutely (pointer-events none, aria-hidden) — the 3D keychain.
- Above it (z-index 2), the content layer fills the hero as a flex row aligned to the **bottom**, with `space-between`, a 40u gap and padding 0 90u 64u (90u side margins, 64u from the bottom). Pointer-events pass through except on the button.
- **Left, bottom — Headline** `Crafted for` / `Motion` (a line break after "for"): Inter Tight 500, **128u**, line-height 0.94, letter-spacing −0.03em, no wrapping, colour ink, left-aligned. The text sits in an inner inline-block span inside a block mask with `overflow: hidden` (padding-bottom 0.08em, margin-bottom −0.08em so descenders aren't clipped).
- **Right, bottom — a column** (left-aligned content, 10u extra bottom padding so it sits on the headline's baseline):
  - **Subtitle** `Glaze, the first video editor` / `you can build on.` (line break after "editor"): 23.5u, letter-spacing 0.01em, line-height 1.15.
  - **Button** `Get Started`: 28u below, height 48u, horizontal padding 29u, radius 13u, background `#16191f`, white text 16u, letter-spacing 0.02em. Hover: scales to 1.05 with a springy `cubic-bezier(.3,1.6,.5,1)` 0.3 s and background `#2b3140`.

### Entrance (starts when the loader's wipe begins)
| Element | From | Duration | Delay | Ease |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Headline inner span | `yPercent 105` (hidden below its mask) | 1.2 s | 0.35 s | expo.out |
| Subtitle, then button (0.1 s stagger) | y +24 px, opacity 0 | 1.0 s | 0.55 s | expo.out |
| Header pills (0.08 s stagger) | y −20 px, opacity 0 | 0.9 s | 0.4 s | expo.out |
| 3D camera rig + gravity (below) | camera y −4 → 0 | 1.5 s | 0.5 s | elastic.out(1,1) |

### The 3D keychain — renderer, light, camera
- WebGL renderer on the hero canvas: antialias, transparent (`alpha`), `preserveDrawingBuffer`, pixel ratio `min(devicePixelRatio, 2)`, ACES Filmic tone mapping, sRGB output. Clear colour `#e3e9f2` at alpha 0 (so glass transmission samples a colour close to the page sky).
- Environment: three's `RoomEnvironment` through a PMREM generator (sigma 0.04), environment intensity 1.05. No visible background.
- Lights: a white directional "rim" light, intensity 1.6, at (−29, −14.8, −35) aimed at (0, 2.2, 0); a white directional key light, intensity 1.1, at (6, 10, 12).
- Camera: perspective, FOV 35°, near 0.1, far 500, inside a rig group. The rig starts at (0, −4, 10) and rises to (0, 0, 10) in the entrance. The camera's own offset inside the rig: desktop (aspect ≥ 0.9) (0, +1.06, −4.4) — so it sits only **5.6 units** from the z = 0 plane, centred on the keyring, which makes the bunch large and hangs it from the top centre with the keyring just above the top edge; phones/portrait (aspect < 0.9) (0, −0.9, +2.2). Canvas and camera aspect follow the hero size on every resize.
- Render only while the hero is in the viewport (IntersectionObserver).

### Physics world (Rapier) — the same rig and tuning as a real keychain
- World gravity (0, −9.81, 0); fixed timestep 1/60 s stepped from an accumulator (frame delta capped at 0.1 s).
- Every body: linear damping **2.3**, angular damping **2.9**, can sleep.
- Collision groups (Rapier interaction groups, membership in the upper 16 bits, filter in the lower 16; group bit = 1 << n): groups **none = 0, tags = 1, chain = 2**. Charms ("tags") are in *tags* and collide with *tags*. Chain links are in *chain* and collide with *none* (they pass through everything). The small start/end rings of every chain are in *chain* and collide with *tags* and *chain*.
- **Main keyring**: a steel torus, radius 0.5, tube 0.04, at (0, 3.2, 0), facing the camera (a visual only; it sits just above the top edge of the frame on desktop).
- Attachment points lie on that ring: for an angle θ (degrees), the point is (0.5·cos(θ−90°), 0.5·sin(θ−90°)) relative to the ring centre, so 0° is the bottom of the ring.

**Every charm hangs on its own chain**, built like this (θ = the charm's ring angle, base = the attachment point on the ring at z 0):
1. A fixed anchor body at base.
2. A **start ring** body at base: collider a cuboid with half extents (0.12·0.12, 0.12, 0.12), density 5; drawn as a steel torus radius 0.12, tube 0.0144, turned 90° about Y (edge-on). Spherical joint anchor↔start ring at their origins.
3. **N link bodies**, each spawned at base + (0.5, 0, 0) (they swing into place on the first frames): ball collider radius 0.1, density 1, group chain/none. Spherical joint from the start ring's local (0, −0.12, 0) to link 0's origin. Consecutive links are joined with **rope joints** of maximum length L (0.06 for metal chains).
4. An **end ring** body at base: same as the start ring but radius 0.08. Spherical joint from the last link's local (0, −0.08, 0) to the end ring's origin.
5. The **charm body**, spawned at (base.x, base.y, z): its collider and density are listed below; it is welded to the end ring with a **fixed joint** — end ring origin ↔ the charm's local point (0, offset, 0). The offset always puts the end ring just *above* the charm's collider, so nothing rubs at rest and the bunch settles completely still.
6. A constant outward force on the charm (set once, persists): with angle φ, F = (0.7·cos(φ−90°), 0.7·sin(φ−90°), z). This fans the charms apart like a real bunch of keys.

Chain links are drawn with one instanced mesh per chain: each instance sits at its link body's position, oriented along the chain (direction to the next link, or from the previous one for the last), with that direction smoothed per frame (lerp factor 10·dt). Metal links are a steel oval: a torus radius 0.062, tube 0.02, scaled 1.5 along Y, colour `#a9afba`, metalness 1, roughness 0.2, and each link is twisted about its own axis by i·16°, plus 90° on every other link, so neighbouring links interlock visually.

Per-frame orientation keeping (runs every rendered frame): the start ring's yaw is limited to ±15°; the end ring's and the charm's yaw to ±12° (yaw = the angle of the body's local +Z axis around world Y; when exceeded, rotate back to the limit about world Y and zero the Y angular velocity). The charm also eases its rotation toward identity by a slerp of 0.001 per frame, skipped while it sleeps (and without waking it).

**The five charms, left to right:**

| # | Charm | Ring angle θ | Push angle φ | Spawn z | Collider (half extents / radius) | Density | Fixed-joint offset | Chain |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Holographic cassette | −50° | −64° | −0.2 | cuboid 0.42 × 0.52 × 0.15 | 1.4 | 0.64 | 8 steel links, L 0.06 |
| 2 | Cobalt bead strand | −18° | −16° | 0.4 | ball r 0.12 | 30 | 0.22 | 9 bead "links", L 0.135, no twist |
| 3 | Pearl ring | 14° | 10° | 0.8 | cuboid 0.5 × 0.5 × 0.12 | 1.4 | 0.62 | 9 steel links, L 0.06 |
| 4 | Orange letter G | 40° | 46° | 0.15 | cuboid 0.42 × 0.48 × 0.12 | 1.4 | 0.6 | 10 steel links, L 0.06 |
| 5 | House key | 84° | 88° | −0.25 | cuboid 0.22 × 0.64 × 0.05 | 4 | 0.7 | 9 steel links, L 0.06 |

**Charm models** (all built in code, centred on their body):
- *Small hanging loop* used on charms: a steel torus (colour `#cfd3da`, metalness 1, roughness 0.18), radius 0.075, tube 0.0225, turned 90° about Y, placed at the top of the charm.
- *Cassette*: a rounded box 0.8 × 1.02 × 0.15 (radius 0.06, 5 segments) in clear holographic glass — physical material, colour `#e9eeff`, roughness 0.08, transmission 1, thickness 0.35, IOR 1.42, iridescence 1 (iridescence IOR 1.7, thickness range 180–820 nm), clearcoat 1 (roughness 0.05). Inside it: a rounded label 0.58 × 0.8 × 0.05 with a pastel rainbow holographic canvas texture (a 256 × 320 diagonal gradient through `#b8f1ff, #c9b8ff, #ffc2ec, #fff1b8, #b8ffd9, #9fc4ff, #e2b8ff`, with 26 random soft ellipses in white / `#8fa0ff` at 18% opacity), metalness 0.45, roughness 0.18, iridescence 1 (IOR 1.9, 250–900 nm), clearcoat 1; a cobalt tape window, rounded box 0.2 × 0.5 × 0.07 (`#2a3a8c`, metalness 0.3, roughness 0.25, clearcoat 1); two steel reel rings (torus r 0.07, tube 0.026) at y ±0.17, z 0.03; loop at y 0.59.
- *Bead strand*: the chain itself is the strand — every link is drawn as a glossy cobalt sphere r 0.068 (`#1430e0`, roughness 0.12, clearcoat 1 / 0.04). The charm at the end is a slightly bigger bead, r 0.085, same material.
- *Pearl ring*: a torus radius 0.33, tube 0.15 (36 × 72 segments), pearl material — colour `#f7f4f2`, metalness 0.05, roughness 0.26, iridescence 0.9 (IOR 1.35, 300–700 nm), sheen 1 with sheen colour `#ffe6f6` (sheen roughness 0.4), clearcoat 1 (0.12); loop at y 0.56.
- *Letter G*: 3D text "G" in Helvetiker Bold, size 0.74, depth 0.1, curve segments 10, bevel thickness 0.1, bevel size 0.055, 8 bevel segments, centred; glossy enamel `#ff5512`, roughness 0.22, clearcoat 1 (0.06); loop at y 0.54.
- *House key*: an extruded 2D shape (depth 0.045, bevel 0.012 in 3 segments, 28 curve segments): a round bow (arc radius 0.21 centred at (0, 0.36), from −0.32π to 1.32π), a shaft from (−0.06, 0.12) down to (−0.06, −0.62), a tip at (0.01, −0.7) and (0.06, −0.66), then seven teeth up the right edge alternating x 0.11 / 0.065 at y −0.6, −0.52, −0.45, −0.37, −0.3, −0.22, −0.14, back to (0.06, −0.08) and (0.06, 0.12); a round hole r 0.055 at (0, 0.44). The geometry is shifted up 0.065 so it spans −0.635 to 0.635 (hole at 0.505), and centred in depth. Material: physical, `#e4e6ea`, metalness 1, roughness 0.16, clearcoat 0.4. A loop (r 0.07) at y 0.6.

### Mouse interaction — a push field, not a constant animation
At rest the keychain is completely still. Only the mouse moves it:
- Track `pointermove` on the window; the pointer counts as "inside" while its y is within the hero canvas. Convert to normalised device coordinates over the canvas.
- Every physics step while inside (and only if the step delta ≤ 0.1 s): cast a ray from the camera through the pointer and intersect it with the plane z = 0 → point P.
- For every charm body within **radius 2** of P (distance d, d > 0): apply an impulse along the vector from P to the charm of magnitude **4.4 · (1 − d/2)² · dt / d** per unit of that vector. Near charms get shoved away from the cursor, swing on their chains and settle back within ~5 s thanks to the damping.

### Entrance physics (the drop-in)
When the entrance starts: one GSAP timeline, defaults duration 1.5 s, delay 0.5 s, `elastic.out(1,1)`. Track 1 moves the camera rig y from −4 to 0. Track 2 runs a dummy progress 0 → 1 alongside; on every update set every body's gravity scale to **−0.25** (the charms float up while the camera rises to meet them) and, once progress reaches 1, to **1** for good (they drop and swing into place).

## 7. Section 2 — Logo ticker

- Padding 72u top, 40u bottom.
- Caption, centred: **"Teams from top studios and agencies build with Glaze"** — 20.66u, letter-spacing 0.033em, colour `rgba(15,20,30,.38)`.
- 52u below: a full-width marquee strip with `overflow: hidden` and a horizontal edge fade mask (transparent → black at 4% and 96% → transparent).
- The track is a flex row of two identical lists (the second is a clone, aria-hidden). Each list: items 48u tall, gap 96u, trailing padding 96u, colour `#0c0e12`, base size 30u, line-height 1. The eight invented wordmarks and their styles:

|---|---|

- Motion (requestAnimationFrame, only while visible): x decreases by (70 + boost) · dt · (viewport width / 1536) px per frame (×2.4 on phones); when the track has moved one list width it wraps back by that width. Every scroll event adds |Δscroll| · 2.2 to `boost`; boost decays by a factor 0.04^dt each frame. So the logos drift steadily and whip faster while you scroll.

## 8. Section 3 — Timeline, then statement

The section (`overflow: hidden`, position relative) holds two blocks in this order: the **timeline** first, the **statement** below it, then a 160u spacer.

### Timeline panel (first)
- Block: padding 150u top, 68u sides, 60u bottom; z-index 1; content centred.
- Inner box: width 100%, max-width 1400u, aspect ratio **1372 / 500**; every child is absolutely positioned in percentages of this box.

- **Two track lanes**, left 8%, right 2.4%, each 33% tall, radius 14u, background `rgba(255,255,255,.05)`: **V1** at top 16%, **V2** at top 56%. Their labels "V1" / "V2" sit in the left gutter at left 2.9%, vertically centred on the lanes (top 32.5% and 72.5%), 13u monospace, weight 600, `#8d97a8`, letter-spacing 0.04em.
- **Five clip slots** (square, height 28% of the box; V1 slots at top 18.5%, V2 slots at top 58.5%), placed in time order like clips on an edit — the lane spans 0–6 s, so x = 8% + 89.6% × t / 6:

| Clip | Track | Left | Tile |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | V1 | 9.5% | inflated star |
| 2 | V2 | 22.9% | glowing "glaze" |
| 3 | V1 | 34.1% | halftone blob |
| 4 | V2 | 50.6% | "JUST EDIT" streaks |
| 5 | V1 | 66.2% | kinetic "MOTION" |

- Each slot holds one absolutely positioned **block** (z-index 1, `will-change: transform`) containing one **tile** (below).
- **Playhead**: an orange (`#ff5512`) vertical line 2u wide from top 12.5% to bottom 4.5%, above the clips (z-index 2), with a pill on top showing the running timecode (white 11.5u, weight 600, tabular numbers, padding 5u 7u, radius 6u, `#ff5512`). While playing it starts at 2.4 s, counts up in real time, sweeps the ruler (left = 8% + 89.6% × t / 6) and wraps at 6 s; the label reads `00:SS.cc`. The pause button freezes it together with the tile video.

### Tiles
- Each tile is clipped with a squircle clip-path (object-bounding-box path: a superellipse with exponent 4.2, sampled at 160 points).
- Background: the tile-sheet still (section 1), `background-size: 358.04% 237.76%` (a 572-px square crop of the 2048 × 1360 sheet). Positions: tile 1 `5.217% 8.312%`, tile 2 `49.966% 8.312%`, tile 3 `94.851% 8.312%`, tile 4 `5.217% 90.04%`, tile 5 `49.966% 90.04%`.
- An inner white glow on every tile: a pseudo-element with radius 22.4% and `inset 0 0 (tile width × 0.15) rgba(255,255,255,.55)`.
- **Motion**: one hidden, muted, looping, inline, `crossorigin="anonymous"` `<video>` plays the Kling clip. Each tile has a `<canvas>` (tile width × min(dpr, 2) px square) that, every animation frame while the section is on screen (IntersectionObserver with 200 px margin), draws its crop of the video frame: the clip is the 2418 × 1360 padded sheet scaled to 1280 × 720, so with K = 1280 / 2418 the source square is 572·K px wide at (262K, 65.5·720/1360), (922.5K, same), (1585K, same), (262K, 709.5·720/1360), (922.5K, same). The canvases fade in over 0.4 s once the video has data; until then (and with reduced motion) the still background shows.

### Statement (second)
- Block: padding 120u top, 90u sides, 170u bottom.
- Heading (h2): Inter Tight 500, 57.2u, line-height 1.08, letter-spacing −0.012em, **centred**, max-width 31.5ch with auto side margins, wrapping into exactly three lines:
  - "Glaze [■] is the first video [■] editor where"
  - "creatives can [■] build and remix [■] custom"
  - "design tools [■] right on timeline."
- Each [■] is an empty inline slot, 1em × 1em, margin 0.1em 0.2em −0.15em 0.2em. Five slots, in reading order, matching clips 1–5.

### The timeline ⇄ statement flight (FLIP)
- The blocks always live in their timeline slots. For block i, from the bounding boxes of sentence slot i and its timeline slot: scale = sentenceSlot.width / timelineSlot.width; x = sentenceSlot.left − timelineSlot.left + (sentenceSlot.width − timelineSlot.width) / 2; y = sentenceSlot.top − timelineSlot.top + (sentenceSlot.height − timelineSlot.height) / 2. Applying that transform (origin centre) parks the block exactly over its slot in the sentence; scale 1, x 0, y 0 puts it back on its track.
- **Start state: on the tracks.** On load, after fonts are ready, and on every width change, set every block straight to its current state with no rotation.
- **Trigger**: while the section is on screen, listen to scroll. Whenever the **sentence** is on screen (its top above the viewport bottom, its bottom below the viewport top) and the page scrolls **down**, send the blocks into the sentence; when it scrolls **up**, send them back to the timeline. Nothing happens if they are already there.
- **The flight** (one GSAP timeline): block i starts at i × 0.1 s going down into the sentence (i × 0.05 s going back up). Track 1: scale, x and y to the target over 1.5 s `power2.inOut`. Track 2, at the same start: rotation to a random angle between −15° and +15° over 0.75 s `power2.in`, then back to 0° over 0.75 s `power2.out`. The clips peel off their tracks, wobble down the page and drop into the words.
- **First reveal**: the first time the timeline comes within 300 px of the viewport bottom (once only, and only while the blocks are on their tracks), the first clip's inner content drops onto its track from y −300 px and rotation 15° over 2 s `power1.out`.

## 9. Interactions summary

| Trigger | Response |
|---|---|
| Page load | Loader line rises; waits for 3D + 1.4 s; wipes up; headline/sub/button/header enter; camera rises with an elastic bounce while the charms float, then they drop and swing to rest |
| Mouse near the charms | Radial impulse pushes them away (strength 4.4, radius 2), chains swing, settle within ~5 s |
| Scroll past 40 px | Left header pill shrinks to logo + dots, nav fades |
| Scrolling (any) | Ticker speeds up, then eases back |
| Sentence on screen + scroll down | Five clips fly off the timeline tracks down into the sentence (staggered, wobbling) |
| Sentence on screen + scroll up | Clips fly back up onto their tracks |
| Playing | Orange playhead sweeps 0–6 s and loops, timecode on it |
| Pause button | Freezes the playhead/timecode and the tile video; icon switches pause ↔ play |
| Nav link hover / CTA hover | Opacity 0.55 / scale 1.05 + lighter background |

## 10. Phone layout (≤ 820 px)

- `--u = 100vw / 390`.
- Header: top/left/right 12 px; pills 46 px tall, radius 12 px; left pill fixed at 128 px wide (logo 22 px, 3-px dot, dots button 22 px), nav hidden; right pill gap 12 px, 14 px text, padding 0 6px 0 14px; dark chip radius 8 px, padding 7px 12px.

- Ticker: padding 44px 0 16px; caption 14 px with 24-px side padding; marquee 28 px below; items 32 px tall, 22 px (KILNWORKS/FORGELY/VELDA 19 px), gap 48 px; drift ×2.4.
- Timeline (first): padding 72px 12px 20px; aspect ratio 1372 / 640 (taller lanes); panel radius 16 px; pause 17 px (radius 5 px, icon 5 × 6 px) at left 1.6%, top 3.4%; ruler 14 px tall at top 4.6%, labels 8 px, ticks 5 px with every other minor tick hidden; lanes radius 7 px; V labels 8 px at left 2.4%; playhead pill 7.5 px text, padding 3px 4px.
- Statement (second): padding 56px 18px 90px; heading 9.2vw, line-height 1.12; slots 1.15em with margin −0.05em 0.2em −0.2em 0.2em.

## 11. Reduced motion (`prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`)

No loader; no entrance tweens; the camera starts at its final position with gravity 1, the physics world is stepped 240 times once to settle and then frozen (no mouse push); the ticker stands still; the tile video is never loaded (tiles show the still sheet); the playhead stays put; the timeline ⇄ statement switch jumps instantly with no flight; header transitions are instant.

## 12. Acceptance checklist

title: Tana Elephant
description: Build three stacked sections of a fictional safari brand's species page, Tana Camps Expeditions, in plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS with no framework and no build step. The look is a quiet nature magazine: warm cream paper, deep brown-plum Didone capitals, small rust caps labels, documentary photography.
