full_prompt:
# Prompt: Tana Camps "Elephant" editorial sections

Build three stacked sections of a fictional safari brand's species page, **Tana Camps Expeditions**, in plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS with no framework and no build step. The look is a quiet nature magazine: warm cream paper, deep brown-plum Didone capitals, small rust caps labels, documentary photography. The motion is slow and letter-by-letter: the hero title rises in behind the elephant, the hero photo melts into the paper as you scroll, and each section's type climbs in one letter at a time.

## Media (Higgsfield CloudFront)

- **Hero photo** (2400×1357, ratio 2688:1520): an African bush elephant with long tusks walking through golden savanna grass, soft cloudy sky in the top third. https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/934f4b51-d05b-4498-9c4a-8262f044da66.jpg
- **Elephant cut-out** (transparent WebP of the same elephant, cropped to its bounding box): https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/5d850aba-1a5b-44eb-bd6c-cd9f87845be7.webp. In the photo's own frame it sits at left 26.19%, top 30.99%, width 46.5%.
- **Round pill photos** (square):
  - savanna with a small elephant under acacias: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/a6ea3433-41c4-46b8-aac3-faefa9ad7558.jpg
  - mother and calf silhouetted at sunset: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/9152c213-6763-4147-83f3-b985e6c65a00.jpg
- **Tall portrait** (2:3): an elephant's head in profile with one long tusk on green foliage. https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/e665edf0-2b16-4b17-ada1-0b928af1dbfa.jpg

## Type and colour

- **Display:** Bodoni Moda (variable), weight 500, optical size pinned to 11 so the hairlines stay sturdy. All display text is uppercase.
- **Labels and body:** Inter. Labels are 600, 10.5px, tracking .2em, uppercase.
- **Colours:** paper `#ECE3D1`, darker paper `#E6DCC8`, ink `#43282A`, body text ink at 72%, rust `#A86438`, hairlines ink at 16%.
- **Grain:** a fixed SVG fractal-noise layer over everything, multiply blend, 38% opacity.

## 1 · Hero (full viewport)

- **Stage:** a box with the photo's ratio (2688:1520) that covers the viewport (`width: max(100vw, 100svh × 1.7684)`), centred, with `container-type: inline-size`. Inside it, three layers:
  1. the photo (object-fit cover)
  2. the title block
  3. the elephant cut-out, so the elephant's back overlaps the lower part of the letters "PH"
- **Title block:** top 19.2% of the stage, centred.
  - Eyebrow "LOXODONTA AFRICANA" (label style, 0.66cqw).
  - "ELEPHANT" at 9.6cqw, line height .8, tracking .01em.
- **Nav (over the photo):**
  - Left: a two-line menu icon + "MENU".
  - Centre: "Tana Camps" in Bodoni Moda 19px over "EXPEDITIONS" (7.5px, tracking .32em).
  - Right: a search icon + "SEARCH".
- **Map pill:** bottom centre, a cream pill "SEE ON MAP" with a round pin icon and an arrow.
- **Load sequence:**
  - The photo settles from scale 1.06 to 1 over 2.2s.
  - The eyebrow and nav fade down into place.
  - The letters of ELEPHANT rise .18em out of a 10px blur, 95ms apart, left to right.
  - The pill rises in last, at about 1.05s.
- **Scroll (hero melts into the paper):**
  - The stage drifts down at .32× the scroll.
  - A paper-coloured gradient at the bottom grows from 34% to 100% of the hero height and to full opacity by about 60% of a viewport scrolled.
  - Photo and cut-out blur up to 6px. The pill sits under the gradient and disappears with the photo.

## 2 · Statement (full viewport, centred)

- **Label:** rust "ELEPHANTS IN AFRICA".
- **Statement:** three lines of uppercase Bodoni at clamp(40px, 7.2vw, 132px), line height 1.06: "THE ● LARGEST / LAND ANIMAL ● ON / THE PLANET".
  - Each ● is a 0.86em round photo pill sitting inline.
- **Emblem:** below, a 66px rust line emblem: a double ring with an elephant head.
- **Reveal (when 35% visible):**
  - Every letter rises from .55em below with a 4° tilt, 26ms apart in reading order.
  - The pills spring in from scale 0, with an overshoot, while their photo zooms from 1.5 to 1.
  - The emblem turns in from −90° and scale .6.

## 3 · Quick facts (full viewport)

- **Layout:** a 1180px column with a hairline on top and three columns (1.12fr / 1.12fr / .96fr).
- **Left column:**
  - Rust label "ELEPHANT".
  - "QUICK / FACTS / ABOUT / ELEPHANT" in Bodoni at clamp(34px, 4.25vw, 66px), one word per line.
  - An 84px play badge: a ring of 48 radial ticks turning once every 16s, with a play triangle in the middle.
  - The caption "7 MINUTES".
- **Middle column:**
  - A 13.4px paragraph about the bush elephant as a keystone species.
  - A facts table with hairlines. The label is ink and the value is rust, right-aligned:
    - Habitat: Woodland and savanna
    - Scientific name: Loxodonta africana
    - Adult weight: 2,000 – 6,300 kg
    - IUCN status: Vulnerable
- **Right column:** the tall 2:3 portrait. The image inside its frame drifts ±7% with scroll (parallax).
- **Reveal:**
  - The title letters rise like the statement's, 30ms apart.
  - The paragraph and table rise 22px in a stagger, and the rows fade in one by one.
  - The portrait wipes up with `clip-path: inset(100% 0 0 0) → inset(0)` (1.2s) while its image settles from scale 1.25.

## Recorder mode (`?rec=1`)

- **Scroll:** the whole page is translated by a 6.5s Web Animation instead of real scrolling:
  - hold to 1.95s
  - glide to section 2 by 3.35s
  - hold to 4.25s
  - glide to section 3 by 5.55s
  - hold
- **Reveals:** created up front at 0, 2.65s and 4.85s.
- **Scroll effects:** a rAF loop reads the page's current translate and applies the same scroll-linked effects, so a frame-by-frame recorder is deterministic.

## Phone (≤ 760px)

- **Nav:** shows icons only.
- **Hero title:** sits higher (top 17%) at 15.6vw so it clears the elephant.
- **Statement:** 8.6vw.
- **Facts:** stack in one column with the title at 12vw and the photo full width.
- **Overflow:** no sideways scroll.

## Acceptance check (1440×960)

- **On load:** the elephant stands in the grass, and ELEPHANT rises in letter by letter behind its back.
- **First scroll:** the photo blurs and melts into the cream paper, then the statement climbs in letter by letter with the two round photos popping into the gaps.
- **Second scroll:** the quick-facts title climbs in, the table fades up, the portrait wipes in and the badge ticks keep turning.
- **Content:** no real brands or logos.

full_prompt:
# Krung Travel — "Welcome to Bangkok" cinematic travel booking landing page

Build a single-file, full-bleed, fully responsive travel booking landing page for an invented brand **"Krung Travel"** (Bangkok, Thailand). It has a cinematic three-slide hero with giant gradient-faded titles, drifting volumetric clouds, a soft misty right-to-left wipe between slides, a column of round destination thumbnails on thin concentric rings, a white search bar with working date-range and guest popovers, a "Recomended Places to Stay" grid of eight photo cards, and a shared-element transition from a card to a property detail page with booking. The whole palette is warm sunset peach and mauve. Every visual must match this description exactly.

---

## 1. Global look

- **Page background:** solid peach `#f7d9c6` down to 115vh. It then blends to `#fbe7da` at 175vh and to `#fdf0e7` at the bottom, so the hero's bottom fade lands on exactly the same peach with no seam. `html` is also `#f7d9c6`.
- **Text colours:**
  - ink `#1d1a1c`
  - muted ink `#5c5156`
  - light muted `#8a7f83`
- **Accents:**
  - orange `#f39419` for Book Now
  - star yellow `#f7c325`
  - heart red `#ff4d5e`
- **Fonts (Google Fonts):**
  - **Urbanist** (300, 400, 500, 600, 700, 800) for all UI text, the nav and the giant titles.
  - **Gilda Display** for section headings and property names: an elegant high-contrast serif.
- **Easing:**
  - `--ease: cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1)` for layout moves.
  - `--out: cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)` for reveals.
- **Body:** `overflow-x: hidden`, antialiased.
- **Edges:** no side margins anywhere. The hero touches both edges of the viewport.

## 2. Custom cursor (matches the reference's grey dot cursor)

- Hide the native cursor everywhere (`cursor: none`).
- A fixed 26 px circle in `rgba(72,62,68,.55)` follows the pointer through `transform: translate(x, y)` with negative margins to centre it.
- **Over anything clickable** (buttons, links, cards, thumbnails, search fields): it grows to 38 px and lightens to `rgba(72,62,68,.35)`.
- **While pressed:** it becomes a 44 px hollow dark ring, with a transparent fill and a 5 px border in `rgba(20,16,18,.9)`.
- Sizes animate over .25 s with `--out`.
- **Recording mode:** when the URL contains `?rec`, the cursor is larger: 50 px, 58 px on hover, and a 62 px ring with a 7 px border while pressed.

## 3. Navigation bar

- **Position and size:** fixed, full width, 74 px tall, side padding `clamp(20px, 9.5vw, 170px)`.
- **Over the hero:** transparent, with white text at 92% opacity and a 1 px bottom hairline in `rgba(255,255,255,.28)`.
- **After scrolling past 30% of the viewport height:** it turns solid. The background becomes `rgba(247,217,198,.86)` with a 14 px backdrop blur, the text becomes ink, and the hairline becomes `rgba(29,26,28,.08)`. Background, colour and border transition over .5 s.
- **Left side, in order:**
  1. "Krung Travel" logo: Urbanist 300 at 26 px. It is clickable and returns home.
  2. A 1 × 42 px vertical divider at 45% opacity with 28 px margins.
  3. "Visitors" at 12.5 px with a tiny chevron.
- **Centre:** three links, "Apartments", "Where to go" and "Contact Us", at 14.5 px with a 44 px gap. On hover, a 1.5 px underline wipes in from the left and wipes out to the right.
- **Right side:** "Become a host" at 14 px, a thin-line globe icon, then a pill button. The pill has a 1.5 px border, 9 px radius, a hamburger icon and a 22 px filled circle containing a user silhouette.

## 4. Hero (100vh, min-height 680 px, overflow hidden)

### 4.1 Slides

There are three stacked full-bleed slides. Each slide has:

- **A photo layer:** inset −3%, `background-size: cover`, base scale 1.04.
- **A top tint:** `linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(84,64,74,.42) 0%, rgba(84,64,74,.08) 26%, transparent 46%)`, which gives the mauve band behind the nav.
- **A giant title** inside the slide, so the wipe reveals the title together with the photo:
  - Urbanist 700, uppercase, line-height .9, white-space nowrap.
  - Each word is wrapped so it can rise from a mask.
  - Each word is filled with a vertical gradient clipped to the text: `rgba(255,255,255,.97)` at 0%, `.86` at 36%, `.16` at 100%. The letters look like frosted metal that fades into the photo at the bottom.

| # | Photo (use exactly) | Title | Title size and position | Photo position | Thumbnail lit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Bangkok skyline at sunset with the pixelated tower and the river | `WELCOME TO BANGKOK` (one line) | 8.25vw, left 2.6vw, top 74 px + 3.2vh | center 62% | Wat Arun (bottom) |
| 2 | Thai teak-house living room opening onto a sunset river terrace | `FIND PLACE TO STAY` | 8.25vw, same position | center 55% | floating market (middle) |
| 3 | Low-angle porcelain-mosaic temple prang against a blue-grey sky | `EXPLORE` / `BANGKOK` (two lines) | 9.6vw, left 7vw, top 74 px + 5vh, line-height .95 | center 40% | tuk-tuk (top) |

**Slide photos** (load at w=2400):
- Slide 1: https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261115_005348_d02f5076-330a-4062-960b-b000a310d6e4.png&w=2400&q=85
- Slide 2: https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261115_005347_2a7781a6-ffd1-48f1-bb19-051b67063047.png&w=2400&q=85
- Slide 3: https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261115_005347_73725010-6ca6-46d8-a732-fc33275a02e0.png&w=2400&q=85

### 4.2 Clouds (volumetric, drifting, screen-blended)

The cloud asset is white clouds on pure black. It is composited with `mix-blend-mode: screen`, so the black disappears and only the white clouds remain.

**Cloud image:** https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261115_005635_6590354a-216c-40a2-9f84-93abe97dc7b1.png&w=2400&q=85

- **Bottom cloud bank:** a box at left/right −4%, bottom −6%, 78% of the hero height, z-index 7. It holds two copies of the cloud image, `cover`, anchored center bottom. Each copy has a mask that fades its top from transparent at 0% to opaque at 38%, so no rectangular edge ever shows.
  - Front copy: drifts sideways from −2.5% to +2.5% over 26 s, alternating, ease-in-out.
  - Back copy: mirrored horizontally at 85% opacity, drifting ±3% sideways and 4% vertically over 34 s.
- **Top cloud layer:** the same image, flipped vertically. It sits from −30% to 50% of the hero height and starts at opacity 0. On scroll it fades in (opacity = scrollY / (0.45 × viewport height)) and moves up. Its mask fades the opposite edge.
- **Bottom fade:** an overlay over the lowest 46% of the hero, `rgba(247,217,198,0)` → `.45` at 45% → `.92` at 82% → solid `#f7d9c6`. The photo melts into the peach page.

### 4.3 Right rail: thumbnails on concentric rings

Three round thumbnails sit in a vertical column centred at x = 85.5% of the viewport. The column starts at 74 px + 8.5% of the hero height.

| Order | Subject | Lit on |
|---|---|---|
| Top | tuk-tuk | slide 3 |
| Middle | floating market | slide 2 |
| Bottom | Wat Arun with a longtail boat | slide 1 |

**Thumbnail images** (w=400):
- Tuk-tuk: https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261115_005347_2697af01-b81b-4c9e-bb4f-7200cb1aa1e8.png&w=400&q=85
- Floating market: https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261115_005347_e2768ec3-714b-47bc-b03e-4fc6794d5dd9.png&w=400&q=85
- Wat Arun: https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261115_005347_c5667173-fd6e-4dcb-9547-6c4518e19388.png&w=400&q=85

**Thumbnails:**
- Sizes:
  - active: 11.3% of the viewport width, clamped to 96–190 px;
  - inactive: 5.4%, clamped to 46–92 px;
  - gap: 0.9% of the viewport width, minimum 8 px.
- Each has a 3 px white border at 92% opacity and the shadow `0 10px 26px rgba(60,30,30,.28)`.
- The active one also gets a halo ring 9 px outside it in `rgba(255,255,255,.55)`.
- Hover: scale 1.07 with a deeper shadow.
- Switching slides animates top, left, width and height over .9 s with `--ease`. The lit thumbnail swells in its own place in the column and the others shrink, so the column reflows smoothly.

**Rings:** two thin outlined circles (1.6 px, `rgba(255,255,255,.5)`), both centred on the active thumbnail.
- Inner ring radius: half the active size + 5% of the viewport width.
- Outer ring radius: half the active size + 10.8% of the viewport width.
- They slide with the active thumbnail over .9 s and are allowed to run off the right edge.

**Connector line:** a 3 px white rounded bar, 4.7% of the viewport width long (minimum 40 px). It sits 0.8% of the viewport width left of the active thumbnail at the same height. On a change it scales out from its right end (scaleX 0), then scales back in.

**Caption block:** anchored by its right edge just left of the connector, at least 16 px away, vertically aligned to the active thumbnail.
- A 3 px white vertical bar, 6.5% of the viewport width tall (minimum 84 px). It grows from the top (scaleY 0 → 1, .6 s).
- A heading in Urbanist 300 at `clamp(26px, 2.75vw, 40px)`, white, with a soft text shadow.
- A description at `clamp(12px, 1vw, 14.5px)`, 88% opacity, max-width 250 px.
- The text reveals left to right with a clip-path (inset right 100% → fully shown) over .9 s.

**Caption copy:**
- Slide 1: "Discover Bangkok" / "Discover Bangkok's best places to stay and visit. Find suitable ones for you and your family"
- Slide 2: "Places to stay" / "Riverside teak houses, sky-high suites and quiet garden villas picked for you"
- Slide 3: "Places to go" / "Explore through the eyes of Bangkok's best Thai adventures"

### 4.4 Slide transition: soft misty right-to-left wipe (the signature move)

Clicking a thumbnail switches slides; otherwise slides auto-advance 1 → 2 → 3 → 1 every 5.2 s. The wipe lasts 1.25 s with easeInOutCubic and is driven by requestAnimationFrame.

- **Incoming slide:** placed above the outgoing one and revealed by a moving linear-gradient mask (to the left) with a soft edge about 35% wide. With progress `p`:
  - fully opaque up to `p·135 − 35` % from the right edge;
  - 60% at the midpoint;
  - transparent at `p·135` %.

  The photo and the giant title wipe together, so mid-transition you read hybrids like "FIND PLACE TO BANGKOK".
- **Incoming photo:** settles from scale 1.12 to 1.04 while sliding from +2% to 0.
- **Outgoing photo:** pushes from scale 1.04 to 1.09 and drifts −2%.
- **Mist band:** a vertical band 34% of the viewport width rides along the wipe edge, a radial blush-white haze (`rgba(255,236,226,.75)` → transparent) blurred 10 px. Its opacity follows sin(π·t) up to .95, so the edge looks like a cloud passing.
- **Rail:** when the wipe starts, the rail re-lays out, and the connector and caption hide. After 650 ms the connector and bar grow back and the new caption text clips in.
- **After the wipe:** the live photo does a very slow Ken Burns. Scale grows 0.0035 per second for up to 12 s, plus a pointer parallax shift of ±0.6% horizontally and ±0.5% vertically.

### 4.5 Intro (on load)

- After 250 ms, each title word rises from below its mask (translateY 105% → 0, 1.15 s `--out`), staggered by 90 ms.
- The thumbnails scale from 0 to 1, staggered 140 ms from a .35 s start.
- The rings fade in.
- The search bar slides up 30 px while fading in over 1 s.
- The caption reveals after 900 ms.

### 4.6 Scroll choreography

| Element | Movement |
|---|---|
| Slide stack | translateY(+0.42 × scrollY), so the photo lags |
| Bottom cloud bank | translateY(−0.38 × scrollY), scale 1 + 0.35 × scrollY / viewport height, so clouds rise and swell past the photo |
| Top cloud layer | fades in |
| Rail | translateY(+0.2 × scrollY), fades out by half a viewport |

The result: scrolling down buries the city in cloud above the search bar, exactly like the reference.

## 5. Search bar

- **Size and position:** absolutely centred, `min(900px, 100% − 40px)` wide, 90 px tall, radius 26 px, bottom 20vh + 2 px.
- **Look:** `rgba(255,255,255,.93)` with the shadow `0 18px 60px rgba(120,70,60,.16)`, z-index above the clouds.
- **Fields:** four. Each has a 16 px thin-line icon, a 21 px Urbanist 500 label and a 13 px muted sub-label.
  1. Pin icon — "Bangkok" / "Choose the destination" (1.35× wider than the others)
  2. Calendar icon — "Check in" / "Add date"
  3. Calendar icon — "Check out" / "Add date"
  4. People icon — "Visitors" / "Add guests"
- **Active or hovered field:** becomes a raised white tile, 72 px tall, radius 14 px, shadow `0 8px 24px rgba(120,80,70,.14)`. "Check in" starts raised.
- **Send button:** a black 40 px square, radius 11 px, with a white paper-plane icon. Hover scales it to 1.1 and rotates it −8°. Clicking it smooth-scrolls to the stays.
- **Calendar popover:** opens under the date fields as a white card, radius 18 px, with a big soft shadow. It drops in from −8 px.
  - Header: month name with ‹ › buttons.
  - Grid: 7 columns × 34 px, Monday first.
  - Picking dates: the first click sets check-in, the second sets check-out. Both ends become black tiles with white numbers, and the days between get a pale peach band. Days before check-in are disabled.
  - The field sub-labels update to dates like "Dec 18".
  - After choosing check-out, the Visitors popover opens automatically.
- **Visitors popover:** Adults (13+) and Children (2–12) rows with round − / + steppers. The sub-label updates, for example "3 guests".
- Clicking outside closes the popovers.

## 6. "Recomended Places to Stay" section

- **Position and padding:** pulled up into the hero by −17vh. Side padding `clamp(20px, 9.5vw, 170px)`.
- **Heading:** "Recomended Places to Stay" in Gilda Display at `clamp(26px, 2.45vw, 36px)`. The spelling matches the reference.
- **"See All" pill:** on the right, with a 1.4 px ink border and radius 20 px. On hover it fills ink with white text.
- **Grid:** two rows of four, gap `clamp(14px, 2.2vw, 30px)`. Each card has:
  - aspect ratio 203:268, radius 12 px, shadow `0 12px 30px rgba(110,60,50,.16)`;
  - a full-bleed photo with a bottom darkening gradient;
  - a top-left price pill: white at 82% opacity, 6 px blur, radius 6 px, 11.5 px text, "/night" at 60% opacity;
  - a top-right 30 px white heart button;
  - bottom-left text: the name (Urbanist 600 at 15.5 px), a pin icon with the area, five yellow stars and "4,8".
- **Entrance:** cards rise 40 px and fade in when scrolled into view, staggered 90 ms per column.
- **Hover:** the card lifts 6 px, the shadow deepens and the photo zooms to 1.07 over 1.2 s.
- **Heart:** toggles between an outline and a filled red heart with a 1.35× pop.

**Cards** (photos at w=700):

| # | Name | Area | Price | Photo |

- Right side: Calendar icon button (size 22, text-white/70)

---

**SCROLLABLE CONTENT:**

- `overflow-y-auto` with hidden scrollbar
- Padding: `px-6 pt-28 pb-24`
- Vertical spacing: `space-y-4` (16px gap)

---

**DESTINATION CARDS (4 total):**

Each card:
- Full width, height 200px, rounded-2xl, overflow hidden, position relative
- Full-bleed background image (`absolute inset-0, object-cover`)
- Gradient overlay: `bg-gradient-to-t from-black/20 to-transparent`

- **Bottom:** Destination name in 96px bold font, centered horizontally, clipped in an 80px tall container with `overflow: hidden`. Color: `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55)`, tracking-tight, leading-none, margin-top 2px

**Card data with exact image URLs:**

1. **Tokyo** - 23 moments
   `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20260704_101902_e8f0f37b-18b7-4c14-bb5c-99f0724d2646.png&w=1280&q=85`

---

**FLOATING BOTTOM NAV BAR:**

- Absolute, bottom-6, centered horizontally, z-30
- liquid-glass pill (`rounded-full, flex, gap-6, px-6 py-2`)
- 3 nav items (flex-col, items-center, gap-0.5):
  - "Feed" + Home icon (size 20) -- inactive (`text-white/50`)
  - "Account" + User icon (size 20) -- inactive (`text-white/50`)
  - "Trips" + FileText icon (size 20) -- active (`text-white`)
- Label style: `text-[10px] font-medium`

---

**LIQUID-GLASS CSS:**

```css
.liquid-glass {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01);
  background-blend-mode: luminosity;
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  border: none;
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.liquid-glass::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border-radius: inherit;
  padding: 1.4px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg,
    rgba(255,255,255,0.45) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 20%,
    rgba(255,255,255,0) 40%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 60%,
    rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 80%, rgba(255,255,255,0.45) 100%);
  -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);
  -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
  mask-composite: exclude;
  pointer-events: none;
}
```

---

**STAGGERED ENTRANCE ANIMATION:**

Each card starts at `opacity: 0` and `transform: translateY(24px)`. On component mount, a `setTimeout` triggers a state change that transitions to `opacity: 1` and `translateY(0)`. Transition: `transition-all duration-700 ease-out`. Stagger delay: first card 150ms, each subsequent +120ms (150, 270, 390, 510ms). Implemented with React `useState` + `useEffect`.

---

**SCROLLBAR HIDING:**

```css
.scrollbar-hide::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
.scrollbar-hide { -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none; }
```

---

**GLOBAL:**

```css
* { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; }
```

Load in HTML head:
```html
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
```

full_prompt:
# Prompt: Wander Far travel hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **travel-booking landing hero** for a fictional travel site: "Wander far. Rest easy." Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The design is clean, white and editorial: a huge black headline, a quiet search bar, and below them a wide cinematic photo panel of a Norwegian fjord at blue hour that comes alive with motion.

## Type and colour

- **Fonts** (self-hosted woff2):
  - Inter Display 700 for the headline (tight, about −0.035em)
  - Inter 400/500/600 for the UI
  - a small mono for the coordinate
- **Colours:**
  - **Base:** background `#FEFEFE`, headline ink `#0B0E0C`, text `#222223`, labels `#111313`
  - **Grey text:** muted `#6E7070`, lede `#727274`, hairlines `#E6E6E7`
  - **Accent:** fjord navy `#00286E` for the button, with `#0A2A72` for the field icons and the active-tab underline

## Scaling

- **Desktop:** the layout is authored at **1446×1088** with `--u = min(100vw/1446, max(100dvh/1088, .78px))`.
- **Height:** the page is exactly one viewport tall; the photo panel absorbs the spare height.

## Layout (desktop)

1. **Header row:**
   - **Left:** the headline **"Wander far. / Rest easy."** on two lines, about 90u.
   - **Right:** a right-aligned grey lede in two lines: "Find quiet fjords, cozy cabins, and the slow, wild / mornings you came for, all here in one place."
2. **Tabs:** Stays (active: semibold, with a navy underline) · Flights · Experiences, each with a thin line icon.
3. **Search bar:** one long hairline-bordered panel split into four cells.
   - **Fields:** each has a tiny caps label and a value with a navy icon. Where to? · Molde | Dates · Jun 18 – Jun 24 | Travelers · 3 travelers.
   - **Button:** a navy "Search" button with a magnifier icon.
4. **Photo panel:** full content width, filling the rest of the screen, square corners.
   - **Image:** `object-fit:cover`, centred. A 16:9 photo of a still fjord at blue hour: steep dark cliffs, low clouds clinging to the slopes, snowy peaks in the distance, a tall waterfall on the right, and a red cabin with lit windows and a small boat on the right shore, all mirrored in glassy water. Still: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/bd8d16a6-ac46-4cb8-bf0b-fb8e732ed31a.webp`.
   - **Motion:** a 5s muted looping video of the same frame plays on top with the identical cover rules: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/62b7e754-022b-4512-9b96-513173cb2e14.mp4` (1280×720). Clouds roll along the cliffs, the sky drifts, the waterfall pours and the reflections ripple. Fade it in when its first frame is ready.
   - **Label:** a small white location chip in the bottom-left corner: **"Geirangerfjord, Norge"** in semibold plus "62.10° N" in mono grey.

## Motion (UI)

- **Entrance:** a one-time CSS entrance. The headline lines rise and settle 0.14s apart, then the lede fades up, the tabs appear, the search panel slides in and the button pops last.
- **Rule:** the photo never animates in code; only the video moves.
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance and no video.

## Smaller screens

- **Layout:** stacked. The headline, then the lede, then the tabs.
- **Search:** the search fields stack vertically with a full-width navy button.
- **Photo:** the panel stays at least 240px tall, with the crop shifted right (`object-position:74%`) so the cabin and waterfall stay in view.

## Acceptance check (1440×900)

- The white page shows the black headline top-left and the grey lede top-right, then the tabs, the navy search bar and the wide fjord panel.
- The clouds and waterfall visibly move in the panel.
- **Content:** no brand logos.

title: Wild Pil
description: Single-file, one-screen travel hero for a fictional rental brand, Wild. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS with no framework and no build step. Features cinematic looping background video integration with precision layout polish.
full_prompt:
# Prompt: Wild pill hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **travel hero for a fictional rental brand, Wild**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS with no framework and no build step.

The page opens on white with the word **WILD** and a hairline between the I and the L. That line opens into a slit, then a circle, then a wide stadium-shaped pill that pushes "WI" and "LD" apart. The pill shows a looping video of a floating island with a waterfall over sunset clouds. As the pill opens, a soft paper background with flowing white lines fades in, the nav drops in from the top and the footer bar rises from the bottom.

## Media

- **Scene video:** https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/175fbbcd-e50a-480c-bab2-ca16d4678322.mp4
  - 1280×720, 60 fps, 4.25 s, muted.
  - It loops seamlessly with a hard loop: no crossfade, no reverse.
  - The island sits centred with sky above and clouds below. The waterfall pours, clouds drift, birds glide and the small islands bob.
- **Poster (first frame):** https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/726b168c-da47-4682-a255-cc3e02f89bae.jpg
- **Display:** the video sits inside the pill at full pill height, centred horizontally, at least 4.2 em wide, so it cover-crops at every pill width. The focal point is the top of the scene: `object-fit: cover; object-position: center top` (the poster too). It is always fully opaque; only the pill's own width and clip reveal it.

## Type and colour

- **Font:** Inter (variable, 400–800), self-hosted.
- **Word:** "WILD" in weight 800, tracking −0.045 em, line-height 0.8.
- **Colours:**
  - page `#ffffff` at the start, then paper `#f2f2f1`
  - ink `#1d1d1d`, secondary text `#3a3a3a`
  - rule `#a9a9a6`
  - button `#1b1b1b` with white text

## Scale

- **Unit:** one type unit, `--fs = min(19.6vh, 13.2vw)` on desktop, which is the font size of the word. Everything in the hero is sized from it.
- **Phone (≤ 720 px):** the word stacks, with "WI" over the pill over "LD". See *Phone* below.

## Layout

- **Hero:** centred 43 % from the top. The row is `WI · pill · LD` in a flex row, with the gap animating between the parts.
- **Pill:**
  - height 1.81 em, fully rounded, overflow hidden, placeholder fill `#d8d3cf`
  - final width 3.62 em on desktop, about a 2:1 stadium
  - a tiny white line icon near each end, at about 85 % opacity: a breeze icon on the left, a speaker icon on the right that toggles its sound waves
- **Background:** a paper layer with about 15 long white strokes sweeping up and to the right as soft S-curves (stroke 1.2–3.9 px, opacity 0.55–0.85), drawn in an SVG stretched to the viewport.
- **Nav (top):**
  - left links "Home · Features · Templates · Contact Us", right links "Instagram · Facebook" as plain text (no logos)
  - size max(12 px, 0.072 em), weight 450
  - padding 0.14 em top, 0.27 em sides
- **Footer (bottom):** a row aligned to the bottom.
  - Left: a paragraph 1.42 em wide, size 0.066 em, line-height 1.45, with a drop-cap "E" (2.35× size, weight 650): "Embark on a wild ride around the world with our travel rental service. Discover breathtaking landscapes and hidden gems on your unforgettable journey."
  - Middle: a 1 px rule filling the space.
  - Right: a black pill button "Let's Get Wild".

## Motion: the reveal

One Web Animations timeline, 2.1 s, starting once fonts are ready.

- **Pill width** (fs = word size):
  - 0.012 fs (a hairline) at 0 %, held to 14 %
  - 0.16 fs (a slit) at 30 %
  - 1.81 fs (a circle) at 58 %
  - the final width at 100 %
  - easings: `(.5,0,.3,1)`, `(.45,0,.3,1)`, `(.4,0,.2,1)`
- **Pill clip:** grows vertically from `inset(50% 0)` to `inset(0)` over 0–14 %, so the hairline draws from the middle out.
- **Hairline:** a grey overlay (`#b9b9b9`) on the pill shows the line as grey, then fades out between 14 % and 30 % as the image appears. This fade is on the overlay, never on the video.
- **Word gap:** 0.026 em until 14 %, 0.05 em at 58 %, then 0.085 em. "WI" and "LD" are pushed outward by the opening pill.
- **Background:** the paper and lines fade in between 45 % and 78 %.
- **Nav:** slides down from −140 % between 50 % and 86 %, with easing `(.2,.8,.2,1)`.
- **Footer:** rises from +160 % between 52 % and 90 %.
- **Rule:** draws from the centre (scaleX 0 → 1) between 40 % and 95 %.
- **Icons:** fade in after 80 %.

## Interaction

- **"Let's Get Wild":** replays the reveal. It plays the same timeline in reverse, collapsing the pill back to the hairline with everything leaving, then opens it again.
- **Resize:** finishes any running animation and resets the pill width.
- **Speaker icon:** toggles its waves. The clip is silent.
- **Reduced motion:** shows the final state with the video paused on the poster.

## Recording mode (`?rec=1`)

- The reveal plays at 0 s and the reverse collapse starts at 4.9 s, matching the reference loop.

full_prompt:
# Prompt: Halora — smart ring hero, Sage Studio

Build a single-file, one-screen **landing hero for a wellness smart ring**, **Halora**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is a calm, sunlit editorial product photo: a real hand rises from the bottom edge against a pale sage wall, a rose-gold ring with a black inner band floats between its fingers, olive-leaf shadows fall across the right side, and a thin clear glass circle arcs behind the hand. Copy sits on the left and three frosted glass metric cards stand on the right.

## Scale

- **Units:** every stage measurement is a reference pixel of a 2048×1152 artboard, multiplied by `--s = min(100vw/2048, 100vh/1152)`, with a floor of 0.55px on desktop.
- **Photo:** fitted to the viewport height and anchored to the bottom, so the arm always leaves the frame at the bottom edge. Up to about 2:1 it behaves like cover; on ultra-wide screens it stops growing and its sides fade into the sage backdrop.
- **Fill:** the hero always fills the viewport, with no letterbox bands.

## Type and colour

- **Fonts:** a neo-grotesk for the UI and copy, and a light geometric display face (300/400/500) for the metric numbers.
- **Colours:**
  - Page `#CBCFB8`, matching the photo's wall.
  - Ink: deep forest `#1E3227` for the logo, nav and headline; `#3F5447` for the eyebrow and paragraph.
  - Accent: olive gold `#9B8A3E` for GOOD and KCAL.
  - Buttons: solid `#1E3227`; the Cart pill is a translucent moss `rgba(62,86,70,.52)` with backdrop blur.

## Header

- **Left:** a six-petal dashed circle logo and "Halora" at 35s.
- **Centre:** links at 22s: Technology, Health, Activity, Insights.
- **Right:** a "Cart" pill with a cart icon, then a dark "Shop the Ring" pill.

## Copy (left, vertically centred)

- **Eyebrow:** a small dot and "Tracking 24/7".
- **Headline:** two lines at 69s, "Know Your Body." / "Move With It."
- **Paragraph:** "Sleep, recovery, stress, heart rate and activity — tracked continuously and turned into insights you can actually use."
- **CTA:** a dark pill, "Explore the Ring".

## Metrics (right, vertically centred)

Three 222×160s glass cards: 20s radius, a pale sage translucent fill, a hairline forest border and backdrop blur. Each has an uppercase tracked label with a line icon, a large light numeral and an uppercase sub-label:

- SLEEP: 7h 42m / GOOD
- CALORIES: 1642 / KCAL
- HRV: 68 / MS

## Motion

- **Entrance:** one Web Animations timeline with backwards fill. It starts only once fonts and the photo are ready, then cancels itself so the page returns to its authored styles.
  - The header items drop in from the top, staggered.
  - The tracking dot switches on with a circular clip, and its label follows.
  - Each headline line rises inside its own mask.
  - The paragraph and the CTA settle in.
  - The glass cards rise one after another.
- **Background video:** a muted, looping video of the same shot sits over the photo with the identical box, anchoring and masks: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/e6d15706-f42b-400d-beda-75840834e8bc.mp4` (1920×1084, 4s). Leaf shadows sway across the wall and hand, light glints on the ring as it turns slightly, and the camera drifts gently.
  - The loop crossfades its last second into its first, so it never jumps or plays in reverse.
  - It fades in (0.8s) once its first frame is ready.
- **Rule:** nothing in the scene is drawn or animated in code.
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance, no transitions and no background video.

## Tablet and phone

- **Landscape below 1200px:** a fluid three-zone grid (copy | hand | cards), with the hand centred in the middle zone.
- **Portrait:** copy first, then the three cards in a row, then the hand filling the remaining height.
- **Below 820px:** the links and pills fold into a frosted sage menu panel behind a round burger button.

## Acceptance check (1440×960)

- The hand and the rose-gold ring sit in the centre on a sage wall, with leaf shadows on the right.
- The copy is legible on the left and the three glass cards stand on the right.
- Every element has an even edge margin, and no drop shadows have been added.

A custom component that creates a sand/particle dissolve effect using SVG filters:

```tsx
function SandTransitionImage({ src, alt, className }) {
  // Uses usePresence() from motion/react for AnimatePresence awareness
  // Unique filterId per instance via useRef
  // requestAnimationFrame loop over 900ms
  // Easing: entering = quartic ease-out (1 - Math.pow(1-t, 4)), exiting = cubic (Math.pow(t, 3))
  // SVG filter chain:
  //   1. feTurbulence: fractalNoise, baseFrequency 1.8, numOctaves 4
  //   2. feDisplacementMap: scale up to 150 based on progress
  //   3. feOffset: dy up to -80 (enter) or 120 (exit), dx up to -30/+30
  //   4. feGaussianBlur: up to 6px
  //   5. feColorMatrix: opacity fades (1 - progress * 1.2)
  // Image has crossOrigin="anonymous" and referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
}
```

3. **Selection Grid** (2 columns, 12px gap, pushes to fill available space):
   - 4 cards: "Sleep quality", "Stress", "Weight", "Skin"
   - Each card: rounded-[32px], 100px height, padding 16px
   - Shows a number label (01, 02, etc.) in white/50, 11px, medium weight
   - Option text in white, 16px, medium weight
   - "Stress" (id:2) and "Skin" (id:4) are pre-selected
   - Cards are toggleable on click

4. **Voice Button** (centered, 24px vertical margin):
   - Yellow/gold radial glow behind: `radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(220,200,80,0.5) 0%, rgba(180,160,40,0.2) 40%, transparent 70%)`
   - 64px circular liquid glass button with a waveform SVG icon (white strokes, strokeWidth 2, strokeLinecap round) showing 5 vertical bars of varying heights
   - "voice" label below in white/70, 12px

5. **Slide-to-Confirm Button** (bottom, inside 24px horizontal padding):
   - Full-width rounded-full track, 56px tall, liquid glass style
   - White circular thumb (44px) on the left with ArrowRight icon (gray-800)
   - "Done" text centered in white/60, 14px, medium weight
   - 3 ChevronRight icons on the right (14px) at white/40, white/50, white/60 opacity
   - Draggable thumb with pointer events: snaps back if not dragged past 85%, snaps to end if past 85%

**Liquid Glass Effect (CSS classes):**

`.liquid-glass`:
- Background: `rgba(255,255,255,0.01)` with luminosity blend mode
- Backdrop filter: `blur(4px)`
- Box shadow: `inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.1)`
- `::before` pseudo-element for gradient border: `linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.45) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 20%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 40%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 60%, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 80%, rgba(255,255,255,0.45) 100%)` with 1.4px padding and mask-composite exclude technique

`.liquid-glass-selected`:
- Same as above but background: `rgba(255,255,255,0.12)`, blur 8px, stronger box shadow (`inset 0 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.2)`), and brighter gradient border (0.6 alpha at edges, 0.25 at 20%/80%)

**Animations:**
- Staggered fade-up animation on all elements
- Keyframes: from `opacity:0, translateY(16px)` to `opacity:1, translateY(0)`
- Duration: 0.5s, easing: `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`, fill: forwards
- Delays: header 0.1s, title 0.25s, grid cards 0.4s/0.48s/0.56s/0.64s, voice 0.7s, slider 0.85s

**Dependencies:**
- React 18, Tailwind CSS 3, Lucide React, Vite, TypeScript
